about: English dub of every key the Slovak dub speaks (art/voice/full/manifest.json, std_manifest.json): the same stock voice, character direction, dry-irony marking and colour per line; text = the en column of the live tables. Method and tools: art/voice/tools/en_dub.py, docs/voice/ENGLISH.md.
language_direction: Speak natural, native British English with a neutral, contemporary accent (standard southern British, neither posh nor regional); no foreign accent. Read the text verbatim.
irony_direction: Delivery for this line: a touch of dry irony, understated - just a slight knowing hint in the voice, never theatrical, never mocking.

name_hints.name: LEAL
name_hints.say: LEH-al, two syllables, said as a word and never spelled

name_hints.name: ZVON
name_hints.say: zvon, one syllable that rhymes with „on“, said as a word and never spelled

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My garage. I’ve been fixing the neighbour’s radio since September. It already picks up one station, as long as I don’t breathe near it.
lines.sk: Moja garáž. Susedovo rádio opravujem od septembra. Už chytá jednu stanicu, keď pri ňom nedýcham.
lines.heard: My garage. I've been fixing the neighbor's radio since September. It already picks up one station as long as I don't breathe near it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Screwdriver, pliers, multimeter. One shopping run for Gran, and I’m kitted out for a full overhaul.
lines.sk: Skrutkovač, kliešte, meradlo. Na jeden babkin nákup som vybavený ako na generálku.
lines.heard: Screwdriver, pliers, multimeter. One shopping run for Gran and I'm kitted out for a full overhaul

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Same rating, same type. The old one goes in the e-waste box.
lines.sk: Rovnaká hodnota, rovnaký typ. Starú dám do priehradky na elektroodpad.
lines.heard: Same rating, same type. The old one goes in the e-waste box

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: With a device that makes sounds without any power, I’d rather not improvise.
lines.sk: Pri prístroji, ktorý sa ozýva bez prúdu, radšej neimprovizujem.
lines.heard: With a device that makes sounds without any power, I'd rather not improvise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Our lane. Every fence different, a different dog behind each one, and they all know me by my footsteps.
lines.sk: Naša ulica. Každý plot iný, za každým iný pes a všetky ma poznajú podľa krokov.
lines.heard: Our lane. Every fence different, a different dog behind each one, and they all know me by my footsteps

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi, Roman. Got a minute for one signature?
lines.sk: Ahoj, Roman. Máš chvíľu na jeden podpis?
lines.heard: Hi, Roman. Got a minute for one signature?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: A signature? Usually I’m the one collecting them.
lines.sk: Podpis? Zvyčajne ich zbieram ja od iných.
lines.heard: A signature? Usually I'm the one collecting them

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Z-17, from the shelter to the garden workshop. I remember it – the heaviest of the lot.
lines.sk: Z-17, z prístrešku do dielne v záhrade. Pamätám si ju, bola najťažšia zo všetkých.
lines.heard: Z17. From the shelter to the garden workshop. I remember it. The heaviest of the lot

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: I carried it like a fridge. Except a fridge at least gives you something to hold on to.
lines.sk: Niesol som ju ako chladničku, len chladničku je aspoň za čo chytiť.
lines.heard: I carried it like a fridge, except a fridge at least gives you something to hold on to.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It held almost sixty years.
lines.sk: Bolo v nej skoro šesťdesiat rokov.
lines.heard: It held almost sixty years

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: That explains it. Here’s my signature.
lines.sk: Tak preto. Tu je môj podpis.
lines.heard: That explains it. Here's my signature

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: And if anyone asks for the address: the gate with the little table, the vine and the lady at the window. You can’t miss the house.
lines.sk: A keby sa niekto pýtal na adresu: bránka so stolíkom, vinič a pani za oknom. Ten dom si nepomýliš.
lines.heard: And if anyone asks for the address, the gate with the little table, the vine, and the lady at the window. You can't miss the house

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll tell Gran. She’ll correct you – you forgot the geranium in the window.
lines.sk: Poviem babke. Ešte ťa opraví, že si zabudol na muškát v okne.
lines.heard: I'll tell Gran. She'll correct you. You forgot the geranium in the window

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: He’s lost his ball. The red one dropped by the pond. He looked for it with his eyes for a bit, then delegated the job to me.
lines.sk: Stratil loptičku. Červená mu vypadla pri nádrži. Chvíľu ju hľadal očami, potom to delegoval na mňa.
lines.heard: He's lost his ball, the red one dropped by the pond. He looked for it with his eyes for a bit, then delegated the job to me.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you didn’t find it?
lines.sk: A ty si ju nenašla?
lines.heard: And you didn't find it

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: I did the searching, he did the leading. To every other dog in the village.
lines.sk: Ja som hľadala, on ma viedol. Ku každému inému psovi v dedine.
lines.heard: I did the searching, he did the leading to every other dog in the village

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll keep an eye out for it. But I’m not going in the water.
lines.sk: Pozriem sa po nej. Do vody však nepôjdem.
lines.heard: I'll keep an eye out for it but I'm not going in the water

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: You don’t have to. It stayed on the dry side of the railing.
lines.sk: Nemusíš. Ostala na suchej strane zábradlia.
lines.heard: You don't have to. It stayed on the dry side of the railing

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: By the retention pond in Cierna Voda, where the cycle path ends.
lines.sk: Pri retenčnej nádrži v Čiernej Vode, kde končí cyklochodník.
lines.heard: By the retention pond in Čierna Voda, where the cycle path ends.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: If I find it, Dotty will owe me one.
lines.sk: Ak ju nájdem, Bodka mi bude niečo dlžný.
lines.heard: If I find it, Dottie'll owe me one

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Dotty owes nobody anything. But he’ll lick your shoe.
lines.sk: Bodka nikomu nič nedlží. Ale olizne ti topánku.
lines.heard: Dottie owes nobody anything but he'll lick your shoe

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One ball, found. Signed with teeth.
lines.sk: Jedna loptička sa našla. Podpísaná zubami.
lines.heard: One ball found signed with teeth

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: He said thank you. Briefly.
lines.sk: Povedal ďakujem. Len stručne.
lines.heard: He said thank you, briefly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Accepted. Drool and all.
lines.sk: Prijímam. Aj so slinami.
lines.heard: Accepted, drool and all

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Now he’ll lose it again. But at least we know where.
lines.sk: Teraz ju zasa stratí. Ale aspoň už vieme kde.
lines.heard: Now he'll lose it again. But at least we know where

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Next time write your phone number on it.
lines.sk: Nabudúce mu na ňu napíš telefónne číslo.
lines.heard: Next time, write your phone number on it

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: I did. He ate it.
lines.sk: Napísala som. Zjedol ho.
lines.heard: I did He ate it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Lots of addresses today?
lines.sk: Veľa adries dnes?
lines.heard: Lots of addresses today

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Two of them were described to me today as ‘the house that used to be yellow’.
lines.sk: Dve mi dnes opísali ako „ten dom, čo býval žltý“.
lines.heard: Two of them were described to me today as the house that used to be yellow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which one is that?
lines.sk: A ktorý to je?
lines.heard: And which one is that?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: The green one. They repainted it in July, but to the village it’ll stay yellow for another ten years.
lines.sk: Ten zelený. Prefarbili ho v júli, ale pre dedinu bude žltý ešte desať rokov.
lines.heard: The green one, they repainted it in July. But to the village, it will stay yellow for another ten years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the other address?
lines.sk: A tá druhá adresa?
lines.heard: And the other address?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: The same house. Two families live in it, and both forgot it’s green now.
lines.sk: Ten istý dom. Bývajú v ňom dve rodiny a obe zabudli, že je už zelený.
lines.heard: The same house, two families live in it, and both forgot it's green now

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So now you just ring the bell and run?
lines.sk: Teraz len zazvoníš a utekáš?
lines.heard: So now you just ring the bell and run

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Exactly. And people thank me and wave through the windows. Strange, but nice.
lines.sk: Presne tak. A ľudia mi ďakujú a mávajú cez okná. Zvláštne, ale milé.
lines.heard: Exactly. And people thank me and wave through the windows. Strange, but nice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: They didn’t wave before?
lines.sk: Predtým ti nemávali?
lines.heard: They didn't wave before

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Before, they didn’t even open the door. Now at least they open the windows.
lines.sk: Predtým mi neotvorili ani dvere. Teraz mi otvárajú aspoň okná.
lines.heard: Before, they didn't even open the door. Now, at least they open the windows

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: One lady even waved a cake at me. Behind the glass, but it still counts.
lines.sk: Jedna pani mi dokonca zamávala koláčom. Za sklom, ale aj tak sa to ráta.
lines.heard: One lady even waved a cake at me. Behind the glass, but it still counts

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran says you carried some boxes for her.
lines.sk: Babka vraví, že si jej nosil krabice.
lines.heard: Gran says you carried some boxes for her

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: I did. One was the heaviest thing all month. And this month I delivered a washing machine.
lines.sk: Nosil. Jedna bola najťažšia vec celého mesiaca. A to som tento mesiac viezol aj práčku.
lines.heard: I did. One was the heaviest thing all month, and this month I delivered a washing machine

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What was in it?
lines.sk: Čo v nej bolo?
lines.heard: What was in it?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: I don’t look in other people’s boxes. But something in it jingled with every step.
lines.sk: Do cudzích krabíc nepozerám. Ale pri každom kroku v nej niečo cinklo.
lines.heard: I don't look in other people's boxes but something in it jingled with every step

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Jingled? Like a bell?
lines.sk: Cinklo? Ako zvonček?
lines.heard: Jingled? Like a bell?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Like when something jingles in your car and you don’t know whether to do anything about it.
lines.sk: Ako keď ti v aute niečo cinká a nevieš, či to máš riešiť.
lines.heard: Like when something jingles in your car and you don't know whether to do anything about it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Where are you driving today?
lines.sk: Kam všade dnes jazdíš?
lines.heard: Where are you driving today?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Grob, Cierna Voda and a bit of the next village.
lines.sk: Grob, Čierna Voda a kus susednej dediny.
lines.heard: Grob, a churn of water, and a bit of the next village

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And are the addresses normal in Cierna Voda?
lines.sk: A v Čiernej Vode sú adresy normálne?
lines.heard: And are the addresses normal in Cernavoda?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: There they’ve got new streets with old names. The satnav sends me into a field.
lines.sk: Tam sú nové ulice so starými menami. Navigácia ma posiela do poľa.
lines.heard: There they've got new streets with old names. The sat nav sends me into a field

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So who points you the right way in the end?
lines.sk: A kto ťa nakoniec nasmeruje?
lines.heard: So who points you the right way in the end?

lines.speaker: ROMAN
lines.text: Mr Joseph by the noticeboard. He knows who lives where, without any house numbers.
lines.sk: Pán Jozef pri výveske. Ten vie, kto kde býva, aj bez čísel.
lines.heard: Mr. Joseph by the notice board. He knows who lives where without any house numbers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why is he actually called Dotty?
lines.sk: Prečo sa vlastne volá Bodka?
lines.heard: Why is he actually called Dotty?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Because when I say ‘that’s enough, full stop’, he always has one more woof to add. With him, it’s never just the one dot.
lines.sk: Lebo keď poviem „dosť, bodka“, on má vždy ešte jedno hafnutie navyše.
lines.heard: Oh, because when I say that's enough, full stop, he always has one more woof to add. With him, it's never just the one dot

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Dotty, anything else you’d like to add?
lines.sk: Bodka, ešte chceš niečo dodať?
lines.heard: Dottie anything else you'd like to add?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: See? Even now.
lines.sk: Vidíš. Aj teraz.
lines.heard: See? Even now

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Not at all. He thinks the whole world has finally discovered walks.
lines.sk: Vôbec. Myslí si, že celý svet konečne objavil prechádzky.
lines.heard: Not at all. He thinks the whole world has finally discovered walks

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And is he right? Do you go out more now?
lines.sk: A má pravdu? Chodíte teraz častejšie?
lines.heard: And is he right? Do you go out more now?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Four times a day. It used to be twice, and even that took some negotiating.
lines.sk: Štyrikrát denne. Predtým dvakrát, aj to sme sa dohadovali.
lines.heard: Four times a day. It used to be twice, and even that took some negotiating

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who won?
lines.sk: A kto vyhral?
lines.heard: And who won?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: He did. Whoever’s standing by the door always wins.
lines.sk: On. Vždy vyhrá ten, kto stojí pri dverách.
lines.heard: He did. Whoever's standing by the door always wins

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Where do you and Dotty go for walks?
lines.sk: Kam chodievate s Bodkom?
lines.heard: Where do you and Dottie go for walks?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: To the pond. Well, he goes to the pond and I follow him.
lines.sk: K nádrži. Teda on chodí k nádrži a ja za ním.
lines.heard: To the pond. Well, he goes to the pond and I follow him

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when you want to go somewhere else?
lines.sk: A keď chceš ísť inam?
lines.heard: And when you want to go somewhere else?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Then we go to the pond a different way.
lines.sk: Tak ideme k nádrži inou cestou.
lines.heard: Then we go to the pond a different way

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do you like living here?
lines.sk: Ako sa ti tu býva?
lines.heard: How do you like living here?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: I like it. People here know each other by their dogs. They call me Dotty’s lady.
lines.sk: Dobre. Ľudia sa tu poznajú podľa psov. Mne hovoria Bodkova pani.
lines.heard: I like it. People here know each other by their dogs. They call me Dottie's lady

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do they call me?
lines.sk: A ako hovoria mne?
lines.heard: And what do they call me?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: Mrs Perry’s grandson. You haven’t got a dog, so you’re your gran’s.
lines.sk: Vnuk pani Hruškovej. Psa nemáš, tak si babkin.
lines.heard: Mrs. Perry's grandson. You haven't got a dog, so you're your gran's

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What does Dotty do when it rains?
lines.sk: Čo robí Bodka, keď prší?
lines.heard: What does Dotty do when it rains?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: He stands by the door looking as if I ordered the rain.
lines.sk: Stojí pri dverách a tvári sa, že dážď som objednala ja.
lines.heard: He stands by the door looking as if I ordered the rain

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you?
lines.sk: A objednala si?
lines.heard: And did you?

lines.speaker: LENKA
lines.text: No. But I apologise to him every time.
lines.sk: Nie. Ale ospravedlňujem sa mu zakaždým.
lines.heard: No, but I apologize to him every time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The Grasshopper playground. The wooden grasshopper it is named after watches Ella under the shelter, handling phone calls and potatoes at the same time.
lines.sk: Lúčny koník. Ten drevený na ihrisku sa díva, ako Ela pod prístreškom vybavuje telefóny aj zemiaky naraz.
lines.heard: The Grasshopper Playground. The wooden grasshopper it is named after watches Ella under the shelter, handling phone calls and potatoes at the same time.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi, Ella. Gran says you’ve got an order for her.
lines.sk: Ahoj, Ela. Babka vraví, že tu pre ňu máte objednávku.
lines.heard: Hi, Ella. Gran says you got an order for her

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: We have. She rang at seven to ask if it was ready, and at eight to ask if you were up yet.
lines.sk: Máme. Volala o siedmej, či je hotová, a o ôsmej, či si už vstal.
lines.heard: We have. She rang at seven to ask if it was ready, and at eight to ask if you were up yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did you tell her?
lines.sk: A čo si jej povedala?
lines.heard: And what did you tell her?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: That we don’t do wake-up calls. So she booked one with us for six tomorrow.
lines.sk: Že budíček nerobíme. Tak si ho u nás objednala na zajtra o šiestej.
lines.heard: That we don't do wake-up calls. So she booked one with us for 6:00 tomorrow?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Dana has it ready. Here’s the list and a spare mask. Leave the bag outside for your gran and ring her.
lines.sk: Dana ju má pripravenú. Tu máš lístok a náhradné rúško. Tašku nechaj babke vonku a zavolaj jej.
lines.heard: Dana has it ready. Here's the list and a spare mask. Leave the bag outside for your gran and ring her.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know. Gran told me before you did. Twice.
lines.sk: Viem. Babka mi to povedala skôr ako ty. Dvakrát.
lines.heard: I know. Gran told me before you did. Twice

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Then this makes three. And Dana will tell you again before lunch.
lines.sk: Tak to máš tretíkrát. A do obeda ti to zopakuje ešte aj Dana.
lines.heard: Then this makes three. And Dana will tell you again before lunch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: If Gran rings again, tell her I’m on my way.
lines.sk: Ak ti babka zavolá ešte raz, povedz jej, že už idem.
lines.heard: If Gran rings again, tell her I'm on my way

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I will. She’s on my list, right after the potatoes.
lines.sk: Poviem. Mám ju v zozname hneď za zemiakmi.
lines.heard: I will. She's on my list right after the potatoes

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I gave the box to Roman when your gran asked me to. In the rush we never got the signatures. Here’s the form.
lines.sk: Krabicu som vydala Romanovi, keď ma o to tvoja babka požiadala. V zhone sme nestihli podpisy. Tu je formulár.
lines.heard: I gave the box to Roman when your gran asked me to. In the rush, we never got the signatures. Here's the form

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran rang to say you had it. Probably before you’d found it.
lines.sk: Babka mi volala, že ho máš. Asi skôr, ako si ho našla.
lines.heard: Gran rang to say you had it. Probably before you'd found it

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I only found it after she rang. So yes, actually.
lines.sk: Našla som ho, až keď zavolala. Takže vlastne áno.
lines.heard: I only found it after she rang. So yes, actually

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then we’ll add them. Exactly as it happened.
lines.sk: Tak ich doplníme. Presne tak, ako to bolo.
lines.heard: Then we'll add them exactly as it happened

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Yes. Roman signs that he collected the box, and I sign that I handed it over. We’re not making anything up, just writing down the truth.
lines.sk: Áno. Roman podpíše, že krabicu prevzal, a ja, že som ju vydala. Nič nevymýšľame, len dopíšeme pravdu.
lines.heard: Yes, Roman signs that he collected the box, and I sign that I handed it over. We're not making anything up, just writing down the truth

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Where’s Roman now?
lines.sk: Kde je teraz Roman?
lines.heard: Where's Roman now?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: In the lane between the fences, by his van. He’s looking for a house that used to be yellow.
lines.sk: Na ulici medzi plotmi, pri dodávke. Hľadá dom, čo býval žltý.
lines.heard: In the lane between the fences, by his van, he's looking for a house that used to be yellow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Roman signed. He says it was the heaviest box of the month.
lines.sk: Roman podpísal. Vraj to bola najťažšia krabica mesiaca.
lines.heard: Roman signed. He says it was the heaviest box of the month

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: He says that about every third one. But with this one I believe him.
lines.sk: To hovorí o každej tretej. Ale pri tejto mu verím.
lines.heard: He says that about every third one but with this one I believe him

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: The collection checks out. I’ll add the handover and your gran’s consent. Strange – a moment ago her name was fading. Now it’s holding.
lines.sk: Prevzatie sedí. Dopíšem vydanie a súhlas tvojej babky. Zvláštne, jej meno pred chvíľou bledlo. Teraz drží.
lines.heard: The collection checks out. I'll add the handover and your gran's consent. Strange. A moment ago, her name was fading. Now it's holding

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Fading? On paper?
lines.sk: Bledlo? Na papieri?
lines.heard: Fading on paper?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I thought my pen was running out. But the pen writes just fine.
lines.sk: Myslela som, že mi pero prestáva písať. Ale pero píše normálne.
lines.heard: I thought my pen was running out but the pen writes just fine

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sometimes an ordinary piece of paper saves something too.
lines.sk: Aj obyčajný papier niekedy niečo zachráni.
lines.heard: Sometimes an ordinary piece of paper saves something too

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: So does ordinary help.
lines.sk: Obyčajná pomoc tiež.
lines.heard: So does ordinary help?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I have. Neighbourhood help, the hours and the phone number, all in large print. And no QR code.
lines.sk: Mám. Susedská pomoc, hodiny aj telefón, všetko veľkým písmom. A bez QR kódu.
lines.heard: I have neighborhood help, the hours, and the phone number all in large print and no QR code

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You had it ready?
lines.sk: Ty si ho mala pripravený?
lines.heard: You had it ready?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I’ve got three versions. A small one for young people, a medium one for the noticeboard and a big one for Mr Joseph.
lines.sk: Mám tri verzie. Malú pre mladých, strednú na nástenku a veľkú pre pána Jozefa.
lines.heard: I've got three versions, a small one for young people, a medium one for the notice board, and a big one for Mr. Joseph

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mr Joseph will be able to read the big one from the bench.
lines.sk: Tú veľkú si pán Jozef prečíta aj z lavičky.
lines.heard: Mr. Joseph will be able to read the big one from the bench

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Just pin it up the right way round. Someone once put it up upside down and people rang numbers that don’t exist.
lines.sk: Len ho pripni správne. Raz ho tam niekto dal hore nohami a ľudia volali na čísla, ktoré neexistujú.
lines.heard: Just pin it up the right way round. Someone once put it up upside down and people rang numbers that don't exist

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many people need help today?
lines.sk: Koľko ľudí dnes potrebuje pomoc?
lines.heard: How many people need help today?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: More than yesterday. But there are more helpers too.
lines.sk: Viac než včera. Ale aj pomocníkov pribudlo.
lines.heard: More than yesterday, but there are more helpers too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then put me down as a helper.
lines.sk: Tak ma pripíš medzi pomocníkov.
lines.heard: Then put me down as a helper

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: You’re already down. Gran signed you up this morning, with a note: ‘willing, but late’.
lines.sk: Už tam si. Babka ťa nahlásila ráno, aj s poznámkou „ochotný, ale mešká“.
lines.heard: You're already down. Gran signed you up this morning with a note, "Willing but late."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Late? I got here at ten.
lines.sk: Meškám? Veď som prišiel o desiatej.
lines.heard: Late? I got here at 10

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: She was expecting you at nine. That’s on the list too.
lines.sk: Ona ťa čakala o deviatej. Aj to je v zozname.
lines.heard: She was expecting you at nine. That's on the list too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Don’t top up with soup? Did that really happen here?
lines.sk: Nedolievať polievku? To sa tu naozaj stalo?
lines.heard: Don't top up with soup? Did that really happen here?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Once. Someone topped up my coffee flask with soup from the pick-up. Once was enough.
lines.sk: Raz. Niekto mi do termosky s kávou dolial polievku z výdaja. Stačilo to.
lines.heard: Once, someone topped up my coffee flask with soup from the pickup. Once was enough

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you drink it?
lines.sk: A vypila si ju?
lines.heard: And did you drink it?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: The first sip. It was good soup, just bad coffee.
lines.sk: Prvý dúšok. Bola to dobrá polievka, len zlá káva.
lines.heard: The first sip. It was good soup, just bad coffee

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who did that to you?
lines.sk: A kto ti to urobil?
lines.heard: And who did that to you?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: I’m not saying. I don’t give out personal data, not even about soup.
lines.sk: To nepoviem. Osobné údaje nevydávam, ani keď ide o polievku.
lines.heard: I'm not saying. I don't give out personal data, not even about soup

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who actually helps you here?
lines.sk: Kto ti tu vlastne pomáha?
lines.heard: Who actually helps you here?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Two students, a teacher, and Roman when he’s passing.
lines.sk: Dvaja študenti, jedna učiteľka a Roman, keď má cestu okolo.
lines.heard: Two students, a teacher, and Roman when he's passing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A teacher, on top of remote learning?
lines.sk: Učiteľka popri dištančnom vyučovaní?
lines.heard: A teacher on top of remote learning

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Mornings she teaches over the camera, afternoons she packs bags here. She says at least potatoes don’t switch their cameras off.
lines.sk: Ráno učí cez kameru, poobede balí tu. Vraví, že zemiaky aspoň nevypínajú kameru.
lines.heard: Mornings she teaches over the camera. Afternoons she packs bags here. She says at least potatoes don't switch their cameras off

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who runs the team?
lines.sk: A kto tomu tímu šéfuje?
lines.heard: And who runs the team?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Nobody. I just know who’s where and when. So everyone asks me anyway.
lines.sk: Nikto. Ja len viem, kto je kde a kedy. Takže sa aj tak všetci pýtajú mňa.
lines.heard: Nobody. I just know who's where and when, so everyone asks me anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many lists have you actually got?
lines.sk: Koľko zoznamov vlastne máš?
lines.heard: How many lists have you actually got?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Four. Shopping, medicines, phone numbers and a list of lists.
lines.sk: Štyri. Nákupy, lieky, telefóny a zoznam zoznamov.
lines.heard: Four, shopping, medicines, phone numbers, and a list of lists

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what’s the fourth one for?
lines.sk: A ten štvrtý je na čo?
lines.heard: And what's the fourth one for?

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: So I know which of the other three I can’t find right now.
lines.sk: Aby som vedela, ktorý z tých troch práve nemôžem nájsť.
lines.heard: So I know which of the other three I can't find right now.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran would approve.
lines.sk: Babka by to schválila.
lines.heard: Gran would approve

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: She did. And she suggested a fifth: people who don’t answer the phone. You’re top of it.
lines.sk: Schválila. A navrhla piaty: kto nezdvíha telefón. Si na ňom prvý.
lines.heard: She did, and she suggested a fifth: people who don't answer the phone. You're top of it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How’s the little one? Well, probably not so little any more.
lines.sk: Ako sa má malá? Teda, asi už nie taká malá.
lines.heard: How's the little one? Well, probably not so little anymore

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Nina? She stopped being little ages ago – she’s fifteen and doing school on the computer. She claims she’s studying. I can hear her laughing.
lines.sk: Nina? Malá už dávno nie je, má pätnásť a školu cez počítač. Tvrdí, že sa učí. Ja počujem, že sa smeje.
lines.heard: Nina? She stopped being little ages ago. She's fifteen and doing school on the computer. She claims she's studying. I can hear her laughing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe the teacher has left the microphone on and doesn’t know.
lines.sk: Možno má učiteľ zapnutý mikrofón a nevie o tom.
lines.heard: Maybe the teacher's left the microphone on and doesn't know

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: Maybe. In the evenings she helps me type the lists into the computer. She says one day she’ll have everything in one place.
lines.sk: Možno. Večer mi pomáha prepisovať zoznamy do počítača. Vraví, že raz bude mať všetko na jednom mieste.
lines.heard: Maybe. In the evenings, she helps me type the lists into the computer. She says one day she'll have everything in one place

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Everything in one place? That sounds like a big plan.
lines.sk: Všetko na jednom mieste? To znie ako veľký plán.
lines.heard: Everything in one place? That sounds like a big plan.

lines.speaker: ELA
lines.text: She’s fifteen. Let her plan; I’ll lend her the lists for now.
lines.sk: Má pätnásť. Nech plánuje, zoznamy jej zatiaľ požičiam.
lines.heard: She's fifteen. Let her plan. I'll lend her the lists for now

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The shop at the hatch. Dana passes bags through it faster than I can say good morning.
lines.sk: Potraviny cez okienko. Dana z neho podáva tašky rýchlejšie, ako stihnem povedať dobrý deň.
lines.heard: The shop at the hatch. Dana passes bags through it faster than I can say good morning

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi, Dana. I’ve brought Gran’s list.
lines.sk: Ahoj, Dana. Nesiem babkin lístok.
lines.heard: Hi, Dana. I brought Gran's list

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Hi. I know that list by heart. Mrs Perry writes the same thing every week, just with a different pen.
lines.sk: Ahoj. Ten lístok poznám naspamäť. Pani Hrušková píše každý týždeň to isté, len iným perom.
lines.heard: Hi. I know that list by heart. Mrs. Perry writes the same thing every week, just with a different pen

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So why does she write it at all?
lines.sk: Tak prečo ho vôbec píše?
lines.heard: So why does she write it at all?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: So I can see Mrs Perry is all right. Her handwriting tells me more than the phone does.
lines.sk: Aby som videla, že je pani Hrušková v poriadku. Rukopis mi povie viac ako telefón.
lines.heard: So I can see Mrs. Perry is all right Her handwriting tells me more than the phone does

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Tea, oats, potatoes. It’s already paid for, Ella sorted it.
lines.sk: Čaj, vločky, zemiaky. Už je zaplatené, Ela to vybavila.
lines.heard: Tea, oats, potatoes. It's already paid for. Ella sorted it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You wouldn’t have a bit of spare time back there as well? Gran has planned my whole day.
lines.sk: Nemáš tam náhodou aj trochu voľného času? Babka mi naplánovala celý deň.
lines.heard: You wouldn't have a bit of spare time back there as well Gran has planned my whole day

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: I don’t sell time. Everyone has to save up their own.
lines.sk: Čas nepredávam. Ten si musí každý ušetriť sám.
lines.heard: I don't sell time. Everyone has to save up their own

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll carry it by both handles. Gran’s rule.
lines.sk: Ponesiem to za obe uchá. Babkino pravidlo.
lines.heard: I'll carry it by both handles Gran's rule

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: See, you know it already. I was supposed to remind you, so consider yourself reminded.
lines.sk: Vidíš, ty to vieš. Mala som ti to pripomenúť, tak to ber ako pripomenuté.
lines.heard: See? You know it already. I was supposed to remind you, so consider yourself reminded

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What are you running out of fastest at the moment?
lines.sk: Čo ti teraz dochádza najrýchlejšie?
lines.heard: What are you running out of fastest at the moment?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Patience. And I’ve no way of reordering that.
lines.sk: Trpezlivosť. A tú nemám ako doobjednať.
lines.heard: Patience and I've no way of reordering that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: If a delivery does turn up, put two packs aside for me.
lines.sk: Keby predsa prišla dodávka, odlož mi dve balenia.
lines.heard: If a delivery does turn up, put two packs aside for me

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: One. Your gran has already ordered the other.
lines.sk: Jedno. Druhé si už objednala tvoja babka.
lines.heard: One, your gran has already ordered the other

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran? She’s got enough patience for three.
lines.sk: Babka? Veď tá má trpezlivosti za troch.
lines.heard: Gran? She's got enough patience for three

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Because she’s saving it for you.
lines.sk: Lebo si ju šetrí na teba.
lines.heard: Because she's saving it for you

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: The usual: tea and potatoes. And she says you’re not to carry the bag by one handle.
lines.sk: To, čo vždy: čaj a zemiaky. A odkázala, aby si tašku nenosil za jedno ucho.
lines.heard: The usual, tea and potatoes. And she says you're not to carry the bag by one handle

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran can even steer me through the shopkeeper.
lines.sk: Babka ma vie riadiť aj cez predavačku.
lines.heard: Gran can even steer me through the shopkeeper

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Through the shopkeeper, through Ella and through the courier. She’s rung me twice today.
lines.sk: Cez predavačku, cez Elu aj cez kuriéra. Mne dnes volala dvakrát.
lines.heard: Through the shopkeeper, through Ella, and through the courier. She's rung me twice today

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Twice for one bag?
lines.sk: Dvakrát kvôli jednej taške?
lines.heard: Twice for one bag?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: The second time she asked whether I remembered what she’d said the first time.
lines.sk: Druhý raz sa pýtala, či si pamätám, čo povedala prvý raz.
lines.heard: The second time she asked whether I remembered what she'd said the first time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you know people by their shopping?
lines.sk: Poznáš ľudí podľa nákupu?
lines.heard: Do you know people by their shopping?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: By their shopping and by their walk. Mr Joseph walks slowly and shops fast: bread and the paper.
lines.sk: Podľa nákupu aj podľa kroku. Pán Jozef chodí pomaly a nakupuje rýchlo: chlieb a noviny.
lines.heard: By their shopping and by their walk. Mr. Joseph walks slowly and shops fast. Bread and the paper

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do I buy?
lines.sk: A čo kupujem ja?
lines.heard: And what do I buy?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Nothing. Your gran does your shopping.
lines.sk: Ty nič. Za teba nakupuje babka.
lines.heard: Nothing. Your gran does your shopping

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I bought myself some chocolate the other day.
lines.sk: Minule som si kúpil čokoládu.
lines.heard: I bought myself some chocolate the other day

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: I know. Your gran rang me afterwards to ask whether you’d had your lunch as well.
lines.sk: Viem. Babka mi potom volala, či si zjedol aj obed.
lines.heard: I know. Your gran rang me afterwards to ask whether you'd had your lunch as well

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do you like selling through the hatch?
lines.sk: Ako sa ti predáva cez okienko?
lines.heard: How do you like selling through the hatch?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: People argue less. Through glass it doesn’t have the same effect.
lines.sk: Ľudia sa menej hádajú. Cez sklo to nemá ten efekt.
lines.heard: People argue less through glass. It doesn't have the same effect

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do you miss most?
lines.sk: A čo ti najviac chýba?
lines.heard: And what do you miss most?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Gossip. Only the quick kind fits through a hatch.
lines.sk: Klebety. Cez okienko sa dajú povedať len tie rýchle.
lines.heard: Gossip? Only the quick kind fits through a hatch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Quick gossip is still gossip.
lines.sk: Rýchla klebeta je tiež klebeta.
lines.heard: Quick gossip is still gossip

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: No. Quick gossip is just news. For proper gossip you need a bench.
lines.sk: Nie. Rýchla klebeta je len správa. Na poriadnu treba lavičku.
lines.heard: No, quick gossip is just news. For proper gossip, you need a bench

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What are people buying most in quarantine?
lines.sk: Čo si ľudia v karanténe kupujú najviac?
lines.heard: What are people buying most in quarantine?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Flour and yeast. The whole village has suddenly started baking.
lines.sk: Múku a droždie. Celá dedina zrazu pečie.
lines.heard: Flour and yeast. The whole village has suddenly started baking

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how’s it going?
lines.sk: A darí sa im?
lines.heard: And how's it going?

lines.speaker: DANA
lines.text: Judging by how much bread they buy from me at the same time, not well so far.
lines.sk: Podľa toho, koľko chleba si u mňa popritom kupujú, zatiaľ nie.
lines.heard: Judging by how much bread they buy from me at the same time, not well so far

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran’s gate. Gran is in quarantine, so today I’m not allowed any further than the little table.
lines.sk: Babkina bránka. Babka je v karanténe, takže ďalej ako po stolík dnes nesmiem.
lines.heard: Gran's gate. Gran is in quarantine, so today I'm not allowed any further than the little table

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran, your shopping’s on the table. I’m stepping back.
lines.sk: Babka, nákup máš na stolíku. Už odstupujem.
lines.heard: Gran, your shopping's on the table. I'm stepping back

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I can see you. One more step back. There, now it’s exactly two metres.
lines.sk: Vidím. Ešte krok dozadu. Tak, teraz máš presne dva metre.
lines.heard: I can see you. One more step back. There. Now it's exactly two meters

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You measured it?
lines.sk: Ty si to vymeriavala?
lines.heard: You measured it?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: On Monday, before the quarantine. I’m an engineer, not a fortune-teller.
lines.sk: V pondelok, ešte pred karanténou. Som inžinierka, nie veštica.
lines.heard: On Monday before the quarantine? I'm an engineer, not a fortune teller

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Thank you. Take the side path to the window and ring me. You wouldn’t hear me through the glass.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Choď bočným chodníčkom k oknu a zavolaj mi. Cez sklo by si ma nepočul.
lines.heard: Thank you Take the side path to the window and ring me You wouldn't hear me through the glass

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Right. The side path and the phone. We haven’t talked this close all month.
lines.sk: Dobre. Bočný chodníček a telefón. Takto blízko sme sa celý mesiac nerozprávali.
lines.heard: Right. The side path and the phone. We haven't talked this close all month

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: And I’ve got something else for you. But that’s for the window.
lines.sk: A ešte niečo pre teba mám. Ale to až pri okne.
lines.heard: And I've got something else for you but that's for the window.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The key fits and the lock doesn’t even creak. Gran clearly oils it more often than I oil the hinges in my garage.
lines.sk: Kľúč pasuje a zámok ani nevrzol. Babka ho zrejme maže častejšie ako ja pánty v garáži.
lines.heard: The key fits and the lock doesn't even creak. Gran clearly oils it more often than I oil the hinges in my garage

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran’s window. She’s behind the glass, I’m below it, and there’s a phone between us. That’s how visiting works round here now.
lines.sk: Babkino okno. Ona za sklom, ja pod ním a medzi nami telefón. Tak sa u nás teraz chodí na návštevu.
lines.heard: Gran's window. She's behind the glass, I'm below it, and there's a phone between us. That's how visiting works around here now

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I do. Roman carried some boxes into the garden workshop for me. There’s a device in them called ZVON, and it keeps making sounds even though it’s unplugged.
lines.sk: Potrebujem. Roman mi preniesol krabice do záhradnej dielne. Je v nich prístroj ZVON a ozýva sa, hoci je odpojený.
lines.heard: I do. Roman carried some boxes into the garden workshop for me. There's a device in them called Zvon, and it keeps making sounds even though it's unplugged

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Probably a capacitor.
lines.sk: Asi kondenzátor.
lines.heard: Probably a capacitor

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: If you think so, go and have a look. The key’s in the letterbox outside, by the window. Take it, but don’t come into the house.
lines.sk: Keď myslíš, tak sa pozri. Kľúč je vo vonkajšej schránke pri okne. Vezmi si ho, ale do domu nechoď.
lines.heard: If you think so, go and have a look. The key's in the letterbox outside by the window. Take it, but don't come into the house

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Not into the house, into the workshop. I know Gran’s rules.
lines.sk: Do domu nie, do dielne áno. Babkine pravidlá poznám.
lines.heard: Not into the house, into the workshop. I know Gran's rules

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: You’ve forgotten one: listen first, take apart later.
lines.sk: Jedno si zabudol: najprv počúvaj, až potom rozoberaj.
lines.heard: You've forgotten one Listen first, take apart later

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why ZVON, of all names?
lines.sk: Prečo práve ZVON?
lines.heard: Why Zvon of all names?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Because the first thing it did was ring out. Like a bell – a zvon. We never came up with anything better.
lines.sk: Lebo sa hneď na začiatku ozval. A lepšie meno sme vtedy nevymysleli.
lines.heard: Because the first thing it did was ring out like a bell, a zvon. We never came up with anything better.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: We? Who’s we?
lines.sk: My? Kto my?
lines.heard: We? Who's we?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Me and Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. I’ll tell you more once you stop going on about capacitors.
lines.sk: Ja a Oto Bielik, mechanik z Ivanky. Viac ti poviem, keď prestaneš hovoriť o kondenzátoroch.
lines.heard: Me and Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. I'll tell you more once you stop going on about capacitors

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll go and get the key. And we’re not finished with that capacitor.
lines.sk: Tak idem pre kľúč. A o kondenzátore sa ešte porozprávame.
lines.heard: Then I'll go and get the key. And we're not finished with that capacitor

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran, I’m back. In the right year, at least. I need to show you something.
lines.sk: Babka, som späť. Aspoň v správnom roku. Musím ti niečo ukázať.
lines.heard: Grant, I'm back in the right year, at least. I need to show you something

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Hold it up to the glass. I’ve had my glasses on since this morning, in case you came back.
lines.sk: Prilož to k sklu. Okuliare mám na nose od rána pre prípad, že sa vrátiš.
lines.heard: Hold it up to the glass. I've had my glasses on since this morning in case you came back

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: So that was you. I remember that imprint.
lines.sk: Tak to si bol ty. Ten odtlačok si pamätám.
lines.heard: So that was you. I remember that imprint

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: And those shoes. In Ivanka they talked about them until Christmas.
lines.sk: Aj tie topánky. V Ivanke sa o nich hovorilo až do Vianoc.
lines.heard: And those shoes! In Ivanka they talked about them until Christmas

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You remembered me all those years?
lines.sk: Ty si si ma celé tie roky pamätala?
lines.heard: You remembered me all those years?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: The shoes, yes. I’ve only just put a face to them.
lines.sk: Topánky áno. Tvár som si k nim priradila až teraz.
lines.heard: The shoes. Yes. I've only just put a face to them

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: And now, seriously. If you want to stop the erasing, you need a return bridge.
lines.sk: A teraz vážne. Ak chceš to mazanie zastaviť, potrebuješ návratový mostík.
lines.heard: And now, seriously, if you want to stop the erasing, you need a return bridge

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: A physical one, ceramic, not another device. I won’t let you go anywhere without it.
lines.sk: Fyzický, keramický, žiadny ďalší prístroj. Bez neho ťa nikam nepustím.
lines.heard: A physical one ceramic, not another device. I won't let you go anywhere without it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A bridge? And where do I get one?
lines.sk: Mostík? A kde ho vezmem?
lines.heard: A bridge? And where do I get one?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Otto built one in 1982, at Sokolikova. His grandson Tony helped him.
lines.sk: Oto jeden postavil v roku 1982 na Sokolíkovej. Pomáhal mu vnuk Tóno.
lines.heard: Otto built one in 1982 at Sokolikova his grandson Tony helped him

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tony? Our caretaker?
lines.sk: Tóno? Náš školník?
lines.heard: Tony our caretaker

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: He was still at school then. Today he’s fifty and he holds the place together. I’ve rung him to say you’ll be coming for my technical property.
lines.sk: Vtedy chodil do školy. Dnes má päťdesiat a drží ju pokope. Volala som mu, že prídeš po môj technický majetok.
lines.heard: He was still at school then. Today he's fifty, and he holds the place together. I've rung him to say you'll be coming for my technical property

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘Technical property.’ Sounds like I’m off to collect a tractor.
lines.sk: Technický majetok. Znie to, akoby som išiel po traktor.
lines.heard: Technical property. Sounds like I'm off to collect a tractor

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: To the school it’s property. To me it’s a box of things nobody but me knows how to plug in.
lines.sk: Pre školu je to majetok. Pre mňa krabica vecí, ktoré okrem mňa nikto nevie zapojiť.
lines.heard: To the school, it's property. To me, it's a box of things nobody but me knows how to plug in

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll drop in on him.
lines.sk: Tak sa za ním zastavím.
lines.heard: Then I'll drop in on him

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: And after that, you and Ella will finish the paperwork for moving my box.
lines.sk: A potom s Elou dotiahnete papiere k presunu mojej krabice.
lines.heard: And after that, you and Ella will finish the paperwork for moving my box

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Anything else, before that device sends me off somewhere again?
lines.sk: Ešte niečo, kým ma ten prístroj zase niekam pošle?
lines.heard: Anything else before that device sends me off somewhere again?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Yes. Take a photo of the school yard, exactly as it is today.
lines.sk: Áno. Odfoť si školský dvor, presne taký, aký je dnes.
lines.heard: Yes. Take a photo of the schoolyard exactly as it is today

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is everything all right? Honestly.
lines.sk: Všetko v poriadku? Ale úprimne.
lines.heard: Is everything all right? Honestly

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I’m at home, I’ve got everything and we talk on the phone. Don’t turn me into another item on a list.
lines.sk: Som doma, mám všetko a voláme si. Nerob zo mňa ďalšiu položku na zozname.
lines.heard: I'm at home. I've got everything, and we talk on the phone. Don't turn me into another item on a list

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Fine. Then at least you’ll be first on the list.
lines.sk: Dobre. Tak budeš na zozname aspoň prvá.
lines.heard: Fine. Then at least you'll be first on the list

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I’m first on Ella’s list anyway. I checked.
lines.sk: Na Elinom zozname som prvá aj tak. Overila som si to.
lines.heard: I'm first on Ella's list anyway. I checked

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran, you check up on Ella too?
lines.sk: Babka, ty kontroluješ aj Elu?
lines.heard: Gran, you check up on Ella too

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I check up on everyone who checks up on me. That’s only fair.
lines.sk: Kontrolujem každého, kto kontroluje mňa. Tak je to spravodlivé.
lines.heard: I check up on everyone who checks up on me that's only fair

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: A repaired thing shows you where it broke. A new one won’t tell you that.
lines.sk: Na opravenej veci vidno, kde sa pokazila. Nová ti to nepovie.
lines.heard: A repaired thing shows you where it broke. A new one won't tell you that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And that’s an advantage?
lines.sk: A to je výhoda?
lines.heard: And that's an advantage?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: For the next repairer, certainly.
lines.sk: Pre ďalšieho opravára určite.
lines.heard: For the next repairer, certainly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the three skis in the workshop?
lines.sk: A tie tri lyže v dielni?
lines.heard: And the three skis in the workshop?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: That’s two skis and a spare part. Over the years it’s come in handy once already.
lines.sk: To sú dve lyže a náhradný diel. Za tie roky sa mi už raz zišiel.
lines.heard: That's two skis and a spare part over the years. It's come in handy once already.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran, do you know what happened?
lines.sk: Babka, vieš, čo sa stalo?
lines.heard: Gran, do you know what happened?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I know you came back. You can tell me the rest when it’s possible to visit.
lines.sk: Viem, že si sa vrátil. Ostatné mi porozprávaš, keď sa bude dať prísť.
lines.heard: I know you came back. You can tell me the rest when it's possible to visit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’ll take a long time to tell.
lines.sk: Bude to dlhé rozprávanie.
lines.heard: It will take a long time to tell

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: That’s why I have a big teapot.
lines.sk: Preto mám veľkú kanvicu.
lines.heard: That's why I have a big teapot

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll start with Ivanka. You were twenty-two and very strict with me.
lines.sk: Začnem Ivankou. Mala si dvadsaťdva a bola si na mňa prísna.
lines.heard: I'll start with Ivanka. You were 22 and very strict with me

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I was strict with anyone who spoke imprecisely. And you kept mentioning the strangest years.
lines.sk: Bola som prísna na každého, kto hovoril nepresne. A ty si vtedy spomínal samé čudné roky.
lines.heard: I was strict with anyone who spoke imprecisely and you kept mentioning the strangest years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you remember teaching me to solder?
lines.sk: Pamätáš, ako si ma učila spájkovať?
lines.heard: Do you remember teaching me to solder?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I do. You were seven and you wanted to solder everything, even a teaspoon.
lines.sk: Pamätám. Mal si sedem a chcel si spájkovať všetko, aj lyžičku.
lines.heard: I do. You were seven and you wanted to solder everything, even a teaspoon

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In the end I didn’t solder the teaspoon.
lines.sk: Lyžičku som nakoniec nespájkoval.
lines.heard: In the end, I didn't solder the teaspoon

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Because I hid it from you. I hid the soldering iron too, but you found that.
lines.sk: Lebo som ti ju schovala. Spájkovačku som schovala tiež, ale tú si si našiel.
lines.heard: Because I hid it from you. I hid the soldering iron too, but you found that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how quickly did I find it?
lines.sk: A ako rýchlo som ju našiel?
lines.heard: And how quickly did I find it?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: In two days. You searched systematically, drawer by drawer. That’s when I knew you’d be a repairer.
lines.sk: Za dva dni. Hľadal si systematicky, zásuvku po zásuvke. Vtedy som vedela, že z teba bude opravár.
lines.heard: In two days, you searched systematically, drawer by drawer. That's when I knew you'd be a repairer

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who have you been on the phone to today?
lines.sk: S kým si dnes už volala?
lines.heard: Who have you been on the phone to today?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Dana, Ella, Roman and the neighbour who couldn’t switch her radio on.
lines.sk: S Danou, s Elou, s Romanom a so susedou, ktorá nevedela zapnúť rádio.
lines.heard: Dana, Ella, Roman, and the neighbor who couldn't switch her radio on

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did she switch it on?
lines.sk: A zapla ho?
lines.heard: And did she switch it on?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: She did. Now she doesn’t know how to switch it off. She’ll ring me about that tomorrow.
lines.sk: Zapla. Teraz nevie, ako ho vypnúť. S tým mi zavolá zajtra.
lines.heard: She did. Now she doesn't know how to switch it off. She'll ring me about that tomorrow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What was Otto like when you worked together?
lines.sk: Aký bol Oto, keď ste spolu robili?
lines.heard: What was Otto like when you worked together?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Precise. I was twenty-two and thought I knew everything. Otto corrected me every day.
lines.sk: Presný. Mala som dvadsaťdva a myslela som si, že viem všetko. Oto ma každý deň opravil.
lines.heard: Precise. I was 22 and thought I knew everything. Otto corrected me every day

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Was he strict?
lines.sk: Bol prísny?
lines.heard: Was he strict?

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Worse. He was right. You can’t have a proper argument with someone like that.
lines.sk: Horšie. Mal pravdu. S takým sa nedá poriadne pohádať.
lines.heard: Worse, he was right. You can't have a proper argument with someone like that.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran calls this ‘a few things’. A storeman would call it ‘a small warehouse’.
lines.sk: Babka tomu hovorí „pár vecí“. Skladník by povedal „menší sklad“.
lines.heard: Gran calls this a few things A storeman would call it a small warehouse

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ZVON, and a sticker saying ‘Sokolikova 1995’. I know this device from school. Back then we weren’t even allowed to breathe on it.
lines.sk: ZVON a nálepka „Sokolíkova 1995“. Ten prístroj poznám zo školy. Vtedy sme naň nesmeli ani dýchnuť.
lines.heard: Zvon and a sticker saying Sokolikova 1995. I know this device from school. Back then we weren't even allowed to breathe on it

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Wearer recognised. Wearer’s memory protected.
lines.sk: Nositeľ rozpoznaný. Jeho pamäť je chránená.
lines.heard: Wearer recognized. Wearer's memory protected.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know it, and it knows me. Gran, you should have told me about this, even if I didn’t ask.
lines.sk: Ja poznám jeho a on pozná mňa. Babka, toto si mi mala povedať, aj keď som sa nepýtal.
lines.heard: I know it and it knows me. Grant, you should have told me about this, even if I didn't ask

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There’s a warning on the wall: DO NOT OVERWRITE THE ORIGINAL. The one I know is DO NOT OPEN. I never obeyed that one.
lines.sk: Na stene visí výstraha NEPREPISOVAŤ ORIGINÁL. Ja poznám skôr NEOTVÁRAŤ. Tú som nikdy nedodržal.
lines.heard: There's a warning on the wall, "Do not overwrite the original." The one I know is, "Do not open." I never obeyed that one

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: First I disconnect the small power supply, then the cover comes off. The fuse is blown, but you can still read the rating.
lines.sk: Najprv odpojím malý zdroj, potom dám dole kryt. Poistka je prepálená, hodnota sa dá prečítať.
lines.heard: First I disconnect the small power supply, then the cover comes off. The fuse is blown, but you can still read the rating

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve got the same one at home in the garage. So far it’s a perfectly ordinary repair.
lines.sk: Rovnakú mám doma v garáži. Zatiaľ je to úplne normálna oprava.
lines.heard: I've got the same one at home in the garage. So far, it's a perfectly ordinary repair

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Fuse in, cover closed, power supply connected.
lines.sk: Poistka sedí, kryt je zavretý, zdroj zapojený.
lines.heard: Fuse in cover closed power supply connected

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Connect three reference shapes.
lines.sk: Pripojte tri referenčné tvary.
lines.heard: Connect three reference shapes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Circle, triangle, square. Like nursery school, only with pricier building blocks.
lines.sk: Kruh, trojuholník, štvorec. Ako v škôlke, len s drahšími kockami.
lines.heard: Circle, triangle, square like nursery school only with pricier building blocks

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Reference 1995 restored.
lines.sk: Referencia 1995 obnovená.
lines.heard: Reference 1995 restored

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: 1995 is a year, not a voltage. I hope the thing is just showing the wrong unit.
lines.sk: 1995 je rok, nie napätie. Dúfam, že prístroj len ukazuje zlú jednotku.
lines.heard: 1995 is a year, not a voltage. I hope the thing is just showing the wrong unit

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Adam, a bit of colour has vanished from that old photo of ours.
lines.sk: Adam, z tej starej fotky nám zmizol kúsok farby.
lines.heard: Adam, a bit of color has vanished from that old photo of ours

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That isn’t colour. Gran, don’t hang up.
lines.sk: To nie je farba. Babka, nezavesuj.
lines.heard: That isn't color Gran, don't hang up

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Wearer stabilised. Contents stabilised. Reference 1995.
lines.sk: Nositeľ stabilizovaný. Obsah stabilizovaný. Referencia 1995.
lines.heard: wearer stabilized, contents stabilized, reference one nine nine five

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All I wanted was to change a fuse.
lines.sk: Ja som chcel len vymeniť poistku.
lines.heard: All I wanted was to change a fuse

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know this stop. It’s just the year that’s wrong.
lines.sk: Tú zastávku poznám. Len rok nesedí.
lines.heard: I know this stop. It's just the year that's wrong

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The imprint, the tape, the record and the bridge. Gran, I’m putting all of it to your device now.
lines.sk: Odtlačok, kazeta, protokol a mostík. Babka, teraz to všetko priložím k tvojmu prístroju.
lines.heard: The imprint, the tape, the record, and the bridge. Grant, I'm putting all of it to your device now

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Origin 1962. Voice 1995. Consent 2020. Destination of the collection: Atlas, Jasna, 2035.
lines.sk: Pôvod 1962. Hlas 1995. Súhlas 2020. Cieľ fondu: Atlas, Jasná, 2035.
lines.heard: Origin 1962. Voice 1995. Consent 2020. Destination of the collection Atlas Yasna 2035

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Curator of the collection: Nina Swift, Grand Jasna.
lines.sk: Kurátorka fondu: Nina Švecová, Grand Jasná.
lines.heard: Curator of the collection, Nina Swift, Grand Yasna

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now I have the address. I’ll deliver the complaint in person.
lines.sk: Adresu už mám. Reklamáciu im doručím osobne.
lines.heard: Now I have the address, I'll deliver the complaint in person

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Adam? There’s an echo on the line.
lines.sk: Adam? Z telefónu ti ide ozvena.
lines.heard: Adam? There's an echo on the line

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s not an echo, Gran. That’s your device. It’s talking about 2035.
lines.sk: To nie je ozvena, babka. To je tvoj prístroj. Hovorí o roku 2035.
lines.heard: That's not an echo, Gran. That's your device. It's talking about 2035

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Then don’t let it talk to itself. Write down what it says, and then switch it off.
lines.sk: Tak ho nenechaj rozprávať samého. Zapíš si, čo hovorí, a potom ho vypni.
lines.heard: Then don't let it talk to itself Write down what it says and then switch it off

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll switch it off at the power supply. Then I’ll ring you properly.
lines.sk: Idem to vypnúť pri zdroji. Potom ti zavolám normálne.
lines.heard: I'll switch it off at the power supply, then I'll ring you properly

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Subsequent custodian of the collection: Atlas. Jasna. Year 2035.
lines.sk: Následný správca fondu: Atlas. Jasná. Rok 2035.
lines.heard: Subsequent custodian of the collection, Atlas, Yasna, year 2035

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So now I know where the past is going wrong.
lines.sk: Tak už viem, kde sa minulosť kazí.
lines.heard: So now I know where the past is going wrong

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: And don’t forget to come back.
lines.sk: A nezabudni sa vrátiť.
lines.heard: And don't forget to come back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I won’t. This time I’ve written the year of return on the device as well.
lines.sk: Nezabudnem. Rok návratu mám tentoraz napísaný aj na prístroji.
lines.heard: I won't. This time I've written the year of return on the device as well

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The Dubravka stop. I used to go to school from here, and the waiting is still exactly the same.
lines.sk: Dúbravská zastávka. Odtiaľto som chodil do školy a čaká sa tu stále rovnako.
lines.heard: The Dubravka stop. I used to go to school from here, and the waiting is still exactly the same

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Back to Cierna Voda. From there I could find my way to Grob blindfolded.
lines.sk: Späť do Čiernej Vody. Odtiaľ už do Grobu trafím aj poslepiačky.
lines.heard: Back to Chain of Order. From there, I could find my way to Grob blindfolded

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Matching local reference. Dubravka, 7 December 1982.
lines.sk: Zhodná lokálna referencia. Dúbravka, 7. decembra 1982.
lines.heard: Matching local reference, Dubravka, 7 December 1982

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Another time window. Three years before I was born, this time.
lines.sk: Ďalšie časové okno. Tentoraz tri roky pred mojím narodením.
lines.heard: Another time window. Three years before I was born this time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My old school. The first time I’ve ever heard it completely silent.
lines.sk: Moja stará škola. Prvý raz ju počujem úplne tichú.
lines.heard: My old school. The first time I've ever heard it completely silent

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll take the whole corner from the pavement: the tarmac yard and the service window with the swallow. No tree, no low wall.
lines.sk: Odfotím z chodníka celý roh: asfaltový dvor a servisné okno s lastovičkou. Žiadny strom, žiadny múrik.
lines.heard: I'll take the whole corner from the pavement, the tarmac yard, and the service window with the swallow. No tree, no low wall

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The photo stays in the phone’s protected memory, even if the yard changes. I take Gran’s advice literally.
lines.sk: Fotka ostane v chránenej pamäti telefónu, aj keby sa dvor zmenil. Babkine rady beriem doslova.
lines.heard: The photo stays in the phone's protected memory even if the yard changes. I take Gran's advice literally

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tony, our caretaker. When he unlocked the prep room for me in 1995, he didn’t have grey temples yet.
lines.sk: Tóno, náš školník. Keď mi v roku 1995 otváral kabinet, nemal ešte sivé spánky.
lines.heard: Tony, our caretaker. When he unlocked the prep room for me in 1995, he didn't have gray temples yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good morning, Mr Wolfe. I’m Mrs Perry’s grandson, and I’m supposed to show you this.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň, pán Farkaš. Som vnuk pani Hruškovej a toto vám mám ukázať.
lines.heard: Good morning, Mr. Wolf. I'm Mrs. Perry's grandson, and I'm supposed to show you this

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Good morning. Hold it up to the glass, please. This year I only open the window for parcels.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Priložte to k sklu, prosím. Okno tento rok otváram iba pre balíky.
lines.heard: Good morning. Hold it up to the glass, please. This year I only open the window for parcels

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Mrs Perry’s device. She said you’d come. My grandad made a bridge for it in 1982, but it got lost over the years.
lines.sk: Prístroj pani Hruškovej. Vravela, že prídete. Dedo k nemu v roku 1982 robil mostík, ale ten sa časom stratil.
lines.heard: Mrs. Perry's device? She said you'd come. My granddad made a bridge for it in 1982, but it got lost over the years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is there at least a drawing of it left?
lines.sk: Ostal po ňom aspoň nákres?
lines.heard: Is there at least a drawing of it left?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Grandad wrote everything down in the service logbook in the prep room. Your permit is ready; Jane will let you in remotely.
lines.sk: Dedo všetko zapisoval do servisnej knihy v kabinete. Povolenie máte pripravené, Jana vás tam pustí na diaľku.
lines.heard: Granddad wrote everything down in the service logbook in the prep room. Your permit is ready. Jane will let you in remotely

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Remotely? How do you let someone into a prep room remotely?
lines.sk: Na diaľku? Ako sa človek púšťa do kabinetu na diaľku?
lines.heard: Remotely? How do you let someone into a prep room remotely?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Jane switches on the camera, I unlock the door. She supervises, I’m responsible.
lines.sk: Jana zapne kameru, ja odomknem dvere. Ona dozerá, ja zodpovedám.
lines.heard: Jane switches on the camera. I unlock the door. She supervises. I'm responsible

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you.
lines.sk: Ďakujem.
lines.heard: Thank you

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: The other classrooms are closed. Today everyone stays where they are. Me, here behind the window.
lines.sk: Ostatné triedy sú zatvorené. Dnes každý zostáva na svojom mieste. Ja tu za oknom.
lines.heard: The other classrooms are closed. Today, everyone stays where they are. Me? Here, behind the window

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Behind the window all day?
lines.sk: Celý deň za oknom?
lines.heard: Behind the window all day?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: All day. Parents ring, I take notes, couriers ring the bell. These days a caretaker is mostly a switchboard operator.
lines.sk: Celý deň. Rodičia volajú, ja zapisujem, kuriéri zvonia. Školník je teraz hlavne telefonista.
lines.heard: All day. Parents ring, I take notes, couriers ring the bell. These days, a caretaker is mostly a switchboard operator

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The swallow comes back. The bridge is intact.
lines.sk: Lastovička sa vracia. Mostík je celý.
lines.heard: The swallow comes back. The bridge is intact

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Say that again.
lines.sk: Povedzte to ešte raz.
lines.heard: Say that again

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The swallow comes back.
lines.sk: Lastovička sa vracia.
lines.heard: The swallow comes back

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Well, I never. I was twelve then, and I’m fifty now. And you’re still wearing the same jacket.
lines.sk: Tak predsa. Vtedy som mal dvanásť, teraz mám päťdesiat. A ty nosíš stále tú istú bundu.
lines.heard: Well, I never. I was 12 then, and I'm 50 now, and you're still wearing the same jacket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: For me it’s been a few hours.
lines.sk: Pre mňa ubehlo pár hodín.
lines.heard: For me, it's been a few hours

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: For me, a whole lifetime. But I never threw that strange deal out with the old papers.
lines.sk: Pre mňa celý život. Ale tú zvláštnu dohodu som so starými papiermi nevyhodil.
lines.heard: For me, a whole lifetime. But I never threw that strange deal out with the old papers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Your map was spot on, right down to the stone.
lines.sk: Tvoja mapa sedela na kameň presne.
lines.heard: Your map was spot on, right down to the stone

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Grandad taught me to draw so that even someone who wasn’t there would understand it.
lines.sk: Dedo ma naučil kresliť tak, aby tomu rozumel aj ten, kto pri tom nebol.
lines.heard: Granddad taught me to draw so that even someone who wasn't there would understand it.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you for waiting for me.
lines.sk: Ďakujem, že si na mňa čakal.
lines.heard: Thank you for waiting for me

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: I didn’t wait. I lived. I just remembered the place.
lines.sk: Nečakal som. Žil som. Len som si pamätal miesto.
lines.heard: I didn't wait. I lived. I just remembered the place

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s even better.
lines.sk: To je ešte lepšie.
lines.heard: That's even better

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: If you ever meet that twelve-year-old again, tell him the plane from the club will fly in the end. He shouldn’t throw it out of the window.
lines.sk: Ak ešte stretneš toho dvanásťročného, povedz mu, že lietadlo z krúžku nakoniec poletí. Nech ho nehádže z okna.
lines.heard: If you ever meet that 12-year-old again, tell him the plane from the club will fly in the end. He shouldn't throw it out of the window

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll tell him. Word for word.
lines.sk: Poviem mu. Slovo od slova.
lines.heard: I'll tell him word for word

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Alongside the maintenance, I make birdhouses for the children. When they come back, at least there’ll be something new waiting for them.
lines.sk: Popri údržbe robím deťom búdky. Keď sa vrátia, aspoň niečo nové ich tu počká.
lines.heard: Alongside the maintenance, I make birdhouses for the children. When they come back, at least there'll be something new waiting for them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So the school hasn’t stopped completely.
lines.sk: Škola teda úplne nezastala.
lines.heard: So the school hasn't stopped completely?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: It’s just gone quiet.
lines.sk: Len stíchla.
lines.heard: It's just gone quiet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many have you made?
lines.sk: Koľko ich už je?
lines.heard: How many have you made?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Seven. Only one is occupied so far. A blue tit didn’t read the notice about the school being closed.
lines.sk: Sedem. Obývaná je zatiaľ jedna. Sýkorka si oznam o zatvorenej škole neprečítala.
lines.heard: Seven. Only one is occupied so far. A blue tit didn't read the notice about the school being closed.

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: It has to be, for now. But it won’t be empty for ever.
lines.sk: Teraz musí byť. Ale prázdna nebude navždy.
lines.heard: It has to be for now, but it won't be empty forever

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now you can even hear your own footsteps here.
lines.sk: Teraz tu počuť aj vlastné kroky.
lines.heard: Now you can even hear your own footsteps here.

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: And every door. At last I know which ones need oiling.
lines.sk: Aj každé dvere. Konečne viem, ktoré treba namazať.
lines.heard: And every door. At last I know which ones need oiling

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which ones creak the most?
lines.sk: A ktoré vŕzgajú najviac?
lines.heard: And which ones creak the most?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: The prep room door. It was already creaking when I went to school here.
lines.sk: Tie do kabinetu. Vŕzgali už vtedy, keď som tam chodil ja.
lines.heard: The prep room door. It was already creaking when I went to school here.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many keys are on that bunch?
lines.sk: Koľko kľúčov je na tom zväzku?
lines.heard: How many keys are on that bunch?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Forty-two. One for every door, and one that doesn’t open anything any more.
lines.sk: Štyridsaťdva. Od každých dverí jeden a jeden, ktorý už nič neotvára.
lines.heard: 42. One for every door and one that doesn't open anything anymore

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what was the last one for?
lines.sk: A ten posledný je od čoho?
lines.heard: And what was the last one for?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: The old boiler room. They knocked the boiler room down; the key stayed. I’ve got used to its weight.
lines.sk: Od starej kotolne. Kotolňu zbúrali, kľúč zostal. Zvykol som si na jeho váhu.
lines.heard: The old boiler room. They knocked the boiler room down. The key stayed. I got used to its weight

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do children still come here now?
lines.sk: Chodia sem deti aj teraz?
lines.heard: Do children still come here now?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: With their parents, to collect equipment. Through the window they show me what they’ve done in remote lessons.
lines.sk: S rodičmi, po pomôcky. Cez okno mi ukazujú, čo urobili na dištančnom.
lines.heard: with their parents to collect equipment. Through the window, they show me what they've done in remote lessons

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do they show you?
lines.sk: A čo ukazujú?
lines.heard: And what do they show you?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Mostly drawings. One once showed me a cat. Apparently that’s homework too.
lines.sk: Väčšinou výkresy. Jeden mi raz ukázal mačku. Vraj je to tiež domáca úloha.
lines.heard: Mostly drawings. One once showed me a cat. Apparently that's homework too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did you make that metal swallow yourself?
lines.sk: Tú kovovú lastovičku si urobil sám?
lines.heard: Did you make that metal swallow yourself?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: From sheet metal, back when I was an apprentice. I’ve got a wooden one at home on a shelf.
lines.sk: Z plechu, ešte ako učeň. Drevenú mám doma na poličke.
lines.heard: From sheet metal, back when I was an apprentice. I've got a wooden one at home, on a shelf

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why a swallow?
lines.sk: Prečo práve lastovička?
lines.heard: Why a swallow?

lines.speaker: TONO20
lines.text: Because it comes back to the same place. At twelve, that seemed like a good plan to me.
lines.sk: Lebo sa vracia na to isté miesto. Mne sa to v dvanástich zdalo ako dobrý plán.
lines.heard: Because it comes back to the same place. At 12, that seemed like a good plan to me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: When I came to school here, they wouldn’t let me in without indoor shoes. Today it’s without a mask and hand gel.
lines.sk: Keď som sem chodil, bez prezuviek ma nepustili. Dnes zas bez rúška a dezinfekcie.
lines.heard: When I came to school here, they wouldn't let me in without indoor shoes. Today, it's without a mask and hand gel

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The first time I’m in the prep room with permission and no fear of a bad mark. It only took me a quarter of a century.
lines.sk: Prvý raz som v kabinete s povolením a bez strachu zo známky. Trvalo mi to len štvrťstoročie.
lines.heard: The first time I'm in the prep room with permission and no fear of a bad mark. It only took me a quarter of a century

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: Good morning. I can see you, just slightly from above. That’s the right book.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Vidím vás, len trochu zhora. Tú knihu máte správnu.
lines.heard: Good morning. I can see you just slightly from above. That's the right book

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Seventh of December 1982, entered by Otto Whitlock. Note: grandson Anthony helped with the preparation.
lines.sk: Siedmeho decembra 1982, zapísal Oto Bielik. Poznámka: pri príprave pomáhal vnuk Anton.
lines.heard: 7th of December, 1982, entered by Otto Whitlock. Note, grandson Anthony helped with the preparation

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: That’s our caretaker today. We went to school together. The bridge got lost, but the drawing survived.
lines.sk: To je náš dnešný školník. Chodili sme spolu do školy. Mostík sa stratil, ale nákres zostal.
lines.heard: That's our caretaker today. We went to school together. The bridge got lost, but the drawing survived

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Otto really did write down everything. I could do with a list like that in my garage.
lines.sk: Oto si zapisoval naozaj všetko. Taký zoznam by sa mi zišiel aj v garáži.
lines.heard: Otto really did write down everything. I could do with a list like that in my garage

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: Not a list. A record. You write a list before the work and a record after it.
lines.sk: Nie zoznam. Záznam. Zoznam sa píše pred prácou, záznam po nej.
lines.heard: Not a list, a record. You write a list before the work and a record after it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The chronometer reacts to that date. I’ll try it by the old clock at the stop.
lines.sk: Chronometer na ten dátum reaguje. Skúsim to pri starých hodinách na zastávke.
lines.heard: The chronometer reacts to that date. I'll try it by the old clock at the stop

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: The copy is yours, the original stays in the prep room. That’s what Tony and I agreed.
lines.sk: Kópia je vaša, originál zostáva v kabinete. Tak to máme s Tónom dohodnuté.
lines.heard: The copy is yours. The original stays in the prep room. That's what Tony and I agreed.

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: Not every child has a computer of their own at home. With the club, we repair old laptops. They’re not new, but they work.
lines.sk: Nie všetky deti majú doma vlastný počítač. S krúžkom opravujeme staré notebooky. Nie sú nové, ale fungujú.
lines.heard: Not every child has a computer of their own at home. With the club, we repair old laptops. They're not new, but they work

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You repair them? You personally?
lines.sk: Opravujete? Vy osobne?
lines.heard: You repair them? You personally

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: Me and twelve children. I say where the fault is, and the children pretend they knew.
lines.sk: Ja a dvanásť detí. Ja poviem, kde je chyba, a deti sa tvária, že to vedeli.
lines.heard: Me and 12 children. I say where the fault is, and the children pretend they knew

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And it all started with that one schematic?
lines.sk: A začalo sa to tou jednou schémou?
lines.heard: And it all started with that one schematic

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: And with someone letting me explain it.
lines.sk: A tým, že mi ju niekto dovolil vysvetliť.
lines.heard: And with someone letting me explain it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll tell that someone.
lines.sk: Tak to tomu niekomu poviem.
lines.heard: Then I'll tell that someone

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: No need. I think they know.
lines.sk: Netreba. Myslím, že to vie.
lines.heard: No need. I think they know

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: By appointment, one at a time. Whoever collects equipment signs a receipt and doesn’t meet anyone.
lines.sk: Po dohode a každý zvlášť. Kto si pomôcky vyzdvihne, podpíše preberací list a s nikým sa nestretne.
lines.heard: By appointment, one at a time. Whoever collects equipment signs a receipt and doesn't meet anyone

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Paperwork that actually helps. Then I suppose nothing goes missing any more.
lines.sk: Papierovanie, ktoré naozaj pomáha. Tak to sa vám už asi nič nestratí.
lines.heard: Paperwork that actually helps. Then I suppose nothing goes missing anymore

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: It does. But we once spent a month looking for a microscope, and now I know where every ruler is.
