lines.sk: Stratí. Ale kedysi sme mesiac hľadali mikroskop a teraz viem, kde je každé pravítko.
lines.heard: It does, but we once spent a month looking for a microscope, and now I know where every ruler is

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even the ones that don’t come back?
lines.sk: Aj tie, čo sa nevrátia?
lines.heard: Even the ones that don't come back

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: Those especially. They get a red circle in the register.
lines.sk: Tie najmä. Tie majú v evidencii červený krúžok.
lines.heard: Those especially. They get a red circle in the register

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How does teaching at a distance work?
lines.sk: Ako sa učí na diaľku?
lines.heard: How does teaching at a distance work?

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: In bits. Maths works; PE is harder.
lines.sk: Po kúskoch. Matematika ide, s telesnou je to horšie.
lines.heard: In bits. Maths works. PE is harder

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: PE over a camera?
lines.sk: Telesná cez kameru?
lines.heard: pee over a camera?

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: The children jump around in their living rooms. The neighbours downstairs confirm it works.
lines.sk: Deti skáču v obývačkách. Susedia zdola potvrdzujú, že to funguje.
lines.heard: The children jump around in their living rooms. The neighbors downstairs confirm it works

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What was Tony like as a classmate?
lines.sk: Aký bol Tóno ako spolužiak?
lines.heard: What was Tony like as a classmate?

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: He drew aeroplanes in every exercise book. Including mine, when I wasn’t looking.
lines.sk: Kreslil lietadlá do každého zošita. Aj do môjho, keď som sa nepozerala.
lines.heard: He drew aeroplanes in every exercise book, including mine when I wasn't looking

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you?
lines.sk: A vy?
lines.heard: And you?

lines.speaker: JANA20
lines.text: I corrected them. The wings were always at the wrong angle.
lines.sk: Ja som mu ich opravovala. Krídla mali vždy zlý uhol.
lines.heard: I corrected them. The wings were always at the wrong angle

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know this corner. I have a feeling something’s missing here, and it isn’t the bench.
lines.sk: Ten roh poznám. Mám pocit, že tu niečo chýba, a nie je to lavička.
lines.heard: I know this corner. I have a feeling something's missing here, and it isn't the bench

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The lime tree stands here. The low wall stayed under it; the bench has moved. The photo on my phone still shows tarmac.
lines.sk: Lipa tu stojí. Pod ňou zostal múrik, lavička sa posunula. Fotka v telefóne stále ukazuje asfalt.
lines.heard: The lime tree stands here. The low wall stayed under it. The bench has moved. The photo on my phone still shows tarmac

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Row two, column three. Behind the service board is our jar. Thirty-eight years of dust on the outside, dry paper inside.
lines.sk: Rad dva, stĺpec tri. Za servisnou doskou je náš pohár. Zvonka tridsaťosem rokov prachu, vnútri suchý papier.
lines.heard: Row two, column three. Behind the service board is our jar. Thirty-eight years of dust on the outside, dry paper inside

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll loosen the old thread. The ceramic is intact; I’ll clean the contacts and measure them.
lines.sk: Uvoľním starý závit. Keramika je celá, kontakty očistím a premeriam.
lines.heard: I'll loosen the old thread. The ceramic is intact. I'll clean the contacts and measure them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The very same piece. I’ve never waited thirty-eight years and five minutes for a part before.
lines.sk: Ten istý kus. Na žiadnu súčiastku som ešte nečakal tridsaťosem rokov a päť minút.
lines.heard: The very same piece. I've never waited 38 years and five minutes for a part before

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The pond below the pump track. Children ride up on the hill, ducks swim down below, and both lots make exactly the same noise.
lines.sk: Rybník pod pumptrackom. Deti hore na kopci jazdia, kačice dole plávajú a obe partie pritom robia rovnaký hluk.
lines.heard: The pond below the pumptrack. Children ride up on the hill, ducks swim down below, and both lots make exactly the same noise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Dry and thoroughly chewed. The owner will come forward himself.
lines.sk: Suchá a poriadne obhryzená. Majiteľ sa prihlási sám.
lines.heard: Dry and thoroughly chewed the owner will come forward himself.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There’s a QR code on the noticeboard and an old gentleman with a magnifying glass below it. Looks like they’ll need an interpreter.
lines.sk: Na výveske je QR kód a pod ním pán s lupou. Vyzerá to, že tu bude treba tlmočníka.
lines.heard: There's a QR code on the notice board and an old gentleman with a magnifying glass below it. Looks like they'll need an interpreter

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: By bus into town, then change for Dubravka. Mask – check. Ticket – check.
lines.sk: Autobusom do mesta a potom prestup do Dúbravky. Rúško mám, lístok tiež.
lines.heard: By bus into town, then change for Dubravka. Mask, check. Ticket, check

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The bus is almost empty. Everyone sits at their own window, as if they’d booked it.
lines.sk: Autobus je skoro prázdny. Každý sedí pri svojom okne, akoby si ho rezervoval.
lines.heard: The bus is almost empty. Everyone sits at their own window as if they've booked it

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: If you’d be so kind, young man. I only need the pick-up hours. I’m not starting a whole new digital life for them.
lines.sk: Ak budeš taký dobrý, mladý pán. Potrebujem len hodiny výdaja. Kvôli nim si nový digitálny život nezaložím.
lines.heard: If you'd be so kind, young man. I only need the pickup hours. I'm not starting a whole new digital life for them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The hours are in that QR code. You just point your phone at it.
lines.sk: Hodiny sú v tom QR kóde. Stačí naň namieriť telefón.
lines.heard: The hours are in that QR code. You just point your phone at it

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: I pointed my magnifying glass at it. It showed me the same little square, only bigger.
lines.sk: Namieril som naň lupu. Ukázala mi ten istý štvorček, len väčší.
lines.heard: I pointed my magnifying glass at it. It showed me the same little square, only bigger

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll ask Ella for a notice in large print. On paper.
lines.sk: Poprosím Elu o oznam veľkým písmom. Na papieri.
lines.heard: I'll ask Ella for a notice in large print on paper

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Then thank you in advance. In capital letters.
lines.sk: Tak ti vopred ďakujem. Veľkými písmenami.
lines.heard: Then thank you in advance in capital letters

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: And put the phone number on it too. I can talk into a telephone. I can’t talk into a square.
lines.sk: A nech je tam aj telefón. Do telefónu hovoriť viem, do štvorčeka nie.
lines.heard: And put the phone number on it too. I can talk into a telephone. I can't talk into a square

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There. Four drawing pins, so the wind doesn’t blow it away before you’ve read it.
lines.sk: Tak. Pripnutý štyrmi pripináčikmi, aby ho vietor neodfúkol skôr, ako si ho prečítate.
lines.heard: There. Four drawing pins so the wind doesn't blow it away before you've read it

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Nine till five. Excellent.
lines.sk: Od deviatej do piatej. Výborne.
lines.heard: Nine till five. Excellent

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: And I didn’t even have to unfold my magnifying glass. I’ll save it for the crosswords.
lines.sk: A ani som nemusel rozkladať lupu. Tú si nechám na krížovky.
lines.heard: And I didn't even have to unfold my magnifying glass. I'll save it for the crosswords

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even the phone number is in large print.
lines.sk: Aj telefónne číslo je veľkým písmom.
lines.heard: Even the phone number is in large print

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: There you are. Today technology has advanced by one sheet of paper.
lines.sk: Vidíš. Dnes technika pokročila o jeden papier.
lines.heard: There you are. Today, technology has advanced by one sheet of paper

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Thank you kindly, young man. I could read this from the bus.
lines.sk: Ďakujem pekne, mladý pán. Toto by som si prečítal aj z autobusu.
lines.heard: Thank you kindly, young man. I could read this from the bus

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: The kind that rings.
lines.sk: Taký, ktorý zvoní.
lines.heard: The kind that rings

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s still a very good feature.
lines.sk: To je stále veľmi dobrá funkcia.
lines.heard: That's still a very good feature

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: And a very underrated one.
lines.sk: A veľmi podceňovaná.
lines.heard: And a very underrated one

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: My grandson wanted to buy me one of those glass ones. I asked him where the buttons were.
lines.sk: Vnuk mi chcel kúpiť taký sklenený. Pýtal som sa ho, kde má tlačidlá.
lines.heard: My grandson wanted to buy me one of those glass ones. I asked him where the buttons were

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did he say?
lines.sk: A čo vám povedal?
lines.heard: And what did he say?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Everywhere. So I kept the one that at least has them all in one place.
lines.sk: Že všade. Tak som si nechal ten, čo ich má aspoň na jednom mieste.
lines.heard: Everywhere. So I kept the one that at least has them all in one place

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: No. I’m waiting for someone to tell me what’s in that little square on the noticeboard.
lines.sk: Nie. Čakám, kým mi niekto povie, čo je v tom štvorčeku na výveske.
lines.heard: No, I'm waiting for someone to tell me what's in that little square on the notice board

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: We’ll find out before the bus comes.
lines.sk: To zistíme skôr, než príde autobus.
lines.heard: We'll find out before the bus comes

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: I know the bus. At least it runs to a timetable that’s printed.
lines.sk: Autobus poznám. Ten aspoň chodí podľa poriadku, ktorý je vytlačený.
lines.heard: I know, the bus. At least it runs to a timetable that's printed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when it’s late?
lines.sk: A keď mešká?
lines.heard: And when it's late

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Then I wait by the noticeboard. Here at least someone tells me why it’s late.
lines.sk: Tak čakám pri výveske. Tu mi aspoň niekto povie, prečo mešká.
lines.heard: Then I wait by the notice board. Here, at least someone tells me why it's late

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you take that magnifying glass everywhere?
lines.sk: Tú lupu nosíte všade?
lines.heard: Do you take that magnifying glass everywhere?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Everywhere, young man. A folding one, from my father. He read with it, and now I do.
lines.sk: Všade, mladý pán. Skladacia, ešte po otcovi. Čítal s ňou už otec, teraz ja.
lines.heard: Everywhere, young man. A folding one, from my father. He read with it and now I do

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do you read with it most?
lines.sk: A čo s ňou čítate najčastejšie?
lines.heard: And what do you read with it most?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: The noticeboard, the paper and guarantees. Guarantees especially – that’s where the print is smallest.
lines.sk: Vývesku, noviny a záručné listy. Tie najmä, tam je najmenšie písmo.
lines.heard: The notice board, the paper, and guarantees. Guarantees especially. That's where the print is smallest.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What was it like here when you were younger?
lines.sk: Ako to tu vyzeralo, keď ste boli mladší?
lines.heard: What was it like here when you were younger?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: A field, a few weekend cottages and water. Now there are streets named after that field.
lines.sk: Pole, pár chát a voda. Teraz sú tu ulice, čo sa volajú po tom poli.
lines.heard: A field, a few weekend cottages, and water. Now there are streets named after that field.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do you like it?
lines.sk: A páči sa vám to?
lines.heard: And do you like it?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: I do. I’d just like someone to print a map as well. On paper, young man.
lines.sk: Páči. Len by som chcel, aby niekto vytlačil aj mapu. Na papier, mladý pán.
lines.heard: I do. I'd just like someone to print a map as well, on paper, young man

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the best way to get to Dubravka from here?
lines.sk: Ako sa odtiaľto najlepšie dostanem do Dúbravky?
lines.heard: What's the best way to get to Dubravka from here?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: Bus from this stop into town, and change there. Don’t forget your mask – the driver’s stricter than I am.
lines.sk: Autobusom z tejto zastávky do mesta a tam prestúpiš. Rúško si nezabudni, šofér je prísnejší ako ja.
lines.heard: Bus from this stop into town and change there. Don't forget your mask. The driver's stricter than I am

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Stricter than you?
lines.sk: Prísnejší ako vy?
lines.heard: Stricter than you?

lines.speaker: JOZEF
lines.text: All I ask for is large print. Without a mask, he won’t even let you on the first step.
lines.sk: Ja prosím len o veľké písmo. On ťa bez rúška nepustí ani na schod.
lines.heard: All I ask for is large print. Without a mask, he won't even let you on the first step.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My school on Sokolikova. If anyone calls me up to the blackboard, I’m returning time travel as faulty.
lines.sk: Moja škola na Sokolíkovej. Ak ma niekto vyvolá k tabuli, cestovanie v čase idem reklamovať.
lines.heard: My school on Sokolnikova. If anyone calls me up to the blackboard, I'm returning time travel as faulty

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘Tape recorder won’t play – a repairer’s help welcome.’ So I’m in the right place, just twenty-five years early.
lines.sk: „Magnetofón neprehráva, pomoc opravára vítaná.“ Tak to som tu správne, len o dvadsaťpäť rokov skôr.
lines.heard: Tape recorder won't play. A repairer's help welcome. So I'm in the right place, just 25 years early

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You report to the caretaker. As a pupil, I only ever went to him for the indoor shoes I’d forgotten.
lines.sk: Hlásiť sa treba u školníka. Ako žiak som k nemu chodil len po zabudnuté prezuvky.
lines.heard: You report to the caretaker. As a pupil, I only ever went to him for the indoor shoes I'd forgotten

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You never forget that smell: floor polish, indoor shoes and fear of tests.
lines.sk: Na tú vôňu sa nedá zabudnúť: leštidlo, prezuvky a strach z písomky.
lines.heard: You never forget that smell. Floor polish, indoor shoes, and fear of tests

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I read the notice on the board. I’ve come to help with the tape recorder, and with this.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Čítal som oznam na nástenke. Prišiel som pomôcť s magnetofónom a s týmto.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I read the notice on the board. I've come to help with the tape recorder and with this

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The notice? It’s been up since Monday. I thought only the pigeons read it any more.
lines.sk: Na oznam? Ten visí od pondelka. Myslel som, že ho čítajú už len holuby.
lines.heard: The notice? It's been up since Monday. I thought only the pigeons read it anymore

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Pigeons wouldn’t fix your tape recorder.
lines.sk: Holuby by vám magnetofón neopravili.
lines.heard: Pigeons wouldn't fix your tape recorder

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: No, they wouldn’t. Show me what you’ve got there.
lines.sk: Holuby nie. Ukážte, čo to máte.
lines.heard: No, they wouldn't. Show me what you got there

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: That’s Mrs Perry’s device. Please sign in: name and purpose – visiting the club. I’ll unlock the prep room for you.
lines.sk: To je prístroj pani Hruškovej. Zapíšte sa, prosím: meno a účel – návšteva krúžku. Kabinet vám otvorím.
lines.heard: That's Mrs. Perry's device. Please sign in, name and purpose. Visiting the club. I'll unlock the prep room for you

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The pen is on a string. Three walked off last month, so we tied this one down.
lines.sk: Pero je na šnúrke. Minulý mesiac nám odišli tri, tak sme ho uviazali.
lines.heard: The pen is on a string. Three walked off last month, so we tied this one down

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Adam Perry.
lines.sk: Adam Hruška.
lines.heard: Adam Perry

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Adam Perry? We’ve already got one of those. He’s ten and he goes to the club.
lines.sk: Adam Hruška? Jedného takého už máme. Má desať rokov a chodí do krúžku.
lines.heard: Adam Perry? We've already got one of those. He's 10 and he goes to the club

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s a family tradition.
lines.sk: To je u nás rodinná tradícia.
lines.heard: It's a family tradition

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: I hope you bring your indoor shoes. The little one forgets his every other day.
lines.sk: Dúfam, že vy si prezuvky nosíte. Ten malý ich zabúda každý druhý deň.
lines.heard: I hope you bring your indoor shoes. The little one forgets his every other day

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: He’ll keep that habit for a long time.
lines.sk: To mu zostane ešte dlho.
lines.heard: He'll keep that habit for a long time

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The club is in the classroom at the end of the corridor. They’re recording, so speak quietly in there – or straight into the microphone.
lines.sk: Krúžok je v triede na konci chodby. Nahrávajú, tak tam hovorte potichu alebo rovno do mikrofónu.
lines.heard: The club is in the classroom at the end of the corridor. They're recording, so speak quietly in there or straight into the microphone

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: And mind you, that tape recorder of ours eats drive belts like a packed lunch.
lines.sk: A pozor, ten náš magnetofón žerie remienky ako desiatu.
lines.heard: And mind you, that tape recorder of ours eats drive belts like a packed lunch

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: If you need a new one, go to Paulie in Karlova Ves. He’s got drawers full of them.
lines.sk: Keby ste potrebovali nový, choďte za Palim do Karlovej Vsi. Má ich plné zásuvky.
lines.heard: If you need a new one, go to Paulie in Karlova Ves. He's got drawers full of them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The swallow comes back.
lines.sk: Lastovička sa vracia.
lines.heard: The swallow comes back

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The last time I heard that sentence I was twelve.
lines.sk: Tú vetu som naposledy počul ako dvanásťročný.
lines.heard: The last time I heard that sentence, I was twelve

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Hang on. It’s you. Grandad was right. You haven’t aged at all.
lines.sk: Počkaj. To si ty. Dedo mal pravdu. Vôbec si nezostarol.
lines.heard: Hang on. It's you. Grandad was right. You haven't aged at all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you’ve grown a bit.
lines.sk: Ty si zato trochu vyrástol.
lines.heard: And you've grown a bit

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: I stayed in repairs. Sokolikova needed a caretaker, and I knew every window here. It was my own choice.
lines.sk: Ostal som pri opravách. Sokolíkova potrebovala školníka a ja som tu poznal každé okno. Vybral som si to sám.
lines.heard: I stayed in repairs. Sokolokova needed a caretaker, and I knew every window here. It was my own choice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m glad.
lines.sk: To som rád.
lines.heard: I'm glad

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: When they replaced the bench, I didn’t let them brick up the cavity. Here’s a new sketch: row two, column three, like on my one from when I was a kid.
lines.sk: Keď menili lavičku, nedal som dutinu zamurovať. Tu je nový nákres: rad dva, stĺpec tri, ako na mojom detskom.
lines.heard: When they replaced the bench, I didn't let them brick up the cavity. Here's a new sketch, row two, column three, like on my one from when I was a kid

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Same row, same column. Only the swallow is drawn better.
lines.sk: Ten istý rad, ten istý stĺpec. Len lastovička je nakreslená lepšie.
lines.heard: Same row, same column, only the swallow is drawn better

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: I’ve had time to practise.
lines.sk: Mal som čas trénovať.
lines.heard: I've had time to practice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thirteen years.
lines.sk: Trinásť rokov.
lines.heard: 13 years

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: For you, one conversation. For me, my first job, a driving licence and quite a few bad haircuts.
lines.sk: Pre teba jeden rozhovor. Pre mňa prvá robota, vodičák a dosť zlých účesov.
lines.heard: For you, one conversation. For me, my first job, a driving license, and quite a few bad haircuts

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then let’s sit down for a moment before the next jump.
lines.sk: Tak si pred ďalším skokom chvíľu sadnime.
lines.heard: Then let's sit down for a moment before the next jump

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Let’s sit on the bench over there by the cloakrooms. We don’t have to say anything.
lines.sk: Sadnime si tam na lavičku pri šatniach. Nemusíme nič hovoriť.
lines.heard: Let's sit on the bench over there by the cloakrooms. We don't have to say anything

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: For that panel in the underpass? We’ve got one spare stick. Here.
lines.sk: Na ten panel v podchode? Jeden kus máme navyše. Tu je.
lines.heard: For that panel in the underpass, we've got one spare stick. Here

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: White, unused. The used ones are shorter than your little finger, and the teachers never give them back anyway.
lines.sk: Biela, nepoužitá. Tie použité sú kratšie ako malíček a učitelia ich aj tak nevracajú.
lines.heard: Why unused? The used ones are shorter than your little finger, and the teachers never give them back anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I promise nobody will write a test with it.
lines.sk: Sľubujem, že ňou nikto nenapíše písomku.
lines.heard: I promise nobody will write a test with it

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Tests are the teachers’ problem. I just sweep up afterwards.
lines.sk: Písomky sú starosť učiteľov. Ja potom len zametám.
lines.heard: Tests are the teacher's problem. I just sweep up afterwards

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who records that a stick of chalk has gone to Petrzalka?
lines.sk: A kto zapíše, že krieda odišla do Petržalky?
lines.heard: And who records that a stick of chalk has gone to Petrijalka?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The caretaker. In the issues book: one chalk, for art. The headmistress enjoys reading it at the end of the year.
lines.sk: Školník. Do zošita výdajov: jedna krieda, na umenie. Riaditeľka to na konci roka rada číta.
lines.heard: The caretaker in the issues book One Chalk for Art. The headmistress enjoys reading it at the end of the year

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Whatever is supposed to go back into place by itself.
lines.sk: To, čo sa má samo vrátiť na miesto.
lines.heard: Whatever's supposed to go back into place by itself

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Things?
lines.sk: Veci?
lines.heard: Things?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Sometimes pupils too.
lines.sk: Niekedy aj žiaci.
lines.heard: Sometimes pupils too

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Mainly the door to the yard. It has a spring that’s meant to close it. The pupils have a foot that props it open.
lines.sk: Hlavne dvere na dvor. Majú pružinu, ktorá ich má zavrieť. Žiaci majú nohu, ktorá ich podoprie.
lines.heard: Mainly the door to the yard. It has a spring that's meant to close it. The pupils have a foot that props it open

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who’s winning?
lines.sk: A kto vyhráva?
lines.heard: And who's winning?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The foot, so far. We’re on our third spring.
lines.sk: Zatiaľ noha. Pružinu meníme už tretíkrát.
lines.heard: The foot so far. We're on our third spring

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Sign in, go only to the prep room and the memory club classroom. And no photographing the children.
lines.sk: Zapísať sa, chodiť len do kabinetu a do triedy pamäťového krúžku. A deti nefotiť.
lines.heard: Sign in, go only to the prep room and the memory club classroom and no photographing the children

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Understood. Today I’m even avoiding my own class photo.
lines.sk: Rozumiem. Dnes sa vyhýbam aj vlastnej triednej fotke.
lines.heard: Understood. Today I'm even avoiding my own class photo

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: And no running in the corridor. That goes for grown-ups who are late too.
lines.sk: A po chodbe sa nebehá. Platí to aj pre dospelých, čo meškajú.
lines.heard: And no running in the corridor That goes for grown-ups who are late too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: For the caretaker as well?
lines.sk: Aj pre školníka?
lines.heard: For the caretaker as well?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The caretaker doesn’t run. The caretaker takes a shortcut.
lines.sk: Školník nebehá. Školník chodí skratkou.
lines.heard: The caretaker doesn't run. The caretaker takes a shortcut

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Where do those stairs down lead?
lines.sk: Kam vedú tie schody dolu?
lines.heard: Where do those stairs down lead?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: To the boiler room. In winter it’s the warmest place, and in summer the quietest.
lines.sk: Do kotolne. V zime je tam najteplejšie a v lete najtichšie.
lines.heard: To the boiler room. In winter, it's the warmest place, and in summer, the quietest

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what happens down there in summer?
lines.sk: A čo sa tam robí v lete?
lines.heard: And what happens down there in summer?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Everything that broke during the year gets repaired. And sometimes lunch gets eaten there too.
lines.sk: Opravuje sa všetko, čo sa cez rok pokazilo. A občas sa tam aj obeduje.
lines.heard: Everything that broke during the year gets repaired, and sometimes lunch gets eaten there too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: By the boiler?
lines.sk: Pri kotli?
lines.heard: By the boiler?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: In summer the boiler is the best neighbour there is. It wants nothing and tells nobody anything.
lines.sk: Kotol je v lete najlepší sused. Nič nechce a nikomu nič nevyrozpráva.
lines.heard: In summer, the boiler is the best neighbor there is. It wants nothing and tells nobody anything

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Can you hear the club all the way out here?
lines.sk: Je krúžok počuť až sem?
lines.heard: Can you hear the club all the way out here?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: Today, yes. They’re recording the sounds of the school, so the children are testing what the doors sound like.
lines.sk: Dnes áno. Nahrávajú zvuky školy, tak deti skúšajú, ako znejú dvere.
lines.heard: Today? Yes. They're recording the sounds of the school, so the children are testing what the doors sound like

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: They’ve shut the gym door twenty times already. For quality, they say.
lines.sk: Dvere od telocvične zavreli už dvadsaťkrát. Vraj kvôli kvalite.
lines.heard: They've shut the gym door 20 times already. For quality, they say

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And will the door survive?
lines.sk: A dvere to vydržia?
lines.heard: And will the door survive?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The door will. The caretaker, less so.
lines.sk: Dvere áno. Školník menej.
lines.heard: The door will the caretaker less so

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So many keys. Can you even tell them apart?
lines.sk: Toľko kľúčov. Dajú sa vôbec rozoznať?
lines.heard: So many keys. Can you even tell them apart?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: You can, by the teeth. Every door has its trick: the prep room you lift, the gym goes left, the canteen needs a gentle touch.
lines.sk: Dajú, podľa zúbkov. Každé dvere majú svoj trik: kabinet nadvihnúť, telocvičňa doľava, jedáleň s citom.
lines.heard: You can. By the teeth. Every door has its trick. The prep room you lift, the gym goes left, the canteen needs a gentle touch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which is the hardest?
lines.sk: A ktoré sú najťažšie?
lines.heard: And which is the hardest?

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: The headmistress’s office. The key fits; it’s just that nobody wants to open it.
lines.sk: Tie do riaditeľne. Kľúč pasuje, len ich nikto nechce otvárať.
lines.heard: The headmistress's office. The key fits, it's just that nobody wants to open it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran is fifty-five, I’m thirty-five. And I still have a feeling she’s about to send me off to wash my hands.
lines.sk: Babka má päťdesiatpäť, ja tridsaťpäť. A aj tak mám pocit, že ma pošle umyť si ruky.
lines.heard: Gran is 55, I'm 35, and I still have a feeling she's about to send me off to wash my hands

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon, Mrs Perry. My name is Adam, and I need help with something.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň, pani Hrušková. Volám sa Adam a potrebujem s niečím pomôcť.
lines.heard: Good afternoon, Mrs. Perry. My name's Adam, and, uh, I need help with something

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Then sit down and talk. First tell me what happened, then what you’ve already tried. In that order.
lines.sk: Tak si sadni a hovor. Najprv povedz, čo sa stalo, a potom, čo si už skúšal. V tomto poradí.
lines.heard: Then sit down and talk. First, tell me what happened, then what you've already tried, in that order

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This device showed the year 1995. And your name is disappearing from a photograph of mine.
lines.sk: Tento prístroj ukázal rok 1995. A z jednej fotografie mi mizne vaše meno.
lines.heard: This device showed the year 1995, and your name is disappearing from a photograph of mine

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Show me. That’s my chronometer. And it’s clinging to you as if it knew you.
lines.sk: Ukáž. To je môj chronometer. A drží sa ťa, akoby ťa poznal.
lines.heard: Show me? That's my chronometer, and it's clinging to you as if it knew you

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Devices like me. People are another matter.
lines.sk: Prístroje ma majú rady. S ľuďmi je to horšie.
lines.heard: Devices, like me, people are another matter

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Then someone has started a write-back. First we save the original voice, then we find the first calibration.
lines.sk: Tak to niekto spustil spätný zápis. Najprv zachránime pôvodný hlas, potom nájdeme prvú kalibráciu.
lines.heard: Then someone has started a write back. First, we save the original voice, then we find the first calibration

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A write-back? That sounds like something I wouldn’t accept for repair even with a surcharge.
lines.sk: Spätný zápis? To znie ako niečo, čo by som v servise neprevzal ani za príplatok.
lines.heard: A write back? That sounds like something I wouldn't accept for repair even with a surcharge

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Neither would I. That’s why we’ll take it one step at a time.
lines.sk: Ani ja nie. Preto pôjdeme pekne po poradí.
lines.heard: Neither would I. That's why we'll take it one step at a time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do we need?
lines.sk: Čo potrebujeme?
lines.heard: What do we need?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: The tape from the school PA and the node map from the reading room in the centre. Here’s my letter of authority – with it they’ll give you copies.
lines.sk: Kazetu zo školského rozhlasu a mapu uzlov zo študovne v centre. Tu máš moje poverenie, s ním ti vydajú kópie.
lines.heard: The tape from the school PA and the node map from the reading room in the center. Here's my letter of authority. With it, they'll give you copies

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: And don’t crumple the letter. Mr Merton in the reading room will reproach you for every crease.
lines.sk: A poverenie nepokrč. Pán Merta v študovni ti vyčíta každý záhyb.
lines.heard: And don't crumple the letter. Mr. Merton in the reading room will reproach you for every crease

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: The children and I will carry on recording in the meantime. I’ll leave the repairs to you.
lines.sk: My s deťmi zatiaľ nahrávame ďalej. Opravy nechám na vás.
lines.heard: The children and I will carry on recording in the meantime. I'll leave the repairs to you

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: At least one Adam is having a quiet afternoon today.
lines.sk: Aspoň jeden Adam má dnes pokojné popoludnie.
lines.heard: At least one atom is having a quiet afternoon today

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Quiet? The little one wants to spend the whole afternoon recording a teaspoon clinking in the canteen.
lines.sk: Pokojné? Ten malý chce celé popoludnie nahrávať, ako cinká lyžička v jedálni.
lines.heard: Quiet? The little one wants to spend the whole afternoon recording a teaspoon clinking in the canteen

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Let him. One day he’ll be glad he has it.
lines.sk: Nech nahráva. Raz bude rád, že to má.
lines.heard: Let him. One day he'll be glad he has it

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: People photograph buildings. But in twenty years nobody will know what break time sounded like.
lines.sk: Budovy sa fotia. Ale ako znie prestávka, to o dvadsať rokov nikto nebude vedieť.
lines.heard: People photograph buildings, but in twenty years, nobody will know what break time sounded like.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I can still hear it today.
lines.sk: Ja to počujem dodnes.
lines.heard: I can still hear it today

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Then you know why we do it.
lines.sk: Tak potom vieš, načo to robíme.
lines.heard: Then you know why we do it.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what does break time sound like in ninety-five?
lines.sk: A ako znie prestávka v deväťdesiatom piatom?
lines.heard: And what does break time sound like in ninety five?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: First the bell, then thirty chairs at once, then someone running down the corridor even though it isn’t allowed.
lines.sk: Najprv zvonček, potom tridsať stoličiek naraz, potom niekto, kto beží po chodbe, hoci sa nesmie.
lines.heard: First the bell, then 30 chairs at once, then someone running down the corridor even though it isn't allowed

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: We’ve got more recordings of that last one than anything else.
lines.sk: Toho posledného máme nahraného najviac.
lines.heard: We've got more recordings of that last one than anything else

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: You hold a screwdriver in an odd way. I know someone like that.
lines.sk: Skrutkovač držíš zvláštnym spôsobom. Poznám niekoho podobného.
lines.heard: You hold a screwdriver in an odd way. I know someone like that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who?
lines.sk: Koho?
lines.heard: Who?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: I’m not telling you. You’d start copying him.
lines.sk: To ti nepoviem. Ešte by si ho začal napodobňovať.
lines.heard: Oh, I'm not telling you. You'd start copying him

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe it’s a family fault.
lines.sk: Možno rodinná chyba.
lines.heard: Maybe it's a family fault

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Then don’t fix it. It works.
lines.sk: Tak ju neopravuj. Funguje.
lines.heard: Then don't fix it It works

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: The old register has the full storage number again. You put something right.
lines.sk: V starom registri je zase celé číslo uloženia. Niečo si napravil.
lines.heard: The old register has the full storage number again. You've put something right

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: More like I just didn’t let what was right get lost.
lines.sk: Skôr som len nedovolil, aby sa stratilo to, čo bolo správne.
lines.heard: More like I just didn't let what was right get lost

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: That tends to be the better repair.
lines.sk: To býva lepšia oprava.
lines.heard: That tends to be the better repair

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: I’ll write it down anyway. Z-17 goes in the register, and in my notebook, that someone helped.
lines.sk: Aj tak si to zapíšem. Do registra pôjde Z-17 a do môjho zošita, že niekto pomohol.
lines.heard: I'll write it down anyway. Z seventeen goes in the register and in my notebook that someone helped

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: No name?
lines.sk: Bez mena?
lines.heard: No name

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: I’ll add the name once I’m sure. I never write anything in advance.
lines.sk: Meno dopíšem, keď si budem istá. Dopredu nepíšem nič.
lines.heard: I'll add the name once I'm sure. I never write anything in advance

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How did you come up with the idea of running a sound club?
lines.sk: Ako vás napadlo viesť zvukový krúžok?
lines.heard: How did you come up with the idea of running a sound club?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: At first I wanted to teach the children to solder. Then I found out what they like best is listening.
lines.sk: Najprv som chcela deti učiť spájkovať. Potom som zistila, že najradšej počúvajú.
lines.heard: At first, I wanted to teach the children to solder. Then I found out what they like best is listening

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So you gave up on soldering?
lines.sk: Takže spájkovanie ste vzdali?
lines.heard: So you gave up on soldering?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: I didn’t give it up, I just moved it to second place. Listen first, then take apart and solder.
lines.sk: Nevzdala, len posunula na druhé miesto. Najprv počúvať, potom rozoberať a spájkovať.
lines.heard: I didn't give it up. I just moved it to second place. Listen first, then take apart and solder

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many cassettes have you recorded so far?
lines.sk: Koľko kaziet už máte nahraných?
lines.heard: How many cassettes have you recorded so far?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Forty-seven. Each one has a label: the date, the class and one word saying what it’s about.
lines.sk: Štyridsaťsedem. Každá má nálepku: dátum, trieda a jedno slovo, o čom je.
lines.heard: Forty-seven. Each one has a label, the date, the class, and one word saying what it's about.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One word is enough?
lines.sk: Jedno slovo stačí?
lines.heard: One word is enough?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: It has to be. Anyone who can’t say it in one word goes back and listens again. Nobody gets a bigger label.
lines.sk: Musí. Kto to nevie povedať jedným slovom, ide počúvať znova. Väčšiu nálepku nedostane nikto.
lines.heard: It has to be. Anyone who can't say it in one word goes back and listens again. Nobody gets a bigger label

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s life like in Dubravka these days?
lines.sk: Ako sa vám teraz žije v Dúbravke?
lines.heard: What's life like in Dubravka these days?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: Fast. Where there was a shop there’s a kiosk, and where there was a kiosk there’s a shop again. I can hardly keep changing my way to the shops.
lines.sk: Rýchlo. Kde bol obchod, je kiosk, a kde bol kiosk, je zase obchod. Ledva stíham meniť cestu na nákup.
lines.heard: Fast. Where there was a shop, there's a kiosk, and where there was a kiosk, there's a shop again. I can hardly keep changing my way to the shops

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the club?
lines.sk: A krúžok?
lines.heard: And the club?

lines.speaker: MIRA95
lines.text: The club is the only thing here that always starts at three. I insist on that.
lines.sk: Krúžok je jediné, čo sa tu začína vždy o tretej. Na tom trvám.
lines.heard: The club is the only thing here that always starts at three. I insist on that

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Anything they’d like to remember. Even if it seems silly to them today.
lines.sk: Čokoľvek, čo by si chceli zapamätať. Aj keď im to dnes pripadá hlúpe.
lines.heard: Anything they'd like to remember, even if it seems silly to them today?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s a very big archive.
lines.sk: To je veľmi veľký archív.
lines.heard: That's a very big archive

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Fortunately.
lines.sk: Našťastie.
lines.heard: Fortunately

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what have they recorded so far?
lines.sk: A čo už nahrali?
lines.heard: And what have they recorded so far?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: The bell for break, a dripping tap, a man feeding the pigeons and one sneeze.
lines.sk: Zvonenie na prestávku, kvapkajúci kohútik, pána, čo kŕmi holuby, a jedno kýchnutie.
lines.heard: The bell for break, a dripping tap, a man feeding the pigeons, and one sneeze

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: They apologised for that sneeze all week. It’s the best thing on the tape.
lines.sk: Za to kýchnutie sa ospravedlňovali celý týždeň. Na nahrávke je najlepšie.
lines.heard: They apologized for that sneeze all week. It's the best thing on the tape

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Even the pauses between words. That’s when people think.
lines.sk: Aj prestávky medzi slovami. Práve vtedy človek rozmýšľa.
lines.heard: Even the pauses between words that's when people think

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My pauses alone would fill a whole cassette.
lines.sk: Mne by to vydalo na samostatnú kazetu.
lines.heard: My pauses alone would fill a whole cassette

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Then let it have its own. Little Adam from the club stays quiet the longest of them all too.
lines.sk: Tak nech je samostatná. Malý Adam z krúžku tiež mlčí najdlhšie zo všetkých.
lines.heard: Then let it have its own. Little Adam from the club stays quiet the longest of them all too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what does he say afterwards?
lines.sk: A čo povie potom?
lines.heard: And what does he say afterwards?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Usually something worth waiting for.
lines.sk: Zvyčajne niečo, na čo stálo za to počkať.
lines.heard: Usually something worth waiting for

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Mira once brought back a programme from Ivanka for a play called ‘Never Fear, Darling!’ The children still laugh at that title.
lines.sk: Mira raz priniesla z Ivanky program k hre „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“ Deti sa tomu názvu smejú dodnes.
lines.heard: Miro once brought back a program from Ivanka for a play called Never Fear, Darling. The children still laugh at that title

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The programme survived. Does anyone still perform the play?
lines.sk: Program prežil. A hrá tú hru ešte niekto?
lines.heard: The program survived. Does anyone still perform the play?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: One boy wants to record it as a radio play. All the parts himself.
lines.sk: Jeden chlapec ju chce nahrať ako rozhlasovú hru. Všetky úlohy sám.
lines.heard: One boy wants to record it as a radio play, all the parts himself

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And has he got the script?
lines.sk: A text má?
lines.heard: And has he got the script?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Only the first line so far. But he performs it brilliantly.
lines.sk: Zatiaľ len prvú vetu. Tú však hrá výborne.
lines.heard: Only the first line so far, but he performs it brilliantly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which sound do you like best of all?
lines.sk: Ktorý zvuk máte zo všetkých najradšej?
lines.heard: Which sound do you like best of all?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: When the bell has gone and the children sit on for a moment, and nobody knows who’ll get up first.
lines.sk: Keď deti po zvonení ešte chvíľu sedia a nikto nevie, kto vstane prvý.
lines.heard: When the bell has gone and the children sit on for a moment and nobody knows who'll get up first

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: But that’s silence.
lines.sk: Veď to je ticho.
lines.heard: But that's silence

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Not quite. There are thirty people in it, all making up their minds.
lines.sk: Nie celkom. Je v ňom tridsať ľudí, čo sa práve rozhodujú.
lines.heard: Not quite. There are 30 people in it, all making up their minds

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you have children of your own, or are these enough for you?
lines.sk: Máte aj vlastné deti, alebo vám stačia tieto?
lines.heard: Do you have children of your own or are these enough for you?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: I have a son, Victor. He’s ten, like some of these.
lines.sk: Mám syna, Viktora. Má desať ako niektorí tuto.
lines.heard: I have a son, Victor. He's 10, like some of these

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what does he like doing?
lines.sk: A čo rád robí?
lines.heard: And what does he like doing?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: At home he takes apart everything that has a screw in it. He wants to know how it works.
lines.sk: Doma mi rozoberá všetko, čo má skrutku. Chce vedieť, ako to funguje.
lines.heard: At home, he takes apart everything that has a screw in it. He wants to know how it works

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And does he put it back together?
lines.sk: A poskladá to späť?
lines.heard: And does he put it back together?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: Not yet. But he puts every part carefully away in a little box.
lines.sk: Zatiaľ nie. Ale každý diel starostlivo uloží do škatuľky.
lines.heard: Not yet, but he puts every part carefully away in a little box

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The physics prep room. As a pupil I wasn’t allowed to touch anything in here. Now it’s going to be my job.
lines.sk: Fyzikálny kabinet. Ako žiak som sa tu nesmel ničoho dotknúť. Teraz to bude moja práca.
lines.heard: The physics prep room As a pupil, I wasn't allowed to touch anything in here Now it's gonna be my job

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: At my first exhibition, someone told me a different design isn’t a wrong one. Since then I’ve filled a whole notebook, and I teach children to build radios.
lines.sk: Na prvej výstavke mi niekto povedal, že iný návrh nie je zlý. Odvtedy mám plný zošit a učím deti stavať rádiá.
lines.heard: At my first exhibition, someone told me a different design isn't a wrong one. Since then, I filled a whole notebook, and I teach children to build radios

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A full notebook? How many schematics are in it?
lines.sk: Plný zošit? Koľko schém v ňom je?
lines.heard: A full notebook? How many schematics are in it?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Forty-two. But it didn’t stop at schematics. I built a radio from every one, and they all work.
lines.sk: Štyridsaťdva. Ale neostalo len pri schémach. Podľa každej som zapojila rádio a všetky hrajú.
lines.heard: 42. But it didn't stop at schematics. I built a radio from every one, and they all work

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do the children’s radios work?
lines.sk: A deťom tie rádiá hrajú?
lines.heard: And do the children's radios work?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Almost all of them. One only picks up taxi drivers, and its owner is the happiest of the lot.
lines.sk: Skoro všetkým. Jednému chytá len taxikárov a on je z toho najšťastnejší.
lines.heard: Almost all of them. One only picks up taxi drivers, and its owner is the happiest of the lot

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That notebook will get even thicker.
lines.sk: Ten zošit bude ešte hrubší.
lines.heard: That notebook will get even thicker

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: You say that as if you’d already seen it.
lines.sk: Hovoríte, akoby ste ho už videli.
lines.heard: You say that as if you'd already seen it

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Yes, with the timetable, the paperwork and the room. A club always needs someone to keep things in order.
lines.sk: Áno, s rozvrhom, papiermi aj s miestnosťou. Krúžok vždy potrebuje niekoho, kto robí poriadok.
lines.heard: Yes, with the timetable, the paperwork, and the room. A club always needs someone to keep things in order

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And someone who leaves room for new ideas.
lines.sk: A niekoho, kto nechá miesto aj novým nápadom.
lines.heard: And someone who leaves room for new ideas

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: I have a separate compartment in my binder for ideas. So far it’s the fullest one.
lines.sk: Na nápady mám v šanóne zvláštnu priehradku. Zatiaľ je najplnšia.
lines.heard: I have a separate compartment in my binder for ideas so far it's the fullest one

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even for the ones that don’t follow the template?
lines.sk: Aj na tie, čo nie sú podľa vzoru?
lines.heard: Even for the ones that don't follow the template?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Those most of all. The templates are in the cupboard; they don’t need a compartment.
lines.sk: Hlavne na tie. Vzory sú v skrini, tie priehradku nepotrebujú.
lines.heard: Those most of all. The templates are in the cupboard. They don't need a compartment

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All this paperwork for one club?
lines.sk: Toľko papierov kvôli jednému krúžku?
lines.heard: All this paperwork for one club?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Application forms, parents’ consent, the room schedule and one list of who has a key.
lines.sk: Prihlášky, súhlasy rodičov, rozpis miestností a jeden zoznam, kto má kľúč.
lines.heard: Application forms, parents' consent the room schedule, and one list of who has a key

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: But the caretaker has the keys.
lines.sk: Kľúč má predsa školník.
lines.heard: But the caretaker has the keys

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: The caretaker has the bunch. The list is so we know who has which key from the bunch.
lines.sk: Školník má zväzok. Zoznam je na to, aby sme vedeli, kto má ktorý kľúč zo zväzku.
lines.heard: The caretaker has the bunch. The list is so we know who has which key from the bunch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I can see you’ve got your hands full. What’s it going to be?
lines.sk: Vidím, že máte plné ruky práce. Čo to bude?
lines.heard: I can see you've got your hands full. What's it gonna be?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: An exhibition. The schedule, name cards and the order. Without an order, an exhibition is just a table with things on it.
lines.sk: Výstavka. Rozvrh, menovky a poradie. Bez poradia je výstavka len stôl s vecami.
lines.heard: An exhibition, the schedule, name cards, and the order. Without an order, an exhibition is just a table with things on it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what will be on that table?
lines.sk: A čo bude na tom stole?
lines.heard: And what will be on that table?

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: Radios, a tape recorder and a model mill that only turns when nobody’s looking at it.
lines.sk: Rádiá, magnetofón a model mlyna, ktorý sa točí, len keď sa naň nikto nepozerá.
lines.heard: Radios, a tape recorder, and a model mill that only turns when nobody's looking at it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that one. In my workshop everything works too, until a customer walks in.
lines.sk: To poznám. U mňa v dielni tiež všetko funguje, kým tam nie je zákazník.
lines.heard: Oh, I know that one. In my workshop, everything works too, until a customer walks in

lines.speaker: JANA95
lines.text: The model isn’t for repair. It’s an exhibit, and an exhibit doesn’t have to turn.
lines.sk: Model nie je na opravu. Je to exponát a exponát sa točiť nemusí.
lines.heard: The model isn't for repair. It's an exhibit, and an exhibit doesn't have to turn

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The school PA. The place that makes even good news sound like a telling-off.
lines.sk: Školský rozhlas. Miesto, odkiaľ aj dobrá správa znie ako napomenutie.
lines.heard: The school PA. The place that makes even good news sound like a telling off

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll unplug the machine, loosen the cover and take out the belt.
lines.sk: Prístroj odpojím, povolím kryt a vyberiem remienok.
lines.heard: I'll unplug the machine, loosen the cover, and take out the belt

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s completely perished. Tony said Paulie in Karlova Ves has drawers full of belts. Hopefully one like this.
lines.sk: Úplne sa rozpadol. Tóno vravel, že Pali v Karlovej Vsi má remienkov plné zásuvky. Snáď aj takýto.
lines.heard: It's completely perished. Tony said Paulie in Carlo Vaves has drawers full of belts. Hopefully one like this

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The belt’s in, the mechanism moves. The cassette is out and in one piece.
lines.sk: Remienok sedí, mechanika sa hýbe. Kazeta je vonku a celá.
lines.heard: The belt's in, the mechanism moves, the cassette is out and in one piece

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You can hardly hear the voices, even though the tape isn’t blank. The tape needs fixing – but how do I make it louder?
lines.sk: Hlasy takmer nepočuť, hoci páska prázdna nie je. Kazetu by to chcelo opraviť, ale ako ju zhlasním?
lines.heard: You can hardly hear the voices, even though the tape isn't blank. The tape needs fixing, but how do I make it louder?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Paulie mentioned Jerry from the cassette club in Ruzinov. He might know.
lines.sk: Pali spomínal Jura z kazetového klubu v Ružinove. Ten by to mohol vedieť.
lines.heard: Paulie mentioned Jerry from the cassette club in Ruzhenov. He might know.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The lead is in the service input. I’ll put the cassette in and only play it – nothing gets recorded over it.
lines.sk: Prepojka je v servisnom vstupe. Vložím kazetu a len ju prehrám, nič na ňu nenahrám.
lines.heard: The lead is in the service input. I'll put the cassette in and only play it. Nothing gets recorded over it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then it goes in my bag next to the chronometer. Its field will protect it.
lines.sk: Potom ju dám do brašne k chronometru. Jeho pole ju ochráni.
lines.heard: Then it goes in my bag next to the chronometer. Its field will protect it

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: No need to rush any more, Adam. We have time.
lines.sk: Už sa neponáhľaj, Adam. Máme čas.
lines.heard: No need to rush anymore, Adam. We have time

lines.speaker: ADAM10
lines.text: And can I say something normal too?
lines.sk: A môžem povedať aj niečo normálne?
lines.heard: And can I say something normal too?

lines.speaker: LEA95
lines.text: That’s exactly why we’re recording.
lines.sk: Práve preto nahrávame.
lines.heard: That's exactly why we're recording

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I thought I’d forgotten it. I just hadn’t heard it for a long time.
lines.sk: Myslel som, že som to zabudol. Len som to dlho nepočul.
lines.heard: I thought I'd forgotten it I just hadn't heard it for a long time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My phone has no signal and the tram is in the colours of my childhood. This is no ordinary network outage.
lines.sk: Telefón nemá signál a električka má farby môjho detstva. Toto nebude obyčajný výpadok siete.
lines.heard: My phone has no signal and the tram is in the colors of my childhood. This is no ordinary network outage

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The man with the accordion plays slowly. The trams are his drummers.
lines.sk: Pán s harmonikou hrá pomaly. Električky mu robia bicie.
lines.heard: The man with the accordion plays slowly. The trams are his drummers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Desmond says I need a mechanical rhythm for Mira’s measurement. Could you lend me your metronome?
lines.sk: Dezider vraví, že na Mirino meranie potrebujem mechanický rytmus. Požičali by ste mi metronóm?
lines.heard: Desmond says I need a mechanical rhythm for Mira's measurement. Could you lend me your metronome?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Desmond? He borrows it every spring. Says he tunes his aerials with it; I think he falls asleep to it.
lines.sk: Dezider? Ten si ho požičiava každú jar. Vraj ladí antény, ja si myslím, že pri ňom zaspáva.
lines.heard: Desmond, he borrows it every spring. Says he tunes his aerials with it. I think he falls asleep to it

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Take it. Desmond will bring it back to me later; we’ve known each other for years.
lines.sk: Vezmi si ho. Dezider mi ho potom vráti, poznáme sa roky.
lines.heard: Take it. Desmond will bring it back to me later. We've known each other for years

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: It’s set to my tempo. Slow, so the trams have time to fill in the rhythm.
lines.sk: Je nastavený na moje tempo. Pomalé, aby mi električky stihli dopĺňať rytmus.
lines.heard: It's set to my tempo, slow, so the trams have time to fill in the rhythm

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The trams keep time for you?
lines.sk: Električky vám držia rytmus?
lines.heard: The trams keep time for you

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Better than the drummer I used to play with. He wasn’t on time once.
lines.sk: Lepšie ako bubeník, s ktorým som kedysi hral. Ten neprišiel načas ani raz.
lines.heard: Better than the drummer I used to play with. He wasn't on time once

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. One day I’ll play you some music from the future in return.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Raz vám za to pustím hudbu z budúcnosti.
lines.heard: Thank you. One day I'll play you some music from the future in return

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Just as long as it isn’t too loud.
lines.sk: Len nech nie je príliš hlasná.
lines.heard: Just as long as it isn't too loud

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: And as long as you can wait for a tram to it.
lines.sk: A nech sa pri nej dá čakať na električku.
lines.heard: And as long as you can wait for a tram to it

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Four Stops – my own composition. I had the ending written down in a book, and I sold the book to Faith at the second-hand bookshop.
lines.sk: Štyri zastávky, moja vlastná skladba. Koniec som mal zapísaný v knihe a tú som predal Viere do antikvariátu.
lines.heard: Four stops, my own composition. I had the ending written down in a book, and I sold the book to Faith at the secondhand bookshop

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why did you sell a book with your own music in it?
lines.sk: Prečo ste predali knihu s vlastnými notami?
lines.heard: Why did you sell a book with your own music in it?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: I didn’t know it was in there. I used to use sheet music as bookmarks. At the time it seemed practical.
lines.sk: Nevedel som, že tam sú. Noty som zakladal do kníh ako záložky. Vtedy sa mi to zdalo praktické.
lines.heard: I didn't know it was in there. I used to use sheet music as bookmarks. At the time, it seemed practical

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how do you play it now?
lines.sk: A ako to teraz hráte?
lines.heard: And how do you play it now?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Up to the third stop from memory. Then I wait for a tram to come and finish it for me.
lines.sk: Po tretiu zastávku z pamäti. Potom čakám, kým príde električka a skončí to za mňa.
lines.heard: Up to the third stop from memory. Then I wait for a tram to come and finish it for me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll ask her about the music.
lines.sk: Tak sa jej na tie noty spýtam.
lines.heard: Then I'll ask her about the music

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Tell her the title. She remembers even the things I can’t play any more.
lines.sk: Povedz jej názov. Ona si pamätá aj to, čo ja už nezahrám.
lines.heard: Tell her the title. She remembers even the things I can't play anymore

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sheet music from Faith. It was in a book about birds.
lines.sk: Noty od Viery. Ležali v knihe o vtákoch.
lines.heard: Sheet music from Faith. It was in a book about birds

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: My bookmark. For twenty years I only played that song up to the third stop.
lines.sk: Moja záložka. Dvadsať rokov som tú skladbu hral len po tretiu zastávku.
lines.heard: My bookmark. For 20 years, I only played that song up to the third stop

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: That’s how it went. Listen.
lines.sk: Takto to išlo. Počúvaj.
lines.heard: That's how it went. Listen

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Four Stops. For the first time, I’m travelling without being in a hurry.
lines.sk: Štyri zastávky. Prvý raz sa pri cestovaní nikam neponáhľam.
lines.heard: Four stops. For the first time, I'm traveling without being in a hurry.

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: That’s usually the best kind of change.
lines.sk: To býva najlepší prestup.
lines.heard: That's usually the best kind of change

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Next time you pass, I’ll play you the whole thing. Last stop and all.
lines.sk: Keď pôjdeš okolo, zahrám ti ju celú. Aj s poslednou zastávkou.
lines.heard: Next time you pass, I'll play you the whole thing last stop and all

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Whatever I remember. And where I forget, I improvise.
lines.sk: To, čo si pamätám. A kde zabudnem, tam improvizujem.
lines.heard: Whatever I remember and where I forget, I improvise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s how I write my service reports too.
lines.sk: Takto robím aj servisné výkazy.
lines.heard: That's how I write my service reports too

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: And do the customers notice?
lines.sk: A zákazníci si to všimnú?
lines.heard: And do the customers notice?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Not as long as it works.
lines.sk: Kým to hrá, nie.
lines.heard: Not as long as it works

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: That’s my rule as well. As long as it plays, nobody wants to see the music.
lines.sk: To je aj moje pravidlo. Kým to hrá, nikto nechce vidieť noty.
lines.heard: That's my rule as well. As long as it plays, nobody wants to see the music

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: My most faithful listener is a lady who waits every day for the tram going the other way.
lines.sk: Najvernejšia je jedna pani, čo každý deň čaká na električku opačným smerom.
lines.heard: My most faithful listener is a lady who waits every day for the tram going the other way

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe she picked her stop by the programme.
lines.sk: Možno si vybrala zastávku podľa programu.
lines.heard: Maybe she picked her stop by the program

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Maybe. Twice now she’s missed her tram before I finished.
lines.sk: Možno. Dvakrát jej už električka ušla, kým som dohral.
lines.heard: Maybe twice now she's missed her tram before I've finished

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And was she cross?
lines.sk: A nahnevala sa?
lines.heard: And was she cross?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: No. She waited for the next one and dropped a crown in my cup. For the extended version, she said.
lines.sk: Nie. Počkala na ďalšiu a hodila mi do pohára korunu. Vraj za predĺženie.
lines.heard: No. She waited for the next one and dropped a crown in my cup. "For the extended version," she said

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why do you play in Karlova Ves of all places?
lines.sk: Prečo hráte práve v Karlovej Vsi?
lines.heard: Why do you play in Colla Vervaas of all places?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Because the trams pull in slowly here. People have time to hear at least the chorus.
lines.sk: Lebo tu električky zastavujú pomaly. Ľudia stihnú počuť aspoň refrén.
lines.heard: Because the trams pull in slowly here. People have time to hear at least the chorus

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And in the centre?
lines.sk: A v centre?
lines.heard: And in the center

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: In the centre people rush. There I’d only get through the intro and the thank-you.
lines.sk: V centre sa ponáhľajú. Tam by som stihol iba úvod a poďakovanie.
lines.heard: In the center, people rush. There I'd only get through the intro and the thank you

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How long have you been playing the accordion?
lines.sk: Odkedy hráte na harmonike?
lines.heard: How long have you been playing the accordion?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: Since I was ten. My father gave it to me so I wouldn’t run around outside.
lines.sk: Od desiatich rokov. Otec mi ju dal, aby som nebehal vonku.
lines.heard: Since I was ten. My father gave it to me so I wouldn't run around outside

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did it work?
lines.sk: A pomohlo to?
lines.heard: And did it work?

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: No. I ran around outside with the accordion.
lines.sk: Nie. Behal som vonku s harmonikou.
lines.heard: No, I ran around outside with the accordion

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A repair shop. Here broken things still get mended, not thrown away.
lines.sk: Opravovňa. Tu sa pokazené veci ešte opravujú, nie vyhadzujú.
lines.heard: A repair shop. Here, broken things still get mended, not thrown away

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi. Are you Paulie? I need a drive belt for the school tape recorder.
lines.sk: Ahoj. Ty si Pali? Potreboval by som remienok do školského magnetofónu.
lines.heard: Hi, are you poorly? I need a drive belt for the school tape recorder

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: I’m Paulie. And the tape recorder was still playing this morning, right? Everyone tells me that.
lines.sk: Ja som Pali. A magnetofón ešte ráno hral, však? To mi tu hovorí každý.
lines.heard: I'm Paulie and the tape recorder was still playing this morning, right? Everyone tells me that.

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Let’s see. I know this size – here’s a new one. The old one goes in the bin.
lines.sk: Ukáž. Tento rozmer poznám, tu máš nový. Starý už ide do koša.
lines.heard: Let's see. I know this size. Here's a new one. The old one goes in the bin

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do I owe you?
lines.sk: Koľko ti dlžím?
lines.heard: What do I owe you?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Nothing, it’s for the school. You pay me by making that PA work.
lines.sk: Nič, je to pre školu. Zaplatíš tým, že ten rozhlas bude hrať.
lines.heard: Nothing. It's for the school. You pay me by making that PA work

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’ll work. I can’t vouch for what it announces.
lines.sk: Hrať bude. Za to, čo bude hlásiť, už neručím.
lines.heard: It'll work. I can't vouch for what it announces

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Nobody vouches for the content. We vouch for people being able to hear it.
lines.sk: Za obsah neručí nikto. My ručíme za to, že to bude počuť.
lines.heard: Nobody vouches for the content we vouch for people being able to hear it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One more thing. Have you got a trick for belts?
lines.sk: Ešte jedna vec. Máš na remienky nejaký trik?
lines.heard: One more thing. Have you got a trick for belts?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: I have. Don’t touch them with greasy fingers. I’ve been telling everyone that for twenty years and nobody listens.
lines.sk: Mám. Nechytaj ho mastnými prstami. Hovorím to každému dvadsať rokov a nikto to nedodrží.
lines.heard: I have. Don't touch them with greasy fingers. I've been telling everyone that for twenty years and nobody listens

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: And if the fault turns out to be in the tape, not the belt, don’t come to me. I don’t repair tapes, I only ruin them.
lines.sk: A keby bola chyba v páske, nie v remienku, za mnou nechoď. Pásky neopravujem, tie len kazím.
lines.heard: And if the fault turns out to be in the tape, not the belt, don't come to me. I don't repair tapes. I only ruin them.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then who do I go to?
lines.sk: A za kým?
lines.heard: Then who do I go to?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Jerry, at the cassette club in Ruzinov. He works magic with tapes – they don’t call him Jerry Cassette for nothing.
lines.sk: Za Jurom do kazetového klubu v Ružinove. S páskami čaruje, nie nadarmo mu hovoria Juro Kazeta.
lines.heard: Jerry at the cassette club in Ruzhenov. He works magic with tapes. They don't call him Jerry Cassette for nothing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What sort of guarantee do you give?
lines.sk: Akú dávaš záruku?
lines.heard: What sort of guarantee do you give?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: That I’ll tell you the truth when a repair isn’t worth it.
lines.sk: Že ti poviem pravdu, keď sa oprava neoplatí.
lines.heard: That I'll tell you the truth when a repair isn't worth it.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many people have you told that today?
lines.sk: A koľkým si to dnes povedal?
lines.heard: And how many people have you told that today?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Two. Both left annoyed, and one came back with something better to repair.
lines.sk: Dvom. Obaja odišli nahnevaní a jeden sa vrátil s lepšou vecou na opravu.
lines.heard: Two. Both left annoyed and one came back with something better to repair.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So honesty pays.
lines.sk: Takže úprimnosť sa oplatí.
lines.heard: So honesty pays

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: It pays. Just not straight away.
lines.sk: Oplatí. Len nie hneď.
lines.heard: It pays just not straight away

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: It’ll get smaller. But screws won’t disappear.
lines.sk: Bude menšia. Ale skrutky nezmiznú.
lines.heard: It will get smaller, but screws won't disappear

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Some will hide under glue.
lines.sk: Niektoré sa schovajú pod lepidlo.
lines.heard: Some will hide under glue

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: We don’t use words like that in here.
lines.sk: Také slová sa tu nehovoria.
lines.heard: We don't use words like that in here

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sorry. It hasn’t happened yet.
lines.sk: Prepáč. Ešte sa to nestalo.
lines.heard: Sorry, it hasn't happened yet

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: And I hope it never does. Glue belongs in a stationer’s, not a repair shop.
lines.sk: A dúfam, že sa ani nestane. Lepidlo patrí do papiernictva, nie do opravovne.
lines.heard: And I hope it never does Glue belongs in a stationers not a repair shop

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What was your worst repair?
lines.sk: Aká bola tvoja najhoršia oprava?
lines.heard: What was your worst repair?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: A radio that only picked up one station. The customer swore it was working yesterday.
lines.sk: Rádio, čo chytalo len jednu stanicu. Zákazník prisahal, že včera to ešte išlo.
lines.heard: A radio that only picked up one station. The customer swore it was working yesterday.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what was wrong with it?
lines.sk: A čo mu bolo?
lines.heard: And what was wrong with it?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Nothing. His dog had eaten the tuning knob.
lines.sk: Nič. Ladiaci gombík mu zjedol pes.
lines.heard: Nothing. His dog had eaten the tuning knob

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And that station?
lines.sk: A tá stanica?
lines.heard: And that station?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: He still listens to it. Says he’s got used to it.
lines.sk: Počúva ju dodnes. Vraj si zvykol.
lines.heard: He still listens to it says he's got used to it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many drive belts have you actually got here?
lines.sk: Koľko remienkov tu vlastne máš?
lines.heard: How many drive belts have you actually got here?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: Three drawers. Round ones, flat ones and the ones that look like hair ties.
lines.sk: Tri zásuvky. Okrúhle, ploché a tie, čo vyzerajú ako gumička do vlasov.
lines.heard: Three drawers, round ones, flat ones, and the ones that look like hair ties

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And can you tell them apart?
lines.sk: A rozoznáš ich?
lines.heard: And can you tell them apart?

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: I can. My daughter once took one for her plait and stretched it. The neighbour’s tape recorder sang bass with it afterwards.
lines.sk: Ja áno. Dcéra si raz jeden zobrala do copu a vyťahala ho. Susedov magnetofón s ním potom spieval basom.
lines.heard: I can. My daughter once took one for her plait and stretched it. The neighbor's tape recorder sang bass with it afterwards

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The city centre. Everyone is rushing somewhere. I’m the only one who’s twenty-five years late.
lines.sk: Centrum. Všetci sa niekam ponáhľajú. Ja jediný meškám o dvadsaťpäť rokov.
lines.heard: The city centre. Everyone is rushing somewhere. I'm the only one who's 25 years late

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mileticka market. Here I can find every component, and a stallholder who asks what I want it for.
lines.sk: Miletička. Tu nájdem každú súčiastku aj predavača, ktorý sa spýta, načo mi je.
lines.heard: Militićka Market. Here I can find every component and a stall holder who asks what I want it for

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. Jerry sent me – he says you’ve got a two-pin connector.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Posiela ma Juro, vraj máte dvojpólový konektor.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. Jerry sent me. He says you've got a two-pin connector

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: I’ve got everything. Only my scales have stopped, so today I’m selling by eye.
lines.sk: Mám všetko. Len váha mi stojí, tak dnes predávam od oka.
lines.heard: I've got everything. Only my scales have stopped, so today I'm selling by eye

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: My scales have jammed. Pliers would do it, but my fingers are too big for that.
lines.sk: Váha sa mi zasekla. Klieštikmi by to šlo, ale na to mám priveľké prsty.
lines.heard: My scales have jammed. Pliers would do it, but my fingers are too big for that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You just need to pull the washer out of the groove. There. Done.
lines.sk: Stačí vytiahnuť podložku z drážky. Tak. Hotovo.
lines.heard: You just need to pull the washer out of the groove. There, done

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Two days I’ve been cursing them, and you fix them before I can say pliers.
lines.sk: Dva dni na ňu nadávam a ty ju opravíš skôr, ako poviem klieštiky.
lines.heard: Two days I've been cursing them and you fix them before I can say pliers

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: For that you get a two-pin connector. Jerry already told me it’s for the school.
lines.sk: Za to máš dvojpólový konektor. Juro mi už hovoril, že je to pre školu.
lines.heard: For that, you get a two-pin connector. Jerry already told me it's for the school

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Jerry’s already rung you?
lines.sk: Juro vám už stihol zavolať?
lines.heard: Jerry's already rung you?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Rung me? He was here this morning for batteries and told me the whole story.
lines.sk: Zavolať? Ráno tu bol po batérie a všetko mi vyrozprával.
lines.heard: Rung me? He was here this morning for batteries and told me the whole story

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: And just so you know, the connector’s original. Just from a different manufacturer.
lines.sk: A keby niečo, konektor je originál. Len od iného výrobcu.
lines.heard: And just so you know, the connector's original, just from a different manufacturer

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Original? Everything here’s original. Just not always from the same manufacturer.
lines.sk: Originál? Tu je všetko originál. Len nie vždy od toho istého výrobcu.
lines.heard: Original? Everything here is original. Just not always from the same manufacturer

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the guarantee?
lines.sk: A záruka?
lines.heard: And the guarantee?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: The guarantee is that you’ll find me here. Every day except Sundays, and except when it rains.
lines.sk: Záruka je, že ma tu nájdeš. Každý deň okrem nedele a okrem dažďa.
lines.heard: The guarantee is that you'll find me here every day except Sundays and except when it rains

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when it rains on a Sunday?
lines.sk: A keď prší v nedeľu?
lines.heard: And when it rains on a Sunday?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Then you’re out of luck twice. But your connector will work all the same.
lines.sk: Tak to máš smolu dvakrát. Ale konektor ti aj tak bude fungovať.
lines.heard: then you're outta luck twice but your connector will work all the same

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Depends how badly you need them. But we’ll help the school PA.
lines.sk: Záleží, ako veľmi ich človek potrebuje. Ale školskému rozhlasu pomôžeme.
lines.heard: Depends how badly you need 'em. But we'll help the school PA

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even if it ends up announcing tests?
lines.sk: Aj keď bude potom oznamovať písomky?
lines.heard: Even if it ends up announcing tests

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Tests it can announce quietly. Buns, loudly.
lines.sk: Písomky nech oznamuje potichu. Buchty nahlas.
lines.heard: Tests it can announce quietly. Buns loudly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Buns?
lines.sk: Buchty?
lines.heard: Buns?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: My daughter goes there. It’s the only announcement she remembers all the way through.
lines.sk: Moja dcéra tam chodí. Je to jediné hlásenie, ktoré si zapamätá celé.
lines.heard: My daughter goes there. It's the only announcement she remembers all the way through

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What sells best at Mileticka?
lines.sk: Čo sa na Miletičke predáva najlepšie?
lines.heard: What sells best at Meletica?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Sunglasses in summer, gloves in winter and batteries all year round.
lines.sk: V lete slnečné okuliare, v zime rukavice a celý rok batérie.
lines.heard: Sunglasses in summer, gloves in winter, and batteries all year round

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Batteries?
lines.sk: Batérie?
lines.heard: Batteries

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: Walkmans eat batteries like kids eat sweets. I just keep the stocks up.
lines.sk: Walkmany žerú batérie ako deti cukríky. Ja len dopĺňam zásoby.
lines.heard: Walkmans eat batteries like kids eat sweets. I just keep the stocks up

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How are your scales working?
lines.sk: Ako vám funguje váha?
lines.heard: How are your scales working?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: They weigh accurately. So accurately that my customers are suspicious of me.
lines.sk: Váži presne. Až tak presne, že ma zákazníčky podozrievajú.
lines.heard: They weigh accurately, so accurately that my customers are suspicious of me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Suspicious of what?
lines.sk: Z čoho?
lines.heard: Suspicious of what?

lines.speaker: FERO
lines.text: That I had them fixed. Before, they always gave them a little extra.
lines.sk: Že som ju opravil. Predtým im vždy kúsok pridala.
lines.heard: that I had 'em fixed. Before, they always gave 'em a little extra

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The club has three rules: don’t kick the speakers, don’t touch the tape, and don’t say everything hisses.
lines.sk: Klub má tri pravidlá: nekopať do bední, nechytať pásku a nehovoriť, že všetko šumí.
lines.heard: The club has three rules don't kick the speakers don't touch the tape and don't say everything hisses

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi. You must be Jerry. I need you to listen to this cassette.
lines.sk: Ahoj. Ty budeš Juro. Potrebujem, aby si si vypočul túto kazetu.
lines.heard: Hi, you must be Jerry. I need you to listen to this cassette

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Jerry Cassette, that’s me. Hand it over, but hold it by the case, not the tape. Tape remembers every finger.
lines.sk: Juro Kazeta, to som ja. Podaj mi ju, ale drž ju za puzdro, nie za pásku. Páska si pamätá každý prst.
lines.heard: Jerry Cassette. That's me. Hand it over, but hold it by the case, not the tape. Tape remembers every finger

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: The recording’s there; it’s just that two tracks are working against each other. Mira recorded it through some odd set-up, didn’t she?
lines.sk: Nahrávka tam je, len dve stopy idú proti sebe. Mira nahrávala cez nejakú zvláštnu zostavu, však?
lines.heard: The recording's there. It's just that two tracks are working against each other. Mira recorded it through some odd setup, didn't she?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Probably. Everything’s odd today.
lines.sk: Asi áno. Dnes je zvláštne úplne všetko.
lines.heard: Probably. Everything's odd today

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Here’s a cross adaptor. It’s missing a connector and insulation: Frank at the market has the connector, Mildred next to the market has the sleeve.
lines.sk: Tu máš krížový adaptér. Chýba mu konektor a izolácia: konektor má Fero na trhu, návlek Milada vedľa trhu.
