lines.heard: Here's a cross adapter. It's missing a connector and insulation. Frank at the market has the connector. Mildred next to the market has the sleeve

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Frank and Mildred. Will they know what it’s about?
lines.sk: Fero a Milada. Budú vedieť, o čo ide?
lines.heard: Frank and Mildred? Will they know what it's about?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Frank sold me my first Walkman, and Mildred sewed up my headphone cable. Tell them I sent you.
lines.sk: Fero mi predal prvý walkman a Milada mi obšila kábel od slúchadiel. Povedz, že ťa posielam ja.
lines.heard: Frank sold me my first Walkman and Mildred sewed up my headphone cable. Tell them I sent you.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So we’re not re-recording anything.
lines.sk: Takže nič nenahrávame znova.
lines.heard: So we're not re-recording anything

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Exactly. The voices are there; we just mustn’t silence them with the wrong wiring.
lines.sk: Presne. Hlasy tam sú, len ich nesmieme umlčať zlým zapojením.
lines.heard: Exactly. The voices are there. We just mustn't silence them with the wrong wiring

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: You can overwrite anything. But whatever you overwrite, you never hear again.
lines.sk: Prepísať sa dá hocičo. Ale čo raz prepíšeš, to už nikdy nepočuješ.
lines.heard: You can overwrite anything, but whatever you overwrite, you never hear again

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: They have a side A and a side B. At least they admit there are two sides to everything.
lines.sk: Majú stranu A aj B. Aspoň priznajú, že sa na vec dá pozrieť z dvoch strán.
lines.heard: They have a side A and a side B. At least they admit there are two sides to everything

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’ll come in handy today.
lines.sk: To sa mi dnes bude hodiť.
lines.heard: That'll come in handy today

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: And when the tape gets tangled, a pencil’s all you need. Don’t try that with other technology.
lines.sk: A keď sa páska zamotá, stačí ceruzka. To pri inej technike neskúšaj.
lines.heard: And when the tape gets tangled, a pencil's all you need. Don't try that with other technology

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Like what?
lines.sk: Pri čom napríklad?
lines.heard: Like what?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: A record. Take a pencil to that and you’ll scratch the whole of side A.
lines.sk: Pri platni. Tam ceruzkou poškriabeš celú stranu A.
lines.heard: A record? Take a pencil to that and you'll scratch the whole of side A

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: A bit of hiss doesn’t matter. What matters is throwing away a whole song because of it.
lines.sk: Trochu šumu nevadí. Vadí, keď kvôli nemu zahodíš celú pesničku.
lines.heard: A bit of hiss doesn't matter. What matters is throwing away a whole song because of it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll remember that. One day I’ll need to tell someone.
lines.sk: To si zapamätám. Raz to budem niekomu potrebovať povedať.
lines.heard: I'll remember that. One day I'll need to tell someone

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Then play them the song first. Maybe they’ll start humming along and forget the hiss.
lines.sk: Tak mu najprv pusti tú pesničku. Možno si začne pospevovať a na šum zabudne.
lines.heard: Then play them the song first. Maybe they'll start humming along and forget the hiss

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which is your best cassette?
lines.sk: Ktorá je tvoja najlepšia kazeta?
lines.heard: Which is your best cassette?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: The one without a label. One night in ninety-three I recorded the radio on it, and to this day I don’t know what’s on it.
lines.sk: Tá bez nálepky. Jednu noc v roku deväťdesiattri som na ňu nahral rádio a dodnes neviem, čo tam hrá.
lines.heard: The one without a label. One night in '93, I recorded the radio on it, and to this day, I don't know what's on it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why don’t you find out what’s on it and label it?
lines.sk: Prečo nezistíš, čo tam hrá, a neoznačíš ju?
lines.heard: Why don't you find out what's on it and label it?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Because if I knew what was on it, I’d stop listening to it. This way it still tempts me.
lines.sk: Lebo keby som vedel, čo tam hrá, prestal by som ju počúvať. Takto ma to stále láka.
lines.heard: Because if I knew what was on it, I'd stop listening to it. This way, it still tempts me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why is the club in the basement?
lines.sk: Prečo je klub práve v suteréne?
lines.heard: Why is the club in the basement?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Because you can’t hear the trams down here. And the neighbours can’t hear us.
lines.sk: Lebo sem nedočuť električky. A susedia zase nepočujú nás.
lines.heard: Because you can't hear the trams down here and the neighbors can't hear us

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Some sort of agreement?
lines.sk: Taká dohoda?
lines.heard: Some sort of agreement?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: More of a ceasefire. An agreement would be if we’d ever talked about it on the stairs.
lines.sk: Skôr prímerie. Dohoda by bola, keby sme sa o tom niekedy porozprávali na schodoch.
lines.heard: More of a ceasefire. An agreement would be if we'd ever talked about it on the stairs

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A tailor’s. They rescue trousers here, and wedding dresses at the last minute.
lines.sk: Krajčírstvo. Tu sa zachraňujú nohavice aj svadobné šaty na poslednú chvíľu.
lines.heard: A tailor's. They rescue trousers here and wedding dresses at the last minute

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon, Mrs Sowerby. Jerry from the cassette club sent me.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň, pani Kyselová. Posiela ma Juro z kazetového klubu.
lines.heard: Good afternoon, Mrs. Sowerby. Jerry from the cassette club sent me

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Jerry? Then it’ll be a cable. Jerry only ever brings me cables. Once he brought a jacket, but that was a mistake.
lines.sk: Juro? Tak to bude kábel. Juro mi nosí len káble. Raz priniesol aj jednu bundu, ale tá bola omyl.
lines.heard: Jerry? Then it'll be a cable. Jerry only ever brings me cables Once, he brought a jacket, but that was a mistake

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Would you have a bit of insulating sleeve? For an audio cable for the school PA.
lines.sk: Nemali by ste kúsok izolačného návleku? Na zvukový kábel pre školský rozhlas.
lines.heard: Would you have a bit of insulating sleeve for an audio cable for the school PA?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Here’s an offcut of cloth insulation, just right for cables like that. Connect it first, then pull it on. Like a coat.
lines.sk: Tu je odrezok textilnej izolácie, presne na také káble. Najprv zapojte, až potom navlečte. Ako pri kabáte.
lines.heard: Here's an offcut of cloth insulation just right for cables like that connect it first, then pull it on like a coat

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Arms in the sleeves first, then the buttons. I’ll remember that.
lines.sk: Najprv ruky do rukávov, potom gombíky. Zapamätám si.
lines.heard: Arms in the sleeves first, then the buttons. I'll remember that

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: And don’t force it on. Whatever you force on comes apart later.
lines.sk: A nenaťahujte ho nasilu. Čo sa natiahne nasilu, to sa potom pára.
lines.heard: And don't force it on. Whatever you force on comes apart later

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Does that go for cables too?
lines.sk: Platí to aj o kábloch?
lines.heard: Does that go for cables too?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: For cables most of all. So promise me you won’t yank it.
lines.sk: Hlavne o kábloch. Tak mi sľúbte, že ho nebudete ťahať.
lines.heard: For cables most of all. So promise me you won't yank it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The markings line up, the contacts click into place. The leads are still bare.
lines.sk: Značky sedia, kontakty zacvakli. Vývody sú ešte holé.
lines.heard: The markings line up, the contacts click into place. The leads are still bare

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Firm, covered, no bare leads. Arms in the sleeves, buttons done up.
lines.sk: Pevné, zakryté, žiadne holé vývody. Ruky v rukávoch, gombíky zapnuté.
lines.heard: Firm, covered, no bare leads. Arms in the sleeves, buttons done up

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: The phrase ‘it’s always been like that’.
lines.sk: Vetu „vždy to tak bolo“.
lines.heard: The phrase it's always been like that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that one. Today more than ever.
lines.sk: To poznám. Dnes viac ako inokedy.
lines.heard: I know that one. Today more than ever

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: With a coat, you just unpick and sew. With a phrase like that, you first have to convince whoever’s wearing it.
lines.sk: Pri kabáte stačí párať a šiť. Pri takej vete treba najprv presvedčiť toho, kto ju nosí.
lines.heard: With a coat, you just unpick and sew with a phrase like that, you first have to convince whoever's wearing it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do you manage it?
lines.sk: A podarí sa to?
lines.heard: And do you manage it?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Now and then. Usually when the coat starts getting tight on them.
lines.sk: Raz za čas. Zvyčajne vtedy, keď mu ten kabát začne byť tesný.
lines.heard: Now and then usually when the coat starts getting tight on them

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: A cable needs a good coat too.
lines.sk: Aj kábel potrebuje dobrý kabát.
lines.heard: A cable needs a good coat too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Especially when it doesn’t want to touch the others.
lines.sk: Najmä keď sa nechce dotýkať ostatných.
lines.heard: Especially when it doesn't want to touch the others

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: The first cable I sewed a cover for was a neighbour’s guitar lead. The guitar still plays; the neighbour learned two chords.
lines.sk: Prvý kábel som obšila susedovi na gitaru. Gitara hrá dodnes, sused sa naučil dva akordy.
lines.heard: The first cable I sewed a cover for was a neighbor's guitar lead. The guitar still plays. The neighbor learned two chords

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Two chords will get you through half the songs there are.
lines.sk: Dva akordy stačia na polovicu pesničiek.
lines.heard: Two chords will get you through half the songs there are

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: He tells me that under my window every summer.
lines.sk: To mi hovorí každé leto pod oknom.
lines.heard: He tells me that under my window every summer

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How long have you had your shop in Ruzinov?
lines.sk: Ako dlho máte opravovňu v Ružinove?
lines.heard: How long have you had your shop in Ruzynov?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Eighteen years. First I mended trousers; now I mend decisions made at the market too.
lines.sk: Osemnásť rokov. Najprv som opravovala nohavice, teraz aj rozhodnutia z trhu.
lines.heard: 18 years. First, I mended trousers. Now I mend decisions made at the market too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Decisions?
lines.sk: Rozhodnutia?
lines.heard: Decisions?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: At Mileticka everyone buys trousers a size too small, because they were cheaper. Then they come to me.
lines.sk: Na Miletičke si každý kúpi nohavice o číslo menšie, lebo boli lacnejšie. Potom príde ku mne.
lines.heard: At Militichka, everyone buys trousers a size too small because they were cheaper. Then they come to me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who comes to you most often?
lines.sk: Kto k vám chodí najčastejšie?
lines.heard: Who comes to you most often?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Mums, just before the end of the school year. In June every pair of trousers rips.
lines.sk: Mamy pred koncom školského roka. V júni sa trhajú všetky nohavice.
lines.heard: Mums, just before the end of the school year, in June, every pair of trousers rips

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why June?
lines.sk: Prečo práve v júni?
lines.heard: Why June?

lines.speaker: MILADA
lines.text: Because in June children climb trees. In September they’re back sitting at their desks.
lines.sk: Lebo v júni sa lezie na stromy. V septembri sa už sedí v laviciach.
lines.heard: Because in June, children climb trees in September, they're back sitting at their desks

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The reading room. People whisper, turn pages and nobody hurries. Nor will I.
lines.sk: Študovňa. Tu sa šepká, listuje a nikto sa neponáhľa. Ani ja nebudem.
lines.heard: The reading room People whisper, turn pages and nobody hurries Nor will I

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon! I’ve come about Mrs Perry’s collection.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň! Prišiel som kvôli fondu pani Hruškovej.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I've come about Mrs. Perry's collection

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Good afternoon. Quietly, please. Here even greetings are whispered.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Potichu, prosím. U nás sa aj pozdrav hovorí šeptom.
lines.heard: Good afternoon quietly, please here even greetings are whispered

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sorry. I have a letter of authority for you.
lines.sk: Prepáčte. Mám pre vás poverenie.
lines.heard: Sorry, I have a letter of authority for you

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: The letter is in order. Here’s a copy of the map and the technical negative that was filed with it.
lines.sk: Poverenie je v poriadku. Tu je kópia mapy a technický negatív, ktorý bol uložený pri nej.
lines.heard: The letter is in order. Here's a copy of the map and the technical negative that was filed with it

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: The originals stay in the reading room. You may take the copies away – and crumple them, if you really must.
lines.sk: Originály zostávajú v študovni. Kópie si môžete odniesť aj pokrčiť, ak už musíte.
lines.heard: The originals stay in the reading room. You may take the copies away and crumple them if you really must

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There are blank areas on the map.
lines.sk: Na mape sú prázdne miesta.
lines.heard: There are blank areas on the map

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: A transparent overlay was separated from it at some point. You’ll see its number on a print from the negative. The studio is across the square.
lines.sk: Priehľadnú fóliu od nej kedysi oddelili. Jej číslo uvidíte na fotografii z negatívu. Ateliér je cez námestie.
lines.heard: A transparent overlay was separated from it at some point. You'll see its number on a print from the negative. The studio is across the square

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An archive is like a repair shop. Something’s always missing.
lines.sk: Archív je ako servis. Vždy niečo chýba.
lines.heard: An archive is like a repair shop. Something's always missing

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Usually a small part. And that tends to be the most important one, which is why I keep a separate card index for small parts.
lines.sk: Zvyčajne malý diel. A ten býva najdôležitejší, preto mám na malé diely zvláštnu kartotéku.
lines.heard: Usually a small part, and that tends to be the most important one, which is why I keep a separate card index for small parts

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Take the negative to the Light studio, to Mrs Elaine Freeman. She’ll make you a print and won’t shout while she does it.
lines.sk: S negatívom choďte do ateliéru Svetlo za pani Alenou Svobodovou. Spraví vám pozitív a nebude pri tom kričať.
lines.heard: Take the negative to the light studio, to Mrs. Elaine Freeman. She'll make you a print and won't shout while she does it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. And sorry about the loud greeting.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. A prepáčte za ten hlasný pozdrav.
lines.heard: Thank you, and sorry about the loud greeting

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: I’ve made a note of it. As an exception.
lines.sk: Zapísal som si ho. Ako výnimku.
lines.heard: I've made a note of it as an exception

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: That depends on their value.
lines.sk: Podľa toho, akú majú hodnotu.
lines.heard: That depends on their value.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when the value only shows later?
lines.sk: A keď sa hodnota ukáže až neskôr?
lines.heard: And when the value only shows later?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: That’s why I never throw anything away prematurely.
lines.sk: Preto nič nevyhadzujem predčasne.
lines.heard: That's why I never throw anything away prematurely.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when is the right time?
lines.sk: A kedy je ten správny čas?
lines.heard: And when is the right time?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: It hasn’t come yet. The reading room is twenty-two years old, and the bin is still new.
lines.sk: Ten ešte nenastal. Študovňa má dvadsaťdva rokov a kôš je stále nový.
lines.heard: It hasn't come yet. The reading room is twenty-two years old, and the bin is still new

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s beautifully quiet in here.
lines.sk: Je tu krásne ticho.
lines.heard: It's beautifully quiet in here

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Please don’t comment on it out loud.
lines.sk: Prosím, nehodnoťte ho nahlas.
lines.heard: Please don't comment on it out loud

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sorry. Is whispering allowed?
lines.sk: Prepáčte. A šepkať sa smie?
lines.heard: Sorry, is whispering aloud?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Whispering, yes. Sighing over your notes, no. That’s the most disturbing thing of all.
lines.sk: Šepkať áno. Vzdychať nad poznámkami nie. To ruší najviac.
lines.heard: Whispering, yes. Sighing over your notes, no. That's the most disturbing thing of all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the strangest thing anyone has ever donated to you?
lines.sk: Čo je najzvláštnejšie, čo vám kto daroval?
lines.heard: What's the strangest thing anyone has ever donated to you?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: A box of buttons and a note: ‘From the coats of our street, 1948 to 1990.’
lines.sk: Krabica gombíkov a lístok: „Z kabátov našej ulice, 1948 až 1990.“
lines.heard: A box of buttons and a note from the coats of our street, 1948 to 1990.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you catalogue it?
lines.sk: A zaevidovali ste ju?
lines.heard: And did you catalog it?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Every button separately. It took the whole winter.
lines.sk: Každý gombík zvlášť. Trvalo to celú zimu.
lines.heard: Every button separately. It took the whole winter

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What does an archive want with a box of buttons?
lines.sk: Načo je archívu krabica gombíkov?
lines.heard: What does an archive want with a box of buttons?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Buttons tell you what coats people wore on our street. You won’t find that in any document.
lines.sk: Gombíky povedia, aké kabáty sa na našej ulici nosili. To v žiadnom dokumente nenájdete.
lines.heard: Buttons tell you what coats people wore on our street. You won't find that in any document

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Can I borrow anything from here to take home?
lines.sk: Môžem si odtiaľto niečo požičať domov?
lines.heard: Can I borrow anything from here to take home?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: The lending rules, article three: originals do not leave the reading room. Copies do.
lines.sk: Výpožičný poriadok, článok tri: originály študovňu neopúšťajú. Kópie áno.
lines.heard: The lending rules. Article three. Originals do not leave the reading room. Copies do

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if I lose a copy?
lines.sk: A keď kópiu stratím?
lines.heard: And if I lose a copy?

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: We make a new one. That’s exactly what a copy is for – being lost.
lines.sk: Spravíme novú. Kópia je presne na to, aby sa dala stratiť.
lines.heard: We make a new one. That's exactly what a copy is for, being lost

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So an original must never be lost.
lines.sk: Takže originál sa nesmie stratiť nikdy.
lines.heard: So an original must never be lost

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Never. That’s why I don’t even lend it to myself.
lines.sk: Nikdy. Preto ho nepožičiavam ani sám sebe.
lines.heard: Never. That's why I don't even lend it to myself

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Here photos are still developed. The people in them look as if they spent ages getting ready for the picture.
lines.sk: Fotky sa tu ešte vyvolávajú. Ľudia na nich vyzerajú, akoby sa na fotenie dlho pripravovali.
lines.heard: Here, photos are still developed. The people in them look as if they spent ages getting ready for the picture

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. The archive sent me with this negative.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Z archívu ma posielajú s týmto negatívom.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. The archive sent me with this negative

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Good afternoon. Mr Merton already rang me. He said you’d come, and quietly.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Pán Merta mi už volal. Vraj prídete a vraj potichu.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. Mr. Merton already rang me. He said you'd come, and quietly

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: A technical shot, not a private photo. Mrs Perry agreed to it being developed when she deposited it.
lines.sk: Technický záber, nie súkromná fotka. Pani Hrušková s vyvolaním súhlasila už pri uložení.
lines.heard: A technical shot, not a private photo. Mrs. Perry agreed to it being developed when she deposited it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There’s a table with a label in the shot. I need to read it.
lines.sk: Na zábere je stôl s označením. To potrebujem prečítať.
lines.heard: There's a table with a label in the shop. I need to read it

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Then wait a moment. Developing can’t be hurried.
lines.sk: Tak chvíľu počkajte. Vyvolávanie sa nedá uponáhľať.
lines.heard: Then wait a moment. Developing can't be hurried

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Here’s the print. The number on the table is K-17. Faith at the second-hand bookshop has the map supplements. The negative goes back to the archive.
lines.sk: Tu je pozitív. Na stole je číslo K-17. Mapové prílohy má Viera v antikvariáte. Negatív vrátim archívu.
lines.heard: Here's the print. The number on the table is K seventeen. Faith at the secondhand bookshop has the map supplements. The negative goes back to the archive

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. At home I’d just zoom in on my phone. Here you need an entire darkroom for it.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Doma by som si to len priblížil v telefóne. Tu na to treba celú temnú komoru.
lines.heard: Thank you. At home, I just zoom in on my phone. Here, you need an entire dark room for it

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: On your phone? Phones are for ringing people. Photos are taken with light – that’s why we’re called Light.
lines.sk: V telefóne? Telefónom sa volá. Fotí sa svetlom, preto sme Svetlo.
lines.heard: On your phone? Phones are for ringing people Photos are taken with light That's why we're called Light

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One more envelope. A school one this time.
lines.sk: Ešte jedna obálka. Tentoraz školská.
lines.heard: One more envelope. A school one this time

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: At last. I spent two weeks looking for it before I found out Rita had it.
lines.sk: Konečne. Hľadala som ju dva týždne, kým som zistila, že je u Zity.
lines.heard: At last. I spent two weeks looking for it before I found out Rita had it

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: A school order, approved and paid for. Here’s the photo for the album; I’ll keep the negative in the envelope.
lines.sk: Školská zákazka, schválená aj zaplatená. Tu je fotka do albumu, negatív si nechám v obálke.
lines.heard: A school order, approved and paid for. Here's the photo for the album. I'll keep the negative in the envelope

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That boy at the back…
lines.sk: Ten chlapec vzadu…
lines.heard: That boy at the back

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: He’s looking the other way. But at least he looks natural.
lines.sk: Pozerá inam. Ale aspoň vyzerá prirodzene.
lines.heard: He's looking the other way but at least he looks natural

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: He never grew out of it.
lines.sk: To mu zostalo.
lines.heard: He never grew out of it

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Do you know him?
lines.sk: Poznáte ho?
lines.heard: Do you know him?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: By sight. Mostly in the mirror.
lines.sk: Z videnia. Hlavne v zrkadle.
lines.heard: By sight, mostly in the mirror

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Yes, there’s a likeness. Especially in the way you both look the other way.
lines.sk: Áno, podoba tam je. Hlavne v tom, ako sa pozeráte inam.
lines.heard: Yes, there's a likeness especially in the way you both look the other way

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How long will it take?
lines.sk: Ako dlho to bude trvať?
lines.heard: How long will it take?

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: I’ll develop a technical shot straight away. Please wait at the dry counter.
lines.sk: Technický záber vyvolám hneď. Počkajte, prosím, pri suchom pulte.
lines.heard: I'll develop a technical shot straight away. Please wait at the dry counter

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The dry counter? So you don’t wait at the wet one?
lines.sk: Pri suchom pulte? Takže pri mokrom sa nečaká?
lines.heard: The dry counter so you don't wait at the wet one?

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: At the wet one you don’t wait, you soak. And anyone who waits there smells of fixer for a week.
lines.sk: Pri mokrom sa nečaká, tam sa máča. A kto tam čaká, vonia potom ustaľovačom celý týždeň.
lines.heard: At The Wet One, you don't wait, you soak and anyone who waits there smells of fixer for a week

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: When people think I’ve stopped taking pictures.
lines.sk: Keď si ľudia myslia, že už nefotím.
lines.heard: When people think I've stopped taking pictures

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So that click at the end is just theatre.
lines.sk: Takže to cvaknutie na konci je len divadlo.
lines.heard: So that click at the end is just theater

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Theatre for the ones who smile on command. The others I photograph when they breathe out.
lines.sk: Divadlo pre tých, čo sa usmievajú na povel. Ostatných fotím, keď si vydýchnu.
lines.heard: Theater for the ones who smile on command the others I photograph when they breathe out

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even now?
lines.sk: Aj teraz?
lines.heard: Even now

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Even now, I would. Only the film for my camera doesn’t arrive until tomorrow.
lines.sk: Aj teraz by som. Len film do foťáka mi príde až zajtra.
lines.heard: Even now, I would, only the film for my camera doesn't arrive until tomorrow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How long can you stay in the darkroom?
lines.sk: Ako dlho vydržíte v temnej komore?
lines.heard: How long can you stay in the dark room?

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: All afternoon. I think better in the dark, because I can’t see the mess.
lines.sk: Celé popoludnie. Po tme sa mi lepšie rozmýšľa, lebo nevidím neporiadok.
lines.heard: All afternoon I think better in the dark because I can't see the mess

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you never have to look for anything in there?
lines.sk: A nič tam nehľadáte?
lines.heard: And you never have to look for anything in there

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: No. Everything is in its place. If someone moves something, I find out with my fingers.
lines.sk: Nie. Všetko je na svojom mieste. Keď mi niekto niečo posunie, zistím to prstami.
lines.heard: No, everything is in its place. If someone moves something, I find out with my fingers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you photograph school classes too?
lines.sk: Fotíte aj školské triedy?
lines.heard: Do you photograph school classes too?

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Every June. Thirty children, three rows, and always one who sneezes.
lines.sk: Každý jún. Tridsať detí, tri rady a vždy jeden, čo kýchne.
lines.heard: Every June 30 children, three rows, and always one who sneezes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do you do about him?
lines.sk: A čo s ním?
lines.heard: And what do you do about him?

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: I leave him be. Twenty years later, he’s the main reason everyone looks at that photo.
lines.sk: Nechám ho tak. Po dvadsiatich rokoch sa na takú fotku všetci pozerajú hlavne kvôli nemu.
lines.heard: I leave him be. Twenty years later, he's the main reason everyone looks at that photo

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Nothing gets thrown away here. Even the price tags have historical value.
lines.sk: Tu sa nič nevyhadzuje. Aj cenovky majú historickú hodnotu.
lines.heard: Nothing gets thrown away here. Even the price tags have historical value

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I’m looking for a map supplement. I’ve got a photo of it.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Hľadám jednu mapovú prílohu. Mám k nej fotografiu.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I'm looking for a, uh, map supplement. Uh, I've got a photo of it

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Supplements are harder to find than books. A book at least has a spine. Show me.
lines.sk: Prílohy sa hľadajú horšie ako knihy. Kniha má aspoň chrbát. Ukážte.
lines.heard: Supplements are harder to find than books. A book at least has a spine. Show me

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: K-17. I know that one. Mira told me that one day someone would come for it who knew the exact number.
lines.sk: K-17. Tú poznám. Mira mi povedala, že si po ňu raz príde niekto, kto bude vedieť presné číslo.
lines.heard: K17? I know that one. Mira told me that one day someone would come for it who knew the exact number

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: When did she tell you that?
lines.sk: Kedy vám to povedala?
lines.heard: When did she tell you that?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Many years ago. I won’t charge you storage. Here you are – the overlay.
lines.sk: Pred mnohými rokmi. Skladné vám neúčtujem. Nech sa páči, fólia.
lines.heard: Many years ago. I won't charge you storage. Here you are, the overlay

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Just don’t hold it in the middle. That overlay remembers fingerprints better than I remember faces.
lines.sk: Len ju nechytajte uprostred. Fólia si odtlačky pamätá lepšie ako ja tváre.
lines.heard: Just don't hold it in the middle. That overlay remembers fingerprints better than I remember faces

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three registration marks: a hole, a double cross and a square. They have to line up with the marks on the map.
lines.sk: Tri registračné značky: dierka, dvojitý kríž a štvorec. Musia sedieť so značkami na mape.
lines.heard: Three registration marks a hole, a double cross, and a square they have to line up with the marks on the map

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: You can lay it on the map right here at the counter.
lines.sk: Na mapu ju môžete priložiť hneď tu pri pulte.
lines.heard: You can lay it on the map right here at the counter

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The map is complete and it leads to Petrzalka: to a garage and to a measuring stand by the Danube.
lines.sk: Mapa je celá a vedie do Petržalky: k jednej garáži a k meraciemu stojanu pri Dunaji.
lines.heard: The map is complete and it leads to Petrzalka, to a garage and to a measuring stand by the Danube

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Under the key there’s Gran’s signature and another one: Desmond Smith, radio ham, garage 17.
lines.sk: Pod legendou je babkin podpis a druhý: Dezider Kováč, rádioamatér, garáž 17.
lines.heard: Under the key, there's Grand Signature and another one, Desmond Smith, Radio Ham, Garage 17

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A radio ham in a garage. After a reading room and a bookshop, finally somewhere you’re allowed to talk out loud.
lines.sk: Rádioamatér v garáži. Po študovni a antikvariáte konečne miesto, kde sa môže hovoriť nahlas.
lines.heard: A radio ham in a garage after a reading room and a bookshop. Finally, somewhere you're allowed to talk out loud

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Four Stops. I put it aside for the composer, so he’d finally come and collect it.
lines.sk: Štyri zastávky. Odložila som ich pre autora, nech sa po ne konečne zastaví.
lines.heard: Four stops. I put it aside for the composer so he'd finally come and collect it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: He’s standing at a stop right now. Hopefully that counts.
lines.sk: Práve stojí na zastávke. Snáď sa to počíta.
lines.heard: He's standing at a stop right now. Hopefully that counts

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: It counts. It was in a book about birds, between the woodpecker and the thrush.
lines.sk: Počíta sa. Ležali v knihe o vtákoch, medzi ďatľom a drozdom.
lines.heard: It counts. It was in a book about birds, between the woodpecker and the thrush

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Emil used his sheet music as bookmarks.
lines.sk: Emil si do kníh zakladal noty ako záložky.
lines.heard: Emil used his sheet music as bookmarks

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: An expensive bookmark. Most people leave a tram ticket.
lines.sk: Drahá záložka. Väčšina ľudí tam nechá lístok z električky.
lines.heard: An expensive bookmark. Most people leave a tram ticket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Have you got anything on time travel?
lines.sk: Máte niečo o cestovaní v čase?
lines.heard: Have you got anything on time travel?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Come back yesterday. I’ve just sold the last copy.
lines.sk: Príďte včera. Poslednú knihu som práve predala.
lines.heard: Come back yesterday. I've just sold the last copy

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Please, go easy with sentences like that today.
lines.sk: Prosím vás, dnes opatrne s takými vetami.
lines.heard: Please go easy with sentences like that today

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Why? Are you sensitive about yesterday?
lines.sk: Prečo? Ste citlivý na včerajšok?
lines.heard: Why? Are you sensitive about yesterday?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: More about tomorrow. I’ve already been through that.
lines.sk: Skôr na zajtrajšok. Ten mám už za sebou.
lines.heard: More about tomorrow? I've already been through that

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Then I’ll recommend something about gardening. Every year is the same there.
lines.sk: Tak vám odporučím niečo o záhradkárstve. Tam je každý rok rovnaký.
lines.heard: Then I'll recommend something about gardening. Every year's the same there

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: The book gets sold, the supplement gets lost. So I’d rather keep them apart.
lines.sk: Kniha sa predá, príloha sa stratí. Tak ich radšej držím oddelene.
lines.heard: The book gets sold, the supplement gets lost so I'd rather keep them apart.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And have you got a system for family photos too?
lines.sk: A na rodinné fotky máte tiež nejaký systém?
lines.heard: And have you got a system for family photos too?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: There’s only one system for family photos: write on the back who’s who.
lines.sk: Na rodinné fotky je jediný systém: napísať na zadnú stranu, kto je kto.
lines.heard: There's only one system for family photos. Write on the back who's who

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Otherwise in thirty years nobody knows which auntie is which.
lines.sk: Inak o tridsať rokov nikto nevie, ktorá teta je ktorá.
lines.heard: Otherwise in thirty years nobody knows which auntie is which

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Where do you get so many books from?
lines.sk: Odkiaľ máte toľko kníh?
lines.heard: Where do you get so many books from?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: From people who are moving house. After every move I have three more shelves and one less wall.
lines.sk: Od ľudí, čo sa sťahujú. Po každom sťahovaní mám o tri police viac a o jednu stenu menej.
lines.heard: From people who are moving house. After every move, I have three more shelves and one less wall

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do they sell most?
lines.sk: A čo predávajú najčastejšie?
lines.heard: And what do they sell most?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: Cookery books. In the new flat they discover they can cook without them.
lines.sk: Kuchárske knihy. V novom byte zistia, že sa dá variť aj bez nich.
lines.heard: Cookery books. In the new flat, they discover they can cook without them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the right way to hold an old book?
lines.sk: Ako sa správne drží stará kniha?
lines.heard: What's the right way to hold an old book?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: From underneath, like a kitten. Never by the spine.
lines.sk: Zospodu ako mačiatko. Nikdy nie za chrbát.
lines.heard: From underneath, like a kitten, never by the spine

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why not by the spine?
lines.sk: Prečo nie za chrbát?
lines.heard: Why not by the spine?

lines.speaker: VIERA
lines.text: That spine remembers more than the two of us. It needs looking after.
lines.sk: Ten chrbát pamätá viac ako my dvaja. Treba ho šetriť.
lines.heard: That spine remembers more than the two of us. It needs looking after

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An underpass with a good echo. Even three notes would sound like a concert here.
lines.sk: Podchod s dobrou ozvenou. Tu by aj tri tóny zneli ako koncert.
lines.heard: An underpass with a good echo even three notes would sound like a concert here

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: White chalk, for the windows. The panel belongs to the youth club and I have permission – I’ve just run out of white.
lines.sk: Biela krieda na okná. Panel patrí klubovni a povolenie mám, len biela mi došla.
lines.heard: White chalk for the windows. The panel belongs to the youth club and I have permission. I've just run out of white

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Wouldn’t another colour do?
lines.sk: Iná farba by nestačila?
lines.heard: Wouldn't another color do?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Yellow is a lamp, orange is a television. White is someone cooking supper in the kitchen. Nothing replaces that.
lines.sk: Žltá je lampa, oranžová televízor. Biela je, keď niekto v kuchyni varí večeru. Tú nič nenahradí.
lines.heard: Yellow is a lamp. Orange is a television. White is someone cooking supper in the kitchen. Nothing replaces that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What about the stationer’s?
lines.sk: A v papiernictve?
lines.heard: What about the stationers?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: They only have coloured ones. Apparently schools buy up the white by the box.
lines.sk: Majú len farebné. Bielu vraj berú školy po krabiciach.
lines.heard: They only have colored ones apparently schools buy up the white by the box.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll ask the caretaker at the school on Sokolikova.
lines.sk: V škole na Sokolíkovej sa spýtam školníka.
lines.heard: I'll ask the caretaker at the school on Sokolikova

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: But only with his permission, please. I don’t want the school to be short of anything because of me.
lines.sk: Ale len s jeho dovolením, prosím. Nechcem, aby kvôli mne v škole niečo chýbalo.
lines.heard: But only with his permission, please. I don't want the school to be short of anything because of me

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Here, here, and these two next to each other. Thank you.
lines.sk: Sem, sem a tieto dve vedľa seba. Ďakujem.
lines.heard: Here, here, and these two next to each other. Thank you

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why those two?
lines.sk: Prečo práve tieto dve?
lines.heard: Why those two?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Two brothers live there, and they argue across the balconies about who should switch the light on first.
lines.sk: Tam bývajú dvaja bratia, čo sa cez balkóny dohadujú, kto má rozsvietiť prvý.
lines.heard: Two brothers live there and they argue across the balconies about who should switch the light on first

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now it looks as if somebody really lives there.
lines.sk: Teraz to vyzerá, akoby tam naozaj niekto býval.
lines.heard: Now it looks as if somebody really lives there

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Exactly. It’s not just a picture of a block of flats any more.
lines.sk: Presne. Už to nie je len obrázok paneláka.
lines.heard: Exactly. It's not just a picture of a block of flats anymore

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Everyone looks at them from the outside. I draw the lights in the windows.
lines.sk: Každý sa na ne pozerá zvonka. Ja kreslím tie svetlá v oknách.
lines.heard: Everyone looks at them from the outside. I draw the lights in the windows

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s a much bigger map than it looks.
lines.sk: To je oveľa väčšia mapa, ako sa zdá.
lines.heard: That's a much bigger map than it looks

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Bigger. There are two hundred windows in our block alone, and every evening different ones are lit.
lines.sk: Väčšia. Len v našom bloku je dvesto okien a každý večer svietia iné.
lines.heard: Bigger. There are 200 windows in our block alone, and every evening different ones are lit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which one is yours?
lines.sk: A ktoré je tvoje?
lines.heard: And which one is yours?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Third from the top, on the left. When I’m drawing, Mum leaves the light on so I can find my way home.
lines.sk: Tretie zhora, vľavo. Keď kreslím, mama v ňom nechá svietiť, aby som trafil domov.
lines.heard: Third from the top on the left. When I'm drawing, Mom leaves the light on so I can find my way home

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Of course. Here, stamp and all.
lines.sk: Jasné. Tu, aj s pečiatkou.
lines.heard: Of course. Here, stamp and all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A stamp? For drawing with chalk?
lines.sk: Aj s pečiatkou? Na kreslenie kriedou?
lines.heard: A stamp for drawing with chalk?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: A stamp from the council. And the consent of the lady who washes the steps here.
lines.sk: S pečiatkou z úradu. A so súhlasom pani, čo tu umýva schody.
lines.heard: A stamp from the council and the consent of the lady who washes the steps here

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Her consent is needed too?
lines.sk: Jej súhlas je tiež potrebný?
lines.heard: Her consent is needed too?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: It’s more important. She’s the one who scrubs the underpass afterwards.
lines.sk: Je dôležitejší. Ona ten podchod potom drhne.
lines.heard: It's more important. She's the one who scrubs the underpass afterwards

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which window in Petrzalka is the most beautiful?
lines.sk: Ktoré okno v Petržalke je najkrajšie?
lines.heard: Which window in Petřín is the most beautiful?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: The one with the light on when everyone else is asleep. Someone in there is reading, or waiting for someone.
lines.sk: To, kde sa svieti, aj keď už ostatní spia. Tam niekto číta alebo na niekoho čaká.
lines.heard: The one with the light on when everyone else is asleep. Someone in there is reading or waiting for someone.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Or forgot to switch it off.
lines.sk: Alebo zabudol zhasnúť.
lines.heard: Or forgot to switch it off

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: That’s a story too.
lines.sk: Aj to je príbeh.
lines.heard: That's a story too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why do you draw in chalk and not paint?
lines.sk: Prečo kreslíš kriedou, a nie farbami?
lines.heard: Why do you draw in chalk and not paint?

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: Chalk washes off. When someone moves out, I switch off their window with a cloth.
lines.sk: Krieda sa dá zmyť. Keď sa niekto odsťahuje, zhasnem mu okno handrou.
lines.heard: Chalk washes off. When someone moves out, I'd switch off their window with a cloth

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s a bit sad.
lines.sk: To je trochu smutné.
lines.heard: That's a bit sad

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: It isn’t. A month later someone moves in, and I light their window up again.
lines.sk: Nie je. O mesiac sa tam niekto nasťahuje a ja mu okno zase rozsvietim.
lines.heard: It isn't. A month later, someone moves in and I light their window up again

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Garage number seventeen. Instead of a car there’s a transmitter, and more cables than in my workshop.
lines.sk: Garáž číslo sedemnásť. Namiesto auta je tu vysielačka a viac káblov ako v mojej dielni.
lines.heard: Garage number 17 instead of a car there's a transmitter and more cables than in my workshop

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I’m looking for Desmond Smith. I’ve got a map that you apparently drew with Mrs Perry.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Hľadám Dezidera Kováča. Mám mapu, ktorú ste vraj kreslili s pani Hruškovou.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I'm looking for Desmond Smith. I've got a map that you apparently drew with Mrs. Perry

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: I’m Desmond. On the airwaves I go by another name, but I don’t tell that to just anyone. Let’s see.
lines.sk: Dezider som ja. Na vlnách mám iné meno, ale to nehovorím hocikomu. Ukáž.
lines.heard: I'm Desmond. On the airwaves, I go by another name, but I don't tell that to just anyone. Let's see

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Mira and I drew this map. Here’s the coil for the stand on the Old Bridge. You still need an independent rhythm.
lines.sk: Túto mapu sme kreslili s Mirou. Tu máš cievku k stojanu na Starom moste. Ešte potrebuješ nezávislý rytmus.
lines.heard: Mira and I drew this map. Here's the coil for the stand on the old bridge. You still need an independent rhythm

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A mechanical clock?
lines.sk: Mechanické hodiny?
lines.heard: A mechanical clock

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: A metronome would be better – Emil in Karlova Ves has one. Mira painted the three digits on the wall at LEAL Court.
lines.sk: Lepší bude metronóm, má ho Emil v Karlovej Vsi. Tri číslice namaľovala Mira na múr pri LEALe.
lines.heard: A metronome would be better. Emil in Karlova Ves has one. Mira painted the three digits on the wall at Leal Court

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Not as numbers, but as waves and beats. She said children remember a picture better than a number.
lines.sk: Nie ako čísla, ale ako vlny a údery. Vraj si deti obrázok zapamätajú lepšie ako číslo.
lines.heard: Not as numbers, but as waves and beats. She said children remember a picture better than a number

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Back to LEAL Court, voluntarily this time. At school I only went there to fetch the ball.
lines.sk: K LEALu sa vraciam dobrovoľne. Ako žiak som tam chodil iba po loptu.
lines.heard: Back to Leal Court, voluntarily this time. At school I only went there to fetch the ball

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: And carry the coil carefully. It only fits one holder, and only one way round.
lines.sk: A cievku nes opatrne. Pasuje len do jedného držiaka a len jedným smerom.
lines.heard: And carry the coil carefully. It only fits one holder and only one way round

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: People calling out into the world and asking whether anyone can hear them.
lines.sk: Ľudí, ktorí volajú do sveta a pýtajú sa, či ich niekto počuje.
lines.heard: People calling out into the world and asking whether anyone can hear them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A network like that could have a future.
lines.sk: Taká sieť by mohla mať budúcnosť.
lines.heard: A network like that could have a future

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: A future? The present without hiss is enough for me. Yesterday a chap from Norway called in and we spent an hour discussing aerials.
lines.sk: Budúcnosť? Mne stačí prítomnosť bez šumu. Včera sa mi ozval chlapík z Nórska a hodinu sme riešili antény.
lines.heard: A future? The present without Hiss is enough for me. Yesterday, a chap from Norway called in, and we spent an hour discussing aerials

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In Norwegian?
lines.sk: Po nórsky?
lines.heard: In Norwegian?

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: In English, and with our hands. You can’t see hands over the radio, but they help anyway.
lines.sk: Po anglicky a rukami. Cez rádio ruky nevidno, ale aj tak pomáhajú.
lines.heard: In English and with our hands. You can't see hands over the radio, but they help anyway

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Precise doesn’t mean identical. Precise is when you know why something reads differently.
lines.sk: Presné neznamená rovnaké. Presné je, keď vieš, prečo niečo ukazuje inak.
lines.heard: Precise doesn't mean identical. Precise is when you know why something reads differently.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’d better write that down.
lines.sk: Toto si radšej zapíšem.
lines.heard: I better write that down

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Write it down. Mira once wrote it for me on a bit of cardboard, and it still hangs above my desk.
lines.sk: Zapíš. Mira mi to raz napísala na kus kartónu a ten visí nad stolom dodnes.
lines.heard: Write it down. Meera once wrote it for me on a bit of cardboard, and it still hangs above my desk.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mrs Perry has a rule for everything.
lines.sk: Pani Hrušková má na všetko pravidlo.
lines.heard: Mrs. Perry has a rule for everything

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: And an exception to every one. She writes those smaller, so you have to look for them.
lines.sk: A ku každému aj výnimku. Tú píše menším písmom, aby ju bolo treba hľadať.
lines.heard: And an exception to every one. She writes those smaller, so you have to look for them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How did you and Mrs Perry meet?
lines.sk: Ako ste sa s pani Hruškovou spoznali?
lines.heard: How did you and Mrs. Perry meet?

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: At a radio hams’ meeting. She fixed my power supply before I’d managed to tell her what was wrong with it.
lines.sk: Na stretnutí rádioamatérov. Opravila mi zdroj skôr, ako som jej stihol povedať, čo mu je.
lines.heard: At a radio hams meeting, she fixed my power supply before I'd managed to tell her what was wrong with it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That sounds like her.
lines.sk: To sa na ňu podobá.
lines.heard: That sounds like her

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Then we drew that map together. She drew, I held the ruler and explained why it was crooked.
lines.sk: Potom sme spolu kreslili tú mapu. Ona kreslila, ja som držal pravítko a vysvetľoval, prečo je krivé.
lines.heard: Then we drew that map together. She drew, I held the ruler and explained why it was crooked

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And was it crooked?
lines.sk: A bolo krivé?
lines.heard: And was it crooked?

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: It wasn’t. I just needed to explain something.
lines.sk: Nebolo. Ja som len potreboval niečo vysvetľovať.
lines.heard: It wasn't. I just needed to explain something

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do those letters and numbers on the wall mean?
lines.sk: Čo znamenajú tie písmená a čísla na stene?
lines.heard: And what do those letters and numbers on the wall mean?

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: Call signs. Every radio ham has one, like an address in the air.
lines.sk: Volacie znaky. Každý rádioamatér má svoj ako adresu vo vzduchu.
lines.heard: Call signs. Every radio ham has one, like an address in the air

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what’s yours?
lines.sk: A aký máte vy?
lines.heard: And what's yours?

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: I’m not telling you – you’d be calling me at midnight. The neighbours call me ‘the one with the aerial’.
lines.sk: Ten ti nepoviem, ešte by si ma volal o polnoci. Susedia mi hovoria „ten s anténou“.
lines.heard: I'm not telling you. You'd be calling me at midnight. The neighbors call me the one with the aerial

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s a call sign too.
lines.sk: To je tiež volací znak.
lines.heard: That's a call sign too

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: The most accurate one I have. All of Petrzalka knows it.
lines.sk: Najpresnejší, aký mám. Pozná ho celá Petržalka.
lines.heard: The most accurate one I have. All of Petrzalka knows it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s probably me in that window, aged ten. Luckily I’m looking the other way, like in every photo.
lines.sk: V tom okne som asi ja, desaťročný. Našťastie sa pozerám inam, ako na každej fotke.
lines.heard: That's probably me in that window, age 10 luckily I'm looking the other way, like in every photo

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Our team photo got lost somewhere between the studio and the kiosk. Rita says she found an envelope.
lines.sk: Fotka nášho družstva sa stratila niekde medzi ateliérom a kioskom. Zita vraj našla nejakú obálku.
lines.heard: Our team photo got lost somewhere between the studio and the kiosk. Rita says she found an envelope

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Team? What team?
lines.sk: Družstva? Akého družstva?
lines.heard: Team? What team?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Dodgeball. Fourth and fifth years – we won the district round.
lines.sk: Vybíjaná. Štvrtáci a piataci, vyhrali sme okresné kolo.
lines.heard: Dodgeball. Fourth and fifth years, we won the district round

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Shall I collect the envelope and see to a photo for the album?
lines.sk: Mám tú obálku vyzdvihnúť a postarať sa o fotku do albumu?
lines.heard: Shall I collect the envelope and see to a photo for the album?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Yes! Miss Korman knows about it. The main thing is that the whole team is in the photo.
lines.sk: Áno! Pani učiteľka Kormanová o tom vie. Hlavne nech je na fotke celé družstvo.
lines.heard: Yes, Miss Corman knows about it. The main thing is that the whole team is in the photo

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Otherwise it’s not a team, just a group. And a group doesn’t go in the album.
lines.sk: Inak to nie je družstvo, len skupina. A skupina do albumu nepatrí.
lines.heard: Otherwise, it's not a team just a group and a group doesn't go in the album.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Understood. The whole team, no groups.
lines.sk: Rozumiem. Celé družstvo, žiadna skupina.
lines.heard: Understood. The whole team, no groups

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: They’re all there! Even Adam, who pretended he’d forgotten about the photo.
lines.sk: Sú tam všetci! Aj Adam, čo sa tváril, že na fotenie zabudol.
lines.heard: They're all there Even Adam, who pretended he'd forgotten about the photo

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m sure he had a good reason.
lines.sk: Určite mal dobrý dôvod.
lines.heard: I'm sure he had a good reason

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: He had an ice cream.
lines.sk: Mal zmrzlinu.
lines.heard: He had an ice cream

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A very good reason.
lines.sk: Veľmi dobrý dôvod.
lines.heard: A very good reason

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Now it’s a team. I’ll put it on page twelve, right next to the certificate.
lines.sk: Teraz je to družstvo. Dám ju na dvanástu stranu, hneď vedľa diplomu.
lines.heard: Now it's a team. I'll put it on page twelve, right next to the certificate

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: May I write something under it?
lines.sk: Môžem k nej niečo pripísať?
lines.heard: May I write something under it?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: You may. But neatly – it’s an album, not an exercise book.
lines.sk: Môžete. Ale pekne, je to album, nie zošit.
lines.heard: You may, but neatly. It's an album, not an exercise book

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘The whole team. Even the one with the ice cream.’
lines.sk: „Celé družstvo. Aj ten so zmrzlinou.“
lines.heard: The whole team, even the one with the ice cream

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: We did. But the result isn’t important.
lines.sk: My. Ale výsledok nie je dôležitý.
lines.heard: We did, but the result isn't important

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did your coach say that?
lines.sk: To povedal tréner?
lines.heard: Did your coach say that?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: No. The ones who lost did.
lines.sk: Nie. Tí, čo prehrali.
lines.heard: No, the ones who lost did

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did your coach say?
lines.sk: A čo povedal tréner?
lines.heard: And what did your coach say?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: That next time we’re playing Karlova Ves, and they’re a head taller.
lines.sk: Že nabudúce hráme proti Karlovej Vsi a tí sú o hlavu vyšší.
lines.heard: That next time we're playing Karlova Ves and they're a head taller

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: So we’re practising jumping.
lines.sk: Tak trénujeme skákanie.
lines.heard: So we're practicing jumping

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: When we record something badly, we can hear it again.
lines.sk: Že keď niečo nahráme zle, môžeme to počuť ešte raz.
lines.heard: When we record something badly, we can hear it again.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Grown-ups would rather delete it.
lines.sk: Dospelí by to radšej zmazali.
lines.heard: Grown-ups would rather delete it

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Not Miss Korman. She says you should listen to your mistakes too.
lines.sk: Pani učiteľka Kormanová nie. Vraví, že aj chybu si treba vypočuť.
lines.heard: Not Miss Corman. She says you should listen to your mistakes too

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: We laugh most at the recording where Adam forgot what he wanted to say.
lines.sk: Najviac sa smejeme na nahrávke, kde Adam zabudol, čo chcel povedať.
lines.heard: We laugh most at the recording where Adam forgot what he wanted to say

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That Adam must be a funny boy.
lines.sk: Ten Adam musí byť zábavný chlapec.
lines.heard: That Adam must be a funny boy

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: He is. He just doesn’t know it yet.
lines.sk: Je. Len o tom ešte nevie.
lines.heard: He is. He just doesn't know it yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What have you got in your album?
lines.sk: Čo všetko máš v albume?
lines.heard: What have you got in your album?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Team photos, certificates and the bus ticket to the district round.
lines.sk: Fotky družstva, diplomy a lístok z autobusu na okresné kolo.
lines.heard: Team photos, certificates, and the bus ticket to the district round

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A bus ticket?
lines.sk: Lístok z autobusu?
lines.heard: A bus ticket

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Without it we wouldn’t have got there. That’s part of winning too.
lines.sk: Bez neho by sme tam neboli. Aj to patrí k výhre.
lines.heard: Without it, we wouldn't have got there. That's part of winning too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Looking forward to the holidays?
lines.sk: Tešíš sa na prázdniny?
lines.heard: Looking forward to the holidays?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Fifteen more days. But I’m not counting them – only the first years do that.
lines.sk: Ešte pätnásť dní. Ale nerátam ich, to robia len prváci.
lines.heard: Fifteen more days. But I'm not counting them. Only the first years do that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you?
lines.sk: A ty?
lines.heard: And you?

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: I’m counting how many photos I still need for the album. Twelve.
lines.sk: Ja rátam, koľko fotiek mi ešte chýba do albumu. Dvanásť.
lines.heard: I'm counting how many photos I still need for the album. Twelve

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: LEAL Court. I once kicked a ball over the wall here and looked for it until dark.
lines.sk: Pri LEALe. Tu som raz prehodil loptu cez múr a hľadal som ju až do tmy.
lines.heard: Layall Court. I once kicked a ball over the wall here and looked for it until dark

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘Three waves, two beats, six segments.’ So: three, two, six.
lines.sk: „Tri vlny, dva údery, šesť dielikov.“ Čiže tri, dva, šesť.
lines.heard: Three waves, two beats, six segments. So three, two, six.

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: That’s right. Six segments, even though the children painted the sixth one twice.
lines.sk: Sedí to. Šesť dielikov, aj keď ten šiesty maľovali deti dvakrát.
lines.heard: That's right, six segments, even though the children painted the sixth one twice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why twice?
lines.sk: Prečo dvakrát?
lines.heard: Why twice?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: The first time they painted it on the next panel along. The lady from the club had it repainted so that all six would be together.
lines.sk: Prvý raz ho namaľovali na susedný panel. Pani z krúžku ho dala premaľovať, aby bolo všetkých šesť pokope.
lines.heard: The first time they painted it on the next panel along, the lady from the club had it repainted so that all six would be together

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll write it down. Today I don’t trust my own memory much.
lines.sk: Zapíšem si to. Vlastnej pamäti dnes veľmi neverím.
lines.heard: I'll write it down. Today I don't trust my own memory much

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Write it down. I’ll remember it anyway.
lines.sk: Zapíšte si. Ja si to zapamätám aj tak.
lines.heard: Write it down. I'll remember it anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why are you tapping that bell?
lines.sk: Prečo ťukáš do toho zvončeka?
lines.heard: Why are you tapping that bell?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Because it won’t ring. I tap and tap and nothing.
lines.sk: Lebo nezvoní. Ťukám, ťukám a nič.
lines.heard: Because it won't ring. I tap and tap and nothing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Let me see. It’s missing its cap – the very part that rings.
lines.sk: Ukáž. Chýba mu vrchnák, presne ten, čo zvoní.
lines.heard: Let me see. It's missing its cap, the very part that rings

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: It popped off when I rode up on the kerb. And then it rolled away.
lines.sk: Odskočil, keď som vyšiel na obrubník. A potom sa kotúľal.
lines.heard: It popped off when I rode up on the curb, and then it rolled away

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: It bounced three times and vanished under the blue spruce. I counted.
lines.sk: Trikrát poskočil a zmizol pod modrým smrekom. Rátala som to.
lines.heard: It bounced three times and vanished under the blue spruce. I counted

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: I didn’t count. I was falling off.
lines.sk: Ja som nerátal. Ja som padal.
lines.heard: I didn't count. I was falling off

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I saw that too. The knee survived; the bell hasn’t yet.
lines.sk: Aj to som videla. Koleno to prežilo, zvonček zatiaľ nie.
lines.heard: I saw that too. The knee survived the bell hasn't yet

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: At the end of the year we all go round the yard ringing our bells. Without a bell it doesn’t count.
lines.sk: Na konci roka ideme všetci okolo dvora a zvoníme. Bez zvončeka sa to nepočíta.
lines.heard: At the end of the year, we all go round the yard ringing our bells without a bell it doesn't count

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll find the cap and screw it back on. At the end of the year, you’ll be ringing.
lines.sk: Vrchnák nájdem a naskrutkujem. Na konci roka budeš zvoniť.
lines.heard: I'll find the cap and screw it back on. At the end of the year, you'll be ringing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Pine needles, two bits of chalk, an old ball and a brass cap.
lines.sk: Ihličie, dve kriedy, stará loptička a mosadzný vrchnák.
lines.heard: Pine needles, two bits of chalk, an old ball, and a brass cap

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It bounced three times and stopped right here. Susanna counted well.
lines.sk: Trikrát poskočil a zastavil sa presne tu. Zuzana rátala dobre.
lines.heard: It bounced three times and stopped right here. Susanna counted well

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Cap on the thread, a quarter turn, and tighten it gently with the screwdriver. Jake, don’t tap yet – my fingers are in there.
lines.sk: Vrchnák na závit, pootočiť a skrutkovačom jemne dotiahnuť. Kubo, ešte neťukaj, mám tam prsty.
lines.heard: Cap on the thread, a quarter turn, and tighten it gently with the screwdriver. Jake, don't tap yet. My fingers are in there

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: It rings! Auntie Susanna, can you hear it?
lines.sk: Zvoní! Teta Zuzana, počujete?
lines.heard: It rings auntie susannah, can you hear it?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I can. The whole yard can.
lines.sk: Počujem. Celý dvor počuje.
lines.heard: I can. The whole Yard can

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: And now listen to this, too. They’re ringing the bell at school.
lines.sk: A teraz počúvajte aj toto. V škole práve zvonia.
lines.heard: And now listen to this too. They're ringing the bell at school

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: When I hear the bell ring at the end of the year, I wave. An old agreement.
lines.sk: Keď počujem zvoniť na konci roka, zamávam. Taká stará dohoda.
lines.heard: When I hear the bell ring at the end of the year, I wave. An old agreement

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: With whom?
lines.sk: S kým?
lines.heard: With whom?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: With a man who repairs bells.
lines.sk: S jedným opravárom zvončekov.
lines.heard: With a man who repairs bells

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: But it isn’t the end of the year yet.
lines.sk: Ale veď ešte nie je koniec roka.
lines.heard: But it isn't the end of the year yet

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Fifteen more days. This is a rehearsal.
lines.sk: Ešte pätnásť dní. Toto je skúška.
lines.heard: Fifteen more days. This is a rehearsal.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The rehearsal went well. I’m waving with you.
lines.sk: Skúška vyšla. Mávam s vami.
lines.heard: The rehearsal went well. I'm waving with you

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Who are you waving to?
lines.sk: Komu mávate?
lines.heard: Who are you waving to?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: To a bell from Ivanka.
lines.sk: Jednému zvončeku z Ivanky.
lines.heard: To a bell from Ivanka

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Excuse me – you’re looking at me as if we knew each other.
lines.sk: Prepáčte, pozeráte sa na mňa, akoby sme sa poznali.
lines.heard: Excuse me. You're looking at me as if we knew each other

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Because we do. From the park in Ivanka, in June sixty-two.
lines.sk: Lebo sa poznáme. Z parku v Ivanke, z júna šesťdesiatdva.
lines.heard: Because we do from the park in Ivanka in June sixty two

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Sixty-two? I wasn’t even born then.
lines.sk: Šesťdesiatdva? Vtedy som ešte nebol ani na svete.
lines.heard: 62? I wasn't even born then

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I know how that sounds. But you had exactly these shoes.
lines.sk: Viem, ako to znie. Ale mali ste presne tieto topánky.
lines.heard: I know how that sounds, but you had exactly these shoes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I bought these shoes last autumn.
lines.sk: Tieto topánky som si kúpil minulú jeseň.
lines.heard: I bought these shoes last autumn

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: And you were looking for paper that writes twice. I sent you to the post office, to Mr Ramsey.
lines.sk: A hľadali ste papier, ktorý píše dvakrát. Poslala som vás na poštu za pánom Baranom.
lines.heard: And you were looking for paper that writes twice. I sent you to the post office, to Mr. Ramsey

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll remember that. Just in case.
lines.sk: To si zapamätám. Pre istotu.
lines.heard: I'll remember that, just in case

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Don’t worry, I won’t ask how you do it. Some things are nicer without instructions.
lines.sk: Nebojte sa, nebudem sa pýtať, ako to robíte. Niektoré veci sú krajšie bez návodu.
lines.heard: Don't worry, I won't ask how you do it. Some things are nicer without instructions

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’re saying that to a repairman.
lines.sk: To hovoríte opravárovi.
lines.heard: You're saying that to a repairman?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: That’s exactly why.
lines.sk: Práve preto.
lines.heard: That's exactly why

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now I know where we know each other from. The park by the manor house.
lines.sk: Už viem, odkiaľ sa poznáme. Z parku pri kaštieli.
lines.heard: Now I know where we know each other from the park by the manor house

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: So it was real. I was beginning to think I’d only dreamt the whole thing.
lines.sk: Tak predsa. Už som si myslela, že sa mi to celé iba prisnilo.
lines.heard: So it was real. I was beginning to think I'd only dreamt the whole thing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You sent me to the post office for carbon paper back then.
lines.sk: Vy ste ma vtedy poslali na poštu po uhľový papier.
lines.heard: Yeah. You sent me to the post office for carbon paper back then

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: And you really went. For someone who was seven, I had you listening very carefully.
lines.sk: A vy ste naozaj išli. Na to, že som mala sedem, ste ma počúvali veľmi pozorne.
lines.heard: And you really went. For someone who was seven, I had you listening very carefully

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I had good reason. That paper did the trick.
lines.sk: Mal som prečo. Ten papier zabral.
lines.heard: I had good reason. That paper did the trick

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: For me it’s been thirty-three years. And for you?
lines.sk: Pre mňa je to tridsaťtri rokov. A pre vás?
lines.heard: For me, it's been thirty-three years. And for you?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Much less. I can’t tell you more than that.
lines.sk: Oveľa menej. Viac vám povedať neviem.
lines.heard: Much less. I can't tell you more than that

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: You don’t have to. What matters is that you came here too.
lines.sk: Nemusíte. Hlavne že ste prišli aj sem.
lines.heard: You don't have to. What matters is that you came here too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That class bell from Ivanka… Did you ring it at the end of the year?
lines.sk: Ten triedny zvonček z Ivanky… Zazvonili ste ním na konci roka?
lines.heard: That class bell from Ivanka, did you ring it at the end of the year?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I did. The class ran off on holiday before I’d finished ringing.
lines.sk: Zazvonila. Trieda vybehla na prázdniny skôr, ako som dozvonila.
lines.heard: I did. The class ran off on holiday before I'd finished ringing

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: The teacher said nobody had ever started the holidays that fast.
lines.sk: Učiteľka povedala, že takto rýchlo ešte nikto prázdniny nezačal.
lines.heard: The teacher said nobody had ever started the holidays that fast

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did the loop hold?
lines.sk: A pútko vydržalo?
lines.heard: And did the loop hold?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: All through June. After that I stopped counting.
lines.sk: Celý jún. Potom som to už nerátala.
lines.heard: All through June. After that, I stopped counting

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You, stop counting? I find that hard to believe.
lines.sk: Vy a nerátať? Tomu sa mi nechce veriť.
lines.heard: You stop counting? I find that hard to believe

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: It was the holidays. Even counting gets a day off now and then.
lines.sk: Boli prázdniny. Aj rátanie má raz za čas voľno.
lines.heard: It was the holidays even counting gets a day off now and then

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Have you seen a drawing round here with waves and little lines?
lines.sk: Nevideli ste tu niekde nákres s vlnami a čiarkami?
lines.heard: Have you seen a drawing around here with waves and little lines?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I have. In the spring, children from the school club painted it on the wall with a lady.
lines.sk: Videla. Na jar ho na múr maľovali deti zo školského krúžku s jednou pani.
lines.heard: I have. In the spring, children from the school club painted it on the wall with a lady.

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: The lady had a tape recorder under her arm, and chalk kept falling out of her sleeve.
lines.sk: Pani mala pod pazuchou magnetofón a z rukáva jej padala krieda.
lines.heard: The lady had a tape recorder under her arm and chalk kept falling out of her sleeve.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’ll be her. Which panel is it on?
lines.sk: To bude ona. A na ktorom paneli to je?
lines.heard: That'll be her. Which panel is it on?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: The wall has thirty-two panels. The drawing is on three on the right, right by the passage.
lines.sk: Múr má tridsaťdva panelov. Nákres je na troch vpravo, hneď pri priechode.
lines.heard: The wall has 32 panels. The drawing is on three on the right, right by the passage

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You counted the panels?
lines.sk: Vy ste tie panely rátali?
lines.heard: You counted the panels?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I count everything. That’s stayed with me.
lines.sk: Ja rátam všetko. To mi zostalo.
lines.heard: I count everything. That's stayed with me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did you draw that hopscotch on the tarmac?
lines.sk: Tú škôlku na asfalte ste kreslili vy?
lines.heard: Did you draw that hopscotch on the tarmac?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I did. Jake wanted one, so he’s got one. Eight squares and a half-circle at the top.
lines.sk: Ja. Kubo ju chcel, tak ju má. Osem políčok a hore polkruh.
lines.heard: I did. Jake wanted one, so he's got one. Eight squares and a half circle at the top

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And straight lines. I’d need a ruler for that.
lines.sk: A rovné čiary. Ja by som na to potreboval pravítko.
lines.heard: And straight lines, I'd need a ruler for that

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: You can have a go. But only up to four – grown-ups fall over after that.
lines.sk: Môžete si skočiť. Ale iba do štvorky, dospelí ďalej padajú.
lines.heard: You can have a go, but only up to four. Grown-ups fall over after that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll stop at three. To leave a margin.
lines.sk: Tak radšej do trojky. Nech mám rezervu.
lines.heard: Then I'll stop at three to leave a margin

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Sensible. Jake jumps all the way to eight, but he doesn’t know yet that he ought to fall over.
lines.sk: Rozumné. Kubo skáče až do osmičky, ale on ešte nevie, že by mal padať.
lines.heard: Sensible. Jake jumps all the way to eight, but he doesn't know yet that he ought to fall over

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The children must be looking forward to the holidays.
lines.sk: Deti sa už určite tešia na prázdniny.
lines.heard: The children must be looking forward to the holidays

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Fifteen more days. Jake crosses them off in chalk on the wall, so not a single one gets away.
lines.sk: Ešte pätnásť dní. Kubo si ich škrtá kriedou na múre, aby mu ani jeden neušiel.
lines.heard: Fifteen more days. Jake crosses them off in chalk on the wall so not a single one gets away

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you help him count them.
lines.sk: A vy mu ich pomáhate rátať.
lines.heard: And you help him count them

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: I do. I count how many times the ball flies over the wall, too.
lines.sk: Pomáham. Ja rátam aj to, koľkokrát lopta preletí cez múr.
lines.heard: I do. I count how many times the ball flies over the wall too

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: Four times today. The lady on the fourth floor threw it back more crossly every time.
lines.sk: Dnes preletela štyrikrát. Pani zo štvrtého poschodia ju zakaždým hodila späť nahnevanejšie.
lines.heard: Four times today. The lady on the fourth floor threw it back more crossly every time.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: She could keep goal for the team.
lines.sk: Tá by mohla chytať za družstvo.
lines.heard: She could keep goal for the team

lines.speaker: ZUZANA95
lines.text: She does keep goal. Just against us.
lines.sk: Ona chytá. Len proti nám.
lines.heard: She does keep goal just against us

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What year are you in at school?
lines.sk: Do ktorej triedy chodíš?
lines.heard: What year are you in at school?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: First. I can already read, write and whistle through my fingers.
lines.sk: Do prvej. Už viem čítať, písať a pískať na prstoch.
lines.heard: First I can already read, write, and whistle through my fingers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which of those did they teach you at school?
lines.sk: A čo z toho ťa naučili v škole?
lines.heard: And which of those did they teach you at school?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Reading and writing. My brother taught me to whistle, but that doesn’t go on your report.
lines.sk: Čítať a písať. Pískať ma naučil brat, ale to sa na vysvedčenie nepíše.
lines.heard: Reading and writing my brother taught me to whistle, but that doesn't go on your report

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Shame. You’d get top marks for it.
lines.sk: Škoda. Za to by si mal jednotku.
lines.heard: Shame. You'd get top marks for it

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Miss wouldn’t give me top marks. She’s heard my whistling.
lines.sk: Pani učiteľka by mi jednotku nedala. Ona to pískanie počula.
lines.heard: Miss wouldn't give me top marks. She's heard my whistling

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why is there such a high wall round the playground?
lines.sk: Prečo je okolo ihriska taký vysoký múr?
lines.heard: Why is there such a high wall around the playground?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: So the ball doesn’t run into the street. But it runs off anyway, just higher.
lines.sk: Aby lopta neutekala na ulicu. Ale ona uteká aj tak, len vyššie.
lines.heard: So the ball doesn't run into the street, but it runs off anyway, just higher

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who goes and gets it?
lines.sk: A kto pre ňu potom chodí?
lines.heard: And who goes and gets it?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: The smallest. That’s me.
lines.sk: Najmenší. Čiže ja.
lines.heard: The smallest. That's me

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: When the ball lands on the balcony on the fourth floor, the lady throws it back. But first she tells us how many geraniums we’ve broken.
lines.sk: Keď lopta spadne na balkón na štvrtom, pani ju hodí späť. Najprv nám ale povie, koľko muškátov sme zlomili.
lines.heard: When the ball lands on the balcony on the fourth floor, the lady throws it back. But first she tells us how many geraniums we've broken

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many?
lines.sk: A koľko?
lines.heard: And how many?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: All of them. But she’s got lots.
lines.sk: Všetky. Ale ona ich má veľa.
lines.heard: All of them. But she's got lots

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So, how’s riding with a bell?
lines.sk: Tak čo, ako sa jazdí so zvončekom?
lines.heard: So, how's riding with a bell?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Faster. When I ring, everyone gets out of the way, even the pigeons.
lines.sk: Rýchlejšie. Keď zvoním, každý uhne, aj holuby.
lines.heard: Faster! When I ring, everyone gets out of the way, even the pigeons

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the lady on the fourth floor?
lines.sk: A pani zo štvrtého poschodia?
lines.heard: And the lady on the fourth floor?

lines.speaker: KUBO
lines.text: Not her. She rings back at us from her balcony, with a spoon on a saucepan.
lines.sk: Tá nie. Tá nám z balkóna odzváňa lyžičkou o hrniec.
lines.heard: Not her. She rings back at us from her balcony with a spoon on a saucepan

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The Danube flows the way it should. Of the two of us, I’m the one travelling strangely.
lines.sk: Dunaj tečie, ako má. Z nás dvoch som tu ja ten, kto cestuje čudne.
lines.heard: The Danube flows the way it should. Of the two of us, I'm the one traveling strangely

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The coil has clicked into the holder. The circuit is ready.
lines.sk: Cievka zapadla do držiaka. Obvod je pripravený.
lines.heard: The coil has clicked into the holder. The circuit is ready

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The metronome ticks slowly, at Emil’s tempo. It doesn’t need electricity, just a level table.
lines.sk: Metronóm tiká pomaly, Emilovým tempom. Nepotrebuje elektrinu, len rovný stolík.
lines.heard: The metronome ticks slowly at Emile's tempo. It doesn't need electricity, just a level table

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three, two, six. The map fits and the tape is playing, so there’s something to compare against.
lines.sk: Tri, dva, šesť. Mapa sedí a kazeta hrá, aby bolo s čím porovnávať.
