lines.heard: 326. The map fits and the tape is playing, so there's something to compare against

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: New time window saved.
lines.sk: Nové časové okno uložené.
lines.heard: New time window saved

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Ivanka, 1962. Gran achieved more than anyone ever mentioned at family parties.
lines.sk: Ivanka, rok 1962. Babka toho dokázala viac, ako sa o nej hovorilo na rodinných oslavách.
lines.heard: Ivanka, 1962. Gran achieved more than anyone ever mentioned at family parties

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran said she built ZVON with Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. I’ll start at his workshop.
lines.sk: Babka vravela, že ZVON robila s Otom Bielikom, mechanikom z Ivanky. Začnem v jeho dielni.
lines.heard: Gran said she built Zvon with Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. I'll start at his workshop

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll travel via the node clock at the Dubravka stop.
lines.sk: Odcestujem cez uzlové hodiny na Dúbravskej zastávke.
lines.heard: I'll travel via the node clock at the Dubravka stop

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Ivanka pri Dunaji. 6 June 1962.
lines.sk: Ivanka pri Dunaji. 6. júna 1962.
lines.heard: Ivanka Pridunai, 6th June 1962

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m off to see a woman who doesn’t know yet that one day she’ll be my gran.
lines.sk: Idem za ženou, ktorá ešte nevie, že raz bude moja babka.
lines.heard: I'm off to see a woman who doesn't know yet that one day she'll be my gran

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And I have to make it before her name vanishes from the later records too.
lines.sk: A musím to stihnúť, kým jej meno nezmizne aj z neskorších zápisov.
lines.heard: And I have to make it before her name vanishes from the later records too.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The kiosk sells newspapers, chewing gum and news that isn’t in the newspapers yet.
lines.sk: Kiosk predáva noviny, žuvačky a správy, ktoré v novinách ešte nie sú.
lines.heard: The kiosk sells newspapers, chewing gum, and news that isn't in the newspapers yet

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Sonia sent you? Here you are, the envelope with the team negative. Elaine at the studio will know what to do with it.
lines.sk: Soňa ťa posiela? Nech sa páči, obálka s negatívom družstva. Alena z ateliéru bude vedieť, čo s ňou.
lines.heard: Sonia sent you. Here you are. The envelope with the team negative. Elaine at the studio will know what to do with it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did you know I was coming?
lines.sk: Vedeli ste, že prídem?
lines.heard: Did you know I was coming?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: On this estate I hear about everything before it happens.
lines.sk: Na sídlisku sa všetko dozviem skôr, než sa to stane.
lines.heard: On this estate, I hear about everything before it happens

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then tell me what’s going to happen tomorrow.
lines.sk: Tak mi povedzte, čo sa stane zajtra.
lines.heard: Then tell me what's gonna happen tomorrow

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Tomorrow it won’t rain, and someone will still forget their umbrella here.
lines.sk: Zajtra pršať nebude, a aj tak mi tu niekto zabudne dáždnik.
lines.heard: Tomorrow it won't rain and someone will still forget their umbrella here

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I haven’t got an umbrella.
lines.sk: Ja dáždnik nemám.
lines.heard: I haven't got an umbrella

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: See? So it won’t be you.
lines.sk: Vidíš. Tak to nebudeš ty.
lines.heard: See? So it won't be you

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Fresh news is in the paper for a few crowns. Yesterday’s I’ll tell you for free.
lines.sk: Čerstvé správy máš v novinách za pár korún. Tie včerajšie ti poviem zadarmo.
lines.heard: Fresh news is in the paper for a few crowns. Yesterday's I'll tell you for free

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Today’s will do. For me it’s twenty-five years old anyway.
lines.sk: Stačia mi dnešné. Pre mňa sú aj tak dvadsaťpäť rokov staré.
lines.heard: Today's will do For me, it's 25 years old anyway

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Then put it away somewhere. In twenty-five years you’ll be glad to look at it.
lines.sk: Tak si ich odlož. O dvadsaťpäť rokov sa na ne rád pozrieš.
lines.heard: Then put it away somewhere. In 25 years, you'll be glad to look at it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that from experience.
lines.sk: To viem z vlastnej skúsenosti.
lines.heard: I know that from experience

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: They’ve repaired the bench. People are complaining it’s freshly painted.
lines.sk: Opravili lavičku. Ľudia nadávajú, že je čerstvo natretá.
lines.heard: They've repaired the bench People are complaining it's freshly painted

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Repaired, and you can’t sit on it? Which one is it?
lines.sk: Opravená, a nedá sa na ňu sadnúť? Ktorá to je?
lines.heard: Repaired and you can't sit on it. Which one is it?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: The one in the courtyard behind the block. On the first day three people sat on it and left in green trousers.
lines.sk: Je to tá vo dvore za blokom. Prvý deň si na ňu sadli traja a odišli v zelených nohaviciach.
lines.heard: The one in the courtyard behind the block. On the first day, three people sat on it and left in green trousers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Wasn’t there a sign?
lines.sk: A nebola tam ceduľa?
lines.heard: Wasn't there a sign?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: There was. They painted that too.
lines.sk: Bola. Natreli aj tú.
lines.heard: There was. They painted that too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do people forget here most often?
lines.sk: Čo tu ľudia najčastejšie zabudnú?
lines.heard: What do people forget here most often?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Umbrellas, keys and envelopes. Once, a whole cake.
lines.sk: Dáždniky, kľúče a obálky. Raz aj celú tortu.
lines.heard: Umbrellas, keys, and envelopes. Once, a whole cake

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A cake?
lines.sk: Tortu?
lines.heard: A cake?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: A birthday cake. The owner came back an hour later, just as my neighbour and I were checking whether it was fresh.
lines.sk: Narodeninovú. Majiteľ sa vrátil o hodinu, keď sme so susedkou práve skúšali, či je čerstvá.
lines.heard: A birthday cake. The owner came back an hour later just as my neighbor and I were checking whether it was fresh

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And was it?
lines.sk: A bola?
lines.heard: And was it?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: It was. He still had half of it left, candles and all.
lines.sk: Bola. Polovica mu ostala aj so sviečkami.
lines.heard: It was. He still had half of it left, candles and all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s there, behind that block?
lines.sk: Čo je tam za tým blokom?
lines.heard: What's there behind that block?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: There? That’s LEAL Court. A playground, a bench and children kicking a ball over the wall.
lines.sk: Tam? To je pri LEALe. Ihrisko, lavička a deti, čo prehadzujú loptu cez múr.
lines.heard: There, that's Laele Court, a playground, a bench, and children kicking a ball over the wall

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Can I get through there?
lines.sk: Dá sa tam prejsť?
lines.heard: Can I get through there?

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Along the side path between the blocks. Just don’t sit on the bench – it’s freshly painted.
lines.sk: Bočnou cestičkou medzi blokmi. Len si nesadaj na lavičku, je čerstvo natretá.
lines.heard: Along the side path between the blocks, just don't sit on the bench. It's freshly painted

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Ivanka, 1962. My phone is as useless here as it was in 1995. I’m a bit more nervous.
lines.sk: Ivanka, rok 1962. Telefón je tu rovnako zbytočný ako v roku 1995. Ja som o niečo nervóznejší.
lines.heard: Ivanka, 1962. My phone is as useless here as it was in 1995. I'm a bit more nervous

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Young Miss Perry? Measuring, behind the park. Otto in his workshop can tell you more.
lines.sk: Mladú Hruškovú? Pri meraní za parkom. Oto v dielni vám povie viac.
lines.heard: Young Miss Perry? Measuring behind the park. Otto in his workshop can tell you more

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: And if you do get lost, little Susie is playing hopscotch in the park.
lines.sk: A keby ste predsa zablúdili, v parku skáče škôlku malá Zuzka.
lines.heard: And if you do get lost, little Susie is playing hopscotch in the park

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: She knows the way?
lines.sk: Ona pozná cestu?
lines.heard: She knows the way?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: She knows every corner of Ivanka. Better than I know the timetable, and I know that by heart.
lines.sk: V Ivanke pozná každý kút. Lepšie ako ja cestovný poriadok, a ten viem naspamäť.
lines.heard: She knows every corner of Ivanka better than I know the timetable, and I know that by heart

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. For now I’ll pretend to be an ordinary visitor.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Zatiaľ sa budem tváriť ako obyčajný návštevník.
lines.heard: Thank you. For now, I'll pretend to be an ordinary visitor

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Ordinary visitors ask about the inn, not about Miss Perry. But good luck to you.
lines.sk: Obyčajní návštevníci sa pýtajú na hostinec, nie na Hruškovú. Ale nech sa vám darí.
lines.heard: Ordinary visitors ask about the inn, not about Miss Perry. But good luck to you

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you sell return tickets as well?
lines.sk: Predávate aj spiatočné lístky?
lines.heard: Do you sell return tickets as well?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Of course.
lines.sk: Samozrejme.
lines.heard: Of course

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even to a completely different year?
lines.sk: Aj na úplne iný rok?
lines.heard: Even to a completely different year

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: For that you’ll have to apply to the management. I only sell tickets to Bratislava.
lines.sk: S tým sa obráťte na vedenie. Ja predávam iba do Bratislavy.
lines.heard: For that, you'll have to apply to the management. I only sell tickets to Bratislava.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And where does the management sit?
lines.sk: A kde sedí to vedenie?
lines.heard: And where does the management sit?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: In Bratislava. So you’ll start with me anyway.
lines.sk: V Bratislave. Takže aj tak začnete u mňa.
lines.heard: In Bratislava so you'll start with me anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many trains stop here a day?
lines.sk: Koľko vlakov tu denne zastaví?
lines.heard: How many trains stop here a day?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: As many as are in the timetable. Not one more.
lines.sk: Toľko, koľko je v cestovnom poriadku. Ani o jeden viac.
lines.heard: As many as are in the timetable, not one more

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when one is late?
lines.sk: A keď niektorý mešká?
lines.heard: And when one is late

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Then it’s the same train, only later. It doesn’t turn into a different train.
lines.sk: Tak je to ten istý vlak, len neskôr. Iný vlak z neho nebude.
lines.heard: Then it's the same train, only later. It doesn't turn into a different train

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You even like delays?
lines.sk: Vy máte rád aj meškanie?
lines.heard: You even like delays?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: I don’t like uncertainty. A train that’s late at least knows where it’s going.
lines.sk: Nemám rád nejasnosti. Vlak, čo mešká, aspoň vie, kam ide.
lines.heard: I don't like uncertainty. A train that's late at least knows where it's going

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is Ivanka a big village?
lines.sk: Je Ivanka veľká dedina?
lines.heard: Is Ivanka a big village?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Just the right size. A church, a manor house with a park, a post office and a station. Everything a person needs.
lines.sk: Taká akurát. Kostol, kaštieľ s parkom, pošta a stanica. Všetko, čo človek potrebuje.
lines.heard: Just the right size A church, a manor house with a park, a post office, and a station Everything a person needs

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: And the Little Danube just beyond the barns. When the wind’s off the water, you can smell it right up on the platform.
lines.sk: A Malý Dunaj kúsok za humnami. Keď fúka od vody, cítiť ho až na peróne.
lines.heard: And the Little Danube just beyond the barns. When the wind's off the water, you can smell it right up on the platform

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And those aeroplanes over our heads?
lines.sk: A tie lietadlá nad nami?
lines.heard: And those aeroplanes over our heads

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: The airport’s right next door. The cows got used to it before the people did.
lines.sk: Letisko je hneď vedľa. Kravy si zvykli skôr ako ľudia.
lines.heard: The airport's right next door. The cows got used to it before the people did

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you?
lines.sk: A vy?
lines.heard: And you?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: I got used to it fastest. Aeroplanes have a timetable too.
lines.sk: Ja najrýchlejšie. Lietadlá majú tiež cestovný poriadok.
lines.heard: I got used to it fastest. Aeroplanes have a timetable too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Have you any advice for someone who travels a lot?
lines.sk: Máte nejakú radu pre človeka, čo veľa cestuje?
lines.heard: Have you any advice for someone who travels a lot?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Where are you headed? That’s the first question. Without an answer I won’t even sell you advice.
lines.sk: Kam ste namierený? To je prvá otázka. Bez odpovede vám nepredám ani radu.
lines.heard: Where are you headed? That's the first question. Without an answer, I won't even sell you advice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Honestly? To the year… to Mr Whitlock’s workshop.
lines.sk: Úprimne? Do roku… do dielne pána Bielika.
lines.heard: Honestly, to the year to Mr. Whitlock's workshop

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Then you’re in luck. You walk there, and you don’t need a timetable.
lines.sk: Tak máte šťastie. Tam sa chodí peši a cestovný poriadok netreba.
lines.heard: Then you're in luck. You walk there and you don't need a timetable

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if I didn’t know where?
lines.sk: A keby som nevedel kam?
lines.heard: And if I didn't know where?

lines.speaker: BOZO
lines.text: Then sit on a bench and wait until you do. The trains run anyway.
lines.sk: Tak si sadnite na lavičku a počkajte, kým to budete vedieť. Vlaky chodia aj tak.
lines.heard: Then sit on a bench and wait until you do. The trains run anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Here everyone asks everyone whose they are. In my case that would be a long answer.
lines.sk: Tu sa každý každého pýta, čí je. U mňa by to bola dlhá odpoveď.
lines.heard: Here, everyone asks everyone whose they are. In my case, that'd be a long answer.

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: I can see that. Nobody here has shoes like those.
lines.sk: Vidím. Také topánky tu nikto nemá.
lines.heard: I can see that. Nobody here has shoes like those

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: They’re work shoes.
lines.sk: Sú pracovné.
lines.heard: They're work shoes

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: That’s what everyone says when they don’t want to dirty their Sunday best.
lines.sk: To hovoria všetci, čo si nechcú zašpiniť slávnostné.
lines.heard: That's what everyone says when they don't want to dirty their Sunday best.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who might I be visiting here?
lines.sk: A u koho by som tu mohol byť na návšteve?
lines.heard: And who might I be visiting here?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: That’s what you’re about to tell me. I’ve already ruled out half the village.
lines.sk: To mi práve poviete vy. Ja som už vylúčila polovicu dediny.
lines.heard: That's what you're about to tell me. I've already ruled out half the village

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the other half?
lines.sk: A tú druhú polovicu?
lines.heard: And the other half?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: I’ll have ruled them out by this evening.
lines.sk: Tú vylúčim do večera.
lines.heard: I'll have ruled them out by this evening

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: Mostly, yes. Only that young Perry girl has her lights on again in the hut behind the park, in broad daylight.
lines.sk: Väčšinou áno. Len tá mladá Hrušková zas svieti v búdke za parkom aj za bieleho dňa.
lines.heard: Mostly, yes. Only that young Perry girl has her lights on again in the hut behind the park in broad daylight

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’ll be Gran. Well, a friend of mine.
lines.sk: To bude babka. Teda, jedna moja známa.
lines.heard: That'll be Gran. Well, a friend of mine

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: Gran? She’s twenty-two.
lines.sk: Babka? Tá má dvadsaťdva rokov.
lines.heard: Gran, she's 22

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I said ‘friend’.
lines.sk: Povedal som „známa“.
lines.heard: I said friend

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: First you said ‘Gran’. My hearing is fine, young man.
lines.sk: Najprv ste povedali „babka“. Ja počujem dobre, mladý pán.
lines.heard: First you said gran My hearing is fine, young man

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who’s the little girl playing hopscotch in the park?
lines.sk: Kto je to malé dievča, čo skáče v parku škôlku?
lines.heard: Who's the little girl playing hopscotch in the park?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: Susie. School in the morning, the park in the afternoon and the channel in the evening.
lines.sk: Zuzka. Ráno v škole, poobede v parku a večer pri kanáli.
lines.heard: Susie, school in the morning, the park in the afternoon, and the channel in the evening

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: She seems to know everything about Ivanka.
lines.sk: Vyzerá to, že vie o Ivanke všetko.
lines.heard: She seems to know everything about Ivanka

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: She does. What Susie doesn’t know, I know. And what I don’t know hasn’t happened yet.
lines.sk: Vie. Čo nevie Zuzka, viem ja. A čo neviem ja, to sa ešte nestalo.
lines.heard: She does. What Susie doesn't know I know, and what I don't know hasn't happened yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do you know anything about me yet?
lines.sk: A o mne už niečo viete?
lines.heard: And do you know anything about me yet?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: That you wear odd shoes. Susie will tell me the rest by this evening.
lines.sk: Že nosíte čudné topánky. Zvyšok mi Zuzka povie do večera.
lines.heard: That you wear odd shoes. Susie will tell me the rest by this evening

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s new in Ivanka?
lines.sk: Čo je nové v Ivanke?
lines.heard: What's new in Avanca?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: The neighbours opposite have a new radio. Now the whole street knows when the news is on and when it’s the brass band.
lines.sk: Susedia oproti majú nové rádio. Teraz celá ulica vie, kedy idú správy a kedy dychovka.
lines.heard: The neighbours opposite have a new radio. Now the whole street knows when the news is on and when it's the brass band

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And is that a good thing?
lines.sk: A to je dobre?
lines.heard: And is that a good thing?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: For the news, yes. The brass band we could play ourselves.
lines.sk: Pri správach áno. Dychovku by sme si vedeli zahrať aj sami.
lines.heard: For the news, yes. The brass band we could play ourselves

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: And in the hall they’re getting ready for a premiere. Rudy shouts so much at rehearsals you can hear him from here.
lines.sk: A v sále chystajú premiéru. Rudo pri skúške kričí tak, že ho počuť až sem.
lines.heard: And in the hall, they're getting ready for a premiere. Rudy shouts so much at rehearsals, you can hear him from here

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is there anything new at all that you don’t know yet?
lines.sk: Je vôbec niečo nové, čo by ste ešte nevedeli?
lines.heard: Is there anything new at all that you don't know yet?

lines.speaker: BERTA
lines.text: You, young man. That’s why I’m so curious.
lines.sk: Vy, mladý pán. Preto som taká zvedavá.
lines.heard: You, young man. That's why I'm so curious

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Here materials are issued only against a slip. If I needed more time, they’d have a form for that too.
lines.sk: Materiál sa tu vydáva iba na lístok. Keby som potreboval viac času, aj naň by tu mali tlačivo.
lines.heard: Here, materials are issued only against a slip. If I needed more time, they'd have a form for that too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. Mr Whitlock sent me – here’s his slip.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Posiela ma pán Bielik, tu je jeho lístok.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. Mr. Whitlock sent me. Here's his slip

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Slip, signature, materials. In that order.
lines.sk: Lístok, podpis, materiál. V tomto poradí.
lines.heard: Slip, signature, materials. In that order

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: The signature is Otto’s. I’d know it in the dark.
lines.sk: Podpis je Otov, ten spoznám aj potme.
lines.heard: The signature is Otto's. I'd know it in the dark.

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Pre-cut leather for a cuff and two rivets. Punch the marked places first, then rivet. I’ll keep the slip.
lines.sk: Predrezaná koža na manžetu a dva nity. Najprv prerazte označené miesta, potom zanitujte. Lístok si nechám.
lines.heard: Pre-cut leather for a cuff and two rivets. Punch the marked places first, then rivet. I'll keep the slip

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A clear procedure. You haven’t got one like that for my whole day?
lines.sk: Jasný postup. Nemáte taký aj na môj celý deň?
lines.heard: A clear procedure. You haven't got one like that for my whole day

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: For the whole day I’ve only got one: lunch at twelve.
lines.sk: Na celý deň mám len jeden: o dvanástej obed.
lines.heard: For the whole day, I've only got one. Lunch at 12:00

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if I don’t manage it by lunch?
lines.sk: A keby som to do obeda nestihol?
lines.heard: And if I don't manage it by lunch?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Then there’s a snack at three. That’s issued without a slip.
lines.sk: Tak o tretej je olovrant. Ten sa vydáva bez lístka.
lines.heard: Then there's a snack at three. That's issued without a slip

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mr Ramsey says you have feed for his pigeon.
lines.sk: Pán Baran vraví, že tu máte krmivo pre jeho holuba.
lines.heard: Mr. Ramsey says you have feed for his pigeon

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: For Aloysius’s Barnaby? Here’s his mix. Just tip it into the bowl and step back, so he doesn’t take fright.
lines.sk: Pre Alojzovho Bélu? Tu je jeho zmes. Len ju nasypte do misky a odstúpte, nech sa nesplaší.
lines.heard: For Aloysius's Barnaby, here's his mix. Just tip it into the bowl and step back so he doesn't take fright

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Two steps and no slip. I can manage that.
lines.sk: Dva kroky a žiaden lístok. To zvládnem.
lines.heard: Two steps and no slip. I can manage that

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: For Barnaby you don’t need a slip. He’s the only one I issue to on his word.
lines.sk: Na Bélu lístok netreba. Ten je jediný, komu vydávam na slovo.
lines.heard: For Barnaby, you don't need a slip. He's the only one I issue to on his word

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why him?
lines.sk: Prečo práve jemu?
lines.heard: Why him?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Because when he gets nothing, he sits on my hatch and stares. That works on me better than a slip.
lines.sk: Lebo keď nič nedostane, sadne si mi na okienko a pozerá. To na mňa zaberá viac než lístok.
lines.heard: Because when he gets nothing, he sits on my hatch and stares. That works on me better than a slip

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: A slip. ‘Please may I have one bit of leather for the bell.’
lines.sk: Lístok. „Prosím jeden kúsok kože na zvonček.“
lines.heard: A slip. Please may I have one bit of leather for the bell?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Signature: Susanna, first year.
lines.sk: Podpis: Zuzana, prvá trieda.
lines.heard: Signature Susanna, first year

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is it valid?
lines.sk: Platí?
lines.heard: Is it valid?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Slip, signature, materials. All in order. Nowhere does it say the signature has to be a grown-up’s.
lines.sk: Lístok, podpis, materiál. Všetko sedí. Nikde nie je napísané, že podpis musí byť dospelý.
lines.heard: Slip, signature, materials all in order. Nowhere does it say the signature has to be a grown-up's.

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: A narrow offcut from a strap. Just right for a loop. I’m keeping the slip.
lines.sk: Úzky odrezok z remeňa. Na pútko akurát. Lístok si nechávam.
lines.heard: A narrow offcut from a strap. Just right for a loop. I'm keeping the slip

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: For the records?
lines.sk: Do evidencie?
lines.heard: For the records

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: For the wall. I’ve never had such a nice slip here.
lines.sk: Na stenu. Taký pekný lístok som tu ešte nemal.
lines.heard: For the wall. I've never had such a nice slip here

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: And tell Susie I don’t need the little flower in the corner next time. But she’s welcome to draw it anyway.
lines.sk: A Zuzke odkážte, že kvetinku v rohu nabudúce nepotrebujem. Ale nech ju tam pokojne nakreslí.
lines.heard: And tell Susie I don't need the little flower in the corner next time. But she's welcome to draw it anyway

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Not everything. But I know exactly what we haven’t got.
lines.sk: Všetko nie. Ale presne viem, čo nemáme.
lines.heard: Not everything but I know exactly what we haven't got

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what haven’t you got?
lines.sk: A čo nemáte?
lines.heard: And what haven't you got?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Brass round-head screws, blue paint, and one spanner somebody borrowed in fifty-eight.
lines.sk: Mosadzné skrutky s polguľatou hlavou, modrú farbu a jeden kľúč, čo si niekto požičal v päťdesiatom ôsmom.
lines.heard: Brass round head screws, blue paint, and one spanner somebody borrowed in '58

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And are you looking for that spanner?
lines.sk: A ten kľúč hľadáte?
lines.heard: And are you looking for that spanner?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: No. I know exactly where it is. That person just doesn’t know yet that I know.
lines.sk: Nie. Viem presne, kde je. Len ten človek ešte nevie, že o tom viem.
lines.heard: No, I know exactly where it is. That person just doesn't know yet that I know.

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Without small pieces, a big thing often won’t budge.
lines.sk: Bez malých kúskov sa veľká vec často nepohne.
lines.heard: Without small pieces, a big thing often won't budge.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what can you make from a piece like that?
lines.sk: A čo sa dá z takého kúska urobiť?
lines.heard: And what can you make from a piece like that?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: A washer, a seal, a loop. With one offcut I once mended an entire stable door.
lines.sk: Podložku, tesnenie, pútko. Jedným odrezkom som raz opravil celé dvere od maštale.
lines.heard: A washer, a seal, a loop. With one offcut, I once mended an entire stable door

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An entire door?
lines.sk: Celé dvere?
lines.heard: An entire door?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: The hinge. But without a hinge a door is just a plank, so – entire.
lines.sk: Pánt. Ale bez pántu sú dvere iba doska, takže celé.
lines.heard: The hinge But without a hinge, a door's just a plank, so entire

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Does Mr Whitlock write slips often?
lines.sk: Pán Bielik píše lístky často?
lines.heard: Does Mr. Whitlock write slips often?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Every week. Neatly, with measurements and a signature. It’s a pleasure to issue materials against a slip like that.
lines.sk: Každý týždeň. Úhľadne, s rozmermi a s podpisom. Na taký lístok je radosť vydávať materiál.
lines.heard: Every week neatly with measurements and a signature. It's a pleasure to issue materials against a slip like that.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which slips don’t you like?
lines.sk: A ktoré lístky nemáte radi?
lines.heard: And which slips don't you like?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: The ones that say ‘something for repairs’. We don’t stock an item called ‘something’. Nobody has that.
lines.sk: Tie, kde je napísané „niečo na opravu“. Položku „niečo“ nevedieme. Tú nemá nikto.
lines.heard: The ones that say something for repairs We don't stock an item called something Nobody has that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why aren’t children allowed in here?
lines.sk: Prečo sem deti nesmú?
lines.heard: Why aren't children allowed in here?

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Because everything here is sharp, heavy or on record. Children would mix it all up.
lines.sk: Lebo tu je všetko ostré, ťažké alebo zapísané. Deti by to pomiešali.
lines.heard: Because everything here is sharp, heavy, or on record. Children would mix it all up.

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: A little girl once counted my sacks over the fence. I had two more than I thought.
lines.sk: Jedno dievčatko mi raz cez plot porátalo vrecia. Mal som o dve viac, než som myslel.
lines.heard: A little girl once counted my sacks over the fence. I had two more than I thought

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Well, that’s good news.
lines.sk: Tak to je dobrá správa.
lines.heard: Well, that's good news

lines.speaker: STEFAN
lines.text: Not for a store. I thought I knew exactly what we had.
lines.sk: Pre sklad nie. Ja som si myslel, že viem presne, čo máme.
lines.heard: Not for a store. I thought I knew exactly what we had

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Otto’s workshop. A covered lathe, the smell of oil, and alarm clocks ticking in every corner.
lines.sk: Otova dielňa. Prikrytý sústruh, vôňa oleja a tikot budíkov z každého rohu.
lines.heard: Otto's workshop. A covered lathe, the smell of oil, and alarm clocks ticking in every corner

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon, Mr Whitlock. Sorry to disturb you. You ought to see this.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň, pán Bielik. Prepáčte, že ruším. Toto by ste mali vidieť.
lines.heard: Good afternoon, Mr. Whitlock. Sorry to disturb you. You ought to see this

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: First we look, then we talk.
lines.sk: Najprv sa pozrieme, až potom budeme rozprávať.
lines.heard: First we look, then we talk

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: This is our design. Only it looks as if someone has been wearing it for decades.
lines.sk: Toto je náš návrh. Lenže vyzerá, akoby ho niekto nosil desaťročia.
lines.heard: This is our design. Only it looks as if someone has been wearing it for decades

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Someone has. I need its original calibration. In the future, someone is erasing everything that doesn’t match.
lines.sk: Nosil. Potrebujem jeho pôvodnú kalibráciu. V budúcnosti niekto maže všetko, čo sa nezhoduje.
lines.heard: Someone has. I need its original calibration. In the future, someone is erasing everything that doesn't match

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: I don’t understand that yet. But a device lies less than a person, and this one says you’re telling the truth.
lines.sk: Tomu zatiaľ nerozumiem. Ale prístroj klame menej ako človek a tento tvrdí, že hovoríte pravdu.
lines.heard: I don't understand that yet, but a device lies less than a person, and this one says you're telling the truth

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So you’ll help me?
lines.sk: Takže mi pomôžete?
lines.heard: So you'll help me?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Mira is with the device. But first the hand pump needs repairing. Here’s a slip for the leather and the rivets. Lydia in the village hall will lend you a punch if you help her.
lines.sk: Mira je pri prístroji. Najprv však treba opraviť ručnú pumpu. Tu je lístok na kožu a nity. Dierovač vám požičia Lída v sále, ak jej pomôžete.
lines.heard: Mira is with the device, but first the hand pump needs repairing. Here's a slip for the leather and the rivets. Lydia in the village hall will lend you a punch if you help her

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A pump? What has a pump got to do with time?
lines.sk: Pumpu? Čo má pumpa spoločné s časom?
lines.heard: A pump? What has a pump got to do with time?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: It cools the model in the hut. Until it draws water, the measuring room stays locked.
lines.sk: Chladí model v búdke. Kým neťahá vodu, meracia miestnosť zostane zamknutá.
lines.heard: It cools the model in the hut. Until it draws water, the measuring room stays locked

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I thought time travel would involve less leather and fewer rivets.
lines.sk: Myslel som, že pri cestovaní v čase bude menej kože a nitov.
lines.heard: I thought time travel would involve less leather and fewer rivets.

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: It’s precisely thanks to them that it works.
lines.sk: Práve vďaka nim to funguje.
lines.heard: It's precisely thanks to them that it works

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: And bring the punch back to me afterwards. I’ll return it to Lydia myself. She remembers things she’s lent better than Rudy remembers his lines.
lines.sk: A dierovač potom doneste mne. Líde ho vrátim sám. Požičané veci si pamätá lepšie ako Rudo svoj text.
lines.heard: And bring the punch back to me afterwards. I'll return it to Lydia myself. She remembers things she's lent better than Rudy remembers his lines

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The pump draws. The new cuff fits and nothing drips.
lines.sk: Pumpa ťahá. Nová manžeta sedí a nič nekvapká.
lines.heard: The pump draws the new cuff fits and nothing drips

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Show me your hands. Dry. Then it really doesn’t drip.
lines.sk: Ukážte ruky. Suché. Tak to naozaj nekvapká.
lines.heard: Show me your hands. Dry? Then it really doesn't drip

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Excellent. Here’s the key to the measuring room. Leave the punch with me; I’ll return it to Lydia.
lines.sk: Výborne. Tu je kľúč od meracej miestnosti. Dierovač mi nechajte, vrátim ho Líde.
lines.heard: Excellent. Here's the key to the measuring room. Leave the punch with me. I'll return it to Lydia

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: May I tell Mira who I am and where I’ve come from?
lines.sk: Môžem Mire povedať, kto som a odkiaľ prichádzam?
lines.heard: May I tell Mira who I am and where I've come from?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Tell her what you’ve seen. We’ll piece the truth together between us.
lines.sk: Povedzte jej, čo ste videli. Pravdu si z toho poskladáme spolu.
lines.heard: Tell her what you've seen. We'll piece the truth together between us

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if she asks me why I’m wearing such odd shoes?
lines.sk: A keď sa ma spýta, prečo mám také čudné topánky?
lines.heard: And if she asks me why I'm wearing such odd shoes?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Mira doesn’t look at shoes. She looks at what people do with their hands.
lines.sk: Mira sa na topánky nepozerá. Pozerá sa na to, čo človek robí rukami.
lines.heard: Mira doesn't look at shoes. She looks at what people do with their hands

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: It was meant to compare clocks in several places at once. And then yesterday spoke to us.
lines.sk: Mal porovnávať hodiny na viacerých miestach naraz. A potom sa nám ozval včerajšok.
lines.heard: It was meant to compare clocks in several places at once. And then yesterday spoke to us

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you didn’t run out of the workshop?
lines.sk: A vy ste z dielne neutiekli?
lines.heard: And you didn't run out of the workshop?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: First we checked the wiring.
lines.sk: Najprv sme skontrolovali zapojenie.
lines.heard: First, we check the wiring

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Only then did we get a fright.
lines.sk: Až potom sme sa zľakli.
lines.heard: Only then did we get a fright

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did yesterday tell you?
lines.sk: A čo vám ten včerajšok povedal?
lines.heard: And what did yesterday tell you?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: That I’d forgotten to switch off the soldering iron. It was right.
lines.sk: Že som zabudol vypnúť spájkovačku. Mal pravdu.
lines.heard: And that I'd forgotten to switch off the soldering iron. It was right.

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: What’s dangerous is thinking we know everything. The machine itself doesn’t think that.
lines.sk: Nebezpečné je myslieť si, že vieme všetko. Stroj sám si to nemyslí.
lines.heard: What's dangerous is thinking we know everything. The machine itself doesn't think that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In the future I know of one that does.
lines.sk: V budúcnosti poznám jedného, čo si to myslí.
lines.heard: In the future, I know of one that does

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: A machine or a person?
lines.sk: Stroj alebo človek?
lines.heard: A machine or a person?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A person with a machine. That’s worse than either on its own.
lines.sk: Človek so strojom. To je horšie ako oboje zvlášť.
lines.heard: A person with a machine, that's worse than either on its own

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Then someone should teach them to measure first and talk afterwards.
lines.sk: Tak nech ho niekto naučí najprv merať a až potom rozprávať.
lines.heard: Then someone should teach them to measure first and talk afterwards.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why have you got four alarm clocks in your workshop?
lines.sk: Prečo máte v dielni štyri budíky?
lines.heard: Why have you got four alarm clocks in your workshop?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: I’m comparing them. Each one runs a little differently, and I want to know why.
lines.sk: Porovnávam ich. Každý ide trochu inak a ja chcem vedieť prečo.
lines.heard: I'm comparing them. Each one runs a little differently, and I want to know why

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which one is right?
lines.sk: A ktorý ide správne?
lines.heard: And which one is right?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: None. But two of them are wrong in the same way, and that’s already information.
lines.sk: Žiaden. Ale dva z nich sa mýlia rovnako, a to je už informácia.
lines.heard: None. But two of them are wrong in the same way, and that's already information

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the fourth?
lines.sk: A ten štvrtý?
lines.heard: And the fourth?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: That one rings. It’s here so I don’t forget lunch.
lines.sk: Ten zvoní. Je tu na to, aby som nezabudol na obed.
lines.heard: That one rings. It's here so I don't forget lunch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve noticed you looking at my shoes.
lines.sk: Všimol som si, že sa mi pozeráte na topánky.
lines.heard: I've noticed you looking at my shoes

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: First I look, then I speak. I’ve never seen soles like that.
lines.sk: Najprv sa pozriem, až potom poviem. Takú podrážku som ešte nevidel.
lines.heard: First I look then I speak. I've never seen souls like that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: They’re work shoes.
lines.sk: Sú pracovné.
lines.heard: They're work shoes

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Mine are work shoes too. And yet nobody turns round to look at me.
lines.sk: Ja mám pracovné tiež. A predsa sa za mnou nikto neobzerá.
lines.heard: Mine are work shoes too, and yet nobody turns around to look at me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Should I change them?
lines.sk: Mám sa prezuť?
lines.heard: Should I change them?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: No. Just don’t stand near Mrs Smithson any longer than you have to.
lines.sk: Nie. Len nestojte pri pani Kovárovej dlhšie, ako musíte.
lines.heard: No just don't stand near Mrs. Smithson any longer than you have to

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s it like working with Mira?
lines.sk: Ako sa vám pracuje s Mirou?
lines.heard: What's it like working with Mira?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Fast. She finishes my sentence before I’ve started it.
lines.sk: Rýchlo. Ona dokončí moju vetu skôr, ako ju ja začnem.
lines.heard: Fast. She finishes my sentence before I've started it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you don’t mind?
lines.sk: To vám nevadí?
lines.heard: And you don't mind?

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: I mind when she finishes it better. And she often does.
lines.sk: Vadí mi, keď ju dokončí lepšie. A to robí často.
lines.heard: I mind when she finishes it better, and she often does

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The village hall before rehearsal. Here everyone plays someone else. I’m playing an ordinary visitor.
lines.sk: Sála pred skúškou. Tu sa každý hrá na niekoho iného. Ja na obyčajného návštevníka.
lines.heard: The village hall before rehearsal. Here, everyone plays someone else. I'm playing an ordinary visitor

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All it needed was the screw on the clamp tightening. The flat holds.
lines.sk: Stačilo dotiahnuť skrutku na svorke. Kulisa drží.
lines.heard: All it needed was the screw on the clamp tightening, the flat holds

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: That’s exactly what little Susie told me yesterday. That our forest was hanging by one screw.
lines.sk: Presne to mi včera hovorila malá Zuzka. Že náš les visí na jednej skrutke.
lines.heard: That's exactly what little Susie told me yesterday, that our forest was hanging by one screw

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: She was right. One screw was all it took.
lines.sk: Mala pravdu. Stačila jedna skrutka.
lines.heard: She was right. One screw was all it took

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: She’s nearly always right. It’s just that nobody will lend her a screwdriver.
lines.sk: Tá má pravdu skoro vždy. Len skrutkovač jej nikto nepožičia.
lines.heard: She's nearly always right. It's just that nobody will lend her a screwdriver

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Thank you. Otto said you need to punch a cuff. Here’s the punch – Otto will give it back to me later.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Oto vravel, že potrebujete dierovať manžetu. Tu je dierovač, Oto mi ho potom vráti.
lines.heard: Thank you. Otto said you need to punch a cuff. Here's the punch. Otto will give it back to me later

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: If only someone could tighten my memory too!
lines.sk: Keby mi tak niekto dotiahol aj pamäť!
lines.heard: If only someone could tighten my memory too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I haven’t got the right spanner for that in my bag.
lines.sk: Na to nemám v brašni správny kľúč.
lines.heard: No, I haven't got the right spanner for that in my bag

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Pity. My first line holds; the rest wobble like that forest.
lines.sk: Škoda. Prvá veta mi drží, ostatné sa kývu ako ten les.
lines.heard: Pity. My first line holds. The rest wobble like that forest

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Rudy, you stick to your script. The forest is holding now.
lines.sk: Rudo, ty sa drž textu. Les už drží.
lines.heard: Rudy, you stick to your script. The forest is holding now

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Two marks, two holes. Not one more.
lines.sk: Dve značky, dva otvory. Ani o jeden navyše.
lines.heard: Two marks, two holes not one more

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The rivets are in. The cuff is closed and the edge has stayed straight.
lines.sk: Nity sedia. Manžeta je uzavretá a okraj zostal rovný.
lines.heard: The rivets are in, the cuff is closed, and the edge has stayed straight

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Oh, the script! I lent it to Mira to rest her drawings on. And now I only know the first line by heart!
lines.sk: Ach, scenár! Požičal som ho Mire ako podložku pod nákresy. A teraz viem naspamäť len prvú vetu!
lines.heard: Oh, the script. I lent it to Mira to rest her drawings on, and now I only know the first line by heart

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And is the first line any good?
lines.sk: A tá prvá veta je dobrá?
lines.heard: And is the first line any good?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: The best! ‘Never fear, darling!’ Only without the second one it sounds as if I’m saying goodbye to someone at a station.
lines.sk: Najlepšia! „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“ Len bez druhej to znie, akoby som sa s niekým lúčil na stanici.
lines.heard: The best. Never fear, darling. Only without the second one, it sounds as if I'm saying goodbye to someone at a station

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And where was Mira drawing?
lines.sk: A kde Mira kreslila?
lines.heard: And where was Mira drawing?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: In the loft by the measuring room. If you find it, I’ll thank you with a bow!
lines.sk: Na povale pri meracej miestnosti. Ak ho nájdete, poďakujem vám aj s poklonou!
lines.heard: In the loft by the measuring room. If you find it, I'll thank you with a bow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A perfectly ordinary thank-you will do.
lines.sk: Stačí, keď poďakujete celkom obyčajne.
lines.heard: A perfectly ordinary thank you will do

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: I can’t do ordinary. But I’ll rehearse it!
lines.sk: Obyčajne to neviem. Ale nacvičím to!
lines.heard: I can't do ordinary, but I'll rehearse it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Your script. It was in the loft under Mira’s drawings.
lines.sk: Váš scenár. Ležal na povale pod Mirinými nákresmi.
lines.heard: Your script, it was in the loft under Mira's drawings

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: My script! All of it! Even the second act!
lines.sk: Môj scenár! Celý! Aj s druhým dejstvom!
lines.heard: My script! All of it, even the second act

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Never fear, darling! Everything will turn out fine!
lines.sk: Žiaden strach, miláčik! Všetko dobre dopadne!
lines.heard: Never fear, darling. Everything will turn out fine

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is that the first line?
lines.sk: To je tá prvá veta?
lines.heard: Is that the first line?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Yes. And then I spend three whole acts proving I overdid it.
lines.sk: Áno. A potom celé tri dejstvá dokazujem, že som to prehnal.
lines.heard: Yes, and then I spend three whole acts proving I overdid it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Whatever you do, don’t cut that line.
lines.sk: Tú vetu hlavne neškrtajte.
lines.heard: Whatever you do, don't cut that line

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Rudy, give me that script right now. I’m locking it away until the premiere.
lines.sk: Rudo, scenár mi hneď daj. Do premiéry ho zamknem.
lines.heard: Rudy, give me that script right now. I'm locking it away until the premiere

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: And what am I supposed to learn from?
lines.sk: A z čoho sa budem učiť?
lines.heard: And what am I supposed to learn from?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: I’ll copy it out for you. The original isn’t leaving this hall again.
lines.sk: Odpíšem ti ho. Originál sa už z tejto sály nepohne.
lines.heard: I'll copy it out for you. The original isn't leaving this hall again

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: When Rudy finds his script.
lines.sk: Keď Rudo nájde scenár.
lines.heard: When Rudy finds his script

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if he doesn’t?
lines.sk: A keď nenájde?
lines.heard: And if he doesn't?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Then it’ll be the premiere of a completely new work.
lines.sk: Tak bude premiéra úplne nového diela.
lines.heard: Then it'll be the premiere of a completely new work

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who’s going to write it?
lines.sk: A kto ho napíše?
lines.heard: And who's gonna write it?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Rudy, right there on stage. He’s already got the first line.
lines.sk: Rudo, priamo na javisku. Prvú vetu už má.
lines.heard: Rudy, right there on stage. He's already got the first line

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Six actors and four coats. And two intervals for changing.
lines.sk: Šesť hercov a štyri kabáty. A dve prestávky na prezliekanie.
lines.heard: Six actors and four coats and two intervals for changing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So someone will be doing the second act in a jumper.
lines.sk: Takže niekto bude v druhom dejstve hrať vo svetri.
lines.heard: So someone will be doing the second act in a jumper?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Rudy will be in the jumper. He always feels cold on stage when he forgets his lines.
lines.sk: Vo svetri bude hrať Rudo. Jemu je na javisku zima vždy, keď zabudne text.
lines.heard: Rudy will be in the jumper. He always feels cold on stage when he forgets his lines

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the audience doesn’t mind?
lines.sk: A divákom to neprekáža?
lines.heard: And the audience doesn't mind

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: The audience is from Ivanka. They know that jumper and give it its own round of applause.
lines.sk: Diváci sú z Ivanky. Ten sveter poznajú a tlieskajú mu zvlášť.
lines.heard: The audience is from Ivanka. They know that jumper and give it its own round of applause

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What are you actually rehearsing in the hall?
lines.sk: Čo vlastne v sále nacvičujete?
lines.heard: What are you actually rehearsing in the hall?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: A play about a mayor who promises at the start that everything will turn out fine. The rest of the play he spends fixing what goes wrong.
lines.sk: Hru o richtárovi, čo na začiatku sľúbi, že všetko dobre dopadne. Zvyšok hry napráva, čo sa pokazí.
lines.heard: A play about a mayor who promises at the start that everything will turn out fine. The rest of the play he spends fixing what goes wrong

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A comedy?
lines.sk: Komédia?
lines.heard: A comedy?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: For the audience. For me it’s a tragedy about buttons.
lines.sk: Pre divákov. Pre mňa je to tragédia o gombíkoch.
lines.heard: For the audience . For me, it's a tragedy about buttons

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: About buttons?
lines.sk: O gombíkoch?
lines.heard: About buttons

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: The mayor has twelve buttons on his coat. By the premiere I have to find at least eight.
lines.sk: Richtár má na kabáte dvanásť gombíkov. Do premiéry ich musím nájsť aspoň osem.
lines.heard: The mayor has 12 buttons on his coat. By the premiere, I have to find at least eight

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is Mr Pawley always so… enthusiastic?
lines.sk: Je pán Pavlík vždy taký… nadšený?
lines.heard: Is Mr. Paulie always so enthusiastic?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: On stage. Backstage he hides behind a flat and waits until I call him.
lines.sk: Na javisku. Za javiskom sa schová za kulisu a čaká, kým ho zavolám.
lines.heard: On stage. Backstage, he hides behind a flat and waits until I call him

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: Once he stood there so long that we locked him in the hall, forest and all.
lines.sk: Raz tam stál tak dlho, že sme ho zamkli v sále aj s lesom.
lines.heard: Once he stood there so long that we locked him in the hall, forest and all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did he do?
lines.sk: A čo urobil?
lines.heard: And what did he do?

lines.speaker: LIDA
lines.text: He rehearsed all night. By morning he knew his whole part. He still had the script back then.
lines.sk: Celú noc nacvičoval. Ráno vedel celú svoju úlohu. Vtedy ešte mal scenár.
lines.heard: He rehearsed all night. By morning, he knew his whole part. He still had the script back then

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: I make my entrance and cry out that everything will turn out fine!
lines.sk: Vstúpim a zvolám, že všetko dobre dopadne!
lines.heard: I make my entrance and cry out that everything will turn out fine

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’d like to hear that offstage too, right now.
lines.sk: To by som teraz rád počul aj mimo javiska.
lines.heard: I'd like to hear that offstage too, right now

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Offstage I can’t say it. Offstage something always goes wrong.
lines.sk: Mimo javiska to neviem povedať. Mimo javiska sa vždy niečo pokazí.
lines.heard: Offstage? I can't say it. Offstage something always goes wrong

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Such as?
lines.sk: Napríklad?
lines.heard: Such as?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Such as losing my script. But on stage I’m convincing!
lines.sk: Napríklad stratím scenár. Ale na javisku som presvedčivý!
lines.heard: such as losing my script. But on stage, I'm convincing

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Me? Never! It’s only my knees that rehearse a performance of their own.
lines.sk: Ja? Nikdy! Iba moje kolená si nacvičujú vlastné predstavenie.
lines.heard: Me? Never. It's only my knees that rehearse a performance of their own

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Just make sure they don’t go off on tour without you.
lines.sk: Hlavne nech vám neodídu na zájazd.
lines.heard: Just make sure they don't go off on tour without you

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Lydia has forbidden it. The knees, the script and the hat all stay in Ivanka!
lines.sk: Lída im to zakázala. Kolená, scenár aj klobúk zostávajú v Ivanke!
lines.heard: Lydia has forbidden it. The knees, the script, and the hat all stay in Ivanka

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you?
lines.sk: A vy?
lines.heard: And you?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: I go wherever my knees go. We’re one company.
lines.sk: Ja idem tam, kam moje kolená. Sme jeden súbor.
lines.heard: I go wherever my knees go. We're one company

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do you do when you’re not acting?
lines.sk: Čo robíte, keď práve nehráte?
lines.heard: What do you do when you're not acting?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: I weigh grain at the cooperative. Quietly. There’s no shouting there.
lines.sk: Vážim obilie na družstve. Potichu. Tam sa nekričí.
lines.heard: I weigh grain at the cooperative quietly. There's no shouting there

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You, quietly?
lines.sk: Vy a potichu?
lines.heard: You quietly

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: On stage I’m a king. At the scales I’m just Rudy. And Rudy says very little.
lines.sk: Na javisku som kráľ. Pri váhe som len Rudo. A Rudo hovorí málo.
lines.heard: On stage, I'm a king. At the scales, I'm just Rudy, and Rudy says very little

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which of them is the real one?
lines.sk: A ktorý z nich je ten skutočný?
lines.heard: And which of them is the real one?

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: The one answering you right now. But don’t tell the audience!
lines.sk: Ten, čo vám práve odpovedá. Ale nehovorte to divákom!
lines.heard: The one answering you right now. But don't tell the audience

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: They say the whole of Ivanka knows your first line.
lines.sk: Vašu prvú vetu vraj vie celá Ivanka.
lines.heard: They say the whole of Evanka knows your first line

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Not the whole of it! But little Susie from the park knows it better than I do. And says it with more conviction!
lines.sk: Celá nie! Ale malá Zuzka z parku ju vie lepšie ako ja. A hovorí ju s väčším presvedčením!
lines.heard: Not the whole of it. But little Susie from the park knows it better than I do, and says it with more conviction

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: Every day she stands in the doorway of the hall and whispers it to me when I forget.
lines.sk: Stojí každý deň vo dverách sály a šepká mi ju, keď zabudnem.
lines.heard: Every day she stands in the doorway of the hall and whispers it to me when I forget

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So you’ve got your own prompter.
lines.sk: Takže máte vlastnú šepkárku.
lines.heard: So you've got your own prompter

lines.speaker: RUDO
lines.text: The smallest in the district. And the only one who doesn’t ask for a fee.
lines.sk: Najmenšiu v okrese. A jedinú, čo si nepýta odmenu.
lines.heard: The smallest in the district, and the only one who doesn't ask for a fee

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The park by the manor house. Someone is drawing on a bench, someone is playing hopscotch on the path. Nobody here is in a hurry.
lines.sk: Park pri kaštieli. Na lavičke niekto kreslí, na chodníku niekto skáče škôlku. Tu sa nikto neponáhľa.
lines.heard: The park by the manor house. Someone is drawing on a bench. Someone is playing hopscotch on the path. Nobody here's in a hurry

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mira sent me to you. I’m making an imprint of the calibration plate and I need something blunt.
lines.sk: Mira ma posiela za vami. Robím odtlačok kalibračnej platne a potrebujem niečo tupé.
lines.heard: Mira sent me to you. I'm making an imprint of the calibration plate, and I need something blunt

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Auntie Vera keeps the blunt one in her case. She keeps the sharp ones for herself.
lines.sk: Tupé má teta Vera v puzdre. Ostré si nechá pre seba.
lines.heard: Auntie Vera keeps the blunt one in her case. She keeps the sharp ones for herself

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Susie, you know my case better than I do.
lines.sk: Zuzka, ty poznáš moje puzdro lepšie ako ja.
lines.heard: Susie, you know my case better than I do

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Because I count the styluses. Five sharp ones and one blunt one.
lines.sk: Lebo tie rydlá rátam. Päť ostrých rydiel a jedno tupé.
lines.heard: Because I count the styluses. Five sharp ones and one blunt one

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Then take my stylus. Press the paper down first, then trace round the edges. Don’t scratch into the plate.
lines.sk: Tak si vezmite moje rydlo. Papier najprv pritlačte, potom obtiahnite hrany. Do platne neryte.
lines.heard: Then take my stylus, press the paper down first, then trace around the edges. Don't scratch into the plate

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A stylus you mustn’t scratch with. I’ll remember that.
lines.sk: Rydlo, ktorým sa nemá ryť. To si zapamätám.
lines.heard: A stylus you mustn't scratch with. I'll remember that

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: That’s why it’s blunt. It remembers it for you.
lines.sk: Preto je tupé. Zapamätá si to za vás.
lines.heard: That's why it's blunt It remembers it for you

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And what else do you need?
lines.sk: A čo ešte potrebujete?
lines.heard: And what else do you need?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I need one form twice. Both exactly the same.
lines.sk: Jeden list mám mať dvakrát. Oba presne rovnaké.
lines.heard: I need one form twice both exactly the same

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Mr Ramsey at the post office has black paper for that. You write on top and it writes itself underneath.
lines.sk: Na to má pán Baran na pošte čierny papier. Píšete hore a dole sa to napíše samo.
lines.heard: Mr. Ramsey at the post office has black paper for that. You write on top, and it writes itself underneath

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Carbon paper. It’s at the post office by the counter, for anyone.
lines.sk: Uhľový papier. Leží na pošte pri prepážke, pre každého.
lines.heard: Carbon paper. It's at the post office by the counter for anyone

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you both. I’ll bring the stylus back afterwards.
lines.sk: Ďakujem obom. Rydlo vám potom vrátim.
lines.heard: Thank you both. I'll bring the stylus back afterwards

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Leave it with Mira afterwards – she’ll give it back to me. You’ll be doing enough walking round Ivanka as it is.
lines.sk: Nechajte ho potom Mire, ona mi ho vráti. Vy sa po Ivanke aj tak dosť nachodíte.
lines.heard: Leave it with Mira afterwards. She'll give it back to me. You'll be doing enough walking around Ivanka as it is.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The feed is in the bowl. I’ll step back so Barnaby can have some peace.
lines.sk: Krmivo je v miske. Odstúpim, nech má Béla pokoj.
lines.heard: The feed is in the bowl. I'll step back so Barnaby can have some peace

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: He’s eaten, shaken himself and he’s flying straight to the post office. He knows the way home better than I do.
lines.sk: Najedol sa, otriasol a letí rovno k pošte. Cestu domov pozná lepšie ako ja.
lines.heard: He's eaten, shaken himself, and he's flying straight to the post office. He knows the way home better than I do

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: This is our class bell. Look, I shake it. Nothing.
lines.sk: Toto je zvonček našej triedy. Pozrite, zatrasiem. Nič.
lines.heard: This is our class bell. Look, I shake it. Nothing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s missing its clapper.
lines.sk: Chýba mu srdce.
lines.heard: It's missing its clapper

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: It isn’t. I’ve got it in my hanky. It’s just that the loop broke.
lines.sk: Nechýba. Mám ho vo vreckovke. Len sa mu roztrhlo pútko.
lines.heard: It isn't. I've got it in my hanky. It's just that the loop broke

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: At the end of the year I’m the one who rings it. Our teacher said I’ve got the steadiest hand.
lines.sk: Na konci roka mám zvoniť ja. Naša učiteľka povedala, že mám najistejšiu ruku.
lines.heard: At the end of the year, I'm the one who rings it. Our teacher said I've got the steadiest hand

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who was supposed to fix it?
lines.sk: A kto ho mal opraviť?
lines.heard: And who was supposed to fix it?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Uncle Otto. But today Uncle Otto has four alarm clocks and not one free hand.
lines.sk: Ujo Oto. Ale ujo Oto má dnes štyri budíky a ani jednu voľnú ruku.
lines.heard: Uncle Otto. But today, Uncle Otto has four alarm clocks and not one free hand

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Uncle Stephen in the yard has the leather. But children aren’t allowed in there.
lines.sk: Kožu má ujo Štefan na dvore. Lenže deti tam nesmú.
lines.heard: Uncle Stephen in the yard has the leather, but children aren't allowed in there

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: So I wrote him a slip. Uncle Stephen always says: ‘Slip, signature, materials.’
lines.sk: Tak som mu napísala lístok. Ujo Štefan vždy hovorí: „Lístok, podpis, materiál.“
lines.heard: So I wrote him a slip Uncle Stephen always says, "Slip, signature, materials."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘Slip. Please may I have one bit of leather for the bell. Susanna, first year.’
lines.sk: „Lístok. Prosím jeden kúsok kože na zvonček. Zuzana, prvá trieda.“
lines.heard: Slip. Please may I have one bit of leather for the bell? Susannah, first year

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: There’s a signature too. Without a signature, nothing.
lines.sk: Aj podpis tam je. Bez podpisu nič.
lines.heard: There's a signature too. Without a signature, nothing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll bring the leather and make the loop. Will you lend me the bell?
lines.sk: Kožu prinesiem a pútko spravím. Požičiaš mi zvonček?
lines.heard: I'll bring the leather and make the loop. Will you lend me the bell?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I will. But be careful – it belongs to the class, not to me.
lines.sk: Požičiam. Ale opatrne, je triedny, nie môj.
lines.heard: I will, but be careful. It belongs to the class, not to me.

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And when you’ve fixed it, don’t ring it on the way. I’m supposed to ring it first.
lines.sk: A keď ho opravíte, nezvoňte ním cestou. Prvá mám zvoniť ja.
lines.heard: And when you've fixed it, don't ring it on the way. I'm supposed to ring it first

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Loop through the eye, clapper in place, knot on the inside so it doesn’t rub.
lines.sk: Pútko cez uško, srdce na miesto, uzol dovnútra, aby sa nešúchal.
lines.heard: Loop through the eye, clapper in place, not on the inside so it doesn't rub

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll give it one careful tinkle. It rings. But Susanna gets to ring it properly first.
lines.sk: Opatrne ním raz zacinkám. Zvoní. Ale poriadne zvoniť bude prvá Zuzana.
lines.heard: I'll give it one careful tinkle. It rings, but Susanna gets to ring it properly first

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: It rings? Really?
lines.sk: Zvoní? Naozaj?
lines.heard: It rings? Really?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Try it. But gently – the loop is still new.
lines.sk: Skús. Ale jemne, pútko je ešte nové.
lines.heard: Try it but gently the loop is still new

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Did you hear? That’s what the end of the year will sound like.
lines.sk: Počuli ste? Takto bude znieť koniec roka.
lines.heard: Did you hear? That's what the end of the year will sound like

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Susie, now the whole park thinks the lesson is over.
lines.sk: Zuzka, teraz celý park vie, že sa skončila hodina.
lines.heard: Susie, now the whole park thinks the lesson is over

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: It isn’t the end yet. Twenty-four more days. That was a rehearsal.
lines.sk: Ešte nie je koniec. Ešte dvadsaťštyri dní. Toto bola skúška.
lines.heard: It isn't the end yet. Twenty-four more days. That was a rehearsal

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The rehearsal went well.
lines.sk: Skúška vyšla.
lines.heard: The rehearsal went well

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Thank you. You can have a go at hopscotch. But only up to four – grown-ups fall over after that.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Môžete si zaskákať škôlku. Ale iba do štvorky, dospelí ďalej padajú.
lines.heard: Thank you. You can have a go at hopscotch, but only up to four. Grown-ups fall over after that

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And whenever you hear the bell ring at the end of the year, wave. That’s the agreement.
lines.sk: A keď budete niekedy počuť zvoniť na konci roka, zamávajte. To je dohoda.
lines.heard: And whenever you hear the bell ring at the end of the year, wave. That's the agreement

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Agreed.
lines.sk: Dohoda.
lines.heard: Agreed.

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: For the light. And out here Otto can’t change the measurements on me every three minutes.
lines.sk: Pre svetlo. A Oto mi tu nemôže každé tri minúty meniť rozmery.
lines.heard: For the light and out here, otto can't change the measurements on me every three minutes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that kind of customer too – the one who keeps changing the brief.
lines.sk: Zákazníka, ktorý mení zadanie, poznám tiež.
lines.heard: I know that kind of customer too, the one who keeps changing the brief

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: And what do you do with him?
lines.sk: A čo s ním robíte?
lines.heard: And what do you do with him?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I write down the first brief. When he comes back, I show him where he started.
lines.sk: Zapíšem si prvé zadanie. Keď sa vráti, ukážem mu, kde začal.
lines.heard: I write down the first brief. When he comes back I show him where he started

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: I’ll try that on Otto. Though he’ll only show me what my first drawing looked like.
lines.sk: To skúsim aj na Ota. Hoci on mi zas ukáže, ako vyzeral môj prvý nákres.
lines.heard: I'll try that on Otto though he'll only show me what my first drawing looked like

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: One where the next person doesn’t have to guess what we meant.
lines.sk: Taký, pri ktorom ďalší človek nemusí hádať, čo sme chceli povedať.
lines.heard: One where the next person doesn't have to guess what we meant

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You should write instructions for household appliances.
lines.sk: Mali by ste písať návody k spotrebičom.
lines.heard: You should write instructions for household appliances

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Does anyone read those? I thought they were included so there’d be something to lose.
lines.sk: Tie niekto číta? Myslela som, že sa prikladajú, aby bolo čo stratiť.
lines.heard: Does anyone read those? I thought they were included so there'd be something to lose

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In my workshop they’re the first thing to go missing.
lines.sk: V mojej dielni sa strácajú ako prvé.
lines.heard: In my workshop, they're the first thing to go missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That little girl playing hopscotch – does she keep you company here every day?
lines.sk: To dievčatko, čo skáče škôlku, vám tu robí spoločnosť každý deň?
lines.heard: That little girl playing hopscotch, does she keep you company here every day?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: Susie? Every day. She hops, she counts, and now and then she tells me one of my lines is crooked.
lines.sk: Zuzka? Každý deň. Skáče, ráta a občas mi povie, že mám krivú čiaru.
lines.heard: Susie every day she hops, she counts and now and then she tells me one of my lines is crooked

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And is it?
lines.sk: A máte?
lines.heard: And is it?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: It is. That’s why I’d rather keep her counting, so she doesn’t check my lines.
lines.sk: Mám. Preto ju radšej nechávam rátať, nech mi nekontroluje čiary.
lines.heard: It is. That's why I'd rather keep her counting so she doesn't check my lines.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What have you got on your drawing board?
lines.sk: Čo to máte na výkrese?
lines.heard: What have you got on your drawing board?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: A cross-section of ZVON. So that one day even someone who wasn’t there can repair it.
lines.sk: Prierez ZVONu. Aby ho raz vedel opraviť aj niekto, kto pri ňom nebol.
lines.heard: A cross section of Zvon so that one day even someone who wasn't there can repair it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Someone like me.
lines.sk: Napríklad ja.
lines.heard: Someone like me?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: For example. Though you look as if you’ve been near it already.
lines.sk: Napríklad. Hoci vy vyzeráte, akoby ste pri ňom už boli.
lines.heard: For example? Though you look as if you've been near it already.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Are you drawing that for Mr Whitlock?
lines.sk: To kreslíte pre pána Bielika?
lines.heard: Are you drawing that for Mr. Whitlock?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: For Otto. This morning he told me it was finished. At lunchtime, nearly finished. Now it’s a draft.
lines.sk: Pre Ota. Ráno mi povedal, že je to hotové. Na obed, že skoro hotové. Teraz je to návrh.
lines.heard: For Otto, this morning he told me it was finished at lunchtime, nearly finished now it's a draft

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do you do about that?
lines.sk: A čo s tým robíte?
lines.heard: And what do you do about that?

lines.speaker: VERA60
lines.text: I draw in pencil. I’m saving the ink for the day Otto stops changing the measurements.
lines.sk: Kreslím ceruzkou. Atrament si nechám na deň, keď Oto prestane meniť rozmery.
lines.heard: I draw in pencil. I'm saving the ink for the day Otto stops changing the measurements

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi. Are you playing hopscotch?
lines.sk: Ahoj. Ty hráš škôlku?
lines.heard: Hi. Are you playing hopscotch?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I am. But I don’t go to nursery any more. I’m in the first year at school.
lines.sk: Hrám. Ale do škôlky už nechodím. Chodím do prvej triedy.
lines.heard: I am, but I don't go to nursery anymore. I'm in the first year at school

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Twenty-four more days and I’ll have done the whole first year.
lines.sk: Ešte dvadsaťštyri dní a mám za sebou celú prvú triedu.
lines.heard: 24 more days and I'll have done the whole first year.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You count them?
lines.sk: Ty si to rátaš?
lines.heard: You count them

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I count everything. Squares, stairs, and how many times Uncle Rudy forgets his lines.
lines.sk: Ja si rátam všetko. Políčka, schody aj to, koľkokrát ujo Rudo zabudne text.
lines.heard: I count everything: squares, stairs, and how many times Uncle Rudy forgets his lines

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many times has he forgotten them today?
lines.sk: A koľkokrát ho dnes zabudol?
lines.heard: And how many times has he forgotten them today?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Eleven times so far. But it isn’t evening yet.
lines.sk: Zatiaľ jedenásťkrát. Ale ešte nie je večer.
lines.heard: 11 times so far, but it isn't evening yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m Adam.
lines.sk: Ja som Adam.
lines.heard: I'm Adam

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I’m Susanna. You’re not from here. You talk differently.
lines.sk: Ja som Zuzana. Vy nie ste odtiaľto. Vy rozprávate inak.
lines.heard: I'm Susanna. You're not from here. You talk differently

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Differently? How?
lines.sk: Inak? Ako?
lines.heard: Differently? How?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Like the radio from Bratislava. Nicely, but fast.
lines.sk: Ako rádio z Bratislavy. Pekne, ale rýchlo.
lines.heard: Like the radio from Bratislava, nicely but fast

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you know where Mr Whitlock has his workshop?
lines.sk: Nevieš, kde má dielňu pán Bielik?
lines.heard: Do you know where Mr. Whitlock has his workshop?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Uncle Otto? You can find him by the sound.
lines.sk: Ujo Oto? Toho nájdete po zvuku.
lines.heard: Uncle Otto? You can find him by the sound

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: From the green, go where it smells of leather. That’s the yard, and Uncle Stephen is there.
lines.sk: Z návsi choďte tam, kde vonia koža. To je dvor a tam je ujo Štefan.
lines.heard: From the green, go where it smells of leather. That's the yard, and Uncle Steven is there

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And past him, go where it ticks from every side. That’s Uncle Otto.
lines.sk: A za ním tam, kde to tiká zo všetkých strán. To je ujo Oto.
lines.heard: And past him go where it ticks from every side. That's Uncle Otto

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The smell of leather, then the ticking. I’ll remember that.
lines.sk: Vôňa kože a potom tikanie. To si zapamätám.
lines.heard: The smell of leather then the ticking. I'll remember that

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Just don’t go where it clucks. That’s only the hens.
lines.sk: Hlavne nechoďte tam, kde to kotkodáka. Tam sú len sliepky.
lines.heard: Just don't go where it clucks. That's only the hens

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you know where I can find Mrs Lydia from the theatre?
lines.sk: Nevieš, kde nájdem pani Lídu z divadla?
lines.heard: Do you know where I can find Mrs. Lydia from the theater?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Auntie Lydia is in the hall. Where someone is shouting ‘Never fear, darling!’
lines.sk: Teta Lída je v sále. Tam, kde niekto kričí „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“
lines.heard: Auntie Lydia is in the hall where someone is shouting, "Never fear, darling."

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Their fabric forest wobbles all day long. One screw is loose – I saw it.
lines.sk: Ten látkový les sa im celý deň kýve. Jedna skrutka je voľná, ja som to videla.
lines.heard: Their fabric forest wobbles all day long. One screw is loose. I saw it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you tell them?
lines.sk: A povedala si im to?
lines.heard: And did you tell them?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I did. But nobody will lend me a screwdriver, because I’m little.
lines.sk: Povedala. Ale skrutkovač mi nikto nepožičia, lebo som malá.
lines.heard: I did, but nobody will lend me a screwdriver because I'm little

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve got one in my bag.
lines.sk: Ja jeden mám v brašni.
lines.heard: I've got one in my bag

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: They probably won’t take yours away. You’re big.
lines.sk: Vám ho asi nevezmú. Vy ste veľký.
lines.heard: They probably won't take yours away. You're big

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That pump by the hut behind the park…
lines.sk: Tá pumpa pri búdke za parkom…
lines.heard: That pump by the hut behind the park

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: It drips. This morning I counted a hundred drips, then I stopped.
lines.sk: Kvapká. Ráno som jej narátala sto kvapiek, potom som prestala.
lines.heard: It drips. This morning, I counted 100 drips. Then I stopped

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why did you stop?
lines.sk: Prečo si prestala?
lines.heard: Why did you stop?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Because after a hundred there was nothing interesting. Just more drips.
lines.sk: Lebo za stovkou už nebolo nič zaujímavé. Len ďalšie kvapky.
lines.heard: Because after a hundred, there was nothing interesting. Just more drips

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Auntie Mira says the pump needs a new cuff.
lines.sk: Teta Mira hovorí, že pumpe treba novú manžetu.
lines.heard: Auntie Mara says the pump needs a new cuff

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I thought a cuff was on a shirt. A pump hasn’t got a shirt.
lines.sk: Ja som myslela, že manžeta je na košeli. Pumpa predsa košeľu nemá.
lines.heard: I thought a cuff was on a shirt. A pump hasn't got a shirt

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This one’s made of leather. It keeps the water where it’s supposed to be.
lines.sk: Táto je kožená. Drží vodu tam, kde má byť.
lines.heard: This one's made of leather. It keeps the water where it's supposed to be

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: So it’s a sort of belt for water.
lines.sk: Tak je to taký opasok pre vodu.
lines.heard: So it's a sort of belt for water?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you know Mira Perry?
lines.sk: Poznáš Miru Hruškovú?
lines.heard: Do you know Mira Perry?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Auntie Mira from the hut? All of Ivanka knows her.
lines.sk: Tetu Miru z búdky? Tú pozná celá Ivanka.
lines.heard: Auntie Mira from the hut? All of Ivanka knows her

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: When the hut by the channel has its light on in the daytime, the grown-ups say: ‘Mira’s measuring time again.’
lines.sk: Keď v búdke pri kanáli svieti aj cez deň, dospelí povedia: „Mira zas meria čas.“
lines.heard: When the hut by the channel has its light on in the daytime, the grown-ups say, "Mira's measuring time again."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do you know what that means?
lines.sk: A ty vieš, čo to znamená?
lines.heard: And do you know what that means?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: No. But she does it very precisely. Once she timed how long it takes me to do the hopscotch.
lines.sk: Neviem. Ale robí to veľmi presne. Raz mi zmerala, ako dlho skáčem škôlku.
lines.heard: No, but she does it very precisely. Once she timed how long it takes me to do the hopscotch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how long?
lines.sk: A ako dlho?
lines.heard: And how long

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Twenty-two seconds. Now it’s twenty-one. I’m practising.
lines.sk: Dvadsaťdva sekúnd. Teraz už dvadsaťjeden. Trénujem.
lines.heard: 22 seconds. Now it's 21. I'm practicing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is that pigeon by the bowl your friend?
lines.sk: Ten holub pri miske je tvoj kamarát?
lines.heard: Is that pigeon by the bowl your friend?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: No, he’s Mr Ramsey’s. He’s a carrier pigeon – he’s got a ring on his leg.
lines.sk: Nie, ten je pána Barana. Je poštový, má na nohe krúžok.
lines.heard: No, he's Mr. Ramsey's. He's a carrier pigeon. He's got a ring on his leg

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I gave him some bread, but he didn’t want it. He must be used to better.
lines.sk: Dala som mu chlieb, ale nechcel. Asi je zvyknutý na lepšie.
lines.heard: I gave him some bread, but he didn't want it. He must be used to better.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe he wants his own feed.
lines.sk: Možno chce svoje vlastné krmivo.
lines.heard: Maybe he wants his own feed

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Uncle Stephen in the yard will have that. He has everything you can pour.
lines.sk: To bude mať ujo Štefan na dvore. On má všetko, čo sa sype.
lines.heard: Uncle Stephen in the yard will have that. He has everything you can pour

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And don’t chase him. When someone chases him, he flies exactly where you don’t want him to.
lines.sk: A nenaháňajte ho. Keď ho niekto naháňa, letí presne tam, kam nechcete.
lines.heard: And don't chase him. When someone chases him, he flies exactly where you don't want him to

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What are you going to do in the holidays?
lines.sk: Čo budeš robiť cez prázdniny?
lines.heard: What are you gonna do in the holidays?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
