lines.text: I’m going to go to the channel and watch the water flow. We’re not allowed in the water, only to watch.
lines.sk: Budem chodiť ku kanálu pozerať, ako tečie voda. Do vody nesmieme, iba pozerať.
lines.heard: I'm going to go to the channel and watch the water flow. We're not allowed in the water, only to watch.

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: And I’m going to go to the station. Uncle Ted lets me wave to the trains to Bratislava.
lines.sk: A budem chodiť na zastávku. Ujo Božo mi dovolí kývať vlakom do Bratislavy.
lines.heard: And I'm going to go to the station. Uncle Ted lets me wave to the trains to Bratislava

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All of them?
lines.sk: Všetkým?
lines.heard: All of them

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Only the ones that are on time. He waves to the others himself. Crossly.
lines.sk: Iba tým, čo idú načas. Tým ostatným kýva on sám. Nahnevane.
lines.heard: Only the ones that are on time. He waves to the others himself, crossly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do they put on plays here too?
lines.sk: Hrá sa tu u vás aj divadlo?
lines.heard: Do they put on plays here too?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: They do. Uncle Rudy is rehearsing in the hall, and I already know his first line: ‘Never fear, darling!’
lines.sk: Hrá sa. V sále skúša ujo Rudo a ja už viem jeho prvú vetu: „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“
lines.heard: They do. Uncle Rudy is rehearsing in the hall and I already know his first line. "Never fear, darling

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the second?
lines.sk: A druhú?
lines.heard: And the second?

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Not even he knows the second. It’s in the script, and the script got lost.
lines.sk: Druhú nevie ani on. Je v scenári a scenár sa stratil.
lines.heard: Not even he knows the second. It's in the script, and the script got lost

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: Auntie Lydia says if it isn’t found, it’ll be a very short play.
lines.sk: Teta Lída hovorí, že ak sa nenájde, bude to veľmi krátke divadlo.
lines.heard: Auntie Lydia says if it isn't found it'll be a very short play

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One line and then applause.
lines.sk: Jedna veta a potom potlesk.
lines.heard: One line and then applause

lines.speaker: ZUZANA
lines.text: I’d clap. But only a little, so he doesn’t think that’s enough.
lines.sk: Ja by som tlieskala. Ale len trochu, aby si nemyslel, že to stačí.
lines.heard: I'd clap, but only a little, so he doesn't think that's enough

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A hut, a pump and a bucket. Research into time starts out like gardening.
lines.sk: Búdka, pumpa a vedro. Výskum času sa začína ako záhradkárčenie.
lines.heard: A hut, a pump, and a bucket. Research into time starts out like gardening

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Old cuff out, new cuff in. A few strokes of the pump and the water is circulating again.
lines.sk: Stará manžeta von, nová dnu. Pár ťahov pumpou a voda znova obieha.
lines.heard: Old cuff out, new cuff in, a few strokes of the pump and the water's circulating again

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now Otto can open the measuring room.
lines.sk: Teraz môže Oto otvoriť meraciu miestnosť.
lines.heard: Now Otto can open the measuring room

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I expected a secret entrance to the past. It’s an ordinary door and an ordinary key.
lines.sk: Čakal som tajný vchod do minulosti. Sú to obyčajné dvere a obyčajný kľúč.
lines.heard: I expected a secret entrance to the past. It's an ordinary door and an ordinary key

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran isn’t a gran yet. But she already has the look that switches off pointless questions.
lines.sk: Babka ešte nie je babka. Ale už má pohľad, ktorým sa vypínajú zbytočné otázky.
lines.heard: Gran isn't a gran yet, but she already has the look that switches off pointless questions

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: You’re the one who mended the pump? Otto said you’d come. Talk – I’ll carry on measuring.
lines.sk: Ty si ten, čo opravil pumpu? Oto vravel, že prídeš. Hovor, ja zatiaľ meriam.
lines.heard: You're the one who mended the pump otto said you'd come talk. I'll carry on measuring

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. In the future, someone is erasing everything that doesn’t fit their model. And overwriting it retrospectively.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. V budúcnosti niekto maže všetko, čo nesedí s jeho modelom. A prepisuje to spätne.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. In the future, someone is erasing everything that doesn't fit their model and overwriting it retrospectively

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: So, a write-back. If it throws away the original difference, in time it throws away whoever caused it too. That’s why we have the return buffer.
lines.sk: Takže spätný zápis. Keď zahodí pôvodný rozdiel, časom zahodí aj toho, kto ho spôsobil. Preto máme návratový zásobník.
lines.heard: So a write back, if it throws away the original difference, in time it throws away whoever caused it too. That's why we have the return buffer

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So what has disappeared isn’t completely gone yet?
lines.sk: Čiže to, čo zmizlo, ešte nie je úplne preč?
lines.heard: So what has disappeared isn't completely gone yet?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Until the write is closed, it’s only set aside. The device has to be able to bring it back.
lines.sk: Kým sa zápis neuzavrie, je to len odložené. Prístroj to musí vedieť vrátiť.
lines.heard: Until the write is closed, it's only set aside. The device has to be able to bring it back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I need proof of what the original rule said.
lines.sk: Potom potrebujem dôkaz, ako znelo pôvodné pravidlo.
lines.heard: Then I need proof of what the original rule said

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Make an imprint of the plate. The paper is in the loft, and Vera in the park has a blunt stylus. And here’s a registration form: the post office will confirm the date, and we’ll file the copy.
lines.sk: Urob odtlačok platne. Papier je na povale, tupé rydlo má Vera v parku. A tu je registračný list: pošta potvrdí dátum, kópiu uložíme.
lines.heard: Make an imprint of the plate. The paper is in the loft, and Vera in the park has a blunt stylus. And here's a registration form. The post office will confirm the date, and we'll file the copy

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You just believe me, like that?
lines.sk: Vy mi len tak veríte?
lines.heard: You just believe me? Like that?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: I believe you’ve come to preserve things, not to overwrite them.
lines.sk: Verím, že si prišiel veci zachovať, nie prepisovať.
lines.heard: I believe you've come to preserve things, not to overwrite them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My gran would say the same. Well… a friend of mine.
lines.sk: Babka by povedala to isté. Teda… jedna moja známa.
lines.heard: My gran would say the same. Well, a friend of mine

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Your friend has sense. Give her my regards.
lines.sk: Tvoja známa má rozum. Pozdravuj ju.
lines.heard: Your friend has sense. Give her my regards

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Here’s a second signed sheet for the duplicate, too. The content has to be identical; we’ll check it together.
lines.sk: Tu máš aj druhý podpísaný hárok na druhopis. Obsah musí byť zhodný, skontrolujeme ho spolu.
lines.heard: Here's a second signed sheet for the duplicate too. The content has to be identical. We'll check it together

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Vera draws on a bench in the park. Little Susie plays hopscotch next to her.
lines.sk: Vera kreslí v parku na lavičke. Vedľa nej skáče škôlku malá Zuzka.
lines.heard: Vera draws on a bench in the park. Little Susie plays hopscotch next to her

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The one playing hopscotch? I saw her on my way here.
lines.sk: Tá, čo skáče škôlku? Videl som ju cestou sem.
lines.heard: The one playing hopscotch. I saw her on my way here

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: That’s her. If you get lost in Ivanka, ask her. She can find her way anywhere here with her eyes closed.
lines.sk: Tá. Ak budeš v Ivanke blúdiť, spýtaj sa jej. Ona tu trafí všade aj so zavretými očami.
lines.heard: That's her. If you get lost in Ivanka, ask her. She can find her way anywhere here with her eyes closed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So: paper from the loft, the stylus from Vera, and then the post office.
lines.sk: Takže papier z povaly, rydlo od Very a potom pošta.
lines.heard: So paper from the loft, the stylus from Vera, and then the post office

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: And don’t crumple the sheet. On a crumpled one the imprint would only be half legible.
lines.sk: A hárok nepokrč. Na pokrčenom by bol odtlačok čitateľný len napoly.
lines.heard: And don't crumple the sheet. On a crumpled one, the imprint would only be half legible

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I press the sheet onto the cold plate. All four fields have come through.
lines.sk: Pritlačím hárok na studenú platňu. Všetky štyri polia sa obtlačili.
lines.heard: I press the sheet onto the cold plate. All four fields have come through

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: The plate stays here, where it was made. You take the imprint.
lines.sk: Platňa zostane tu, kde vznikla. Ty si odnesieš odtlačok.
lines.heard: The plate stays here where it was made. You take the imprint

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Origin. Voice. Consent. Return. And below that: ‘Different data are not invalid data.’
lines.sk: Pôvod. Hlas. Súhlas. Návrat. A pod tým: „Rôzne údaje neznamenajú neplatné údaje.“
lines.heard: Origin, voice, consent, return. And below that, different data are not invalid data

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that sentence. Gran used to say it to me when I wanted to throw out a broken radio.
lines.sk: Túto vetu poznám. Babka mi ju hovorila, keď som chcel vyhodiť pokazené rádio.
lines.heard: I know that sentence. Gran used to say it to me when I wanted to throw out a broken radio

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Something that doesn’t fit the model. That doesn’t mean it doesn’t exist.
lines.sk: Niečo, čo nezapadá do modelu. To ešte neznamená, že to neexistuje.
lines.heard: Something that doesn't fit the model, that doesn't mean it doesn't exist

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So, me?
lines.sk: Takže ja?
lines.heard: So me

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: You especially.
lines.sk: Ty obzvlášť.
lines.heard: You especially

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: That’s why I won’t throw you out. I’ll note you down alongside, like everything that doesn’t fit.
lines.sk: Preto ťa nevyhodím. Zapíšem ťa vedľa ako všetko, čo nesedí.
lines.heard: That's why I won't throw you out. I'll note you down alongside like everything that doesn't fit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Alongside what?
lines.sk: Vedľa čoho?
lines.heard: Alongside what?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Alongside the original data, in the margin. My margins are written up more densely than my pages.
lines.sk: Vedľa pôvodných údajov, na okraj. Okraje mám popísané hustejšie ako strany.
lines.heard: Alongside the original data in the margin. My margins are written up more densely than my pages

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: I ask about what I can verify. The rest I leave open.
lines.sk: Pýtam sa na to, čo viem overiť. Zvyšok si nechávam otvorený.
lines.heard: I ask about what I can verify the rest I leave open

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then that’ll run in our family.
lines.sk: Tak to sa u nás v rodine bude dediť.
lines.heard: Then that'll run in our family

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: What family?
lines.sk: V akej rodine?
lines.heard: What family?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s one of those questions you leave open.
lines.sk: To je jedna z tých otázok, čo si nechávate otvorené.
lines.heard: That's one of those questions you leave open

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Fine. But don’t think I’ll forget to ask about that family.
lines.sk: Dobre. Ale nemysli si, že sa na tú rodinu zabudnem opýtať.
lines.heard: Fine, but don't think I'll forget to ask about that family

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That little Susie from the park turns up everywhere I go.
lines.sk: Tá malá Zuzka z parku je všade, kam prídem.
lines.heard: That little Susie from the park turns up everywhere I go

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: She does that to everyone. Even to people who don’t know they need someone to show them the way.
lines.sk: To robí každému. Aj tým, čo nevedia, že potrebujú sprievod.
lines.heard: She does that to everyone even to people who don't know they need someone to show them the way

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Yesterday she asked me where I put the time I measure.
lines.sk: Včera sa ma pýtala, kam dávam ten čas, čo meriam.
lines.heard: Yesterday she asked me where I put the time I measure

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did you tell her?
lines.sk: A čo ste jej povedali?
lines.heard: And what did you tell her?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: The truth. That I write it down so it doesn’t get lost.
lines.sk: Pravdu. Že ho zapisujem, aby sa nestratil.
lines.heard: The truth that I write it down so it doesn't get lost

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And was that enough for her?
lines.sk: A stačilo jej to?
lines.heard: And was that enough for her?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: No. She wanted to see the notebook. So I showed her the page with her hopscotch.
lines.sk: Nie. Chcela vidieť zošit. Tak som jej ukázala stranu s jej škôlkou.
lines.heard: No, she wanted to see the notebook, so I showed her the page with her hopscotch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What exactly are you measuring in that hut?
lines.sk: Čo vlastne v tej búdke meriate?
lines.heard: What exactly are you measuring in that hut?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Time, in several places at once. And differences that shouldn’t be there.
lines.sk: Čas na viacerých miestach naraz. A rozdiely, ktoré by tam nemali byť.
lines.heard: time in several places at once, and differences that shouldn't be there

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And are they there?
lines.sk: A sú tam?
lines.heard: And are they there?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: They are. That’s why I note them alongside. What doesn’t fit, we write alongside, not over the original data.
lines.sk: Sú. Preto ich zapisujem vedľa. Čo nesedí, píšeme vedľa, nie cez pôvodné údaje.
lines.heard: They are. That's why I note them alongside. What doesn't fit, we write alongside, not over the original data

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even when it looks like a mistake?
lines.sk: Aj keď to vyzerá ako chyba?
lines.heard: Even when it looks like a mistake?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Then most of all. I can always throw it away. I can’t bring it back.
lines.sk: Hlavne vtedy. Vyhodiť to môžem vždy. Vrátiť už nie.
lines.heard: Then most of all I can always throw it away. I can't bring it back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mr Whitlock speaks of you with great respect.
lines.sk: Pán Bielik o vás hovorí s veľkým rešpektom.
lines.heard: Mr. Whitlock speaks of you with great respect

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Otto speaks of everything with respect. Even of a screw that’s rolled under the table.
lines.sk: Oto o všetkom hovorí s rešpektom. Aj o skrutke, čo mu spadla pod stôl.
lines.heard: Otto speaks of everything with respect, even of a screw that's rolled under the table

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you of him?
lines.sk: A vy o ňom?
lines.heard: And you of him

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: That he measures first and talks afterwards. That’s why he’s so good to work with.
lines.sk: Že najprv meria a až potom rozpráva. Preto sa s ním tak dobre pracuje.
lines.heard: That he measures first and talks afterwards. That's why he's so good to work with

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The loft. Where things are stored temporarily until the next century.
lines.sk: Povala. Miesto, kde sú veci dočasne uložené až do ďalšieho storočia.
lines.heard: The loft where things are stored temporarily until the next century

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A clean waxed sheet. I have to get it to the plate flat, not crumpled.
lines.sk: Čistý voskovaný hárok. K platni ho musím doniesť rovný, nie pokrčený.
lines.heard: A clean waxed sheet. I have to get it to the plate flat, not crumpled

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: I’ve made a clean archive copy from your imprint. We’ll attach the registration form to it and lock it in the box.
lines.sk: Podľa tvojho odtlačku som urobila čistú archívnu kópiu. Priložíme k nej registračný list a zamkneme ju do schránky.
lines.heard: I've made a clean archive copy from your imprint. We'll attach the registration form to it and lock it in the box

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m taking the imprint with me. I’ll still need it.
lines.sk: Odtlačok si beriem so sebou. Ešte ho budem potrebovať.
lines.heard: I'm taking the imprint with me i'll still need it

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Then I’ll add the storage number to it. The plate and the original stay here. Leave me the stylus; I’ll return it to Vera.
lines.sk: Tak naň dopíšem číslo uloženia. Platňa aj prvopis zostávajú tu. Rydlo mi nechaj, vrátim ho Vere.
lines.heard: Then I'll add the storage number to it. The plate and the original stay here. Leave me the stylus. I'll return it to Vera

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank Vera for me too. And Mr Ramsey.
lines.sk: Poďakujte odo mňa aj Vere. A pánovi Baranovi.
lines.heard: Thank Vera for me too and Mr. Ramsey

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: I will. Ivanka will be talking about you for a long time anyway.
lines.sk: Poďakujem. V Ivanke sa o tebe aj tak bude ešte dlho hovoriť.
lines.heard: I will. Ivanka will be talking about you for a long time anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Will you remember me?
lines.sk: Budete si ma pamätať?
lines.heard: Will you remember me?

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: I may forget the face. I won’t forget what we did together.
lines.sk: Tvár možno zabudnem. To, čo sme spolu urobili, nie.
lines.heard: I may forget the face. I won't forget what we did together

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s more than I hoped for.
lines.sk: To je viac, než som dúfal.
lines.heard: That's more than I hoped for

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: What doesn’t match, we put side by side. We don’t throw it away.
lines.sk: Čo sa nezhoduje, necháme vedľa seba. Nevyhodíme to.
lines.heard: What doesn't match, we put side by side. We don't throw it away

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One day someone will need to hear that sentence again.
lines.sk: Túto vetu bude raz treba niekomu zopakovať.
lines.heard: One day someone will need to hear that sentence again

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: One object. Many hands. Not one of them is an error in the record.
lines.sk: Jeden predmet. Veľa rúk. Ani jedna z nich nie je chyba v zázname.
lines.heard: One object, many hands. Not one of them is an error in the record

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: ‘Never fear, darling!’ If only someone had told me that this morning, when I was only going to change a fuse.
lines.sk: „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“ Keby mi to niekto povedal ráno, keď som išiel len vymeniť poistku.
lines.heard: Never fear, darling. If only someone had told me that this morning when I was only going to change a fuse

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A small post office with a counter. Here every piece of paper is weighed, stamped and recorded.
lines.sk: Malá pošta s prepážkou. Tu sa každý papier odváži, opečiatkuje a zapíše.
lines.heard: A small post office with a counter. Here, every piece of paper is weighed, stamped, and recorded

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: The carbon paper is by the counter, for all the forms. Please, help yourself.
lines.sk: Uhľový papier je pri prepážke, pre všetky tlačivá. Nech sa páči, poslúžte si.
lines.heard: The carbon paper is by the counter for all the forms. Please help yourself.

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Carefully, please. It stains fingers too. Little Susie traces round her hands with it here.
lines.sk: Len opatrne, prosím. Farbí aj prsty. Malá Zuzka si ním u mňa obkresľuje dlane.
lines.heard: Carefully, please. It stains fingers too. Little Susie traces round her hands with it here

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The little girl who plays hopscotch in the park?
lines.sk: Tá malá, čo skáče v parku škôlku?
lines.heard: The little girl who plays hopscotch in the park

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: That’s her. She comes in to look at the new stamps. By the time she’s looked at them all, she’s traced round both hands.
lines.sk: Tá. Chodí sa sem pozerať na nové známky. Kým si ich prezrie, má obkreslené obe ruky.
lines.heard: That's her. She comes in to look at the new stamps. By the time she's looked at them all, she's traced round both hands

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. I’ll take just one sheet and keep my hands clean.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Vezmem si len jeden hárok a ruky si nechám čisté.
lines.heard: Thank you I'll take just one sheet and keep my hands clean

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: One sheet of carbon paper. I’ll make a note: one item issued, for official use.
lines.sk: Jeden hárok uhľového papiera. Zapíšem: vydaný jeden kus, na úradnú potrebu.
lines.heard: One sheet of carbon paper. I'll make a note. One item issued for official use

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You even record carbon paper?
lines.sk: Vy zapisujete aj uhľový papier?
lines.heard: You even recall carbon paper?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: I record everything, if you please. Otherwise one day somebody would find that nothing was ever here.
lines.sk: Zapisujem všetko, prosím pekne. Inak by sa jedného dňa zistilo, že tu nič nebolo.
lines.heard: I record everything, if you please otherwise one day somebody would find that nothing was ever here.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I put the carbon paper between the sheets and write out the text. Mira signed both in advance. I’ll compare them and throw the carbon away.
lines.sk: Medzi hárky vložím uhľový papier a prepíšem text. Mira oba podpísala vopred. Porovnám ich a papier vyhodím.
lines.heard: I put the carbon paper between the sheets and write out the text. Mira signed both in advance. I'll compare them and throw the carbon away

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I need this form confirmed. I have it in duplicate.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Potreboval by som potvrdiť tento list. Mám ho v dvoch vyhotoveniach.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I need this form confirmed. I have it in duplicate

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Certainly. First I read it, then the stamp. Otherwise I’d be confirming cake recipes.
lines.sk: Prosím pekne. Najprv si ho prečítam, až potom pečiatka. Inak by som potvrdzoval aj recepty na koláč.
lines.heard: Certainly. First I read it, then the stamp. Otherwise I'd be confirming cake recipes

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Two copies, identical content. Reference number Z-17, today’s date, stamp.
lines.sk: Dve vyhotovenia, obsah zhodný. Evidenčné číslo Z-17, dnešný dátum, pečiatka.
lines.heard: Two copies, identical content, reference number Z17, today's date, stamp

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I need it to be clear, even in seventy-three years, that this piece of paper existed.
lines.sk: Potrebujem, aby aj o sedemdesiattri rokov bolo jasné, že tento papier existoval.
lines.heard: I need it to be clear, even in 73 years, that this piece of paper existed

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: I can’t guarantee delivery in seventy-three years. But the stamp will last.
lines.sk: O sedemdesiattri rokov vám doručenie nezaručím. Ale pečiatka vydrží.
lines.heard: I can't guarantee delivery in seventy-three years, but the stamp will last.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s all I need. I’ll see to the delivery myself.
lines.sk: To mi stačí. O doručenie sa postarám sám.
lines.heard: That's all I need. I'll see to the delivery myself

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: And don’t fold it more often than you have to. Paper tears at the folds first.
lines.sk: A neskladajte ho viackrát, ako treba. Papier sa najprv trhá na ohyboch.
lines.heard: And don't fold it more often than you have to paper tears at the folds first.

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Barnaby stayed behind in the park. Put his feed in his bowl and he’ll come home. Stephen in the workshop yard has the mix.
lines.sk: Béla zostal v parku. Nasypte mu do misky jeho krmivo a vráti sa domov. Zmes má Štefan na dvore dielne.
lines.heard: Barnaby stayed behind in the park put his feed in his bowl, and he'll come home Stephen in the workshop yard has the mix

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So I won’t be chasing the post round the park.
lines.sk: Takže nebudem po parku naháňať poštu.
lines.heard: So I won't be chasing the post around the park

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: That would be beneath the dignity of both you and the post.
lines.sk: To by nebolo dôstojné ani pre vás, ani pre poštu.
lines.heard: That would be beneath the dignity of both you and the post.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And why doesn’t he come back by himself?
lines.sk: A prečo sa nevráti sám?
lines.heard: And why doesn't he come back by himself?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: This morning I gave him ordinary grain. Barnaby is used to his own mix, and he knows how to make his feelings known.
lines.sk: Ráno som mu dal obyčajné zrno. Béla je zvyknutý na svoju zmes a vie to dať najavo.
lines.heard: This morning I gave him ordinary grain. Barnaby is used to his own mix, and he knows how to make his feelings known.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’ll bring him the right one.
lines.sk: Tak mu donesiem tú správnu.
lines.heard: Then I'll bring him the right one

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: I’d be most grateful. Without him the post office is far too quiet.
lines.sk: Budem vám povďačný. Bez neho je pošta príliš tichá.
lines.heard: I'd be most grateful. Without him, the post office is far too quiet

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Barnaby is home, thanks to you. I’ll put a print of an old stamp in your notebook. As a keepsake – it isn’t officially valid.
lines.sk: Béla je doma, vďaka vám. Do zápisníka vám dám odtlačok starej pečiatky. Na pamiatku, úradne to neplatí.
lines.heard: Barnaby is home thanks to you. I'll put a print of an old stamp in your notebook as a keepsake. It, uh, isn't officially valid

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. My notebook is all numbers and arrows. This will be the first nice page.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. V zápisníku mám samé čísla a šípky. Toto bude prvá pekná strana.
lines.heard: Thank you. My notebook is all numbers and arrows. This will be the first nice page

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: And if you ever need to send a message, Barnaby will fly. Not far, but willingly.
lines.sk: A keby ste niekedy potrebovali poslať správu, Béla poletí. Nie ďaleko, ale ochotne.
lines.heard: And if you ever need to send a message, Barnaby will fly. Not far, but willingly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: He probably wouldn’t find my address.
lines.sk: Na moju adresu by asi netrafil.
lines.heard: He probably wouldn't find my address

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Barnaby doesn’t find any address, if you please. He only flies home. That’s why he’s so reliable.
lines.sk: Béla netrafí na žiadnu adresu, prosím. Letí len domov. Preto je taký spoľahlivý.
lines.heard: Barnaby doesn't find any address, if you please. He only flies home. That's why he's so reliable

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: That the document was here at the post office today. Whether it’s true is for someone wiser to judge.
lines.sk: Že dokument bol dnes tu, na pošte. Či je pravdivý, to nech posúdi niekto múdrejší.
lines.heard: That the document was here at the post office today. Whether it's true is for someone wiser to judge.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s exactly what I need.
lines.sk: Presne toto potrebujem.
lines.heard: That's exactly what I need

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: I rarely hear that, if I may say so. Most people want the stamp to confirm they’re right.
lines.sk: To počujem zriedka, prosím. Väčšina ľudí chce, aby pečiatka potvrdila, že majú pravdu.
lines.heard: I rarely hear that, if I may say so. Most people want the stamp to confirm they're right

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And it can’t do that?
lines.sk: A to nevie?
lines.heard: And it can't do that?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: A stamp only knows the date, if you please. Everyone has to bring the truth with them.
lines.sk: Pečiatka vie iba dátum, prosím. Pravdu si musí každý priniesť so sebou.
lines.heard: A stamp only knows the date, if you please. Everyone has to bring the truth with them

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Barnaby is not a service pigeon. He is my private joy, with wings.
lines.sk: Béla nie je služobný holub. Je to moja súkromná radosť s krídlami.
lines.heard: Barnaby is not a service pigeon. He is my private joy with wings

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And does he ever carry letters?
lines.sk: A nosí niekedy aj listy?
lines.heard: And does he ever carry letters?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: The odd note to the neighbour, when I’m out of sugar. He is not permitted to carry official post.
lines.sk: Občas lístok susedovi, keď mi chýba cukor. Úradnú poštu nosiť nesmie.
lines.heard: The odd note to the neighbor when I'm out of sugar. He is not permitted to carry official post

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why not?
lines.sk: Prečo nie?
lines.heard: Why not?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: He hasn’t got a service cap. And if he got one, he’d want a service dovecote too.
lines.sk: Nemá služobnú čiapku. A keby ju dostal, chcel by aj služobný holubník.
lines.heard: He hasn't got a service cap and if he got one, he'd want a service dovecote too.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do people send telegrams from here too?
lines.sk: Posielajú sa odtiaľto aj telegramy?
lines.heard: Do people send telegrams from here too?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Regularly, if you please. You pay by the word, so people are very brief in telegrams.
lines.sk: Pravidelne, prosím. Platí sa od slova, preto sú ľudia v telegramoch veľmi struční.
lines.heard: Regularly, if you please. You pay by the word, so people are very brief in telegrams

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: The shortest one I ever sent had two words: ARRIVING TOMORROW.
lines.sk: Najkratší, aký som odoslal, mal dve slová: PRÍDEM ZAJTRA.
lines.heard: The shortest one I ever sent had two words, "Arriving tomorrow."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did he arrive?
lines.sk: A prišiel?
lines.heard: And did he arrive?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: He did. A week later. He didn’t send a correction – every word costs money.
lines.sk: Prišiel. O týždeň. Opravný telegram neposlal, každé slovo stojí peniaze.
lines.heard: He did a week later. He didn't send a correction. Every word costs money

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many rubber stamps have you actually got here?
lines.sk: Koľko pečiatok tu vlastne máte?
lines.heard: How many rubber stamps have you actually got here?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Seven, if you please. Each one confirms something different.
lines.sk: Sedem, prosím. Každá potvrdzuje niečo iné.
lines.heard: Seven, if you please each one confirms something different

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which one is your favourite?
lines.sk: A ktorú máte najradšej?
lines.heard: And which one's your favorite?

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: The date stamp. Every day it tells the truth – I just mustn’t forget to change it.
lines.sk: Tú s dátumom. Každý deň hovorí pravdu, len ju nesmiem zabudnúť prestaviť.
lines.heard: The date stamp every day it tells the truth. I just mustn't forget to change it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Jasna, fifteen years later, in the depths of winter. Good thing I’ve still got my coat from December 1982.
lines.sk: Jasná o pätnásť rokov neskôr, v plnej zime. Dobre, že mám ešte kabát z decembra 1982.
lines.heard: Yasna, 15 years later in the depths of winter. Good thing I've still got my coat from December 1982

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Ticket valid.
lines.sk: Lístok platný.
lines.heard: Ticket valid

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: First section: Biela Put – Priehyba. An ordinary gondola, no node clock.
lines.sk: Prvý úsek: Biela Púť – Priehyba. Obyčajná kabínka, žiadne uzlové hodiny.
lines.heard: First section, Biela Put Prieba, an ordinary gondola, no node clock

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Up along the cable. A snowy forest below us, silence in the gondola.
lines.sk: Hore po lane. Pod nami zasnežený les, v kabínke ticho.
lines.heard: Up along the cable, a snowy forest below us, silence in the gondola

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Priehyba. Change for the Funitel towards Chopok.
lines.sk: Priehyba. Prestup na Funitel smer Chopok.
lines.heard: Priheba. Change for the Funitel towards Chopok.

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Recipient: repair shop by the bench with the dog. There is no repair shop at these coordinates today.
lines.sk: Príjemca: opravovňa pri lavičke so psom. Na týchto súradniciach dnes žiadna opravovňa nie je.
lines.heard: Recipient: Repair shop by the bench with the dog. There is no repair shop at these coordinates today

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The bench with the dog? What dog?
lines.sk: Lavička so psom? Akým psom?
lines.heard: The bench with the dog? What dog?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Not specified. Dogs in the area: two alive and one on a poster. None is sitting on a bench.
lines.sk: Neuvedené. Psy v okolí: dva živé a jeden na plagáte. Žiadny nesedí na lavičke.
lines.heard: Not specified. Dogs in the area, two alive and one on a poster. None is sitting on a bench.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe the dog isn’t alive.
lines.sk: Možno ten pes nie je živý.
lines.heard: Maybe the dog isn't alive

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: This possibility was not in the brief. Probability of success increased to thirty per cent.
lines.sk: Táto možnosť nebola v zadaní. Pravdepodobnosť úspechu zvyšujem na tridsať percent.
lines.heard: This possibility was not in the brief. Probability of success increased to thirty percent.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll try to find out. Hang on to the parcel for now.
lines.sk: Skúsim to zistiť. Balík si zatiaľ nechajte.
lines.heard: I'll try to find out. Hang on to the parcel for now

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Sensible division of labour recorded.
lines.sk: Rozumná deľba práce zaznamenaná.
lines.heard: Sensible division of labor recorded

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: You walk, I wait. My driving success rate in snow is forty per cent.
lines.sk: Vy chodíte, ja čakám. V snehu mám úspešnosť jazdy štyridsať percent.
lines.heard: You walk, I wait. My driving success rate in snow is 40%.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Here’s the confirmation from Tamara. She’s not by the lake any more; she’s in the hotel lobby.
lines.sk: Tu je potvrdenie od Tamary. Už nesedí pri plese, je v lobby hotela.
lines.heard: Here's the confirmation from Tamara. She's not by the lake anymore. She's in the hotel lobby

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Recipient confirmed. New point: repairer’s desk in the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasna.
lines.sk: Príjemkyňa potvrdená. Nový bod: opravársky stôl v lobby hotela Grand Jasná.
lines.heard: Recipient confirmed. New point, repairer's desk in the lobby of Hotel Grand Yasna

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The last hundred metres sometimes take a person.
lines.sk: Na posledných sto metrov niekedy treba človeka.
lines.heard: The last hundred meters sometimes take a person

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Recording: last hundred metres, human.
lines.sk: Zapisujem: posledných sto metrov, človek.
lines.heard: Recording last hundred meters, human

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And Tamara sends her thanks. With a coffee.
lines.sk: A Tamara vám posiela poďakovanie. Aj s kávou.
lines.heard: And Tamara sends her thanks with a coffee.

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Thanks have no navigational value. I will keep them anyway.
lines.sk: Poďakovanie nemá navigačnú hodnotu. Uchovám ho aj tak.
lines.heard: Thanks have no navigational value. I will keep them anyway

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Coffee: incompatible. Saving the offer in the folder Unnecessary But Kind.
lines.sk: Káva: nekompatibilná. Ponuku ukladám do priečinka Nepotrebné, ale milé.
lines.heard: Coffee incompatible. Saving the offer in the folder unnecessary but kind

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Parcels delivered: ninety-nine per cent. Peace of mind: unknown quantity.
lines.sk: Doručené zásielky: deväťdesiatdeväť percent. Pokoj: neznáma veličina.
lines.heard: Parcels delivered: 99%. Peace of mind: unknown quantity

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the one per cent?
lines.sk: A to jedno percento?
lines.heard: And the 1%

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Parcels with an address from a human. For example: ‘the entrance where the dog barks’. The dog does not bark all the time.
lines.sk: Zásielky s adresou od človeka. Napríklad: „ten vchod, kde šteká pes“. Pes nešteká stále.
lines.heard: Parcels with an address from a human. For example, the entrance where the dog barks. The dog does not bark all the time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A human couldn’t find that either.
lines.sk: To by nenašiel ani človek.
lines.heard: A human couldn't find that either

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: A human could. A human asks another human. When I ask, people usually tell me I am adorable.
lines.sk: Človek áno, spýta sa iného človeka. Mne na otázku zvyčajne povedia, že som zlatý.
lines.heard: A human could. A human asks another human. When I ask, people usually tell me I am adorable.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do those lights mean a smile?
lines.sk: Tie svetlá znamenajú úsmev?
lines.heard: Do those lights mean a smile?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: They mean the battery is sufficiently charged. An effect on mood is probable.
lines.sk: Znamenajú dostatočné nabitie batérie. Vplyv na náladu je pravdepodobný.
lines.heard: They mean the battery is sufficiently charged. An effect on mood is probable.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when the battery is low?
lines.sk: A keď je batéria slabá?
lines.heard: And when the battery is low

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: The lights narrow. People say I am frowning. In winter I frown from four in the afternoon.
lines.sk: Svetlá sa zúžia. Ľudia hovoria, že sa mračím. V zime sa mračím od štvrtej popoludní.
lines.heard: The lights narrow. People say I am frowning. In winter I frown from four in the afternoon

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do you get on driving in this snow?
lines.sk: Ako sa vám jazdí v tomto snehu?
lines.heard: How do you get on driving in this snow?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Speed: halved. Falls: two this week. Dignity: seventy per cent preserved.
lines.sk: Rýchlosť: polovičná. Pády: dva tento týždeň. Dôstojnosť: zachovaná na sedemdesiat percent.
lines.heard: Speed: halved. Falls: two this week. Dignity: seventy percent preserved

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who put you back on your wheels?
lines.sk: A kto vás postavil späť na kolesá?
lines.heard: And who put you back on your wheels?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: A skier and a child. The child drew a smile on my lid at the same time.
lines.sk: Lyžiar a jedno dieťa. Dieťa mi pritom nakreslilo na veko úsmev.
lines.heard: A skier and a child. The child drew a smile on my lid at the same time.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s still there.
lines.sk: Ešte ho tam máte.
lines.heard: It's still there

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Yes. According to statistics, people help me a third more willingly with it.
lines.sk: Áno. Podľa štatistiky mi s ním ľudia pomáhajú o tretinu ochotnejšie.
lines.heard: Yes, according to statistics, people help me a third more willingly with it

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Everything unnecessary. Except one folder.
lines.sk: Všetko nepotrebné. Okrem jedného priečinka.
lines.heard: Everything unnecessary except one folder

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which one?
lines.sk: Akého?
lines.heard: Which one?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Unnecessary But Kind. Contents: three thank-yous, one drawn smile and a song a courier whistled.
lines.sk: Nepotrebné, ale milé. Obsah: tri poďakovania, jeden nakreslený úsmev a pesnička, ktorú pískal kuriér.
lines.heard: Unnecessary but kind. Contents: three thank yous, one drawn smile, and a song a courier whistled

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s not nothing.
lines.sk: To nie je málo.
lines.heard: That's not nothing

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Folder capacity: unlimited. I set it myself.
lines.sk: Kapacita priečinka: neobmedzená. Nastavil som si ju sám.
lines.heard: Folder capacity unlimited. I set it myself

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which address took you longest to find?
lines.sk: Ktorú adresu ste hľadali najdlhšie?
lines.heard: Which address took you longest to find?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: ‘Where the lángos stall used to be.’ Lángos stalls in the area: zero.
lines.sk: „Tam, kde bol kedysi stánok s langošmi.“ Stánky s langošmi v okolí: nula.
lines.heard: Where the langos stall used to be. Langos stalls in the area, zero.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you find the place?
lines.sk: A našli ste to miesto?
lines.heard: And did you find the place?

lines.speaker: ROBOT
lines.text: Yes. I asked a lady. She said I was adorable, and then she pointed to exactly where it had been.
lines.sk: Áno. Spýtal som sa jednej panej. Povedala, že som zlatý, a potom presne ukázala, kde to bolo.
lines.heard: Yes. I asked a lady. She said I was adorable, and then she pointed to exactly where it had been

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hotel Grand Jasna, with half a metre of snow on the roof. By the exhibition stand someone is waiting, as if for me.
lines.sk: Hotel Grand Jasná, na streche pol metra snehu. Pri výstavnom stojane niekto čaká, akoby práve na mňa.
lines.heard: Hotel Grand Jasna with half a meter of snow on the roof by the exhibition stand, someone is waiting as if for me.

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Adam Perry? Your name is falling apart on my visitor list as we speak.
lines.sk: Adam Hruška? Vaše meno sa mi práve rozpadá v zozname návštevníkov.
lines.heard: Adam Perry, your name is falling apart on my visitor list as we speak

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Falling apart? How can a name fall apart?
lines.sk: Rozpadá? Ako sa môže rozpadnúť meno?
lines.heard: Falling apart? How can a name fall apart?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Letter by letter. A minute ago you were all there; now you’re just ‘Adam Per’.
lines.sk: Po písmenách. Pred minútou ste tu boli celý, teraz už len „Adam Hru“.
lines.heard: Letter by letter. A minute ago, you were all there. Now you're just Adam Per

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So far I’m still here in one piece. What’s going on?
lines.sk: Zatiaľ som tu celý. Čo sa to deje?
lines.heard: So far, I'm still here in one piece. What's going on?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Atlas has an exhibition in the hotel and a pavilion on Chopok. The cable cars are running normally, but our device is rewriting people’s records retrospectively.
lines.sk: Atlas má výstavu v hoteli a pavilón na Chopku. Lanovky idú normálne, ale náš prístroj spätne prepisuje záznamy ľudí.
lines.heard: Atlas has an exhibition in the hotel and a pavilion on Chopok. The cable cars are running normally, but our device is rewriting people's records retrospectively.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Retrospectively? So it even corrects things that happened long ago?
lines.sk: Spätne? Čiže opravuje aj to, čo sa už dávno stalo?
lines.heard: Retrospectively? So it even corrects things that happened long ago?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: At the exhibition they call it normalisation. Whatever contradicts itself in the records, the device evens out. Names included.
lines.sk: Na výstave sa tomu hovorí normalizácia. Čo si v záznamoch protirečí, prístroj zarovná. Aj mená.
lines.heard: At the exhibition, they call it normalization. Whatever contradicts itself in the records, the device evens out, names included

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who set it up like that?
lines.sk: Kto ho tak nastavil?
lines.heard: Who set it up like that?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Victor Korman, our founder. He didn’t switch it off even after my warning. Tamara will give you a reader, Boris the collection card, and Sarah a pass and a ticket.
lines.sk: Viktor Korman, náš zakladateľ. Nevypol ho ani po mojom varovaní. Čítačku vám dá Tamara, kartu fondu Boris, preukaz s lístkom Sára.
lines.heard: Victor Corman, our founder. He didn't switch it off even after my warning. Tamara will give you a reader, Boris the collection card, and Sarah a pass and a ticket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three people. Where do I find them?
lines.sk: Traja ľudia. Kde ich nájdem?
lines.heard: Three people? Where do I find them?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Tamara has a desk in the lobby, Boris sits in the exhibition room, and Sarah is at the customer centre.
lines.sk: Tamara má stôl v lobby, Boris sedí vo výstavnom salóne a Sára je v klientskom centre.
lines.heard: Tamara has a desk in the lobby, Boris sits in the exhibition room, and Sarah is at the customer center

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A reader, a card, a pass and a ticket. And this morning I only set out to change a fuse.
lines.sk: Čítačka, karta, preukaz a lístok. A ja som dnes ráno išiel len vymeniť poistku.
lines.heard: A reader, a card, a pass, and a ticket. And this morning, I only set out to change a fuse

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: I could do with a fuse myself. The kind that blows when someone ignores warnings.
lines.sk: Poistku by som potrebovala aj ja. Takú, čo vypadne, keď niekto nepočúva varovania.
lines.heard: I could do with a fuse myself, the kind that blows when someone ignores warnings

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Nobody’s made one of those yet. But I’ll try.
lines.sk: Takú ešte nikto nevyrobil. Ale skúsim to.
lines.heard: Nobody's made one of those yet, but I'll try

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: The reader first. Up in the pavilion I’ll contact you over the service channel.
lines.sk: Najprv tá čítačka. Hore v pavilóne sa vám ozvem cez servisný kanál.
lines.heard: The reader first, up in the pavilion. I'll contact you over the service channel

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Yes. She still writes lists. Only now there’s a holiday on them too.
lines.sk: Áno. Stále píše zoznamy. Len teraz je na nich aj dovolenka.
lines.heard: Yes, she still writes lists, only now there's a holiday on them too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A holiday? Your mother has a holiday on her list as a task?
lines.sk: Dovolenka? Tú má vaša mama na zozname ako úlohu?
lines.heard: A holiday? Your mother has a holiday on her list as a task

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: As task number five. After shopping, medicines, phone numbers and the list of lists.
lines.sk: Ako úlohu číslo päť. Za nákupmi, liekmi, telefónmi a zoznamom zoznamov.
lines.heard: As task number five after shopping, medicines, phone numbers, and the list of lists

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And does she do it?
lines.sk: A plní ju?
lines.heard: And does she do it?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: She ticks it off. Last year she ticked it off in October, in one weekend.
lines.sk: Odškrtáva. Vlani si ju odškrtla v októbri, za jeden víkend.
lines.heard: She ticks it off last year she ticked it off in October in one weekend

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: For the exhibition we also collect memories of trips. The public part is in the hotel; on Chopok we have a temporary pavilion.
lines.sk: Na výstavu zbierame aj spomienky na výlety. Verejná časť je v hoteli, na Chopku máme dočasný pavilón.
lines.heard: For the exhibition, we also collect memories of trips. The public part is in the hotel. On Chopok, we have a temporary pavilion

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And on the way up, everyone has a reason to look out of the window for a while.
lines.sk: A cestou hore má každý dôvod chvíľu sa pozerať z okna.
lines.heard: And on the way up, everyone has a reason to look out of the window for a while

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Exactly. People talk in the gondola. We collected half the exhibition in the queue for the cable car.
lines.sk: Presne. Ľudia v kabínke rozprávajú. Polovicu výstavy sme nazbierali v rade na lanovku.
lines.heard: Exactly. People talk in the gondola. We collected half the exhibition in the queue for the cable car.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In the queue for the cable car?
lines.sk: V rade na lanovku?
lines.heard: In the queue for the cable car

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Anyone who stands for twenty minutes with skis on their shoulder will happily tell you how they came here with their dad.
lines.sk: Kto stojí dvadsať minút s lyžami na pleci, ten vám rád povie, ako sem chodil s otcom.
lines.heard: Anyone who stands for 20 minutes with skis on their shoulder will happily tell you how they came here with their dad.

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: The original records have stayed separate from the edits. And the incident report is public.
lines.sk: Pôvodné záznamy zostali oddelené od úprav. A správa o incidente je verejná.
lines.heard: The original records have stayed separate from the edits, and the incident report is public

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even the uncomfortable part?
lines.sk: Aj tá nepohodlná časť?
lines.heard: Even the uncomfortable part?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: That part especially.
lines.sk: Práve tá.
lines.heard: That part especially

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And Victor?
lines.sk: A Viktor?
lines.heard: And Victor?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: He’s writing it himself and hasn’t crossed anything out. That’s new for him.
lines.sk: Píše ju sám a nič z nej nevyškrtol. To je u neho novinka.
lines.heard: He's writing it himself and hasn't crossed anything out. That's new for him

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And you?
lines.sk: A vy?
lines.heard: And you?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: I’ve added a holiday to my list. Mum will be pleased.
lines.sk: Ja som si na zoznam pripísala dovolenku. Mama bude mať radosť.
lines.heard: I've added a holiday to my list. Mum will be pleased

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What should I imagine under that title?
lines.sk: Čo si mám pod tým názvom predstaviť?
lines.heard: What should I imagine under that title?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Ordinary days. Shopping lists, postcards, recordings from kitchens.
lines.sk: Obyčajné dni. Nákupné lístky, pohľadnice, nahrávky z kuchyne.
lines.heard: Ordinary days, shopping lists, postcards, recordings from kitchens

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Are people interested in that?
lines.sk: To ľudí zaujíma?
lines.heard: Are people interested in that?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Most of all. They stop for a minute at famous things, and for twenty at a shopping list from 2020.
lines.sk: Najviac. Pri slávnych veciach postoja minútu, pri nákupnom lístku z roku 2020 aj dvadsať.
lines.heard: Most of all, they stop for a minute at famous things and for twenty at a shopping list from twenty twenty.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why?
lines.sk: Prečo?
lines.heard: Why?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Because everyone is looking to see whether it’s their handwriting.
lines.sk: Lebo každý hľadá, či tam nie je jeho písmo.
lines.heard: Because everyone is looking to see whether it's their handwriting

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What exactly are you allowed to do as curator?
lines.sk: Čo všetko vlastne smiete ako kurátorka?
lines.heard: What exactly are you allowed to do as curator?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Select, describe and hang. Not delete – nobody is allowed to do that.
lines.sk: Vybrať, opísať a zavesiť. Vymazať nie, to nesmie nikto.
lines.heard: Select, describe, and hang not delete. Nobody is allowed to do that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Not even Victor?
lines.sk: Ani Viktor?
lines.heard: Not even Victor?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Not even him. I told him in person, in writing and at the meeting.
lines.sk: Ani on. Povedala som mu to ústne, písomne aj na porade.
lines.heard: Not even him. I told him in person, in writing, and at the meeting

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And he?
lines.sk: A on?
lines.heard: Annie?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: In person he nodded, in writing he said thank you, and at the meeting he ran the test anyway.
lines.sk: Naživo prikývol, písomne poďakoval a na porade aj tak pustil skúšku.
lines.heard: In person, he nodded. In writing, he said thank you. And at the meeting, he ran the test anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Aren’t you cold out here? You’ve been standing outside since this morning.
lines.sk: Nie je vám tu zima? Stojíte vonku od rána.
lines.heard: Aren't you cold out here? You've been standing outside since this morning

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: I’ve got three layers and a flask from Mum. She still pours my tea, even though I’m thirty.
lines.sk: Mám tri vrstvy a termosku od mamy. Čaj mi nalieva, aj keď mám tridsať.
lines.heard: I've got three layers and a flask from Mom. She still pours my tea even though I'm 30

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That flask wouldn’t happen to have something written on the side?
lines.sk: Tá termoska nemá náhodou nápis na boku?
lines.heard: That flask wouldn't happen to have something written on the side?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: It does. DO NOT TOP UP WITH SOUP. It’s been on there since 2020.
lines.sk: Má. NEDOLIEVAŤ POLIEVKU. Drží na nej od roku 2020.
lines.heard: It does. Do not top up with soup. It's been on there since 2020

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then that’s the oldest exhibit in the whole exhibition.
lines.sk: Tak to je najstarší exponát na celej výstave.
lines.heard: Then that's the oldest exhibit in the whole exhibition

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: It’s not an exhibit, it’s a flask. But I’ll tell Mum – she’ll be pleased.
lines.sk: To nie je exponát, to je termoska. Ale mame to poviem, poteší sa.
lines.heard: It's not an exhibit, it's a flask. But I'll tell Mum. She'll be pleased

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A repairer’s desk in a hotel lobby. Next holiday, I’m packing a broken tape recorder too.
lines.sk: Opravársky stôl v hotelovom lobby. Nabudúce si na dovolenku zbalím aj pokazený magnetofón.
lines.heard: A repairer's desk in a hotel lobby. Next holiday, I'm packing a broken tape recorder too

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Hi. You’re a repairer, aren’t you? Only repairers and small children look at my desk like that.
lines.sk: Ahoj. Ty si opravár, však? Takto sa na môj stôl pozerajú len opravári a malé deti.
lines.heard: Hi. You're a repairer, aren't you? Only repairers and small children look at my desk like that

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A repairer. Mostly tape recorders and anything that plays.
lines.sk: Opravár. Hlavne magnetofóny a všetko, čo hrá.
lines.heard: A repairer. Mostly tape recorders and anything that plays

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Nina sent me. I need to read this old school cassette.
lines.sk: Posiela ma Nina. Potrebujem prečítať túto starú školskú kazetu.
lines.heard: Nina sent me. I need to read this old school cassette

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Let’s see. A school cassette with a handwritten label. I haven’t held one of those in years.
lines.sk: Ukáž. Ručne popísaná školská kazeta. Takú som v rukách nemala roky.
lines.heard: Let's see. A school cassette with a handwritten label. I haven't held one of those in years

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Take this reader – it reads cassettes and service memory. You’ll get a coffee once the names stop vanishing from my orders.
lines.sk: Vezmi si túto čítačku, prečíta kazetu aj servisnú pamäť. Kávu dostaneš, až mi z objednávok prestanú miznúť mená.
lines.heard: Take this reader. It reads cassettes and service memory. You'll get a coffee once the names stop vanishing from my orders

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then I’d better hurry.
lines.sk: Tak to sa poponáhľam.
lines.heard: Then I'd better hurry

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Only read the cassette – don’t fix anything on it. It’s an original.
lines.sk: Kazetu len čítaj, nič na nej neopravuj. Je to originál.
lines.heard: Only read the cassette. Don't fix anything on it. It's an original

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’re telling me not to fix something?
lines.sk: Ty mi hovoríš, aby som niečo neopravoval?
lines.heard: You're telling me not to fix something?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: I know it hurts. It hurts me too. But an original gets read, not repaired.
lines.sk: Viem, že to bolí. Mňa tiež. Ale originál sa číta, neopravuje.
lines.heard: I know it hurts. It hurts me too but an original gets read not repaired

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Fine. I’ll just look at it and suffer.
lines.sk: Dobre. Budem sa na ňu len pozerať a trpieť.
lines.heard: Fine. I'll just look at it and suffer

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Welcome to the club. I sit on my hands with every original.
lines.sk: Vitaj v klube. Ja si pri každom origináli sadám na ruky.
lines.heard: Welcome to the club. I sit on my hands with every original

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tamara, are you expecting a parcel? A delivery robot called Blinky is looking for you.
lines.sk: Tamara, nečakáš balík? Hľadá ťa doručovací robot Očko.
lines.heard: Tamara, are you expecting a parcel? A delivery robot called Blinky is looking for you

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Blinky? He’s been looking for me since the autumn. Show me that request.
lines.sk: Očko? Ten ma hľadá už od jesene. Ukáž tú požiadavku.
lines.heard: Blinky? He's been looking for me since the autumn. Show me that request

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Yes, that parcel is mine. Last year I had a stall by the lake; this year I’m at the Grand. Here’s a confirmation with the new address.
lines.sk: Áno, ten balík je môj. Vlani som mala stôl pri plese, tento rok som v Grande. Tu máš potvrdenie s novou adresou.
lines.heard: Yes, that parcel is mine. Last year, I had a stall by the lake. This year, I'm at the Grand. Here's a confirmation with the new address

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll take it to him. A new address and no bench with a dog – Blinky can manage that.
lines.sk: Zanesiem mu ju. Nová adresa a žiadna lavička so psom, to Očko zvládne.
lines.heard: I'll take it to him. A new address and no bench with a dog. Blinky can manage that

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: And tell him that when he comes, he’ll get a coffee. Even though he claims he doesn’t drink it.
lines.sk: A povedz mu, že keď príde, dostane kávu. Aj keď tvrdí, že ju nepije.
lines.heard: And tell him that when he comes, he'll get a coffee, even though he claims he doesn't drink it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Coffee? For a robot?
lines.sk: Kávu? Robotovi?
lines.heard: Coffee for a robot?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: For anyone who brings me parts. Rules are rules.
lines.sk: Každému, kto mi prinesie súčiastky. Pravidlo je pravidlo.
lines.heard: For anyone who brings me parts. Rules are rules

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Coffee is a temporary repair for a person.
lines.sk: Káva je dočasná oprava človeka.
lines.heard: Coffee's a temporary repair for a person

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And have you got a more permanent repair?
lines.sk: A trvalejšiu opravu máš?
lines.heard: And have you got a more permanent repair?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Yes. We close at six.
lines.sk: Áno. Zatvárame o šiestej.
lines.heard: Yes, we close at 6:00

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what do people bring you most often?
lines.sk: A čo ti sem nosia najčastejšie?
lines.heard: And what do people bring you most often?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: In winter, heated gloves. Only the left one ever heats up, and nobody knows why.
lines.sk: V zime vyhrievané rukavice. Vždy hreje len ľavá a nikto nevie prečo.
lines.heard: In winter, heated gloves. Only the left one ever heats up and nobody knows why

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My guess is a broken wire in the right thumb.
lines.sk: Tipujem prelomený kábel v pravom palci.
lines.heard: My guess is a broken wire in the right thumb

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Good guess. You really are a repairer.
lines.sk: Tipuješ dobre. Ty si fakt opravár.
lines.heard: Good guess. You really are a repairer

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: With a cassette at least you can see that something is turning.
lines.sk: Na kazete aspoň vidíš, že sa niečo točí.
lines.heard: With a cassette, at least you can see that something is turning

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And with other devices you can’t?
lines.sk: A pri ostatných prístrojoch to nevidíš?
lines.heard: And with other devices you can't?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: You see an indicator light. And that stays on even when everything inside is asleep.
lines.sk: Vidíš kontrolku. A tá svieti, aj keď vnútri všetko spí.
lines.heard: You see an indicator light, and that stays on even when everything inside is asleep

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know that one. Green, and lying.
lines.sk: Tú poznám. Zelená a klame.
lines.heard: I know that one. Green and lying

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: That’s the one. A cassette at least admits it’s stopped.
lines.sk: Presne tá. Kazeta aspoň prizná, že stojí.
lines.heard: That's the one. A cassette at least admits it's stopped

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you always do your repairs here in the lobby?
lines.sk: Ty tu v lobby opravuješ stále?
lines.heard: Do you always do your repairs here in the lobby?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Only during the exhibition. Last year I had my workshop outside by Lake Vrbicke, by the bench with the dog.
lines.sk: Len počas výstavy. Vlani som bola s dielňou vonku pri Vrbickom plese, pri lavičke so psom.
lines.heard: Only during the exhibition. Last year I had my workshop outside by Lake Verbitské, by the bench with the dog

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And why not now as well?
lines.sk: A prečo nie aj teraz?
lines.heard: And why not now as well?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: In winter my coffee would freeze out there, and the screws.
lines.sk: V zime by mi tam zamrzla káva aj skrutky.
lines.heard: In winter, my coffee would freeze out there and the screws

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Screws freeze?
lines.sk: Skrutky zamrznú?
lines.heard: Screws freeze?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Screws don’t, fingers do. And a screw that falls out of them, I won’t find in the snow even with a magnet.
lines.sk: Skrutky nie, prsty áno. A skrutku, čo mi z nich vypadne, v snehu nenájdem ani magnetom.
lines.heard: Screws don't, fingers do. And a screw that falls out of them, I won't find in the snow, even with a magnet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Names have stopped vanishing from your orders. How about that coffee?
lines.sk: Mená ti už z objednávok nemiznú. Ako je to s tou kávou?
lines.heard: Names have stopped vanishing from your orders? How about that coffee?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: A promise is a promise. Here you are, no sugar.
lines.sk: Sľub je sľub. Tu máš, bez cukru.
lines.heard: A promise is a promise. Here you are, no sugar

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do you know no sugar?
lines.sk: Ako vieš, že bez cukru?
lines.heard: How do you know? No sugar

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Repairers haven’t got time to stir.
lines.sk: Opravári nemajú čas miešať.
lines.heard: Repairers haven't got time to stir

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s your workshop called?
lines.sk: Ako sa volá tvoja dielňa?
lines.heard: What's your workshop called?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Druhý život – Second Life. Because things have a second life too; people just don’t give it to them.
lines.sk: Druhý život. Lebo veci majú aj druhý život, len im ho ľudia nedajú.
lines.heard: Druhi Jivot, Second Life. Because things have a second life too. People just don't give it to 'em

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many lives does a tape recorder like that have?
lines.sk: A koľko životov má taký magnetofón?
lines.heard: And how many lives does a tape recorder like that have?

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: As many as the number of times someone repairs it rather than throwing it in the skip.
lines.sk: Toľko, koľkokrát ho niekto radšej opraví, než vyhodí do kontajnera.
lines.heard: As many as the number of times someone repairs it rather than throwing it in the skip?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve repaired one four times already.
lines.sk: Ja som jeden opravoval už štvrtýkrát.
lines.heard: I repaired one four times already

lines.speaker: TAMARA
lines.text: Then it’s a regular patient. Open a file for it.
lines.sk: Tak to je stály pacient. Založ mu kartu.
lines.heard: Then it's a regular patient. Open a file for it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A hotel function room full of archive boxes. Outside the window people ski; in here people quietly turn pages.
lines.sk: Hotelový salón plný archívnych krabíc. Za oknom sa lyžuje, tu sa potichu listuje.
lines.heard: A hotel function room full of archive boxes. Outside the window, people ski. In here, people quietly turn pages

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I’m looking for collection Z-17. I have a confirmed handover for it from 2020.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Hľadám fond Z-17. Mám k nemu potvrdené odovzdanie z roku 2020.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I'm looking for collection Z seventeen. I have a confirmed handover for it from twenty twenty.

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Let me see. Two signatures, a date and the owner’s consent. An archivist couldn’t wish for a nicer piece of paper.
lines.sk: Ukážte. Dva podpisy, dátum a súhlas majiteľky. Krajší papier si archivár nemôže priať.
lines.heard: Let me see. Hmm, two signatures, a date, and the owner's consent. An archivist couldn't wish for a nicer piece of paper

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: The record checks out. Here is the collection’s catalogue card. Private recordings can only be opened by the curator, in service mode.
lines.sk: Protokol sedí. Tu je katalógová karta fondu. Súkromné nahrávky otvorí len kurátorka v servisnom režime.
lines.heard: The record checks out. Here is the collection's catalog card. Private recordings can only be opened by the curator in service mode

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What did Atlas discard from the collection first?
lines.sk: Čo z fondu Atlas vyradil ako prvé?
lines.heard: What did Atlas discard from the collection first?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Names that contradicted each other, pauses in speech, laughter. And one message from Mrs Korman. Apparently it was too ambiguous.
lines.sk: Mená, ktoré si odporovali, pauzy v reči, smiech. A jednu správu pani Kormanovej. Vraj bola príliš nejednoznačná.
lines.heard: Names that contradicted each other, pauses in speech, laughter, and one message from Mrs. Corman. Apparently, it was too ambiguous

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Laughter too? But laughter doesn’t bother anyone.
lines.sk: Aj smiech? Ten predsa nikomu neprekáža.
lines.heard: Laughter too? But laughter doesn't bother anyone

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: It bothers the normaliser. Laughter has no column, and anything without a column is noise to it.
lines.sk: Normalizátoru áno. Smiech nemá kolónku, a čo nemá kolónku, to je preň šum.
lines.heard: It bothers the normalizer laughter has no column and anything without a column is noise to it.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Leah Korman? Victor’s mother?
lines.sk: Lea Kormanová? Viktorova mama?
lines.heard: Leah Corman, Victor's mother

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Yes. And that’s exactly why her message should have stayed whole.
lines.sk: Áno. A práve preto mala jej správa zostať celá.
lines.heard: Yes, and that's exactly why her message should have stayed whole

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Does Victor know?
lines.sk: Vie o tom Viktor?
lines.heard: Does Victor know?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: He knows what’s in the catalogue. What’s missing from it, nobody can read in a catalogue.
lines.sk: Vie, čo je v katalógu. Čo v ňom chýba, to sa v katalógu nedočíta nikto.
lines.heard: He knows what's in the catalog, what's missing from it. Nobody can read in a catalog

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. I’ll show the card to Sarah.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. Kartu ukážem Sáre.
lines.heard: Thank you. I'll show the card to Sarah

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Hold it by the edges and keep it away from coffee. Footnote: coffee is the archive’s worst enemy.
lines.sk: Držte ju za okraje a ďaleko od kávy. Poznámka pod čiarou: káva je najväčší nepriateľ archívu.
lines.heard: Hold it by the edges and keep it away from coffee. Footnote: coffee is the archive's worst enemy

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Here’s my first drawing from 1982. Next to it is a photo of the laptops from 2020 and the names of the people who helped.
lines.sk: Tu visí môj prvý výkres z roku 1982. Vedľa je fotka notebookov z roku 2020 a mená ľudí, ktorí pomáhali.
lines.heard: Here's my first drawing from 1982. Next to it is a photo of the laptops from 2020 and the names of the people who helped

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So no changing the world overnight.
lines.sk: Takže žiadna zmena sveta zo dňa na deň.
lines.heard: So no changing the world overnight

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: No. Just a lot of small things that might never have happened otherwise.
lines.sk: Nie. Len veľa malých vecí, ktoré by bez toho možno nevznikli.
lines.heard: No, just a lot of small things that might never have happened otherwise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s enough.
lines.sk: To stačí.
lines.heard: That's enough

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: By the way, I have the notebook in my bag. Someone once told me they’d like to see it.
lines.sk: Mimochodom, zošit mám v taške. Niekto mi raz povedal, že by ho rád videl.
lines.heard: By the way, I have the notebook in my bag. Someone once told me they'd like to see it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And will you show it to me?
lines.sk: A ukážete mi ho?
lines.heard: Then will you show it to me?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Only the first page. I’m still drawing the rest.
lines.sk: Len prvú stranu. Ostatné ešte dokresľujem.
lines.heard: Only the first page. I'm still drawing the rest

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is that the notebook from the exhibition?
lines.sk: To je ten zošit z výstavky?
lines.heard: Is that the notebook from the exhibition?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Not that one. The fourth. The first three are full.
lines.sk: Nie ten. Štvrtý v poradí. Prvé tri sú plné.
lines.heard: Not that one. The fourth. The first three are full

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Everything has a digital copy. That isn’t the same sentence.
lines.sk: Všetko má digitálnu kópiu. To nie je tá istá veta.
lines.heard: Everything has a digital copy that isn't the same sentence.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the difference?
lines.sk: V čom je ten rozdiel?
lines.heard: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: A copy tells you what was on the paper. The original also tells you who held it and where their coffee dripped.
lines.sk: Kópia vám povie, čo na papieri stálo. Originál aj to, kto ho držal a kde mu kvapla káva.
lines.heard: A copy tells you what was on the paper. The original also tells you who held it and where their coffee dripped.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the coffee stain isn’t on the copy?
lines.sk: A škvrna od kávy na kópii nie je?
lines.heard: And the coffee stain isn't on the copy?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: It is. But the normaliser cleans it off. And with it, the date that was underneath.
lines.sk: Je. Ale normalizátor ju vyčistí. A s ňou aj dátum, ktorý bol pod ňou.
lines.heard: It is, but the normalizer cleans it off and with it the date that was underneath

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Two people can remember the same day differently. An archive has to hold both.
lines.sk: Dvaja ľudia si môžu ten istý deň pamätať inak. Archív má uniesť oboch.
lines.heard: Two people can remember the same day differently. An archive has to hold both.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then someone at Atlas bought shelves that were too narrow.
lines.sk: Tak niekto v Atlase kúpil príliš úzke police.
lines.heard: Then someone at Atlas bought shelves that were too narrow

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: The shelves are fine. What’s narrow is the rule someone stuck on them.
lines.sk: Police sú v poriadku. Úzke je pravidlo, ktoré na ne niekto nalepil.
lines.heard: The shelves are fine what's narrow is the rule someone stuck on them.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what would you stick on them?
lines.sk: A vy by ste na ne nalepili aké?
lines.heard: And what would you stick on them?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Nothing. Shelves get numbers, not opinions.
lines.sk: Žiadne. Na police patria čísla, nie názory.
lines.heard: Nothing shelves get numbers, not opinions.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the oldest thing in the exhibition?
lines.sk: Čo je na výstave najstaršie?
lines.heard: What's the oldest thing in the exhibition?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: A postcard whose postmark is older than I am. It says the snow is good and the soup is expensive.
lines.sk: Pohľadnica, ktorej pečiatka je staršia ako ja. Píše sa na nej, že sneh je dobrý a polievka drahá.
lines.heard: A postcard whose postmark is older than I am. It says, "The snow is good and the soup is expensive."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And that’s worth exhibiting?
lines.sk: A to stojí za vystavenie?
lines.heard: And that's worth exhibiting?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: It is. Footnote: some news doesn’t change in a hundred years.
lines.sk: Stojí. Poznámka pod čiarou: niektoré správy sa nemenia ani za sto rokov.
lines.heard: It is footnote some news doesn't change in a hundred years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Which part? The snow or the soup?
lines.sk: Ktorá časť? Sneh, alebo polievka?
lines.heard: Which part? The snow or the soup?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: Both. I checked the snow through the window and the soup yesterday in the hotel restaurant.
lines.sk: Obe. Sneh som overil cez okno a polievku včera v hotelovej reštaurácii.
lines.heard: Both. I checked the snow through the window and the soup yesterday in the hotel restaurant

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What are those protectors on your sleeves for?
lines.sk: Načo sú vám tie návleky na rukávoch?
lines.heard: What are those protectors on your sleeves for?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: So that I add nothing to the archive. Not even dust from my own shirt.
lines.sk: Aby som archívu nič nepridal. Ani prach z vlastnej košele.
lines.heard: So that I add nothing to the archive, not even dust from my own shirt

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And does the archive add anything to you?
lines.sk: A archív vám niečo pridá?
lines.heard: And does the archive add anything to you?

lines.speaker: BORIS
lines.text: All the time. Paper cuts and good stories. In that order.
lines.sk: Stále. Rezné rany od papiera a dobré príbehy. V tomto poradí.
lines.heard: All the time. Paper cuts and good stories in that order.

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Maybe. You’ve got the look of someone who’s wandered in here for the second time.
lines.sk: Možno. Máte taký výraz, akoby ste sem zablúdili už druhýkrát.
lines.heard: Maybe. You've got the look of someone who's wandered in here for the second time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That guess is more accurate than you’d think.
lines.sk: Ten odhad je presnejší, než by ste si mysleli.
lines.heard: That guess is more accurate than you'd think

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: I’m bad with faces. Expressions I remember exactly.
lines.sk: Tváre si pamätám zle. Výrazy presne.
lines.heard: I'm bad with faces. Expressions I remember exactly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what’s mine like?
lines.sk: A ten môj je aký?
lines.heard: And what's mine like?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Like someone who went to ask the way and fixed something instead.
lines.sk: Ako keď sa niekto ide spýtať na cestu a namiesto toho niečo opraví.
lines.heard: Like someone who went to ask the way and fixed something instead

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What brings you here?
lines.sk: Čo vás sem priviedlo?
lines.heard: What brings you here?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: I came to check the captions. An occupational hazard.
lines.sk: Prišla som skontrolovať popisky. Profesionálna deformácia.
lines.heard: I came to check the captions. An occupational hazard

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And are they right?
lines.sk: A sedia?
lines.heard: And are they right?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Two typos and one ‘approx.’. At an exhibition about memory I’d expect more precision.
lines.sk: Dva preklepy a jedno „cca“. Na výstave o pamäti by som čakala väčšiu presnosť.
lines.heard: Two typos and one approx. At an exhibition about memory, I'd expect more precision

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did you tell Boris?
lines.sk: Povedali ste to Borisovi?
lines.heard: Did you tell Boris?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: I did. He wrote it down and added a footnote underneath: ‘Thank you.’
lines.sk: Povedala. Zapísal si to a pod čiaru pripísal: „Ďakujem.“
lines.heard: I did. He wrote it down and added a footnote underneath, "Thank you."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You went to school on Sokolikova, didn’t you?
lines.sk: Vy ste chodili do školy na Sokolíkovej, však?
lines.heard: You went to school on Sokolikova, didn't you?

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Yes. In the same class as Tony Wolfe. He drew aeroplanes in every exercise book.
lines.sk: Áno. S Tónom Farkašom do jednej triedy. Kreslil lietadlá do všetkých zošitov.
lines.heard: Yes, in the same class as Tony Wolf. He drew aeroplanes in every exercise book

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Yours too?
lines.sk: Aj do vašich?
lines.heard: Yours too

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: Mine too. And I corrected them; the wings were always at the wrong angle.
lines.sk: Aj. A ja som mu ich opravovala, krídla mali vždy zlý uhol.
lines.heard: Mine too, and I corrected them. The wings were always at the wrong angle

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All of them?
lines.sk: Všetky?
lines.heard: All of them

lines.speaker: JANA35
lines.text: All except the first. I still have that one in my archive. I don’t touch first versions, even when the wings are crooked.
lines.sk: Všetky okrem prvého. To mám dodnes v archíve. Na prvé verzie nesiaham, ani keď majú krivé krídla.
lines.heard: All except the first. I still have that one in my archive. I don't touch first versions, even when the wings are crooked

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The information centre. A good place to start for someone who already has trouble with today’s date.
lines.sk: Infocentrum. Dobrý začiatok pre človeka, ktorý má problém už s dnešným dátumom.
lines.heard: The information center. A good place to start for someone who already has trouble with today's date

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. Boris sent me with this card.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Boris ma posiela s touto kartou.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. Boris sent me with this card

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Good afternoon. I know the card. First I’ll write you into the visitors’ book in pen. Nobody vanishes from that.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Kartu poznám. Najprv vás zapíšem perom do knihy návštev. Odtiaľ mi nikto nezmizne.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I know the card. First, I'll write you into the visitor's book in pen. Nobody vanishes from that

lines.speaker: SARA
