lines.text: Nina has confirmed your service access to the pavilion. Here’s the pass and a return ticket for both sections of the cable car.
lines.sk: Nina vám potvrdila servisný vstup do pavilónu. Tu je preukaz a spiatočný lístok na oba úseky lanovky.
lines.heard: Nina has confirmed your service access to the pavilion. Here's the pass and a return ticket for both sections of the cable car

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do I get there?
lines.sk: Ako sa tam dostanem?
lines.heard: How do I get there?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Gondola to Priehyba, where you change for the Funitel to Chopok. The pavilion is by the Rotunda. Everything’s running today.
lines.sk: Kabínkou na Priehybu, tam prestúpite na Funitel na Chopok. Pavilón je pri Rotunde. Dnes všetko premáva.
lines.heard: Gondola to Prahiba, where you change for the funitel to Chopok. The pavilion is by the Rotunda. Everything's running today

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An ordinary change, no leap across decades? I’ve been waiting all day for one of those.
lines.sk: Obyčajný prestup, žiadny skok cez desaťročia? Na taký som dnes čakal celý deň.
lines.heard: An ordinary change? No leap across decades? I've been waiting all day for one of those

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Keep the ticket – it’s valid for the way back too.
lines.sk: Lístok si nechajte, platí aj späť.
lines.heard: Keep the ticket. It's valid for the way back too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if I lose it?
lines.sk: A keby som ho stratil?
lines.heard: And if I lose it?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: You won’t. Tickets are like gloves – they always turn up in the other pocket.
lines.sk: Nestratíte. Lístky sú ako rukavice, vždy sa nájdu v tom druhom vrecku.
lines.heard: You won't. Tickets are like gloves. They always turn up in the other pocket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My coat has six pockets.
lines.sk: Ja mám v kabáte šesť vreciek.
lines.heard: My coat has six pockets.

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Then you’ve got five extra chances. Have a good trip.
lines.sk: Tak máte päť šancí navyše. Šťastnú cestu.
lines.heard: Then you've got five extra chances. Have a good trip

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Where have you come from?
lines.sk: Odkiaľ prichádzate?
lines.heard: Where have you come from?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: From a complicated date.
lines.sk: Z komplikovaného dátumu.
lines.heard: from a complicated date

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I’ll put: business visit.
lines.sk: Napíšem: služobná návšteva.
lines.heard: I'll put business visit

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: And the date of arrival?
lines.sk: A dátum príchodu?
lines.heard: And the date of arrival?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Today’s. I hope.
lines.sk: Dnešný. Dúfam.
lines.heard: Today's I hope

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I’ll put today’s. So far, the pen has never once been wrong.
lines.sk: Napíšem dnešný. Pero sa zatiaľ ešte nikdy nepomýlilo.
lines.heard: I'll put today's. So far, the pen has never once been wrong

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: When names vanish from the system, I write them down here in pen.
lines.sk: Keď mená miznú zo systému, zapisujem ich sem perom.
lines.heard: When names vanish from the system, I write them down here in pen

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many names have you got in there today?
lines.sk: A koľko mien tam dnes máte?
lines.heard: And how many names have you got in there today?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Twenty-three. One gentleman wanted me to write his name with his title.
lines.sk: Dvadsaťtri. Jeden pán chcel, aby som mu meno napísala aj s titulom.
lines.heard: Twenty-three. One gentleman wanted me to write his name with his title

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you?
lines.sk: A napísali ste?
lines.heard: And did you?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I did. When his name vanished from the system, all he had left there was the title.
lines.sk: Napísala. Keď mu meno zmizlo zo systému, ostal mu tam len ten titul.
lines.heard: I did. When his name vanished from the system all he had left there was the title

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you always write with the same pen?
lines.sk: Píšete stále tým istým perom?
lines.heard: Do you always write with the same pen?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: For three years. It’s never fallen on the floor or run out.
lines.sk: Tri roky. Ešte mi nikdy nespadlo ani sa nevypísalo.
lines.heard: For three years it's never fallen on the floor or run out?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do you do it?
lines.sk: Ako to robíte?
lines.heard: How do you do it?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: When I write, I hold it. When I’m not writing, I put it down. And I change the refill on Mondays.
lines.sk: Keď píšem, držím ho. Keď nepíšem, odložím ho. A náplň mením v pondelok.
lines.heard: When I write, I hold it. When I'm not writing, I put it down, and I change the refill on Mondays

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You could teach that.
lines.sk: To by ste mohli učiť.
lines.heard: You could teach that

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I do. Every new colleague, on their first day.
lines.sk: Učím. Každého nového kolegu hneď prvý deň.
lines.heard: I do every new colleague on their first day

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Where the toilets are, when the last gondola goes and whether it’s cold up top.
lines.sk: Kde sú toalety, kedy ide posledná kabínka a či je hore zima.
lines.heard: Where the toilets are, when the last gondola goes, and whether it's cold up top

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And is it?
lines.sk: A je?
lines.heard: And is it?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Always. But everyone wants me to say it out loud.
lines.sk: Vždy. Ale každý chce, aby som mu to povedala nahlas.
lines.heard: Always but everyone wants me to say it out loud

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And do you?
lines.sk: A poviete?
lines.heard: And do you?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I do. And I tell them to zip their jacket right up to the chin.
lines.sk: Poviem. A dodám, nech si zapne bundu až po bradu.
lines.heard: I do, and I tell them to zip their jacket right up to the chin

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why is coffee in the biggest letters on the visitor rules?
lines.sk: Prečo je v návštevníckom poriadku najväčším písmom práve káva?
lines.heard: Why is coffee in the biggest letters on the visitor rules?

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: Because once a coffee ended up in the visitors’ book. The names from three pages ran together into one stain.
lines.sk: Lebo raz jedna káva skončila v knihe návštev. Mená z troch strán sa zliali do jednej škvrny.
lines.heard: Because once a coffee ended up in the visitors' book, the names from three pages ran together into one stain.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the names?
lines.sk: A tie mená?
lines.heard: And the names

lines.speaker: SARA
lines.text: I deciphered them through the stain and rewrote them in pen, one by one. Since then the rule is: coffee outside, pen inside.
lines.sk: Rozlúštila som ich aj cez škvrnu a prepísala perom, jedno po druhom. Odvtedy platí: káva vonku, pero dnu.
lines.heard: I deciphered them through the stain and rewrote them in pen one by one. Since then, the rule is coffee outside, pen inside

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Priehyba. This time I’m only changing to another cable car, not to another year.
lines.sk: Priehyba. Tentoraz prestupujem len na inú lanovku, nie do iného roku.
lines.heard: Pre-Aber. This time I'm only changing to another cable car, not to another year

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Good afternoon. Ticket, please. No skis?
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Lístok, prosím. Lyže nemáte?
lines.heard: Good afternoon ticket please no skis?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: No. Just a tool bag.
lines.sk: Nemám. Len servisnú brašnu.
lines.heard: No, just a tool bag

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: That’s equipment too. It’s just harder to ski down on.
lines.sk: Aj to je výstroj. Len sa s ňou horšie zjazduje.
lines.heard: That's equipment too. It's just harder to ski down on

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Your ticket is valid here too, go ahead. The doors only open once the cabin reaches the top.
lines.sk: Lístok platí aj tu, nech sa páči. Dvere sa otvoria, až keď kabína príde hore.
lines.heard: Your ticket is valid here too. Go ahead. The doors only open once the cabin reaches the top

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Only at the destination? Excellent. I’ve been through enough doors today with a different year behind them.
lines.sk: Až v cieli? Výborne. Dnes som prešiel cez dosť dverí, za ktorými bol iný rok.
lines.heard: Only at the destination. Excellent. I've been through enough doors today with a different year behind them

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: You came up from Biela Put by gondola; now you take the Funitel to Chopok. Keep your return ticket.
lines.sk: Z Bielej Púte ste prišli kabínkou, teraz pôjdete Funitelom na Chopok. Spiatočný lístok si nechajte.
lines.heard: You came up from Bielerputz by gondola. Now you take the funitel to Chopok. Keep your return ticket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Today I’m holding on to anything with a return with both hands.
lines.sk: Všetko spiatočné si dnes držím oboma rukami.
lines.heard: Today, I'm holding onto anything with a return with both hands

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Inside pocket is better. It’s windy up there, and tickets fly off like sparrows.
lines.sk: Radšej do vnútorného vrecka. Hore fúka a lístky odlietajú ako vrabce.
lines.heard: Inside pocket is better it's windy up there and tickets fly off like sparrows

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Have you had one fly off?
lines.sk: Už vám nejaký odletel?
lines.heard: Have you had one fly off?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Last week, from a gentleman. A piste-basher driver found it two kilometres further down.
lines.sk: Minulý týždeň jednému pánovi. Našiel ho ratrakista o dva kilometre nižšie.
lines.heard: Last week from a gentleman. A piste basher driver found it two kilometers further down

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Good today, everything’s running. If that changes, you’ll hear it from me.
lines.sk: Dnes je dobre, jazdí sa. Keby sa to zmenilo, dozviete sa to odo mňa.
lines.heard: Good today. Everything's running. If that changes, you'll hear it from me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if it clouds over, what should I go by?
lines.sk: A keď sa zatiahne, podľa čoho sa mám riadiť?
lines.heard: And if it clouds over, what should I go by?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: By what I tell you. I wouldn’t trust the clouds that much.
lines.sk: Podľa toho, čo vám poviem ja. Oblakom by som tak neveril.
lines.heard: By what I tell you I wouldn't trust the clouds that much.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how cold is it up there?
lines.sk: A koľko je hore stupňov?
lines.heard: And how cold is it up there?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Minus fourteen and windy – an ordinary February, in other words. Pull your scarf up over your nose.
lines.sk: Mínus štrnásť a vietor, čiže obyčajný február. Šál si vytiahnite aj na nos.
lines.heard: Minus 14 and windy. An ordinary February, in other words. Pull your scarf up over your nose

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How is the Funitel different from the gondola below?
lines.sk: Čím je ten Funitel iný ako kabínka zdola?
lines.heard: How is the funitel different from the gondola below?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: It hangs on two cables at once. The wind has a much harder time arguing with it.
lines.sk: Visí na dvoch lanách naraz. Vietor sa s ním dohaduje oveľa ťažšie.
lines.heard: It hangs on two cables at once. The wind has a much harder time arguing with it.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many people fit in?
lines.sk: A koľko ľudí sa doň zmestí?
lines.heard: And how many people fit in?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: A whole ski school, instructor included. And always one more, running to catch up.
lines.sk: Celá lyžiarska škola aj s inštruktorom. A vždy ešte jeden, čo dobieha.
lines.heard: A whole ski school, instructor included and always one more running to catch up

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: There’s one of those in every cabin?
lines.sk: Ten je v každej kabíne?
lines.heard: There's one of those in every cabin?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: Every one. Usually with one boot undone and one pole.
lines.sk: V každej. Väčšinou má rozopnutú lyžiarku a jednu palicu.
lines.heard: Everyone. Usually with one boot undone and one pole

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Doesn’t the same station all day bore you?
lines.sk: Nenudí vás celý deň tá istá stanica?
lines.heard: Doesn't the same station all day bore you?

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: The station’s the same; the people are different. Three have already asked me today where Chopok is.
lines.sk: Stanica je tá istá, ľudia sú iní. Dnes sa ma už traja pýtali, kde je Chopok.
lines.heard: The station's the same, the people are different. Three have already asked me today where Chopok is.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Up.
lines.sk: Veď hore.
lines.heard: Yep

lines.speaker: IVAN
lines.text: That’s exactly what I told them. Two said thank you, one took offence.
lines.sk: Presne to som im povedal. Dvaja poďakovali, jeden sa urazil.
lines.heard: That's exactly what I told them. Two said thank you. One took offense

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: At last, a form of transport where everyone travels to the same time.
lines.sk: Konečne doprava, kde všetci cestujú do rovnakého času.
lines.heard: At last, a form of transport where everyone travels to the same time

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Up there it’s always a slightly different world.
lines.sk: Hore je to vždy trochu iný svet.
lines.heard: Up there, it's always a slightly different world

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Today I hope only slightly.
lines.sk: Dnes dúfam, že len trochu.
lines.heard: Today, I hope only slightly

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Colder and quieter. And phones get a worse signal up there – that’s the best thing about it.
lines.sk: Chladnejší a tichší. A telefón tam chytá horšie, to je na ňom najkrajšie.
lines.heard: Colder and quieter. And phones get a worse signal up there. That's the best thing about it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve got out of the habit of signals today.
lines.sk: Od signálu som si dnes už odvykol.
lines.heard: I've got out of the habit of signals today

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Arriving at the station. Please exit once the doors open.
lines.sk: Príchod do stanice. Prosíme, vystupujte po otvorení dverí.
lines.heard: Arriving at the station. Please exit once the doors open.

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Because it’s part of the trip too.
lines.sk: Lebo aj tá patrí k výletu.
lines.heard: Because it's part of the trip too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’d like to repeat that sentence to someone up top.
lines.sk: Tú vetu by som rád niekomu hore zopakoval.
lines.heard: I'd like to repeat that sentence to someone up top

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Go ahead. It’s free, like the fog.
lines.sk: Pokojne. Je zadarmo ako hmla.
lines.heard: Go ahead. It's free, like the fog

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Today there’s a sea of fog down in the valley and we’re going up above it. The photo will have both.
lines.sk: Dnes je dole v doline more hmly a my ideme nad ňu. Na fotke bude oboje.
lines.heard: Today, there's a sea of fog down in the valley, and we're going up above it. The photo will have both

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which part do you like better?
lines.sk: A ktorá časť sa vám páči viac?
lines.heard: And which part do you like better?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: The fog. Everybody has clear skies in their photos.
lines.sk: Tá s hmlou. Jasno má na fotke každý.
lines.heard: The fog. Everybody has clear skies in their photos.

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: With my father. I don’t remember where we ate. I remember that he laughed.
lines.sk: S otcom. Nepamätám si, kde sme jedli. Pamätám si, že sa smial.
lines.heard: With my father. I don't remember where we ate. I remember that he laughed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what did he laugh at?
lines.sk: A na čom sa smial?
lines.heard: And what did he laugh at?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: He laughed because I had my skis on crooked all day.
lines.sk: Smial sa, lebo som mal celý deň lyže nakrivo.
lines.heard: He laughed because I had my skis on crooked all day

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And today?
lines.sk: A dnes?
lines.heard: And today?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Today I’d have them on straight. If I hadn’t left them in the car.
lines.sk: Dnes by som ich mal rovno. Keby som si ich nezabudol v aute.
lines.heard: Today, I'd have them on straight if I hadn't left them in the car

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do you carry in such a small rucksack?
lines.sk: Čo nosíte v takom malom batohu?
lines.heard: What do you carry in such a small rucksack?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: I pack like my father did: a flask, schnitzels in foil and spare gloves.
lines.sk: Balím ako otec: termosku, rezne v alobale a náhradné rukavice.
lines.heard: I pack like my father did a flask schnitzels in foil and spare gloves.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Schnitzels, on Chopok?
lines.sk: Rezne na Chopok?
lines.heard: schnitzels on Chopok

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Everything up there is expensive. A schnitzel only cost me ten minutes at the stove.
lines.sk: Hore je všetko drahé. Rezeň ma stál len desať minút pri sporáku.
lines.heard: Everything up there is expensive. A schnitzel only cost me 10 minutes at the stove

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many have you got?
lines.sk: A koľko ich máte?
lines.heard: And how many have you got?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: Four. My father always said there’s always someone who could do with one.
lines.sk: Štyri. Otec vravel, že jeden sa vždy niekomu ujde.
lines.heard: Four. My father always said, "There's always someone who could do with one."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You still take pictures with a camera? Not your phone?
lines.sk: Vy ešte fotíte fotoaparátom? Nie telefónom?
lines.heard: You still take pictures with a camera, not your phone?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: With my phone I photograph where I parked. With the camera, trips.
lines.sk: Telefónom si fotím, kde som zaparkoval. Fotoaparátom výlety.
lines.heard: With my phone, I photograph where I parked. With the camera, trips

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s the difference?
lines.sk: Aký je v tom rozdiel?
lines.heard: What's the difference?

lines.speaker: TURISTA
lines.text: I’ll still look at the trips in ten years. Not the car park.
lines.sk: Výlety si pozriem aj o desať rokov. Parkovisko už nie.
lines.heard: I'll still look at the trips in 10 years, not the car park

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The Rotunda, with the Atlas exhibition inside. The view is beautiful; it’s just that people are vanishing from the photos on the walls.
lines.sk: Rotunda a v nej výstava Atlasu. Výhľad je krásny, len z fotiek na stenách miznú ľudia.
lines.heard: The Rotunda with the Atlas exhibition inside. The view is beautiful. It's just that people are vanishing from the photos on the walls

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The panel is public, so I’ll take a photo. It says: DIFFERENCE = DISCARD.
lines.sk: Panel je verejný, tak si ho odfotím. Je na ňom napísané: ROZDIEL = ZAHODIŤ.
lines.heard: The panel is public, so I'll take a photo. It says, "Difference equals discard."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The exact opposite of Gran’s sentence. The fault isn’t in the memories. It’s in the rule.
lines.sk: Presný opak babkinej vety. Chyba nie je v spomienkach. Je v pravidle.
lines.heard: The exact opposite of grand sentence. The fault isn't in the memories, it's in the rule

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This equipment belongs to the exhibition. I’m not touching the cable car. I’ll be needing that again.
lines.sk: Táto technika patrí výstave. Na lanovku nesiaham. Tú budem ešte potrebovať.
lines.heard: This equipment belongs to the exhibition. I'm not touching the cable car. I'll be needing that again

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Nina here. Can you hear me? I can see you at the terminal.
lines.sk: Tu Nina. Počujete ma? Vidím vás pri termináli.
lines.heard: Nina here. Can you hear me? I can see you at the terminal.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I can. I can also hear my teeth chattering. It’s properly cold up here.
lines.sk: Počujem. Aj to, ako mi cvakajú zuby. Tu hore je poriadna zima.
lines.heard: I can. I can also hear my teeth chattering. It's properly cold up here

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: I’m granting you access to the return buffer. The private record we’ll play only for Victor.
lines.sk: Prístup k návratovému zásobníku vám povoľujem. Súkromný záznam pustíme iba Viktorovi.
lines.heard: I'm granting you access to the return buffer. The private record will play only for Victor

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Connecting the reader. The cassette, Gran’s rule and the photo of the faulty panel.
lines.sk: Pripájam čítačku. Kazeta, babkino pravidlo a fotka chybného panelu.
lines.heard: Connecting the reader, the cassette, Gran's rule, and the photo of the faulty panel

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Withheld data can be restored. Switch the output to MONITOR.
lines.sk: Zadržané údaje možno obnoviť. Prepnite výstup na MONITOR.
lines.heard: Withheld data can be restored. Switch the output to monitor.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Withheld data? So it isn’t lost, it’s just waiting?
lines.sk: Zadržané údaje? Takže sa nestratili, len čakajú?
lines.heard: withheld data. So it isn't lost, it's just waiting

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: In the buffer, until someone confirms the write. So far nobody has confirmed it, not even Victor.
lines.sk: V zásobníku, kým niekto potvrdí zápis. Zatiaľ ho nepotvrdil nikto, ani Viktor.
lines.heard: In the buffer until someone confirms the write. So far nobody has confirmed it, not even Victor

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: The diagnostics and the original message from Victor’s mother are on your reader. You still need the trace from the stand by Lake Vrbicke.
lines.sk: Diagnostiku aj pôvodnú správu Viktorovej mamy máte v čítačke. Ešte treba stopu zo stojana pri Vrbickom plese.
lines.heard: The diagnostics and the original message from Victor's mother are on your reader. You still need the trace from the stand by Lake Vrabice.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I hope that isn’t another device that rewrites things.
lines.sk: Dúfam, že to nie je ďalší prístroj, ktorý niečo prepisuje.
lines.heard: I hope that isn't another device that rewrites things

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: It isn’t. That stand only measures.
lines.sk: Nie je. Ten stojan iba meria.
lines.heard: It isn't. That stand only measures

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How do I get to the lake?
lines.sk: Ako sa k plesu dostanem?
lines.heard: How do I get to the lake?

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Down by cable car, then on foot from the hotel. You’ll see the stand right by the path.
lines.sk: Lanovkami dole a od hotela pešo. Stojan uvidíte hneď pri chodníku.
lines.heard: Down by cable car, then on foot from the hotel. You'll see the stand right by the path.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Nina, the trace from the lake is in the terminal.
lines.sk: Nina, stopa z plesa je v termináli.
lines.heard: Nina, the trace from the lake is in the terminal

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: I can see it. It’s clean; nothing on it needs adjusting.
lines.sk: Vidím ju. Je čistá, nič na nej netreba upravovať.
lines.heard: I can see it. It's clean. Nothing on it needs adjusting

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: The rule from 1962 and the local trace both match. I’ve signed the restore procedure.
lines.sk: Pravidlo z roku 1962 aj miestna stopa sedia. Obnovovací postup som podpísala.
lines.heard: The rule from 1962 and the local trace both match. I've signed the restore procedure

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So: keep the exceptions, return the withheld records and switch off the write-back.
lines.sk: Takže: výnimky nechať, zadržané záznamy vrátiť a spätný zápis vypnúť.
lines.heard: So keep the exceptions, return the withheld records, and switch off the write back

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: There’s a switch on the terrace – set it to MONITOR. It’s a separate output; it won’t shut down the servers or the cable cars.
lines.sk: Na terase je prepínač, dajte ho na MONITOR. Je to samostatný výstup, servery ani lanovky ním nevypnete.
lines.heard: There's a switch on the terrace. Set it to monitor. It's a separate output. It won't shut down the servers or the cable cars

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Understood. No pulling out cables blindly.
lines.sk: Rozumiem. Žiadne vyťahovanie káblov naslepo.
lines.heard: Understood. No pulling out cables blindly

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Exactly. That’s why my note hangs by the cables.
lines.sk: Presne. Kvôli tomu visí pri kábloch môj lístok.
lines.heard: Exactly. That's why my note hangs by the cables

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I saw it. Victor probably didn’t read it.
lines.sk: Videl som ho. Viktor ho asi nečítal.
lines.heard: I saw it victor probably didn't read it

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: He read it. He just thought it was meant for everyone else.
lines.sk: Čítal. Len si myslel, že je pre ostatných.
lines.heard: He read it. He just thought it was meant for everyone else

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: MONITOR mode confirmed. Chamber entry permitted.
lines.sk: Režim MONITOR potvrdený. Vstup do komory povolený.
lines.heard: Monitor mode confirmed. Chamber entry permitted.

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Victor is inside. First he has to hear what the system threw away. Then we put in the four pieces of evidence.
lines.sk: Viktor je vnútri. Najprv musí počuť, čo systém zahodil. Potom vložíme štyri dôkazy.
lines.heard: Victor is inside. First, he has to hear what the system threw away. Then we put in the four pieces of evidence

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How is he?
lines.sk: Ako je na tom?
lines.heard: How is he?

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Sitting at the table, staring into a glass of water. He poured it before the test started.
lines.sk: Sedí pri stole a pozerá do pohára s vodou. Nalial si ju ešte pred spustením skúšky.
lines.heard: Sitting at the table, staring into a glass of water. He poured it before the test started

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll play him the whole recording. Pauses between the sentences and all.
lines.sk: Pustím mu celý záznam. Aj s prestávkami medzi vetami.
lines.heard: I'll play him the whole recording, pauses between the sentences and all

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: All right. I’ll stay on the channel, but I won’t interrupt.
lines.sk: Dobre. Budem na kanáli, ale nebudem rušiť.
lines.heard: All right. I'll stay on the channel, but I won't interrupt

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Lake Vrbicke under ice. In the middle it’s been swept, and the ice reflects the forest without a single edit.
lines.sk: Vrbické pleso pod ľadom. Uprostred je zametené a ľad odráža les bez jedinej úpravy.
lines.heard: Lake Vrbice under ice. In the middle, it's been swept and the ice reflects the forest without a single edit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The exhibition’s stand on the path by the lake. The chronometer will read this place’s trace from it.
lines.sk: Stojan výstavy na chodníku pri plese. Chronometer si z neho prečíta stopu tohto miesta.
lines.heard: The exhibitions stand on the path by the lake. The chronometer will read this place's trace from it

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Local reference trace 2035 saved.
lines.sk: Miestna referenčná stopa 2035 uložená.
lines.heard: Local reference trace 2035 saved

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The lake and the ice have stayed exactly as they were.
lines.sk: Pleso aj ľad zostali presne také, aké boli.
lines.heard: The lake and the ice have stayed exactly as they were

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A ceramic dog and the sign DRUHÝ ŽIVOT – ‘second life’. On a note underneath: ‘Tamara, during the exhibition, in the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasna.’
lines.sk: Keramický pes a nápis DRUHÝ ŽIVOT. Na lístku pod ním: „Tamara, počas výstavy v lobby hotela Grand Jasná.“
lines.heard: A ceramic dog and the sign Druhy Zivot, Second Life. On a note underneath, Tamra during the exhibition in the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasna

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So the repair shop has just moved. I’ll ask Tamara whether the parcel is really hers.
lines.sk: Opravovňa sa teda len presťahovala. Spýtam sa Tamary, či ten balík naozaj patrí jej.
lines.heard: So the repair shop has just moved. I'll ask Tamra whether the parcel is really hers.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A lovely view. If only Atlas also kept the people looking at it in its records.
lines.sk: Pekný výhľad. Keby tak Atlas nechal v záznamoch aj ľudí, ktorí sa naň pozerajú.
lines.heard: A lovely view. If only Atlas also kept the people looking at it in its records

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Atlas’s separate connector. Otto’s bridge with Tony’s swallow, thirty-eight years in the dry.
lines.sk: Samostatný konektor Atlasu. Otov mostík s Tónovou lastovičkou, tridsaťosem rokov v suchu.
lines.heard: Atlas's separate connector otto's bridge with tony swallow thirty eight years in the dry

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: The contact is holding. Now MONITOR will bypass the faulty write command.
lines.sk: Kontakt drží. Teraz už MONITOR obíde chybný príkaz na zápis.
lines.heard: The contact is holding. Now monitor will bypass the faulty right command

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: That bridge is older than I am.
lines.sk: Ten mostík je starší ako ja.
lines.heard: That bridge is older than I am

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: By quite a bit. I sealed it in a jar in December 1982.
lines.sk: O dosť. Do pohára som ho zapečatil v decembri 1982.
lines.heard: By quite a bit. I sealed it in a jar in December 1982

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: All the way here, led by a map a twelve-year-old Tony drew.
lines.sk: Až sem ma doviedla mapa, ktorú nakreslil dvanásťročný Tóno.
lines.heard: All the way here, led by a map a 12-year-old Tony drew

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Then give it my regards. And now the switch.
lines.sk: Tak ho odo mňa pozdravujte. A teraz prepínač.
lines.heard: Then give it my regards. And now the switch.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: WRITE off, MONITOR on.
lines.sk: ZÁPIS vypnutý, MONITOR zapnutý.
lines.heard: Right off, monitor on

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Write-back suspended. Buffer preserved.
lines.sk: Spätný zápis pozastavený. Zásobník zachovaný.
lines.heard: Writeback suspended, buffer preserved.

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Nothing is vanishing any more. We have time for the repair.
lines.sk: Už nič nemizne. Máme čas na opravu.
lines.heard: Nothing is vanishing anymore. We have time for the repair

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This is a very pleasant kind of silence.
lines.sk: Toto je veľmi príjemný druh ticha.
lines.heard: This is a very pleasant kind of silence

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: The visitor list has stopped falling apart. You’re all there again.
lines.sk: Zoznam návštevníkov sa prestal rozpadať. Ste v ňom zase celý.
lines.heard: The visitor list has stopped falling apart. You're all there again

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: With both r’s?
lines.sk: Aj s mäkčeňom?
lines.heard: With both Rs

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: Both r’s. Now confirm entry to the chamber at the terminal.
lines.sk: Aj s mäkčeňom. Teraz potvrďte na termináli vstup do komory.
lines.heard: Both ours. Now confirm entry to the chamber at the terminal

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: We’re high up on Chopok. I’m carrying things from every year I’ve visited today in my bag.
lines.sk: Sme vysoko na Chopku. Veci zo všetkých rokov, ktoré som dnes navštívil, nosím v brašni.
lines.heard: We're high up on Chopok. I'm carrying things from every year I've visited today in my bag

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mr Korman, I’ve brought you a recording.
lines.sk: Pán Korman, nesiem vám jednu nahrávku.
lines.heard: Mr. Corman, I've brought you a recording

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: You’ve switched off the write. Do you know how much could be lost now?
lines.sk: Vypli ste zápis. Viete, koľko sa toho teraz môže stratiť?
lines.heard: You've switched off the right. Do you know how much could be lost now?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I know what has already been lost. Listen to the original.
lines.sk: Viem, čo sa už stratilo. Vypočujte si originál.
lines.heard: I know what has already been lost. Listen to the original

lines.speaker: LEA_REC
lines.text: Victor? It’s me. I’m just ringing. You don’t have to fix anything. When you have time, call me.
lines.sk: Viktor? To som ja. Len ti volám. Nemusíš nič opravovať. Keď budeš mať čas, ozvi sa.
lines.heard: Victor, it's me. I'm just ringing. You don't have to fix anything. When you have time, call me

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: That’s how she always rang. When she had nothing to say.
lines.sk: Takto volávala vždy. Keď nemala čo povedať.
lines.heard: That's how she always rang when she had nothing to say.

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: In the edited version, all that was left was ‘call me’.
lines.sk: V upravenej verzii zostalo len „ozvi sa“.
lines.heard: In the edited version, all that was left was "Call me."

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Those pauses weren’t a fault. Nor was the fact that she didn’t want anything from you.
lines.sk: Tie pauzy neboli chyba. Ani to, že od vás nič nechcela.
lines.heard: Those pauses weren't a fault, nor was the fact that she didn't want anything from you

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: The normaliser flagged them as noise. I approved it.
lines.sk: Normalizátor ich označil ako šum. Ja som to schválil.
lines.heard: The normalizer flagged them as noise. I approved it

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Nina warned me. I let the test run because I wanted to believe the result.
lines.sk: Nina ma varovala. Nechal som skúšku bežať, lebo som chcel veriť výsledku.
lines.heard: Nina warned me. I let the test run because I wanted to believe the result

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s left in the buffer can still be brought back.
lines.sk: To, čo ostalo v zásobníku, sa ešte dá vrátiť.
lines.heard: What's left in the buffer can still be brought back

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I agree. We’ll switch off the write for good and return the originals. And I’ll make public what I did.
lines.sk: Súhlasím. Zápis vypneme natrvalo a originály vrátime. A zverejním, čo som urobil.
lines.heard: I agree. We'll switch off the right for good and return the originals, and I'll make public what I did

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: That voice was there all along. I just didn’t want to leave it as it was.
lines.sk: Ten hlas tam bol celý čas. Len som ho nechcel nechať taký, aký bol.
lines.heard: That voice was there all along. I just didn't want to leave it as it was

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I cleaned out of the message exactly what I should have kept.
lines.sk: Vyčistil som zo správy presne to, čo som si mal nechať.
lines.heard: I cleaned out of the message exactly what I should have kept

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The recording is still there.
lines.sk: Záznam tam ešte je.
lines.heard: The recording is still there

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Then let’s keep it whole.
lines.sk: Tak ho nechajme celý.
lines.heard: Then let's keep it whole

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: ORIGIN: confirmed.
lines.sk: PÔVOD: potvrdený.
lines.heard: Origin confirmed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran’s rule. It was here long before the normaliser.
lines.sk: Babkino pravidlo. Bolo tu dávno pred normalizátorom.
lines.heard: Gran's rule. It was here long before the normalizer

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: ‘Different data are not invalid data.’ My normaliser would have thrown that sentence out first.
lines.sk: „Rôzne údaje neznamenajú neplatné údaje.“ Môj normalizátor by túto vetu vyradil ako prvú.
lines.heard: Different data are not invalid data. My normalizer would have thrown that sentence out first

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: VOICE: confirmed.
lines.sk: HLAS: potvrdený.
lines.heard: Voice confirmed.

lines.speaker: ADAM10
lines.text: And can I say something normal too?
lines.sk: A môžem povedať aj niečo normálne?
lines.heard: And can I say something normal too?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Today you can. And it’ll stay whole.
lines.sk: Dnes áno. A zostane to celé.
lines.heard: Today you can and it'll stay whole

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: My mother recorded this cassette. I know that hiss in the background.
lines.sk: Túto kazetu nahrávala moja mama. Poznám ten šum v pozadí.
lines.heard: My mother recorded this cassette. I know that hiss in the background

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Her voice is on it too. All of it.
lines.sk: Je na nej aj jej hlas. Celý.
lines.heard: Her voice is on it too. All of it

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: CONSENT: confirmed.
lines.sk: SÚHLAS: potvrdený.
lines.heard: Consent confirmed.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Preserve, not erase. Signed by people who were really there.
lines.sk: Uchovať, nie vymazať. Podpísali to ľudia, ktorí pri tom naozaj boli.
lines.heard: Preserve, not erase. Signed by people who were really there

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Consent. I never asked anyone for that.
lines.sk: Súhlas. Na ten som sa ja nikoho nepýtal.
lines.heard: Consent? I never asked anyone for that

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: RETURN: ready.
lines.sk: NÁVRAT: pripravený.
lines.heard: Return ready

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The procedure is signed and the write is stopped at the switch.
lines.sk: Postup je podpísaný a zápis zastavený prepínačom.
lines.heard: The procedure is signed and the write is stopped at the switch

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Nina’s signature. I should have listened to her back then.
lines.sk: Ninin podpis. Mal som ju počúvať už vtedy.
lines.heard: Nina's signature. I should have listened to her back then

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I thought order meant one correct version.
lines.sk: Myslel som si, že poriadok znamená jednu správnu verziu.
lines.heard: I thought order meant one correct version

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: People have their own versions. Let’s leave them those.
lines.sk: Ľudia majú svoje verzie. Nechajme im ich.
lines.heard: People have their own versions let's leave them those

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Even the ones that contradict each other?
lines.sk: Aj tie, ktoré si odporujú?
lines.heard: Even the ones that contradict each other

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Those most of all. Gran would say: ‘What doesn’t match, we put side by side.’
lines.sk: Tie najmä. Babka by povedala: „Čo sa nezhoduje, necháme vedľa seba.“
lines.heard: Those most of all. Graham would say, "What doesn't match, we put side by side."

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Restore ready. Confirm the final step.
lines.sk: Obnova pripravená. Potvrďte posledný krok.
lines.heard: Restore ready. Confirm the final step.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My name is Adam Perry. I was there. And I’m here too.
lines.sk: Volám sa Adam Hruška. Bol som tam. A som aj tu.
lines.heard: My name is Adam Perry. I was there and I'm here too

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Victor Korman. I started the test.
lines.sk: Viktor Korman. Skúšku som spustil ja.
lines.heard: Victor Corman. I started the test

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I confirm my consent to the restore.
lines.sk: Potvrdzujem súhlas s obnovou.
lines.heard: I confirm my consent to the restore

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Original records restored. Write-back switched off.
lines.sk: Pôvodné záznamy obnovené. Spätný zápis vypnutý.
lines.heard: Original records restored. Writeback switched off

lines.speaker: SYSTEM
lines.text: Buffer data returned. Write-back permanently switched off.
lines.sk: Údaje zo zásobníka vrátené. Spätný zápis trvalo vypnutý.
lines.heard: Buffer data returned. Write back permanently switched off.

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: The names are back. Even the ones that contradict each other.
lines.sk: Mená sú späť. Aj tie, ktoré si navzájom odporujú.
lines.heard: The names are back, even the ones that contradict each other

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: At last I see people in it, not a spreadsheet.
lines.sk: Konečne v tom vidím ľudí, nie tabuľku.
lines.heard: At last. I see people in it, not a spreadsheet

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I’ll publish the whole procedure, including the fact that I carried on despite the warning. The originals will be kept separate from the edits.
lines.sk: Zverejním celý postup aj to, že som pokračoval napriek varovaniu. Originály budú oddelené od úprav.
lines.heard: I'll publish the whole procedure, including the fact that I carried on despite the warning. The originals will be kept separate from the edits.

lines.speaker: NINA_REMOTE
lines.text: And the next change will be approved by the people it affects as well.
lines.sk: A ďalšiu zmenu schvália aj tí, ktorých sa týka.
lines.heard: And the next change will be approved by the people it affects as well.

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: Adam? I can hear you without the echo now.
lines.sk: Adam? Už ťa počujem bez ozveny.
lines.heard: Adam? I can hear you without the echo now

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Yes. And I’m ringing from the right year.
lines.sk: Áno. A volám aj zo správneho roku.
lines.heard: Yes, and I'm ringing from the right year

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: You left my shopping exactly where it was supposed to be.
lines.sk: Nákup si mi nechal presne tam, kde mal byť.
lines.heard: You left my shopping exactly where it was supposed to be

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I saved a bit more than that.
lines.sk: Zachránil som aj trochu viac.
lines.heard: Oh, I've saved a bit more than that

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I noticed.
lines.sk: Všimla som si.
lines.heard: I noticed

lines.speaker: MIRA20
lines.text: I’ll make you a cup of tea when you can come round properly.
lines.sk: Čaj ti spravím, keď bude možné prísť normálne.
lines.heard: I'll make you a cup of tea when you can come round properly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This time I’ll wait.
lines.sk: Tentoraz počkám.
lines.heard: This time I'll wait

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Not everything needs repairing. Some things are worth keeping.
lines.sk: Nie všetko treba opraviť. Niečo si treba nechať.
lines.heard: Not everything needs repairing. Some things are worth keeping

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: When someone is gone, fragments remain. I wanted them to fit together.
lines.sk: Keď človek odíde, zostanú útržky. Chcel som, aby sa dali spojiť.
lines.heard: When someone is gone, fragments remain. I wanted them to fit together.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: They fit together without you cutting off their edges.
lines.sk: Spojiť sa dajú aj bez toho, aby ste im odstrihli okraje.
lines.heard: They fit together without you cutting off their edges

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: You say that now. When you’re left with a single recording, you start noticing every bit of hiss.
lines.sk: To hovoríte teraz. Keď vám zostane jediná nahrávka, začnete si všímať každý šum.
lines.heard: You say that now. When you're left with a single recording, you start noticing every bit of hiss

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ve worked with hiss all my life. Usually the best part of the recording is hiding under it.
lines.sk: So šumom robím celý život. Väčšinou sa pod ním skrýva to najlepšie z nahrávky.
lines.heard: I've worked with hiss all my life. Usually the best part of the recording's hiding under it

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Records will show their origin and their versions, and people will be able to disagree. And I’ll make public what I started.
lines.sk: Záznamy budú mať uvedený pôvod aj verzie a ľudia budú môcť nesúhlasiť. A ja zverejním, čo som spustil.
lines.heard: Records will show their origin and their versions, and people will be able to disagree. And I'll make public what I started

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: That’s what Nina wanted from the beginning. I called it a mess.
lines.sk: Nina to chcela od začiatku. Ja som tomu hovoril neporiadok.
lines.heard: That's what Nina wanted from the beginning. I called it a mess

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran would call it a proper archive.
lines.sk: Babka by tomu povedala poriadny archív.
lines.heard: Graham would call it a proper archive

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: She’d be right.
lines.sk: Mala by pravdu.
lines.heard: She'd be right

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good. Let’s start with those four ports.
lines.sk: Dobre. Začnime tými štyrmi portmi.
lines.heard: Good. Let's start with those four ports

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I’ve kept that recording whole. Even the moment when she says nothing.
lines.sk: Ten záznam som si nechal celý. Aj chvíľu, keď nepovie nič.
lines.heard: I've kept that recording whole, even the moment when she says nothing

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Four seconds. The longest four seconds I know.
lines.sk: Štyri sekundy. Najdlhšie štyri sekundy, aké poznám.
lines.heard: Four seconds The longest four seconds I know

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That silence is yours.
lines.sk: To ticho je vaše.
lines.heard: That silence is yours.

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I know. Thank you for not trying to repair it.
lines.sk: Viem. Ďakujem, že ste sa ho nepokúsili opraviť.
lines.heard: I know. Thank you for not trying to repair it

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Because most of a life is made of them. And they’re the first thing to be lost.
lines.sk: Lebo z nich sa skladá väčšina života. A strácajú sa ako prvé.
lines.heard: Because most of a life is made of them, and they're the first thing to be lost.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And that’s why you clean them up?
lines.sk: A preto ich čistíte?
lines.heard: And that's why you clean them up?

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I tidy them. Whatever remains should still be readable in a hundred years.
lines.sk: Upratujem. Čo zostane, má byť čitateľné aj o sto rokov.
lines.heard: I tidy them. Whatever remains should still be readable in a hundred years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even if only a fragment remains?
lines.sk: Aj keď z toho zostane len kúsok?
lines.heard: even if only a fragment remains

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Better a readable fragment than a whole that nobody understands.
lines.sk: Radšej čitateľný kúsok ako celok, ktorému nikto nerozumie.
lines.heard: Better a readable fragment than a whole that nobody understands.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why didn’t you listen to Nina back then?
lines.sk: Prečo ste vtedy Ninu nepočúvali?
lines.heard: Why didn't you listen to Nina back then?

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I did listen. I just thought she was afraid of something I already knew.
lines.sk: Počúval. Len som si myslel, že sa bojí niečoho, čo ja už poznám.
lines.heard: I did listen. I just thought she was afraid of something I already knew

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And did you know it?
lines.sk: A poznali ste to?
lines.heard: And did you know it?

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: I only knew my mother’s voice in the edited version. I thought it was enough for me.
lines.sk: Poznal som len mamin hlas v upravenej verzii. Myslel som si, že mi stačí.
lines.heard: I only knew my mother's voice in the edited version. I thought it was enough for me.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And now?
lines.sk: A teraz?
lines.heard: And now

lines.speaker: VIKTOR
lines.text: Now I know how much of it was missing.
lines.sk: Teraz viem, koľko z neho chýbalo.
lines.heard: Now I know how much of it was missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Dubravka, 1982. I won’t be born for another three years, and here I am already.
lines.sk: Dúbravka, rok 1982. Narodím sa až o tri roky a už som tu.
lines.heard: Dubravka, 1982. I won't be born for another three years, and here I am already.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: My school, still almost new. It looks stricter than I remember it.
lines.sk: Moja škola, ešte skoro nová. Vyzerá prísnejšie, než si ju pamätám.
lines.heard: My school, still almost new. It looks stricter than I remember it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The same yard, only the lime is still a twig. On my photo from 2020 it isn’t here at all.
lines.sk: Ten istý dvor, len lipa je ešte prútik. Na mojej fotke z roku 2020 tu nie je vôbec.
lines.heard: The same yard, only the lime is still a twig. On my photo from 2020, it isn't here at all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m putting the jar behind the service board. Second row from the top, third stone from the left.
lines.sk: Pohár ukladám za servisnú dosku. Druhý rad zhora, tretí kameň zľava.
lines.heard: I'm putting the jar behind the service board. Second row from the top, third stone from the left

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Here’s my map. I drew a swallow on it too.
lines.sk: Tu je moja mapa. Nakreslil som tam aj lastovičku.
lines.heard: Here's my map. I drew a swallow on it too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A nice map. Even a stranger could find it with that.
lines.sk: Pekná mapa. Podľa tej by to našiel aj cudzí.
lines.heard: A nice map. Even a stranger could find it with that

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: A stranger isn’t supposed to find it. That’s why there’s a swallow on it and not an arrow.
lines.sk: Cudzí to nájsť nemá. Preto je tam lastovička a nie šípka.
lines.heard: A stranger isn't supposed to find it. That's why there's a swallow on it and not an arrow

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I’ll record it as a harmless technical reserve. Just don’t take it out every time you visit.
lines.sk: Zapíšem to ako neškodnú technickú rezervu. Len to nevyberajte pri každej návšteve.
lines.heard: I'll record it as a harmless technical reserve. Just don't take it out every time you visit

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: I’ll remember the place. I promise.
lines.sk: Ja si to miesto zapamätám. Sľubujem.
lines.heard: I'll remember the place, I promise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And I’ll try to come in the right year.
lines.sk: A ja sa pokúsim prísť v správnom roku.
lines.heard: And I'll try to come in the right year

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Which one?
lines.sk: V ktorom?
lines.heard: Which one?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The one when we both need it.
lines.sk: V tom, keď to budeme obaja potrebovať.
lines.heard: The one when we both need it

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: And now the board back on and hands in your pockets. It’s December.
lines.sk: A teraz dosku späť a ruky do vreciek. Je december.
lines.heard: And now the board back on and hands in your pockets. It's December

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The guard is up round the little tree. From now on the cart will take the detour Simon draws.
lines.sk: Ohrádka stojí okolo stromčeka. Vozík odteraz pôjde obchádzkou, ktorú zakreslí Šimon.
lines.heard: The guard is up around the little tree. From now on, the cart will take the detour Simon draws

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A small thing. That’s exactly why I’m curious what it’ll become in a few decades.
lines.sk: Malá vec. Práve preto som zvedavý, čo z nej bude o pár desaťročí.
lines.heard: A small thing. That's exactly why I'm curious what it'll become in a few decades

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That boy is Tony. A moment ago, as the caretaker, he was signing me into the visitors’ book, and now he’s carrying a school bag.
lines.sk: Ten chlapec je Tóno. Pred chvíľou ma ako školník zapisoval do knihy návštev a teraz nosí školskú tašku.
lines.heard: That boy is Tony. A moment ago, as the caretaker, he was signing me into the visitors book, and now he's carrying a school bag

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. Hi. May I show you both something?
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Ahoj. Môžem vám obom niečo ukázať?
lines.heard: Good afternoon. Hi. May I show you both something?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: If it isn’t another notice about a work brigade, yes.
lines.sk: Ak to nie je ďalší oznam o brigáde, tak áno.
lines.heard: If it isn't another notice about a work brigade, yes

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: My grandad made that with Mrs Perry. But this one looks much older.
lines.sk: To vyrobil môj dedo s pani Hruškovou. Ale tento vyzerá oveľa starší.
lines.heard: My granddad made that with Mrs. Perry. But this one looks much older

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’re Tony?
lines.sk: Ty si Tóno?
lines.heard: You're Tony?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Yes. Do you know me, mister?
lines.sk: Áno. Vy ma poznáte?
lines.heard: Yes. Do you know me, mister?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A bit. So far, mostly the grown-up one.
lines.sk: Trochu. Zatiaľ skôr toho dospelého.
lines.heard: A bit. So far, mostly the grown-up one

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: What grown-up one? I haven’t been grown up yet.
lines.sk: Akého dospelého? Ja som ešte dospelý nebol.
lines.heard: What grown-up one? I haven't been grown up yet

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I remember this gentleman from Ivanka. Since then I’ve got older, and he hasn’t.
lines.sk: Tohto pána si pamätám z Ivanky. Odvtedy som zostarol ja, on nie.
lines.heard: I remember this gentleman from Ivanka. Since then, I've got older and he hasn't

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: Tony, fetch the gentleman a chair. This is going to be a longer conversation.
lines.sk: Tóno, prines pánovi stoličku. Toto bude dlhší rozhovor.
lines.heard: Tony, fetch the gentleman a chair. This is gonna be a, uh, longer conversation

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: We’ve only got one. And I’m sitting on it.
lines.sk: Máme len jednu. A na tej sedím ja.
lines.heard: We've only got one, and I'm sitting on it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m Adam, Mrs Perry’s grandson. I’ll be born in three years. I’ve come from 2020.
lines.sk: Som Adam, vnuk pani Hruškovej. Narodím sa o tri roky. Prichádzam z roku 2020.
lines.heard: I'm Adam, Mrs. Perry's grandson. I'll be born in three years. I've come from 2020

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: From 2020? That’s even further than the year 2000. And that’s really far away.
lines.sk: Z roku 2020? To je ešte ďalej ako rok 2000. A ten je strašne ďaleko.
lines.heard: From 2020? That's even further than the year 2000, and that's really far away

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: So I’m actually older than you.
lines.sk: Tak to som od teba vlastne starší.
lines.heard: So I'm actually older than you?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: If we count the normal way, yes.
lines.sk: Ak to rátame normálne, tak áno.
lines.heard: If we count the normal way, yes

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: And is the school still standing?
lines.sk: A škola ešte stojí?
lines.heard: And is the school still standing?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Look – the same window. Your swallow’s there too, only it’s metal now.
lines.sk: Pozri, to isté okno. Aj tvoja lastovička tam je, len už kovová.
lines.heard: Look the same window your swallow's there too only it's metal now

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: I haven’t made a metal one yet. So I’ll make one some day, then.
lines.sk: Kovovú som ešte nerobil. Tak ju teda raz urobím.
lines.heard: I haven't made a metal one yet, so I'll make one someday then

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: And will it have the right centre of gravity?
lines.sk: A bude mať správne ťažisko?
lines.heard: And will it have the right center of gravity?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It will. It hangs perfectly straight.
lines.sk: Bude. Visí úplne rovno.
lines.heard: It will. It hangs perfectly straight

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: The photo checks out and I know the device. What do you need to preserve?
lines.sk: Fotografia sedí a prístroj poznám. Čo potrebujete zachovať?
lines.heard: The photo checks out, and I know the device. What do you need to preserve?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One return bridge. If you store it the normal way, it’ll be lost by 2020.
lines.sk: Jeden návratový mostík. Ten, čo uložíte normálne, sa do roku 2020 stratí.
lines.heard: One return bridge. If you store it the normal way, it'll be lost by 2020

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: Lost? Things don’t get lost with me.
lines.sk: Stratí sa? U mňa sa veci nestrácajú.
lines.heard: Lost? Things don't get lost with me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Not with you. But the school will move things and be rebuilt many times yet.
lines.sk: U vás nie. Ale škola sa bude ešte veľakrát sťahovať a prerábať.
lines.heard: Not with you, but the school will move things and be rebuilt many times yet

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I’ll take care of the materials and making it. Here’s a signed slip for the store. We can hide a spare in the service cavity in the low wall.
lines.sk: Materiál a výrobu beriem na seba. Tu je podpísaný lístok do výdajne. Rezervný kus môžeme schovať do servisnej dutiny v múriku.
lines.heard: I'll take care of the materials and making it. Here's a signed slip for the store. We can hide a spare in the service cavity in the low wall

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: Take the slip to the store, to Mrs Martha Dobson. She’ll issue everything that’s written on it, and not a screw more.
lines.sk: Lístok odneste do výdajne pani Marte Dobiášovej. Vydá všetko, čo je na ňom napísané, ani o skrutku viac.
lines.heard: Take the slip to the store to Mrs. Martha Dobson. She'll issue everything that's written on it and not a screw more

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: I’ll draw a map. And when we meet again some day, say: ‘The swallow comes back.’
lines.sk: Ja nakreslím mapu. A keď sa raz zase stretneme, povedz: „Lastovička sa vracia.“
lines.heard: I'll draw a map, and when we meet again someday, say, the swallow comes back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Deal. But you don’t have to stop living a normal life because of it.
lines.sk: Platí. Ale kvôli tomu nemusíš prestať normálne žiť.
lines.heard: Deal. But you don't have to stop living a normal life because of it

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Don’t worry. We’ve got a test tomorrow anyway.
lines.sk: Neboj sa. Zajtra aj tak píšeme písomku.
lines.heard: Don't worry, we've got a test tomorrow anyway

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Suspicious of what?
lines.sk: Z čoho?
lines.heard: Suspicious of what?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: A history test. From now on I’ll take it more seriously.
lines.sk: Z dejepisu. Odteraz ho budem brať vážnejšie.
lines.heard: A history test. From now on, I'll take it more seriously

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: A swallow. Grandad says even a model has to have the right centre of gravity.
lines.sk: Lastovičku. Dedo hovorí, že aj model musí mať správne ťažisko.
lines.heard: A swallow. Grandad says even a model has to have the right center of gravity

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So does a person. It’s just harder to measure.
lines.sk: Aj človek. Len sa to horšie meria.
lines.heard: So does a person. It's just harder to measure

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Then we’ll make him a stand.
lines.sk: Tak mu spravíme stojan.
lines.heard: Then we'll make him a stand

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And where will the swallow live?
lines.sk: A kde bude lastovička bývať?
lines.heard: And where will the swallow live?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: On the window next to Grandad. You can see the whole yard from there.
lines.sk: Na okne pri dedovi. Odtiaľ je vidieť celý dvor.
lines.heard: On the window next to Granddad You can see the whole yard from there

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: In the prep room, yes. There every thing does what it’s for.
lines.sk: V kabinete áno. Tam každá vec robí to, na čo je.
lines.heard: In the prep room, yes. There everything does what it's for

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And elsewhere?
lines.sk: A inde?
lines.heard: And elsewhere?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Elsewhere you have to say everything with the right words first.
lines.sk: Inde treba najprv všetko povedať správnymi slovami.
lines.heard: Elsewhere, you have to say everything with the right words first

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: In lessons you mustn’t say ‘that thing’. You have to say ‘component’ or ‘teaching aid’.
lines.sk: Na hodine sa nesmie povedať „tá vec“. Musí sa povedať „súčiastka“ alebo „pomôcka“.
lines.heard: In lessons you mustn't say that thing. You have to say component or teaching aid

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what’s that you’re holding called?
lines.sk: A ako sa volá to, čo máš v ruke?
lines.heard: And what's that you're holding called?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: At home, a wing. At school, technical model, part one.
lines.sk: Doma krídlo. V škole technický model, časť prvá.
lines.heard: At home, a wing at school technical model part one

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did St Nicholas come to your house yesterday?
lines.sk: Bol včera u vás Mikuláš?
lines.heard: Did St. Nicholas come to your house yesterday?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: He did. He brought me chocolate and coal. Grandad says the coal is for the alarm clock I took apart.
lines.sk: Bol. Doniesol mi čokoládu a uhlie. Dedo vraví, že uhlie je za ten rozobratý budík.
lines.heard: He did. He brought me chocolate and coal. Granddad says the coal is for the alarm clock I took apart

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You took an alarm clock apart?
lines.sk: Ty si rozobral budík?
lines.heard: You took an alarm clock apart?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: I did. And put it back together. I just had one part left over.
lines.sk: Rozobral. Aj zložil. Len mi zostala jedna súčiastka navyše.
lines.heard: I did and put it back together. I just had one part left over

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That happens to the best of us.
lines.sk: To sa stáva aj najlepším.
lines.heard: That happens to the best of us

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Grandad says not to the best. But it probably happens to you too, doesn’t it?
lines.sk: Dedo hovorí, že najlepším nie. Ale tebe sa to asi tiež stáva, nie?
lines.heard: Granddad says not to the best, but it probably happens to you too, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do you want to be when you grow up?
lines.sk: Čím chceš byť, keď vyrastieš?
lines.heard: What do you want to be when you grow up?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: An aircraft designer. Or a pilot. Anything but a caretaker.
lines.sk: Konštruktérom lietadiel. Alebo pilotom. Hlavne nie školníkom.
lines.heard: An aircraft designer or a pilot anything but a caretaker

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why not a caretaker?
lines.sk: Prečo nie školníkom?
lines.heard: Why not a caretaker?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: A caretaker has to carry a hundred keys and know which one’s for what. That would bore me.
lines.sk: Školník musí mať pri sebe sto kľúčov a vedieť, ktorý je od čoho. To by ma nebavilo.
lines.heard: A caretaker has to carry a hundred keys and know which one's for what. That would bore me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hm. Keys can be quite interesting.
lines.sk: Hm. Kľúče vedia byť celkom zaujímavé.
lines.heard: Hmm. Keys can be quite interesting

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: You sound like Grandad. He says every door has its own trick too.
lines.sk: Hovoríš ako dedo. Aj on tvrdí, že každé dvere majú svoj trik.
lines.heard: You sound like Granddad. He says every door has its own trick too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why do you draw swallows everywhere?
lines.sk: Prečo kreslíš všade lastovičky?
lines.heard: Why do you draw swallows everywhere?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: Because they come back. Every spring to the same place, even though they fly across the whole sea.
lines.sk: Lebo sa vracajú. Každú jar na to isté miesto, aj keď letia cez celé more.
lines.heard: Because they come back every spring to the same place, even though they fly across the whole sea

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And would you come back?
lines.sk: A ty by si sa vracal?
lines.heard: And would you come back?

lines.speaker: TONO82
lines.text: I haven’t been anywhere yet. But if I had, I definitely would.
lines.sk: Ja som ešte nikde nebol. Ale keby som bol, tak určite.
lines.heard: I haven't been anywhere yet but if I had, I definitely would

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: In Ivanka you asked about the future. Now I’m watching it in my own grandson.
lines.sk: V Ivanke ste sa pýtali na budúcnosť. Teraz ju vidím na vlastnom vnukovi.
lines.heard: In Ivanka, you asked about the future. Now I'm watching it in my own grandson

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And I haven’t aged a day since.
lines.sk: A ja som odvtedy nezostarol ani o deň.
lines.heard: And I haven't aged a day since

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I noticed. You’ve even got the same jacket.
lines.sk: Všimol som si. Aj bundu máte tú istú.
lines.heard: I noticed. You've even got the same jacket

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I’ve been through three since then. And you haven’t lost a single button.
lines.sk: Ja som odvtedy vystriedal tri. A vy ste nestratili ani gombík.
lines.heard: I've been through three since then and you haven't lost a single button

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Those buttons bring me luck.
lines.sk: Tie gombíky mi nosia šťastie.
lines.heard: Those buttons bring me luck

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: Then don’t lend them to anyone. Not even me.
lines.sk: Tak ich nikomu nepožičiavajte. Ani mne.
lines.heard: Then don't lend them to anyone Not even me

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: He helps. Let him try things out and then explain them. But I approve the making of things and I sign the papers.
lines.sk: Pomáha. Nech si veci vyskúša a potom ich vysvetlí. Výrobu však schvaľujem a papiere podpisujem ja.
lines.heard: He helps. Let him try things out and then explain them. But I approve the making of things, and I sign the papers

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And does Tony agree with that?
lines.sk: A Tóno s tým súhlasí?
lines.heard: And does Tony agree with that?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: He agrees until he needs a signature for something of his own. Then he haggles like a market trader.
lines.sk: Súhlasí, kým nepotrebuje podpis na niečo svoje. Potom vyjednáva ako na trhu.
lines.heard: He agrees until he needs a signature for something of his own, then he haggles like a market trader

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And who’s winning?
lines.sk: A kto vyhráva?
lines.heard: And who's winning?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: According to him, he does. But I do the signing, so he only thinks he’s won.
lines.sk: Podľa neho on. Ale podpisujem ja, takže si len myslí, že vyhral.
lines.heard: According to him, he does. But I do the signing, so he only thinks he's won

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You run a technical club here?
lines.sk: Vy tu vediete technický krúžok?
lines.heard: You run a technical club here?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: I help. The children have the ideas and I have the pliers. Together that makes a club.
lines.sk: Pomáham. Deti majú nápady a ja mám kliešte. Spolu je z toho krúžok.
lines.heard: I help. The children have the ideas and I have the pliers. Together, that makes a club

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And what are you making at the moment?
lines.sk: A čo teraz robíte?
lines.heard: And what are you making at the moment?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: A radio, a lamp and one aeroplane that won’t take off. That’s Tony’s.
lines.sk: Rádio, lampu a jedno lietadlo, čo nevzlietne. To je Tónovo.
lines.heard: A radio, a lamp and one aeroplane that won't take off That's Tony's

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It won’t take off yet.
lines.sk: Zatiaľ nevzlietne.
lines.heard: It won't take off yet

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: That’s what he says too. He gets it from me.
lines.sk: To isté hovorí aj on. Má to po mne.
lines.heard: That's what he says too. He gets it from me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you still remember Ivanka?
lines.sk: Spomínate si ešte na Ivanku?
lines.heard: Do you still remember Ivanka?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: The workshop, Mira, and you. You most of all, because you vanished without saying goodbye.
lines.sk: Na dielňu, na Miru a na vás. Na vás najviac, lebo ste zmizli bez rozlúčky.
lines.heard: The workshop, Mira, and you. You most of all, because you vanished without saying goodbye

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’m sorry. I was in a hurry.
lines.sk: Prepáčte. Ponáhľal som sa.
lines.heard: I'm sorry. I was in a hurry

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: You’ve been in a hurry for twenty years. This time at least say goodbye.
lines.sk: Ponáhľali ste sa dvadsať rokov. Tentoraz sa so mnou aspoň rozlúčte.
lines.heard: You've been in a hurry for 20 years. This time, at least say goodbye

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What’s life like for you here on the estate?
lines.sk: Ako sa vám tu na sídlisku žije?
lines.heard: What's life like for you here on the estate?

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: They’re building everywhere. In the morning it’s mud, in the evening there’s a new block.
lines.sk: Všade sa stavia. Ráno je tu blato, večer nový dom.
lines.heard: They're building everywhere. In the morning, it's mud. In the evening, there's a new block

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: The blocks are all the same, only the numbers differ. The first week I kept ringing the neighbour’s bell.
lines.sk: Domy sú rovnaké, len čísla iné. Prvý týždeň som zvonil u suseda.
lines.heard: The blocks are all the same, only the numbers differ. The first week, I kept ringing the neighbor's bell

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’ll get used to it. In a few years it’ll be all green round here.
lines.sk: Zvyknete si. O pár rokov tu bude samá zeleň.
lines.heard: You'll get used to it. In a few years, it'll be all green round here

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: You say that as if you knew.
lines.sk: Hovoríte to, akoby ste to vedeli.
lines.heard: You say that as if you knew

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I have an inkling. And you do know where I come from.
lines.sk: Tuším. A vy predsa viete, odkiaľ chodím.
lines.heard: I have an inkling and you do know where I come from

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A small shop on the estate. The shop assistant knows every customer by name.
lines.sk: Malý obchod na sídlisku. Predavačka pozná každého zákazníka po mene.
lines.heard: A small shop on the estate. The shop assistant knows every customer by name

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň.
lines.heard: Good afternoon

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Good afternoon. I don’t know you, and I know everyone. What’ll it be?
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Vás tu nepoznám, a to poznám každého. Čo to bude?
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I don't know you, and I know everyone. What'll it be?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Would you have a jar with a seal? Mr Whitlock needs to store a component for the school somewhere dry.
lines.sk: Nemali by ste pohár s tesnením? Pán Bielik potrebuje pre školu uložiť jednu súčiastku v suchu.
lines.heard: Would you have a jar with a seal? Mr. Whitlock needs to store a component for the school somewhere dry.

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Here’s a clean jar with a lid, and some dry wrapping paper. It isn’t new, but it’ll do the job.
lines.sk: Tu máte čistý pohár s viečkom a suchý baliaci papier. Nie je nový, ale dobre poslúži.
lines.heard: Here's a clean jar with a lid and some dry wrapping paper. It isn't new, but it'll do the job

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: The jar is returnable. Bring it back and you get your deposit.
lines.sk: Pohár je vratný. Keď ho donesiete späť, dostanete zálohu.
lines.heard: The jar is returnable. Bring it back and you get your deposit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’d better keep the deposit.
lines.sk: Zálohu si radšej nechajte.
lines.heard: You'd better keep the deposit

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This one will last longer than you’d believe.
lines.sk: Tento vydrží dlhšie, než by ste verili.
lines.heard: This one will last longer than you believe

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: I believe you. At home we’ve got a gherkin jar that’s older than I am.
lines.sk: Verím. U nás doma je pohár od uhoriek starší ako ja.
lines.heard: I believe you. At home, we've got a gherkin jar that's older than I am

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Dry packing, the bridge with the swallow label, the seal and the lid. I’ll tighten it twice.
lines.sk: Suchá výplň, mostík so štítkom s lastovičkou, tesnenie a viečko. Dotiahnem ho dvakrát.
lines.heard: Dry packing, the bridge with the swallow label, the seal and the lid. I'll tighten it twice

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Now it needs hiding. Tony will remember the spot longer than I will.
lines.sk: Teraz to treba schovať. Tóno si to miesto bude pamätať dlhšie ako ja.
lines.heard: Now it needs hiding. Tony will remember the spot longer than I will

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: What you can see. What you can’t see, ask about.
lines.sk: To, čo vidíte. Čo nevidíte, na to sa spýtajte.
lines.heard: What you can see, what you can't see, ask about

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if I ask about something you haven’t got?
lines.sk: A keď sa spýtam na niečo, čo nemáte?
lines.heard: And if I ask about something you haven't got?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Then I’ll tell you when it’ll come in. And if I don’t know, I’ll tell you who does.
lines.sk: Tak vám poviem, kedy to bude. A keď to neviem, poviem vám, kto to vie.
lines.heard: Then I'll tell you when it'll come in, and if I don't know, I'll tell you who does

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who?
lines.sk: Kto?
lines.heard: Who?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: The driver who brings the deliveries. He knows everything a day before I do.
lines.sk: Šofér, čo vozí tovar. Ten vie všetko o deň skôr ako ja.
lines.heard: The driver who brings the deliveries , he knows everything a day before I do

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: A good jar lasts for years. As long as you don’t lose it.
lines.sk: Dobrý pohár slúži roky. Ak ho človek nestratí.
lines.heard: A good jar lasts for years, as long as you don't lose it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then it needs hiding well.
lines.sk: Tak ho treba dobre schovať.
lines.heard: Then it needs hiding well

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Hiding, but also writing down where. Most jars get lost in the cellar.
lines.sk: Schovať, ale aj zapísať kam. Najviac pohárov sa stratí v pivnici.
lines.heard: Hiding, but also writing down where. Most jars get lost in the cellar

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In the cellar?
lines.sk: V pivnici?
lines.heard: In the cellar

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: People put them away down there so well that only their grandchildren find them.
lines.sk: Človek ich tam odloží tak dobre, že ich nájdu až vnúčatá.
lines.heard: People put them away down there so well that only their grandchildren find them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Do you know everyone here?
lines.sk: Poznáte tu každého?
lines.heard: Do you know everyone here?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Everyone who buys bread rolls. The rest I know by their bags.
lines.sk: Každého, kto si kupuje rožky. Ostatných podľa tašky.
lines.heard: Everyone who buys bread rolls. The rest I know by their bags

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: By their bags?
lines.sk: Podľa tašky?
lines.heard: Buy their bags

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: A string bag means this block, a plastic bag the one next door. And anyone with a basket is from old Dubravka.
lines.sk: Sieťovka je z tohto domu, igelitka z vedľajšieho. A kto chodí s košíkom, je zo starej Dúbravky.
lines.heard: A string bag means this block, a plastic bag, the one next door, and anyone with a basket is from Old Dubrovka

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how do you know me?
lines.sk: A mňa podľa čoho?
lines.heard: And how do you know me?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: By your empty hands. I remember those best – they always ask about something.
lines.sk: Podľa prázdnych rúk. Takých si pamätám najlepšie, tí sa vždy na niečo pýtajú.
lines.heard: By your empty hands. I remember those best. They always ask about something

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many bottles do people bring back to you a day?
lines.sk: Koľko fliaš vám ľudia denne vrátia?
lines.heard: How many bottles do people bring back to you a day?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: It varies. Most on Mondays. In the morning there’s a queue of people with bottles right out to the door.
lines.sk: Ako kedy. Najviac v pondelok. Ráno je tu rad ľudí s fľašami až po dvere.
lines.heard: It varies. Most on Mondays. In the morning, there's a queue of people with bottles right out to the door

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And which ones come back most often?
lines.sk: A ktoré sa vracajú najčastejšie?
lines.heard: And which ones come back most often?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: Milk bottles. People drink milk all the time, even when there’s nothing to celebrate.
lines.sk: Od mlieka. Mlieko sa pije stále, aj keď sa nič neoslavuje.
lines.heard: Milk bottles. People drink milk all the time, even when there's nothing to celebrate

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It smells of oranges in here.
lines.sk: Tu to vonia pomarančmi.
lines.heard: It smells of oranges in here

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: They came in this morning. By ten the whole estate knew.
lines.sk: Ráno ich priviezli. Do desiatej to vedelo celé sídlisko.
lines.heard: They came in this morning. By ten, the whole estate knew

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How did they find out so quickly?
lines.sk: Ako to tak rýchlo zistili?
lines.heard: How did they find out so quickly?

lines.speaker: RUZENA
lines.text: The neighbour from the first entrance saw them from her balcony. She’s faster than the radio.
lines.sk: Susedka z prvého vchodu ich videla z balkóna. Tá je rýchlejšia ako rozhlas.
lines.heard: The neighbor from the first entrance saw them from her balcony. She's faster than the radio

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The part is small. The paperwork for issuing it has ambitions.
lines.sk: Súčiastka je malá. Papier na jej vydanie má ambície.
lines.heard: The part is small the paperwork for issuing it has ambitions

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. I have a requisition slip from Mr Whitlock.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Mám tu výdajný lístok od pána Bielika.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. I have a requisition slip from Mr. Whitlock

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Let me see. Mr Whitlock writes his slips so that even the night porter could read them without glasses.
lines.sk: Ukážte. Pán Bielik píše lístky tak, že by ich prečítal aj nočný vrátnik bez okuliarov.
lines.heard: Let me see. Mr. Whitlock writes his slips so that even the night porter could read them without glasses

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: A requisition slip from Mr Whitlock. A ceramic base and three copper links. It’s signed, so I’m issuing the materials.
lines.sk: Výdajný lístok od pána Bielika. Keramická pätica a tri prepojky. Podpis je, materiál vydávam.
lines.heard: A requisition slip from Mr. Whitlock a ceramic base and three copper links it's signed, so I'm issuing the materials

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. That was quick.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. To bolo rýchle.
lines.heard: Thank you. That was quick.

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: When a slip is in order, it’s quick. And this one is. Here you are.
lines.sk: Keď je lístok v poriadku, ide to rýchlo. A tento je, nech sa páči.
lines.heard: When a slip is in order, it's quick, and this one is. Here you are

lines.speaker: MARTA82
