lines.text: Give my regards to Tony. He left a model aeroplane here the other day – he should come for it before it flies off.
lines.sk: Pozdravujte Tóna. Minule tu nechal model lietadla, nech si poňho príde, kým mi neodletí.
lines.heard: Give my regards to Tony. He left a model aeroplane here the other day. He should come for it before it flies off

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll tell him. And if it does fly off?
lines.sk: Poviem mu. A keby predsa odletel?
lines.heard: I'll tell him. And if it does fly off?

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Then I’ll record it as a loss. The first aeroplane in my inventory book.
lines.sk: Tak ho zapíšem ako úbytok. Prvé lietadlo v mojej inventárnej knihe.
lines.heard: Then I'll record it as a loss. The first aeroplane in my inventory book

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Everything that came in and everything that went out. Then, when something needs finding, it’s easier to breathe.
lines.sk: Všetko, čo prišlo, aj čo odišlo. Keď sa potom niečo hľadá, ľahšie sa dýcha.
lines.heard: Everything that came in and everything that went out. Then when something needs finding, it's easier to breathe

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I should introduce that in my workshop too.
lines.sk: To by som zaviedol aj vo svojej dielni.
lines.heard: I should introduce that in my workshop too

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Do. But start with what you no longer have. That’s the longest list.
lines.sk: Zaveďte. Ale začnite tým, čo už nemáte. To je najdlhší zoznam.
lines.heard: Do but start with what you no longer have that's the longest list

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That would take me until Christmas.
lines.sk: Ten by som písal do Vianoc.
lines.heard: That would take me until Christmas

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: It took me two years here. Now the only thing missing is one key to the boiler room.
lines.sk: Ja som ho tu písala dva roky. Teraz chýba už len jeden kľúč od kotolne.
lines.heard: It took me two years here. Now the only thing missing is one key to the boiler room

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Then tell me exactly what you need. That’s quicker than explaining to me that you’re in a hurry.
lines.sk: Tak mi povedzte presne, čo potrebujete. To je rýchlejšie ako mi vysvetľovať, že sa ponáhľate.
lines.heard: Then tell me exactly what you need. That's quicker than explaining to me that you're in a hurry

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You’re right. I’ll stop explaining.
lines.sk: Máte pravdu. Už nevysvetľujem.
lines.heard: You're right. I'll stop explaining

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: See? We’ve already saved two minutes.
lines.sk: Vidíte. Hneď sme ušetrili dve minúty.
lines.heard: See? We've already saved two minutes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Lucky you don’t write the minutes down.
lines.sk: Ešteže si tie minúty nezapisujete.
lines.heard: Lucky you don't write the minutes down

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: I do. In the ‘saved’ column.
lines.sk: Zapisujem. Do kolónky „ušetrené“.
lines.heard: I do in the saved column

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Is Tony’s aeroplane still here?
lines.sk: Je tu ešte to Tónovo lietadlo?
lines.heard: Is Tony's aeroplane still here?

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: It is. I put it on the top shelf so nobody sits on it.
lines.sk: Je. Dala som ho na hornú policu, aby naň nikto nesadol.
lines.heard: It is. I put it on the top shelf so nobody sits on it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Did you record it in the inventory book?
lines.sk: Zapísali ste ho do inventárnej knihy?
lines.heard: Did you record it in the inventory book?

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: In pencil. It’s somebody else’s property and I’m only minding it. In pen it would become ours.
lines.sk: Ceruzkou. Je to cudzí majetok a ja ho len strážim. Perom by sa z neho stal náš.
lines.heard: In pencil, it's somebody else's property, and I'm only minding it. In pen, it would become ours

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Doesn’t all this paperwork bother you?
lines.sk: Nevadí vám toľko papierov?
lines.heard: Doesn't all this paperwork bother you?

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: Not when it makes sense. A requisition slip says who took what and why. That’s order, not torment.
lines.sk: Nevadí, keď majú zmysel. Výdajka povie, kto čo vzal a prečo. To je poriadok, nie trápenie.
lines.heard: Not when it makes sense. A requisition slip says who took what and why. That's order, not torment

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when is it torment?
lines.sk: A kedy je to trápenie?
lines.heard: And when is it torment?

lines.speaker: MARTA82
lines.text: When someone wants three signatures for one screw. A form like that I send straight back.
lines.sk: Keď niekto chce tri podpisy na jednu skrutku. Taký papier hneď vraciam.
lines.heard: When someone wants three signatures for one screw, a form like that I send straight back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The school corridor. Silence, terrazzo, and the feeling that someone is writing me up in the class register.
lines.sk: Školská chodba. Ticho, terazzo a pocit, že ma niekto zapisuje do triednej knihy.
lines.heard: The school corridor, silence, terrazzo, and the feeling that someone is writing me up in the class register

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The same cupboard as in 2020. It already looks as if it knows more than I do.
lines.sk: Tá istá skriňa ako v roku 2020. Už teraz vyzerá, že vie viac než ja.
lines.heard: The same cupboard as in 2020. Hmm. It already looks as if it knows more than I do

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Following Otto’s drawing: three contacts, each a different shape. The board has no power; I’ll connect it and measure.
lines.sk: Podľa Otovho nákresu: tri kontakty, každý iného tvaru. Doska je bez prúdu, zapojím a premeriam.
lines.heard: Following Otto's drawing, three contacts, each a different shape, the board has no power. I'll connect it and measure

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tony has drawn a swallow on the label. Nobody will ever mix it up with another bridge.
lines.sk: Tóno nakreslil na štítok lastovičku. S iným mostíkom si ho už nikto nepomýli.
lines.heard: Tony has drawn a swallow on the label. Nobody will ever mix it up with another bridge

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Future shade is stored here. For now, in the form of three planks.
lines.sk: Tu sa skladuje budúci tieň. Zatiaľ vo forme troch dosiek.
lines.heard: Future shade is stored here for now in the form of three planks

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Good afternoon. That young lime tree in the yard… the cart passes right next to it.
lines.sk: Dobrý deň. Tá mladá lipa na dvore… Vozík chodí tesne popri nej.
lines.heard: Good afternoon. That young lime tree in the yard, the cart passes right next to it

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: You’re right, the cart has already caught it once. Here’s a ready-made guard. Put it up and I’ll draw the cart a detour.
lines.sk: Máte pravdu, vozík o ňu už raz zavadil. Tu je hotová ohrádka. Postavte ju a ja zakreslím vozíku obchádzku.
lines.heard: You're right. The cart has already caught it once. Here's a ready-made guard. Put it up, and I'll draw the cart a detour

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One day there could be some nice shade here.
lines.sk: Raz by tu mohol byť pekný tieň.
lines.heard: One day there could be some nice shade here

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: That’s why we’re planting it. But a lime that gets run over by a cart won’t give any shade.
lines.sk: Preto ju sadíme. Lenže lipa, ktorú prejde vozík, tieň nedá.
lines.heard: That's why we're planting it. But a lime that gets run over by a cart won't give any shade.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How long will it need a guard?
lines.sk: Ako dlho bude potrebovať ohrádku?
lines.heard: How long will it need a guard?

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Until people learn to walk round it. On foot it takes them a few years; with a cart, longer.
lines.sk: Kým sa ju ľudia nenaučia obchádzať. Pešo im to trvá pár rokov, s vozíkom dlhšie.
lines.heard: Until people learn to walk round it. On foot, it takes them a few years. With a cart, longer

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: I’ve written it down: lime with guard, the cart goes clear of the roots. And there’ll always be access to the low wall for servicing.
lines.sk: Zapísal som to: lipa s ohrádkou, vozík pôjde mimo koreňov. A k múriku bude stále prístup kvôli servisu.
lines.heard: I've written it down. Lime with guard. The cart goes clear of the roots, and there'll always be access to the low wall for servicing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: So the next time they redo the yard, it won’t all disappear under tarmac.
lines.sk: Takže pri najbližšej úprave dvora to tu nezaleje asfalt.
lines.heard: So the next time they redo the yard, it won't all disappear under tarmac

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Once the lime grows up, people will look after this place even without my note.
lines.sk: Keď lipa vyrastie, ľudia si to tu ustrážia aj bez môjho zápisu.
lines.heard: Once the lime grows up, people will look after this place even without my note

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll come and have a look. For me, it’ll be tomorrow.
lines.sk: Prídem sa pozrieť. Pre mňa to bude zajtra.
lines.heard: I'll come and have a look. For me, it'll be tomorrow

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Tomorrow it’ll still be a twig. Better come and look in a few decades.
lines.sk: Zajtra tu bude ešte prútik. Príďte sa radšej pozrieť o pár desaťročí.
lines.heard: Tomorrow it'll still be a twig. Better come and look in a few decades

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s exactly my plan.
lines.sk: Presne tak to mám v pláne.
lines.heard: That's exactly my plan

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Goodbye, then. And pull the store door to behind you, so I don’t get a draught.
lines.sk: Tak dovidenia. A dvere od skladu za sebou privrite, nech mi sem nefúka.
lines.heard: Goodbye then. And pull the store door to behind you so I don't get a draft

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three planks and a cart that takes a slight detour. In a few decades this will be a place where people sit down.
lines.sk: Tri dosky a vozík, ktorý chodí trochu oklukou. O pár desaťročí tu bude miesto, kde si ľudia sadnú.
lines.heard: Three planks and a cart that takes a slight detour. In a few decades, this will be a place where people sit down

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: This is how you repair time. Bit by bit, not all at once.
lines.sk: Takto sa opravuje čas. Po kúsku, nie naraz.
lines.heard: This is how you repair time, bit by bit, not all at once

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And the low wall with our hiding place has stayed standing.
lines.sk: A múrik s našou skrýšou zostal stáť.
lines.heard: And the low wall with our hiding place has stayed standing

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Because one day someone will be glad to sit under it.
lines.sk: Lebo pod ňou raz bude niekto rád sedieť.
lines.heard: Because one day, someone will be glad to sit under it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Decades ahead. I plan about as far as Friday.
lines.sk: Na desaťročia dopredu. Ja plánujem tak do piatku.
lines.heard: Decades ahead? I plan about as far as Friday

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Soup you plan until Friday. A tree you plant for two generations.
lines.sk: Do piatku sa plánuje polievka. Strom sa sadí na dve generácie.
lines.heard: Soup you plan until Friday. A tree you plant for two generations

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And if it doesn’t work out?
lines.sk: A keď to nevyjde?
lines.heard: And if it doesn't work out

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Then at least we tried. The lime starts all over again every spring too.
lines.sk: Tak sme to aspoň skúsili. Lipa tiež každú jar začína odznova.
lines.heard: Then at least we tried. The lime starts all over again every spring too

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: People take the shortest route. A young tree can’t defend itself yet.
lines.sk: Ľudia chodia najkratšou cestou. Mladý strom sa zatiaľ nevie brániť.
lines.heard: People take the shortest route. A young tree can't defend itself yet.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Then we’ll give it a guard.
lines.sk: Tak mu spravíme ohrádku.
lines.heard: Then we'll give it a go

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: And the cart a detour. People will have to push it the long way round.
lines.sk: A vozíku obchádzku. Ľudia ho potom budú musieť tlačiť okolo.
lines.heard: And the cart? A detour. People will have to push it the long way round

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Will whoever pushes it like that?
lines.sk: Bude sa to páčiť tomu, kto ho tlačí?
lines.heard: Well, whoever pushes it like that

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: No. But in ten years he’ll sit down in the shade and forget.
lines.sk: Nebude. Ale o desať rokov si sadne do tieňa a zabudne.
lines.heard: No, but in 10 years he'll sit down in the shade and forget

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: How many trees will there be here once the estate is finished?
lines.sk: Koľko stromov tu bude, keď sídlisko dostavajú?
lines.heard: How many trees will there be here once the estate is finished?

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: As many as we plant and as many as survive their first three winters.
lines.sk: Toľko, koľko ich zasadíme a koľko prežije prvé tri zimy.
lines.heard: As many as we plant, and as many as survive their first three winters

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And how many survive?
lines.sk: A koľko prežije?
lines.heard: And how many survive?

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: More, when nobody runs them over with a cart. That’s why I worry so much about that lime.
lines.sk: Viac, keď ich nikto neprejde vozíkom. Preto sa o tú lipu tak bojím.
lines.heard: More when nobody runs them over with a cart. That's why I worry so much about that lime

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And after that?
lines.sk: A potom?
lines.heard: And after that?

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: After that they defend themselves. A tree with thick bark only fears saws and people with plans.
lines.sk: Potom sa už bránia samy. Strom s hrubou kôrou sa bojí iba píly a ľudí s plánmi.
lines.heard: After that, they defend themselves. A tree with thick bark only fears saws and people with plans.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do you grow in the school garden?
lines.sk: Čo pestujete v školskej záhrade?
lines.heard: Oh, what do you grow in the school garden?

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Carrots, beans and peas. The children sow them in spring and are amazed in September that something has grown.
lines.sk: Mrkvu, fazuľu a hrach. Deti ich na jar zasejú a v septembri sa čudujú, že niečo vyrástlo.
lines.heard: Carrots, beans, and peas. The children sow them in spring and are amazed in September that something has grown

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And now, in December?
lines.sk: A teraz v decembri?
lines.heard: And now, in December

lines.speaker: SIMON
lines.text: Now we’re planning what to sow in spring. And the children are already arguing about who gets to do the watering.
lines.sk: Teraz plánujeme, čo na jar zasejeme. A deti sa už hádajú, kto bude polievať.
lines.heard: Now, we're planning what to sow in spring, and the children are already arguing about who gets to do the watering

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The pupils’ technical exhibition. I’d better leave my phone in my pocket.
lines.sk: Technická výstavka žiakov. Telefón nechám radšej vo vrecku.
lines.heard: The People's Technical Exhibition? I better leave my phone in my pocket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi. May I see what you’ve got under that template?
lines.sk: Ahoj. Môžem sa pozrieť, čo máš pod tým vzorom?
lines.heard: Hi. May I see what you've got under that template?

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: You may. Just please don’t laugh.
lines.sk: Môžete. Len sa, prosím, nesmejte.
lines.heard: You may. Just please don't laugh

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: It’s not according to the template. But here a weak signal isn’t thrown away; it’s just separated from the interference.
lines.sk: Nie je to podľa predlohy. Ale slabý signál sa tu nezahodí, len sa oddelí od rušenia.
lines.heard: It's not according to the template, but here a weak signal isn't thrown away. It's just separated from the interference

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Separated? How?
lines.sk: Oddelí? Ako?
lines.heard: Separated? How?

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: It goes a different way. Like when the queue in the canteen splits so the little ones don’t have to push in with the big ones.
lines.sk: Pôjde druhou cestou. Ako keď sa v jedálni rozdelí rad, aby sa malí nemuseli tlačiť s veľkými.
lines.heard: It goes a different way. Like when the queue in the canteen splits so the little ones don't have to push in with the big ones

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: You explained that precisely. May I show it to your teacher? Only if you agree.
lines.sk: Vysvetlila si to presne. Môžem to ukázať učiteľovi? Iba ak súhlasíš.
lines.heard: You explained that precisely. May I show it to your teacher? Only if you agree

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Yes. But he has to see my notes too, not just the clean schematic.
lines.sk: Áno. Ale nech vidí aj moje poznámky, nielen čistú schému.
lines.heard: Yes, but he has to see my notes too, not just the clean schematic

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Without the notes it’s just a line that looks like a mistake.
lines.sk: Bez poznámok je to len čiara, ktorá vyzerá ako chyba.
lines.heard: Without the notes, it's just a line that looks like a mistake.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The notes go with it. I promise.
lines.sk: Poznámky pôjdu s ňou. Sľubujem.
lines.heard: The notes go with it, I promise

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Excuse me, sir, have you got a moment? Jane drew this.
lines.sk: Pán učiteľ, máte chvíľu? Toto nakreslila Jana.
lines.heard: Excuse me, sir. Have you got a moment? Uh, Jane drew this

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Everything for the exhibition has already been approved. But show me.
lines.sk: Na výstavku už máme všetko schválené. Ale ukážte.
lines.heard: Everything for the exhibition has already been approved. But show me

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: The wiring is different from the template. Why?
lines.sk: Zapojenie sa líši od vzoru. Prečo?
lines.heard: The wiring is different from the template. Why?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Jane explains it here in her notes. It doesn’t discard the weak signal, it sends it down a second branch.
lines.sk: Jana to vysvetľuje tu v poznámkach. Slabý signál nevyradí, pošle ho druhou vetvou.
lines.heard: Jane explains it here in her notes it doesn't discard the weak signal, it sends it down, uh, a second branch

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: That’s logical. Let her explain it at the exhibition in her own words. I’ll add my approval.
lines.sk: To je logické. Nech to na výstavke vysvetlí vlastnými slovami. Pripíšem povolenie.
lines.heard: That's logical. Let her explain it at the exhibition in her own words. I'll add my approval

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s exactly what she was waiting for.
lines.sk: Na to presne čakala.
lines.heard: And that's exactly what she was waiting for

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Perhaps I’ve been waiting for a design like this myself. I just didn’t know it.
lines.sk: Možno som na takýto návrh čakal aj ja. Len som to nevedel.
lines.heard: Perhaps I've been waiting for a design like this myself. I just didn't know it

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Comrade Headmistress will read every word, so Jane should write her explanation neatly.
lines.sk: Súdružka riaditeľka bude čítať každé slovo, tak nech Jana píše vysvetlenie úhľadne.
lines.heard: Comrade Headmistress will read every word, so Jane should write her explanation neatly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Here’s your schematic. Your teacher has written his approval on it.
lines.sk: Tu máš svoju schému. Pán učiteľ ti na ňu pripísal povolenie.
lines.heard: Here's your schematic. Your teacher has written his approval on it

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Can I really show it like this, my own way?
lines.sk: Naozaj to môžem ukázať takto, po svojom?
lines.heard: Can I really show it like this, my own way?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Exactly like this. It’s your design and you know why it works.
lines.sk: Práve takto. Je to tvoj návrh a vieš, prečo funguje.
lines.heard: Exactly like this. It's your design and you know why it works

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: And what do I say if someone asks why it’s different from the template?
lines.sk: A čo poviem, keď sa niekto spýta, prečo je to inak ako vo vzore?
lines.heard: And what do I say if someone asks why it's different from the template?

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The same as you told me. The canteen queue and all.
lines.sk: To isté, čo mne. Aj s tým radom v jedálni.
lines.heard: The same as you told me. The canteen queue and all

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Then I’ll draw a second design too. Maybe one day I’ll have a whole notebook.
lines.sk: Tak nakreslím aj druhý návrh. Možno raz budem mať celý zošit.
lines.heard: Then I'll draw a second design too. Maybe one day I'll have a whole notebook

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’d like to see that notebook one day.
lines.sk: Ten zošit by som raz rád videl.
lines.heard: I'd like to see that notebook one day

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: It’ll be tidy. Every schematic with its notes.
lines.sk: Bude v ňom poriadok. Každá schéma aj s poznámkami.
lines.heard: It'll be tidy. Every schematic with its notes

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: To show that the pupils have mastered the approved procedure.
lines.sk: Ukázať, že žiaci ovládajú schválený postup.
lines.heard: To show that the pupils have mastered the approved procedure

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when they’ve mastered it so well that they improve on it?
lines.sk: A keď ho ovládajú tak dobre, že ho vylepšia?
lines.heard: And when they've mastered it so well that they improve on it?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Then they have to be able to explain it too.
lines.sk: Potom to musia vedieť aj vysvetliť.
lines.heard: Then they have to be able to explain it too

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Out loud, in front of the panel, and without their parents whispering to them.
lines.sk: Nahlas, pred komisiou a bez toho, aby im rodičia šepkali.
lines.heard: Out loud, in front of the panel, and without their parents whispering to them

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Parents whisper?
lines.sk: Rodičia šepkajú?
lines.heard: Parents whisper?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Last year a father explained his son’s radio to me better than the son did. The boy just stood there nodding.
lines.sk: Minulý rok mi jeden otec vysvetlil synovo rádio lepšie ako syn. Ten len mlčal a prikyvoval.
lines.heard: Last year, a father explained his son's radio to me better than the son did. The boy just stood there nodding

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: A thing can be good and still need three signatures.
lines.sk: Vec môže byť dobrá a zároveň potrebovať tri podpisy.
lines.heard: A thing can be good and still need three signatures

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three signatures? For one school drawing?
lines.sk: Tri podpisy? Na jeden školský výkres?
lines.heard: Three signatures for one school drawing?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Mine, the headmistress’s and the building manager’s. The building manager signs that the drawing won’t fall off the wall.
lines.sk: Môj, riaditeľky a správcu budovy. Správca podpisuje, že výkres nespadne zo steny.
lines.heard: Mine, the headmistress's, and the building manager's. The building manager signs that the drawing won't fall off the wall.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And has one ever fallen off?
lines.sk: A spadol už niekedy?
lines.heard: And has one ever fallen off?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Once. Since then the building manager is on every form.
lines.sk: Raz. Odvtedy je správca na každom tlačive.
lines.heard: Once. Since then, the building manager is on every form

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Who’s going to judge the exhibition?
lines.sk: Kto bude hodnotiť výstavku?
lines.heard: Who's gonna judge the exhibition?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Comrade Headmistress. She reads every label, even the one under the table.
lines.sk: Súdružka riaditeľka. Číta každý štítok, aj ten pod stolom.
lines.heard: Comrade Headmistress. She reads every label, even the one under the table

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even under the table?
lines.sk: Aj pod stolom?
lines.heard: Even under the table?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Someone once left a model there without a label, and she found it. Since then everything has a label, even the things under the tables.
lines.sk: Raz tam niekto zabudol model bez štítka a ona ho našla. Odvtedy má štítok všetko, aj to pod stolmi.
lines.heard: Someone once left a model there without a label, and she found it. Since then, everything has a label, even the things under the tables

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s strict.
lines.sk: To je prísne.
lines.heard: That's strict

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: That’s thorough. Strict would be sending the unlabelled model home.
lines.sk: To je dôkladné. Prísne by bolo, keby model bez štítka poslala domov.
lines.heard: That's thorough. Strict would be sending the unlabeled model home

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: What do you think makes a good pupil’s project?
lines.sk: Aký je podľa vás dobrý žiacky projekt?
lines.heard: What do you think makes a good pupils project?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: One that works, where the pupil can say why. Anyone can follow a template.
lines.sk: Taký, ktorý funguje a žiak vie povedať prečo. Podľa vzoru to vie urobiť každý.
lines.heard: One that works, where the pupil can say why anyone can follow a template.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And when it’s different from the template?
lines.sk: A keď sa od vzoru líši?
lines.heard: And when it's different from the template?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: Then the explanation has to be even better than the drawing. That doesn’t happen often.
lines.sk: Potom musí byť vysvetlenie ešte lepšie ako výkres. To sa nestáva často.
lines.heard: Then the explanation has to be even better than the drawing. And that doesn't happen often.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: But it happens.
lines.sk: Ale stáva sa.
lines.heard: But it happens

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: It does. And you remember those longer than all the templates put together.
lines.sk: Stáva. A taký si človek pamätá dlhšie ako všetky vzory.
lines.heard: It does. And you remember those longer than all the templates put together

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The school looks as if it’s only just been built.
lines.sk: Škola vyzerá, akoby ju práve postavili.
lines.heard: The school looks as if it's only just been built

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: It is new. The plaster is still drying, and the children are multiplying faster than the desks.
lines.sk: Je nová. Omietka ešte schne a detí pribúda rýchlejšie ako lavíc.
lines.heard: It is new. The plaster is still drying and the children are multiplying faster than the desks

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That many children?
lines.sk: Toľko detí?
lines.heard: That many children?

lines.speaker: DOBRO
lines.text: The estate is growing. A new block of flats every month, and a new class every September.
lines.sk: Sídlisko rastie. Každý mesiac nový panelák a v septembri nová trieda.
lines.heard: The estate is growing, a new block of flats every month and a new class every September

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Yes. But it doesn’t look like the one in the textbook.
lines.sk: Áno. Ale nevyzerá to ako v učebnici.
lines.heard: Yes, but it doesn't look like the one in the textbook

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Maybe that’s exactly why it’s worth a look.
lines.sk: Možno práve preto sa na to oplatí pozrieť.
lines.heard: Maybe that's exactly why it's worth a look

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Comrade Teacher says the wiring in the textbook has been tested.
lines.sk: Súdruh učiteľ vraví, že zapojenie z učebnice je vyskúšané.
lines.heard: Comrade Teacher says the wiring in the textbook has been tested

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Yours can be tested too.
lines.sk: Aj tvoje sa dá vyskúšať.
lines.heard: Yours can be tested too

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: I know. I tested it at home and it works. It’s just that nobody knows yet.
lines.sk: Ja viem. Doma som to vyskúšala a funguje. Len to zatiaľ nikto nevie.
lines.heard: I know! I tested it at home, and it works. It's just that nobody knows yet

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: There’s less hiss, and you can still hear the whole broadcast.
lines.sk: Menej to šumí a pritom počuť celé vysielanie.
lines.heard: There's less hiss and you can still hear the whole broadcast

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Even in the evening, when tuning is at its worst?
lines.sk: Aj večer, keď sa ladí najhoršie?
lines.heard: Even in the evening when tuning's at its worst?

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Especially in the evening. In the evening the airwaves are crowded and the weak stations get lost.
lines.sk: Hlavne večer. Večer je v éteri plno a slabé stanice sa strácajú.
lines.heard: Especially in the evening. In the evening, the airwaves are crowded and the weak stations get lost

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: With my wiring they don’t get lost. It’s different from the template.
lines.sk: V mojom zapojení sa nestratia. Je to inak ako vo vzore.
lines.heard: With my wiring, they don't get lost. It's different from the template

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Have you got a radio at home?
lines.sk: Máš doma rádio?
lines.heard: Have you got a radio at home?

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: We have. An old one with a green eye. When Dad switches it on, the eye slowly lights up.
lines.sk: Máme. Staré, so zeleným okom. Keď ho otec zapne, oko sa pomaly rozsvieti.
lines.heard: We have an old one with a green eye. When Dad switches it on, the eye slowly lights up

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: I’ve worked out why it hisses in the evenings. But I haven’t told Dad yet.
lines.sk: Ja som zistila, prečo v ňom večer šumí. Ale otcovi som to ešte nepovedala.
lines.heard: I've worked out why it hisses in the evenings, but I haven't told Dad yet

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Why not?
lines.sk: Prečo nie?
lines.heard: Why not?

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: Because he’d want me to fix it. And then I’d have to know how to put it back together too.
lines.sk: Lebo by chcel, aby som ho opravila. A potom by som ho musela vedieť aj zložiť.
lines.heard: Because he'd want me to fix it, and then I'd have to know how to put it back together too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Looking forward to the exhibition?
lines.sk: Tešíš sa na výstavku?
lines.heard: Looking forward to the exhibition

lines.speaker: JANA82
lines.text: A bit. I’m showing the one that follows the template. That can’t go wrong.
lines.sk: Trochu. Vystavím to, čo je podľa vzoru. To sa nemôže pokaziť.
lines.heard: A bit. I'm showing the one that follows the template that can't go wrong

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And your own one?
lines.sk: A to svoje?
lines.heard: And your own one?

lines.text: A brass device with four little lights and the club’s emblem. Its protective field protects me and everything I carry.
lines.sk: Mosadzný prístroj so štyrmi svetielkami a značkou krúžku. Jeho ochranné pole chráni mňa aj všetko, čo nesiem.
lines.heard: A brass device with four little lights and the club's emblem. Its protective field protects me and everything I carry

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Blown, but the rating is still readable. It belongs in the e-waste, not back in the device.
lines.sk: Prepálená, ale hodnota sa dá prečítať. Patrí do elektroodpadu, nie späť do prístroja.
lines.heard: Blown, but the rating is still readable. It belongs in the e-waste, not back in the device

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The same rating and type as the blown one. Exactly what the base node needs.
lines.sk: Rovnaká hodnota aj typ ako tá prepálená. Presne taká, akú stolový uzol potrebuje.
lines.heard: The same rating and type as the blown one exactly what the base node needs.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran’s letter of authority. With it, the reading room will give me copies from her collection.
lines.sk: Babkino poverenie. S ním mi v študovni vydajú kópie z jej fondu.
lines.heard: Gran's letter of authority. With it, the reading room will give me copies from her collection

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The drive belt from the school tape recorder, perished into pieces. Paulie can tell the size from it.
lines.sk: Remienok zo školského magnetofónu, rozpadnutý na kúsky. Pali podľa neho určí rozmer.
lines.heard: The drive belt from the school tape recorder perished into pieces paulie can tell the size from it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A new drive belt, exactly like the sample. Paulie got it right first time.
lines.sk: Nový remienok presne podľa vzoru. Pali to trafil na prvý pokus.
lines.heard: A new drive belt exactly like the sample. Paulie got it right first time

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The cassette ‘Our School’s Sound Atlas’, 1995. The recording’s there; it’s just that two tracks cancel each other out.
lines.sk: Kazeta „Zvukový atlas našej školy“, 1995. Nahrávka tam je, len sa dve stopy navzájom rušia.
lines.heard: The cassette, Our School's Sound Atlas, 1995. The recording's there, it's just that two tracks cancel each other out

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The circuit is finished, but it lacks a connector and insulation. Jerry has marked the contacts with matching symbols.
lines.sk: Obvod je hotový, chýba mu konektor a izolácia. Juro označil kontakty rovnakými značkami.
lines.heard: The circuit is finished, but it lacks a connector and insulation. Jerry has marked the contacts with matching symbols

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: From Frank, for mending his scales. The contacts click into the marked places.
lines.sk: Od Fera za opravenú váhu. Kontakty zacvaknú do označených miest.
lines.heard: From Frank for mending his scales, the contacts click into the marked places

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An offcut of cloth insulation from Mildred. Made for a delicate audio cable.
lines.sk: Odrezok textilnej izolácie od Milady. Na slabý zvukový kábel ako stvorený.
lines.heard: An offcut of cloth insulation from Mildred made for a delicate audio cable

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The connector is fitted, but the leads are still bare.
lines.sk: Konektor sedí, ale vývody sú ešte holé.
lines.heard: The connectors fitted, but the leads are still bare

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The cross adaptor with its connector and insulation. Ready for work.
lines.sk: Krížový adaptér s konektorom aj izoláciou. Pripravený do práce.
lines.heard: The cross adapter with its connector and insulation ready for work

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The tracks are read correctly and the chronometer protects them. You can hear Leah, and me aged ten. I haven’t overwritten anything.
lines.sk: Stopy sú správne prečítané a chronometer ich chráni. Počuť Leu aj mňa ako desaťročného. Nič som neprepísal.
lines.heard: The tracks are read correctly and the chronometer protects them You can hear Leah and me aged 10 I haven't overwritten anything

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A copy of the map of three old measuring points. The transparent overlay is missing.
lines.sk: Kópia mapy troch starých meracích bodov. Chýba na nej priehľadná fólia.
lines.heard: A copy of the map of three old measuring points The transparent overlay's missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A negative of the measuring set-up. Even against the light, I can’t read the supplement number on it.
lines.sk: Negatív záberu meracej zostavy. Číslo prílohy na ňom proti svetlu neprečítam.
lines.heard: A negative of the measuring setup. Even against the light, I can't read the supplement number on it

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The shot shows a table labelled K-17. Faith at the bookshop has the transparent overlay with that number.
lines.sk: Na zábere je stôl s označením K-17. Priehľadnú fóliu s týmto číslom má Viera v antikvariáte.
lines.heard: The shot shows a table labeled K17. Faith at the Bookshop has the transparent overlay with that number

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three registration marks: a hole, a double cross and a square. They have to line up with the marks on the map.
lines.sk: Tri registračné značky: dierka, dvojitý kríž a štvorec. Musia sedieť so značkami na mape.
lines.heard: Three registration marks a hole, a double cross, and a square they have to line up with the marks on the map

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The map leads to Desmond’s garage and to the measuring point on the Old Bridge. Which year it will show, I’ll only find out by measuring.
lines.sk: Mapa vedie k Deziderovej garáži a k meraciemu bodu na Starom moste. Ktorý rok ukáže, zistím až meraním.
lines.heard: The map leads to Desmond's garage and to the measuring point on the old bridge. Which year it will show, I'll only find out by measuring

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: An insulated measuring coil. It belongs in the round holder in the measuring booth on the Old Bridge.
lines.sk: Izolovaná meracia cievka. Patrí do kruhového držiaka v meracom stánku na Starom moste.
lines.heard: An insulated measuring coil. It belongs in the round holder in the measuring booth on the old bridge

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Emil’s metronome, lent for the measurement. Desmond will return it to Emil afterwards.
lines.sk: Emilov metronóm, požičaný na meranie. Emilovi ho potom vráti Dezider.
lines.heard: Amiel's metronome, lent for the measurement. Desmond will return it to Amiel afterwards

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Otto’s slip for Stephen: one pre-cut leather cuff and two hollow rivets.
lines.sk: Otov lístok pre Štefana: jedna predrezaná kožená manžeta a dva duté nity.
lines.heard: Auto slip for Steven. One pre-cut leather cuff and two hollow rivets

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The leather is cut to size. Two marked holes still need punching.
lines.sk: Koža je narezaná na mieru. Ešte treba preraziť dva vyznačené otvory.
lines.heard: The leather is cut to size. Two marked holes still need punching

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Two hollow rivets. They’ll join the cuff into a ring.
lines.sk: Dva duté nity. Spoja manžetu do kruhu.
lines.heard: Two hollow rivets, they'll join the cuff into a ring

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A punch and pliers in one. Otto will return it to Lydia after the job.
lines.sk: Dierovač a kliešte v jednom. Oto ho po práci vráti Líde.
lines.heard: A punch and pliers in one. Otto will return it to Lydia after the job

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The holes are punched. Now I just need to join it with the rivets.
lines.sk: Otvory sú prerazené. Teraz ju ešte spojím nitmi.
lines.heard: The holes are punched. Now I just need to join it with the rivets

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A new leather cuff. It fits the hand pump’s piston exactly.
lines.sk: Nová kožená manžeta. Sedí presne na piest ručnej pumpy.
lines.heard: A new leather cuff it fits the hand pump's piston exactly

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Otto’s key to the measuring room. I got it for mending the pump.
lines.sk: Otov kľúč od meracej miestnosti. Dostal som ho za opravenú pumpu.
lines.heard: Otto's key to the measuring room. I got it for mending the pump

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Mira’s signed form with today’s date and the measurement results. I need a duplicate and a post office stamp.
lines.sk: Mirin podpísaný list s dnešným dátumom a výsledkami merania. Potrebujem druhopis a poštovú pečiatku.
lines.heard: Mira's signed form with today's date and the measurement results. I need a duplicate and a post office stamp

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Vera’s blunt stylus. It traces the edges of the imprint without scratching the plate.
lines.sk: Verino tupé rydlo. Obtiahne hrany odtlačku a platňu nepoškriabe.
lines.heard: Vera's blunt stylus. It traces the edges of the imprint without scratching the plate

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A soft waxed sheet. An imprint without a camera, the old-fashioned way.
lines.sk: Mäkký voskovaný hárok. Odtlačok bez fotoaparátu, po starom.
lines.heard: A soft waxed sheet, an imprint without a camera, the old-fashioned way

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The plate’s relief is on the paper, but it’s faint. The edges need tracing with a blunt stylus.
lines.sk: Reliéf platne je na papieri, ale slabý. Hrany treba obtiahnuť tupým rydlom.
lines.heard: The plate's relief is on the paper, but it's faint. The edges need tracing with a blunt stylus

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Four words, the rule, and Mira’s and Otto’s signatures. The post office confirmation is still missing.
lines.sk: Štyri slová, pravidlo a podpisy Miry a Ota. Chýba ešte potvrdenie z pošty.
lines.heard: Four words, the rule, and Mira's and Otto's signatures The post office confirmation is still missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Carbon paper from the post office. I put it between two sheets and one writing gives me two identical copies.
lines.sk: Uhľový papier z pošty. Vložím ho medzi dva hárky a jedným písaním mám dve rovnaké vyhotovenia.
lines.heard: Carbon paper from the post office. I put it between two sheets and one writing gives me two identical copies

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Two identical forms, both signed by Mira. Now just the stamp.
lines.sk: Dva rovnaké listy, oba s Miriným podpisom. Teraz ešte pečiatka.
lines.heard: Two identical forms, both signed by Mira now just the stamp

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A stamp and the number Z-17. The post office has confirmed that the form existed today – not that the physics is right.
lines.sk: Pečiatka a číslo Z-17. Pošta potvrdila, že list dnes existoval, nie že je fyzika správna.
lines.heard: A stamp and the number Z17. The post office has confirmed that the form existed today, not that the physics is right

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The imprint with its storage number. The plate and the archive copy stayed in 1962; I’m carrying this one.
lines.sk: Odtlačok s číslom uloženia. Platňa aj archívna kópia zostali v roku 1962, ja nesiem tento.
lines.heard: The imprint with its storage number, the plate and the archive copy stayed in 1962. I'm carrying this one

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A record from Ella: who handed over box Z-17, who collected it, and the owner’s consent. The signatures are missing.
lines.sk: Protokol od Ely: kto krabicu Z-17 vydal, kto ju prevzal a súhlas majiteľky. Chýbajú podpisy.
lines.heard: A record from Ella, who handed over box Z17, who collected it, and the owner's consent. The signatures are missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Roman’s signature is there: he collected the box and took it to Gran’s workshop.
lines.sk: Romanov podpis je tam: krabicu prevzal a odniesol do babkinej dielne.
lines.heard: Roman's signature is there. He collected the box and took it to Graham's workshop

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Box Z-17: the pick-up point, Roman, the workshop. Gran gave her consent in a recorded call; nobody had to enter the house.
lines.sk: Krabica Z-17: výdajné miesto, Roman, dielňa. Babka súhlasila cez zaznamenaný hovor, do domu nemusel nikto.
lines.heard: Box Z17, the pickup point. Roman, the workshop. Grant gave her consent in a recorded call. Nobody had to enter the house

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A small reader from Tamara. It reads cassettes and service memory, and it doesn’t need a network.
lines.sk: Malá čítačka od Tamary. Prečíta kazetu aj servisnú pamäť a sieť nepotrebuje.
lines.heard: A small reader from Tamra. It reads cassettes and service memory, and it doesn't need a network

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The public card for collection Z-17, with the years 1962, 1995 and 2020. It won’t get me into the private recordings.
lines.sk: Verejná karta fondu Z-17 s rokmi 1962, 1995 a 2020. K súkromným nahrávkam ma nepustí.
lines.heard: The public card for collection Z17 with the years 1962, 1995, and 2020. It won't get me into the private recordings

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Nina has approved my diagnostics of the collection. Sarah wrote my name down in pen as well.
lines.sk: Nina mi schválila diagnostiku fondu. Sára si moje meno zapísala aj perom.
lines.heard: Nina has approved my diagnostics of the collection. Sarah wrote my name down in pen as well

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A phone photo of the panel: DIFFERENCE = DISCARD. I’ve copied the rule into my notes too.
lines.sk: Fotka panelu z telefónu: ROZDIEL = ZAHODIŤ. Pravidlo som si prepísal aj do poznámok.
lines.heard: The phone photo of the panel, difference equals discard. I've copied the rule into my notes too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Leah’s message from 2032, whole and unedited. It survived in the buffer. Nina has allowed it to be played only for Victor.
lines.sk: Leina správa z roku 2032, celá a bez úprav. Prežila v zásobníku. Nina ju dovolila pustiť iba Viktorovi.
lines.heard: Leah's message from 2032, whole and unedited. It survived in the buffer. Nina has allowed it to be played only for Victor

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The deleted data are waiting in the buffer until the write is confirmed. If I switch the output to MONITOR, they can be returned.
lines.sk: Vymazané údaje čakajú v zásobníku, kým sa zápis nepotvrdí. Keď výstup prepnem na MONITOR, dajú sa vrátiť.
lines.heard: The deleted data are waiting in the buffer until the write is confirmed. If I switch the output to monitor they can be returned

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The trace of Lake Vrbicke and its surroundings, saved in the chronometer. I didn’t even touch the ice while measuring.
lines.sk: Stopa okolia Vrbického plesa uložená v chronometri. Pri meraní som sa nedotkol ani ľadu.
lines.heard: The trace of Lake Vrbitza and its surroundings saved in the chronometer. I didn't even touch the ice while measuring

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The procedure KEEP THE EXCEPTIONS, signed by Nina. It returns the withheld data and switches off the write-back.
lines.sk: Postup ZACHOVAŤ VÝNIMKY, podpísaný Ninou. Vráti zadržané údaje a vypne spätný zápis.
lines.heard: The procedure keep the exceptions signed by Nina. It returns the withheld data and switches off the write back

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A chewed red ball. Dotty clearly loves it with every one of his teeth.
lines.sk: Obhryzená červená loptička. Bodka ju zjavne miluje celým chrupom.
lines.heard: A chewed red ball. Dottie clearly loves it with every one of his teeth

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: NEIGHBOURHOOD HELP 9–17 and Ella’s number below it, all in large print. You can read it without a magnifying glass.
lines.sk: SUSEDSKÁ POMOC 9–17 a pod tým Elino číslo, všetko veľkým písmom. Prečíta sa to aj bez lupy.
lines.heard: Neighborhood help nine to five and Ella's number below it, all in large print. You can read it without a magnifying glass

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A forgotten school order. Rita gave it to me because Sonia sent me.
lines.sk: Zabudnutá školská zákazka. Zita mi ju dala, lebo ma poslala Soňa.
lines.heard: A forgotten school order. Rita gave it to me because Sonya sent me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The whole team. The boy in the back row looking the other way is me.
lines.sk: Celé družstvo. Chlapec v zadnom rade, čo pozerá inam, som ja.
lines.heard: The whole team. The boy in the back row looking the other way is me

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Handwritten sheet music: Four Stops. Including the last bars Emil was missing.
lines.sk: Ručne písané noty: Štyri zastávky. Aj posledné takty, ktoré Emilovi chýbali.
lines.heard: Handwritten sheet music. Four stops, including the last bars Emile was missing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One stick of white chalk. Tony gave it to me for the approved panel in the underpass.
lines.sk: Jeden kus bielej kriedy. Tóno mi ho dal na povolený panel v podchode.
lines.heard: One stick of white chalk tony gave it to me for the approved panel in the underpass

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A handful of Barnaby’s mix from Stephen. Enough for one feed.
lines.sk: Hrsť Bélovej zmesi od Štefana. Na jedno kŕmenie stačí.
lines.heard: A handful of Barnaby's mix from Steven. Enough for one feed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Rudy’s script, ‘Never Fear, Darling!’ The margins are full of notes.
lines.sk: Rudov scenár „Žiaden strach, miláčik!“ Okraje sú plné poznámok.
lines.heard: Rudy's script, Never Fear, Darling. The margins are full of notes

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Blinky’s request: a parcel for the repair shop by the bench with the dog. That description dates from last year.
lines.sk: Očkova požiadavka: zásielka pre opravovňu pri lavičke so psom. Ten opis je ešte z minulého roka.
lines.heard: Blinky's request, a parcel for the repair shop by the bench with the dog. That description dates from last year

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tamara has confirmed the parcel is hers, and the new address: the lobby of Hotel Grand Jasna.
lines.sk: Tamara potvrdila, že zásielka je jej, a novú adresu: lobby hotela Grand Jasná.
lines.heard: Tamara has confirmed the parcel's hers and the new address, the lobby of Hotel Grand Jaszna.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The yard in 2020: a tarmac corner with no lime tree and the service window with the metal swallow. Tony will recognise that swallow.
lines.sk: Dvor v roku 2020: asfaltový roh bez lipy a servisné okno s kovovou lastovičkou. Tú lastovičku Tóno spozná.
lines.heard: The yard in 2020, a tarmac corner with no lime tree and the service window with the metal swallow. Tony will recognize that swallow

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A permit from the school: I may enter the lobby and the physics prep room. The other classrooms are closed.
lines.sk: Povolenie od školy: smiem do zádveria a do fyzikálneho kabinetu. Ostatné triedy sú zatvorené.
lines.heard: A permit from the school. I may enter the lobby and the physics prep room. The other classrooms are closed

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: 7 December 1982: Otto’s drawing of a ceramic bridge with three leads. His grandson Tony helped. The bridge was lost.
lines.sk: 7. decembra 1982: Otov nákres keramického mostíka s tromi vývodmi. Pomáhal vnuk Tóno. Mostík sa stratil.
lines.heard: 7th December 1982. Otto's drawing of a ceramic bridge with three leads. His grandson Tony helped. The bridge was lost.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A requisition slip for a ceramic base and three copper links. Signed by Otto, not by Tony.
lines.sk: Výdajný lístok na keramickú päticu a tri prepojky. Podpísal ho Oto, nie Tóno.
lines.heard: A requisition slip for a ceramic base and three copper links signed by Otto, not by Tony

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A ceramic base and three marked copper links. Nothing that will leak or rust over the years.
lines.sk: Keramická pätica a tri označené medené prepojky. Nič, čo by za roky vytieklo alebo zhrdzavelo.
lines.heard: A ceramic base and three marked copper links nothing that will leak or rust over the years.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A ceramic bridge built to Otto’s drawing, with no battery, and Tony’s swallow on the label. I’ll hide it in a dry jar.
lines.sk: Keramický mostík podľa Otovho nákresu, bez batérie, na štítku Tónova lastovička. Ukryjem ho v suchom pohári.
lines.heard: A ceramic bridge built to Otto's drawing with no battery and Tony Swallow on the label. I'll hide it in a dry jar.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A dry jar with a rubber seal, and wrapping paper. Otto will add the dried packing.
lines.sk: Suchý pohár s gumovým tesnením a baliaci papier. Vysušenú výplň pridá Oto.
lines.heard: A dry jar with a rubber seal and wrapping paper. Otto will add the dried packing

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The jar is sealed and Otto has checked the lid. It belongs in the dry cavity in the low wall, not in the ground.
lines.sk: Pohár je zapečatený, Oto skontroloval viečko. Patrí do suchej dutiny v múriku, nie do zeme.
lines.heard: The jar is sealed and Otto has checked the lid. It belongs in the dry cavity in the low wall, not in the ground

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three ready-made sections of a tree guard. Simon agrees to the cart’s new route too.
lines.sk: Tri hotové diely ohrádky. Šimon súhlasí aj s novou trasou vozíka.
lines.heard: Three ready-made sections of a tree guard. Simon agrees to the cart's new route too

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tony’s childish but accurate sketch, approved by Otto. Second row from the top, third stone from the left. A little swallow instead of a signature.
lines.sk: Tónov detský, no presný nákres schválený Otom. Druhý rad zhora, tretí kameň zľava. Malá lastovička namiesto podpisu.
lines.heard: Tony's childish but accurate sketch approved by Otto. Second row from the top, third stone from the left, a little swallow instead of a signature

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Tony’s note: the cavity in the low wall is in the 3 × 4 grid, row 2, column 3. When the bench was replaced, he didn’t let them brick it up.
lines.sk: Tónova poznámka: dutina v múriku je na mriežke 3 × 4, rad 2, stĺpec 3. Pri výmene lavičky ju nedal zamurovať.
lines.heard: Tony's note. The cavity in the low wall is in the three-by-four grid, row two, column three. When the bench was replaced, he didn't let them brick it up

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Dust on the outside, dry paper inside. The seal has held for thirty-eight years.
lines.sk: Zvonka prach, vnútri suchý papier. Tesnenie vydržalo tridsaťosem rokov.
lines.heard: Dust on the outside dry paper inside the seal has held for thirty-eight years

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The ceramic is intact, the contacts are clean, and Tony’s swallow is on the label. The very piece I hid in 1982.
lines.sk: Keramika celá, kontakty čisté, na štítku Tónova lastovička. Ten istý kus, ktorý som v roku 1982 schoval.
lines.heard: The ceramic is intact, the contacts are clean, and Tony's swallow is on the label. The very piece I hid in 1982

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A ticket for the gondola Biela Put – Priehyba and the Funitel Priehyba – Chopok, there and back. Valid all day.
lines.sk: Lístok na kabínku Biela Púť – Priehyba aj Funitel Priehyba – Chopok, tam aj späť. Platí celý deň.
lines.heard: A ticket for the Gondola Biela Puta Priehuba and the Funitel Priehuba Chopok there and back valid all day

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Jane’s schematic with her notes. It explains why the wiring doesn’t cut off the weak signal.
lines.sk: Janina schéma s poznámkami. Vysvetľuje, prečo zapojenie neodreže slabý signál.
lines.heard: Jane's schematic with her notes explains why the wiring doesn't cut off the weak signal

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Approval for the exhibition is written on the schematic. Jane’s explanation convinced the teacher.
lines.sk: Na schéme je pripísané povolenie na výstavku. Učiteľa presvedčilo Janino vysvetlenie.
lines.heard: Approval for the exhibition is written on the schematic. Jane's explanation convinced the teacher

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A brass hand bell with a wooden handle. The clapper is wrapped in Susanna’s hanky; the loop is torn.
lines.sk: Mosadzný ručný zvonček s drevenou rúčkou. Srdce je zabalené v Zuzaninej vreckovke, pútko je roztrhnuté.
lines.heard: A brass handbell with a wooden handle. The clapper is wrapped in Susanna's hanky. The loop is torn

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: In printed capitals: SLIP. PLEASE MAY I HAVE ONE BIT OF LEATHER FOR THE BELL. SUSANNA, FIRST YEAR. A little flower in the corner.
lines.sk: Tlačenými písmenami: LÍSTOK. PROSÍM JEDEN KÚSOK KOŽE NA ZVONČEK. ZUZANA, 1. TRIEDA. V rohu kvetinka.
lines.heard: In printed capitals, "Slip, please. May I have one bit of leather for the bell? Susanna, first year." A little flower in the corner

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A narrow strip of leather from Stephen’s offcuts. Just right for a loop, not a bit more.
lines.sk: Úzky pásik kože zo Štefanových odrezkov. Na pútko akurát, ani o kúsok viac.
lines.heard: A narrow strip of leather from Steven's offcuts just right for a loop, not a bit more

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The clapper hangs on the new loop, with the knot hidden inside. It rings clearly, but the first proper ringing belongs to Susanna.
lines.sk: Srdce visí na novom pútku, uzol je schovaný vnútri. Zvoní čisto, ale prvé poriadne zvonenie patrí Zuzane.
lines.heard: The clapper hangs on the new loop with the knot hidden inside. It rings clearly but the first proper ringing belongs to Susanna

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The brass cap from a child’s bell. It has a thread inside and a scratch on the side from the kerb.
lines.sk: Mosadzný vrchnák z detského zvončeka. Vnútri má závit, na boku škrabanec od obrubníka.
lines.heard: The brass cap from a child's bell. It has a thread inside and a scratch on the side from the curb.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Three shapes, three matches. Done.
lines.sk: Tri tvary, tri zhody. Hotovo.
lines.heard: Three shapes, three matches. Done

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: These shapes don’t belong together. The diagram above the panel connects like with like.
lines.sk: Tieto tvary k sebe nepatria. Schéma nad panelom spája rovnaký s rovnakým.
lines.heard: These shapes don't belong together. The diagram above the panel connects like with like

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The hole, the cross and the square all line up. The map is complete.
lines.sk: Sedí dierka, kríž aj štvorec. Mapa je celá.
lines.heard: The hole, the cross, and the square all line up. The map is complete

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: One mark lines up, the other two don’t. The overlay needs turning further.
lines.sk: Jedna značka sedí, ďalšie dve nie. Fóliu treba ešte otočiť.
lines.heard: One mark lines up the other two don't the overlay needs turning further

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Original reference found: Ivanka pri Dunaji, 6 June 1962.
lines.sk: Pôvodná referencia nájdená: Ivanka pri Dunaji, 6. júna 1962.
lines.heard: Original reference found, Ivanka Predunyi, 6th June 1962

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s not it. The right digits are on the rhythm drawing at LEAL Court.
lines.sk: Nesedí to. Správne číslice sú na rytmickom nákrese pri LEALe.
lines.heard: That's not it. The right digits are on the Reddam drawing at Leyhall Court

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Four independent testimonies verified.
lines.sk: Štyri nezávislé svedectvá overené.
lines.heard: Four independent testimonies verified

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That year doesn’t match this port. The right one is on the item and in my notes.
lines.sk: Rok k tomu portu nesedí. Správny je na predmete aj v mojich poznámkach.
lines.heard: That year doesn't match this port. The right one is on the item and in my notes.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The cavity is in the same place. It’s just that everything around it has grown.
lines.sk: Dutina je na tom istom mieste. Len všetko okolo nej vyrástlo.
lines.heard: The cavity's in the same place. It's just that everything around it has grown

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: That’s a solid brick; I’m not prising that out. According to the note, it’s row two, column three.
lines.sk: Tu je plná tehla, tú páčiť nebudem. Podľa poznámky je to rad dva, stĺpec tri.
lines.heard: That's a solid brick. I'm not prizing that out. According to the note, it's row two, column three

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I can’t get through this way.
lines.sk: Tadiaľto neprejdem.
lines.heard: I can't get through this way

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: The chronometer reacts to that date. I need a place that remembers that year.
lines.sk: Chronometer na ten dátum reaguje. Potrebujem miesto, ktoré si ten rok pamätá.
lines.heard: The chronometer reacts to that date I need a place that remembers that year

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: I’ll sort it out. On paper, in large print. Somebody round here writes those notices, after all.
lines.sk: Vyriešim to. Na papieri a veľkými písmenami. Niekto tu predsa tie oznamy píše.
lines.heard: I'll sort it out on paper in large print. Somebody around here writes those notices after all

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Ella has names and recipients’ consent for every bag. Under the list there’s a stack of neighbourhood help notices in three sizes.
lines.sk: Ela má k taškám mená aj súhlasy adresátov. Pod zoznamom je stoh oznamov susedskej pomoci v troch veľkostiach.
lines.heard: Ella has names and recipient's consent for every bag. Under the list, there's a stack of neighborhood help notices in three sizes

lines.speaker: TONO
lines.text: They still have belts at repair shops where nothing gets thrown away. The tram will take you to one before you’ve finished your packed lunch.
lines.sk: Remienky ešte majú v opravovniach, kde sa nič nevyhadzuje. Električka vás k jednej dovezie skôr, ako zjete desiatu.
lines.heard: They still have belts at repair shops where nothing gets thrown away. The tram will take you to one before you've finished your packed lunch

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: It’s completely perished. I won’t find a belt like that at a stationer’s – only at a repair shop where nothing gets thrown away.
lines.sk: Úplne sa rozpadol. Taký remienok nezoženiem v papiernictve, ale v opravovni, kde nič nevyhadzujú.
lines.heard: It's completely perished. I won't find a belt like that at a stationers. Only at a repair shop where nothing gets thrown away

lines.speaker: PALI
lines.text: To the people who listen to hiss as if it were music. They meet in a basement in Ruzinov, and one of them works magic with tapes.
lines.sk: Za tými, čo počúvajú šum ako hudbu. Schádzajú sa v suteréne v Ružinove a jeden z nich s páskami čaruje.
lines.heard: To the people who listen to hiss as if it were music. They meet in a basement in Ruzinov, and one of them works magic with tapes.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Paulie mentioned someone who works magic with tapes. He might know.
lines.sk: Pali spomínal niekoho, kto s páskami čaruje. Ten by to mohol vedieť.
lines.heard: Paul Lee mentioned someone who works magic with tapes. He might know

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Hi. They say someone here works magic with tapes. I need you to listen to this cassette.
lines.sk: Ahoj. Vraj tu niekto s páskami čaruje. Potrebujem, aby si si vypočul túto kazetu.
lines.heard: Hi. They say someone here works magic with tapes. I need you to listen to this cassette

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: Here’s a cross adaptor. You’ll find a two-pin connector at the market with the parts and the stories, and the missing insulation at a tailor’s who sews coats and cables alike.
lines.sk: Tu máš krížový adaptér. Dvojpólový konektor zoženieš na trhu so súčiastkami aj historkami, chýbajúcu izoláciu u krajčírky, čo šije kabáty aj káblom.
lines.heard: Here's a cross adapter. You'll find a two-pin connector at the market with the parts and the stories, and the missing insulation at a tailor's who sews coats and cables alike

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: And will they know what it’s about?
lines.sk: A budú vedieť, o čo ide?
lines.heard: And will they know what it's about?

lines.speaker: JURO
lines.text: At the market they sold me my first Walkman, and the tailor next door sewed up my headphone cable. Tell them I sent you.
lines.sk: Na trhu mi predali prvý walkman a krajčírka vedľa mi obšila kábel od slúchadiel. Povedz, že ťa posielam ja.
lines.heard: At the market, they sold me my first Walkman, and the tailor next door sewed up my headphone cable. Tell them I sent you

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: A transparent overlay was separated from it at some point. Its number is on the negative; you just need to read it in a print.
lines.sk: Priehľadnú fóliu od nej kedysi oddelili. Jej číslo je na negatíve, len ho treba prečítať v pozitíve.
lines.heard: A transparent overlay was separated from it at some point. Its number is on the negative. You just need to read it in a print.

lines.speaker: KAROL
lines.text: Someone will have to develop the negative for you. They still know how on the square; you just have to look for the light.
lines.sk: Negatív vám musí niekto vyvolať. Na námestí to ešte vedia, len treba hľadať svetlo.
lines.heard: Someone will have to develop the negative for you. They still know how on the square. You just have to look for the light

lines.speaker: ALENA
lines.text: Here’s the print. The number on the table is K-17. Map supplements tend to drift around second-hand bookshops. The negative goes back to the archive.
lines.sk: Tu je pozitív. Na stole je číslo K-17. Mapové prílohy sa zvyknú túlať po antikvariátoch. Negatív vrátim archívu.
lines.heard: Here's the print. The number on the table is K seventeen. Map supplements tend to drift around secondhand bookshops. The negative goes back to the archive

lines.speaker: DEZI
lines.text: A metronome would be better. Every decent musician carries one, even the one who plays to the trams. Mira drew the three digits on a wall for the children.
lines.sk: Lepší bude metronóm. Nosí ho každý poriadny muzikant, aj ten, čo hrá električkám. Tri číslice Mira nakreslila deťom na múr.
lines.heard: A metronome would be better. Every decent musician carries one, even the one who plays to the trams. Mira drew the three digits on a wall for the children

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A wall with pictures. There are more of those in Dubravka than you’d like. At one of them, as a schoolboy, I looked for a ball until dark.
lines.sk: Múr s obrázkami. V Dúbravke ich je viac, ako by človek chcel. Pri jednom som ako žiak hľadal loptu až do tmy.
lines.heard: A wall with pictures. There are more of those in Dubrovka than you'd like. At one of them, as a schoolboy, I looked for a ball until dark.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Emil keeps the tempo, even when the city around him doesn’t. A metronome ticks along on his case.
lines.sk: Emil drží tempo, aj keď mesto okolo neho nie. Na puzdre mu pritom tiká metronóm.
lines.heard: Emil keeps the tempo even when the city around him doesn't. A metronome ticks along on his case

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Gran said she built ZVON with Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. In a village you find the mechanic by the sound.
lines.sk: Babka vravela, že ZVON robila s Otom Bielikom, mechanikom z Ivanky. Mechanika v dedine nájdem po zvuku.
lines.heard: Gran said she built one with Otto Whitlock, a mechanic from Ivanka. In a village, you find the mechanic by the sound

lines.speaker: SONA
lines.text: Our team photo got lost somewhere between the studio and the kiosk. They say the kiosk finds everything. Except our photo.
lines.sk: Fotka nášho družstva sa stratila niekde medzi ateliérom a kioskom. Pri kiosku vraj nájdu všetko. Len našu fotku nie.
lines.heard: Our team photo got lost somewhere between the studio and the kiosk. They say the kiosk finds everything, except our photo

lines.speaker: ZITA
lines.text: Sonia sent you? Here you are, the envelope with the team negative. You won’t see anything on it until it’s developed.
lines.sk: Soňa ťa posiela? Nech sa páči, obálka s negatívom družstva. Bez vyvolania na ňom nič neuvidíš.
lines.heard: Sonya sent you? Here you are, the envelope with the Tim negative. You won't see anything on it until it's developed

lines.speaker: EMIL
lines.text: ‘Four Stops’, my song. I wrote the ending in a book and sold the book to the second-hand bookshop. They say books don’t vanish there; they just wait.
lines.sk: „Štyri zastávky“, moja skladba. Koniec som zapísal do knihy a tú predal do antikvariátu. Vraj tam knihy nemiznú, len čakajú.
lines.heard: Four stops. My song. I wrote the ending in a book and sold the book to the secondhand bookshop. They say books don't vanish there. They just wait.

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: White chalk by the box… That rings a bell.
lines.sk: Biela krieda po krabiciach… To mi niečo pripomína.
lines.heard: White chalk by the box That rings a bell

lines.speaker: JURAJ
lines.text: But only with permission, please. I don’t want anywhere to be short of anything because of me.
lines.sk: Ale len s dovolením, prosím. Nechcem, aby kvôli mne niekde niečo chýbalo.
lines.heard: But only with permission, please. I don't want anywhere to be short of anything because of me

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: Mira is with the device. First, repair the hand pump. Here’s a slip; they’ll issue the leather and rivets in the yard. The people sewing costumes in the hall have a punch.
lines.sk: Mira je pri prístroji. Najprv opravte ručnú pumpu. Tu je lístok; kožu a nity vydajú na dvore. Dierovač majú tí, čo v sále šijú kostýmy.
lines.heard: Mira is with the device first. Repair the hand pump is a slip they'll issue the leather and rivets in the yard The people sewing costumes in the hall have a punch

lines.speaker: OTO
lines.text: And bring the punch back to me afterwards. I’ll return it myself – borrowed things go back through me here.
lines.sk: A dierovač potom doneste mne. Vrátim ho sám, požičané veci sa tu vracajú cezo mňa.
lines.heard: And bring the punch back to me afterwards. I'll return it myself. Borrowed things go back through me here

lines.speaker: MIRA60
lines.text: Make an imprint of the plate. You need waxed paper and something blunt that won’t scratch. Here’s a registration form. An official has to confirm the date. We’ll file the copy.
lines.sk: Urob odtlačok platne. Treba voskovaný papier a niečo tupé, čo neškriabe. Tu je registračný list. Úradník musí potvrdiť dátum. Kópiu uložíme.
lines.heard: Make an imprint of the plate. You need waxed paper and something blunt that won't scratch. Here's a registration form. An official has to confirm the date. We'll file the copy

lines.speaker: OTO82
lines.text: Take the slip to the store. They’ll issue everything that’s written on it, and not a screw more.
lines.sk: Lístok odneste do výdajne. Vydajú všetko, čo je na ňom napísané, ani o skrutku viac.
lines.heard: Take the slip to the store. They'll issue everything that's written on it and not a screw more

lines.speaker: ALOJZ
lines.text: Barnaby stayed behind in the park and won’t touch ordinary grain. His mix is issued wherever everything in Ivanka is issued against a slip.
lines.sk: Béla zostal v parku a obyčajné zrno nechce. Jeho zmes vydávajú tam, kde sa v Ivanke všetko vydáva na lístok.
lines.heard: Barnaby stayed behind in the park and won't touch ordinary grain. His mix is issued, well, everything in Ivanka is issued against a slip

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: Victor Korman, our founder. I warned him, but he didn’t switch it off. To get into the pavilion you need a cassette reader, the collection card, a service pass and a ticket.
lines.sk: Viktor Korman, náš zakladateľ. Varovala som ho, ale nevypol ho. Do pavilónu treba čítačku na kazetu, kartu fondu, servisný preukaz a lístok.
lines.heard: Victor Korman, our founder. I warned him, but he didn't switch it off. To get into the pavilion, you need a cassette reader, the collection card, a service pass, and a ticket

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: A reader, a card, a pass. Where do I get them?
lines.sk: Čítačka, karta, preukaz. Kde to zoženiem?
lines.heard: A reader, a card, a pass? Where do I get them?

lines.speaker: NINA
lines.text: In the hotel, ask whoever does repairs and whoever guards the boxes. And tickets are sold where tickets are sold.
lines.sk: V hoteli sa spýtajte toho, kto opravuje, a toho, kto stráži krabice. A lístky predávajú tam, kde sa predávajú lístky.
lines.heard: In the hotel, ask whoever does repairs and whoever guards the boxes, and tickets are sold where tickets are sold

lines.speaker: ADAM
lines.text: Thank you. With the card I can ask about a pass.
lines.sk: Ďakujem. S kartou sa už dá pýtať na preukaz.
lines.heard: Thank you with the card, I can ask about a pass?
